```ts
import { LIBRARY_SORT_COLUMNS, SETTINGS, type ItemType, type LibraryItem, type StorageMode } from '@learn/domain';

export type LibrarySortColumn = (typeof LIBRARY_SORT_COLUMNS)[number];
export type LibrarySort = { column: LibrarySortColumn; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' };

/** 추가일, newest first (spec §3.1). */
export const DEFAULT_SORT: LibrarySort = { column: 'createdAt', direction: 'desc' };

/** library.sort as stored, else the default. */
export function parseSort(raw: unknown): LibrarySort {
  const r = SETTINGS['library.sort'].safeParse(raw);
  return r.success ? r.data : DEFAULT_SORT;
}

const NEWEST_FIRST: ReadonlySet<LibrarySortColumn> = new Set<LibrarySortColumn>(['createdAt', 'updatedAt', 'openedAt', 'size', 'progress']);
/** The direction a first press on a column sorts in (ruling 7, Finder): dates and sizes newest or largest first. */
export const firstDirection = (column: LibrarySortColumn): 'asc' | 'desc' => (NEWEST_FIRST.has(column) ? 'desc' : 'asc');

const collator = new Intl.Collator('ko', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
const TYPE_ORDER: Readonly<Record<ItemType, number>> = { pdf: 0, video: 1 };
const STORAGE_ORDER: Readonly<Record<StorageMode, number>> = { managed: 0, linked: 1 };
type SortKey = string | number | null;
const time = (iso: string | null): number | null => {
  if (iso === null) return null;
  const t = Date.parse(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(t) ? null : t;
};
const text = (s: string): string | null => (s === '' ? null : s);
const KEY: Readonly<Record<LibrarySortColumn, (i: LibraryItem) => SortKey>> = {
  title: (i) => text(i.title),
  creators: (i) => i.creators[0] ?? null,
  year: (i) => i.year,
  type: (i) => TYPE_ORDER[i.type],
  createdAt: (i) => time(i.createdAt),
  openedAt: (i) => time(i.openedAt),
  progress: (i) => i.progress,
  updatedAt: (i) => time(i.updatedAt),
  storageMode: (i) => STORAGE_ORDER[i.storageMode],
  size: (i) => i.size,
  originalName: (i) => text(i.originalName),
};

/**
 * The table's order (spec §3.1): text by the Korean collator (numbers in it by value), times, sizes and counts by value,
 * kinds and storage in a fixed order. Empty values go last in either direction; equal values by 추가일 newest first,
 * then in the list's own order (the repository's created_at DESC, rowid DESC: two files of one import can share a
 * millisecond, ruling 11). Returns a new array.
 */
export function sortItems(items: readonly LibraryItem[], sort: LibrarySort): LibraryItem[] {
  const keyOf = KEY[sort.column];
  const dir = sort.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
  const rows = items.map((item, at) => ({ item, at, key: keyOf(item), added: time(item.createdAt) ?? 0 }));
  rows.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.key === null || b.key === null) {
      if (a.key !== b.key) return a.key === null ? 1 : -1;
    } else {
      const c = typeof a.key === 'string' && typeof b.key === 'string' ? collator.compare(a.key, b.key) : Number(a.key) - Number(b.key);
      if (c !== 0) return c * dir;
    }
    if (a.added !== b.added) return b.added - a.added;
    return a.at - b.at;
  });
  return rows.map((r) => r.item);
}
```

`R/library/selectionModel.ts`(새 파일, 전체):
```ts
/**
 * The table's selection model (M4 spec 3.3, design-spec 7.1; Finder's list view): pure, over the rows in the table's
 * order. The store (useLibrary) holds its state; the table turns clicks and keys into actions.
 */
export interface SelectionState {
  /** The selected item ids. */
  readonly selected: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** Where ⇧-click and ⇧-arrows extend from: the row last picked without ⇧. */
  readonly anchorId: string | null;
  /** The keyboard cursor: the row the arrows move from, and the table's one focus target. */
  readonly cursorId: string | null;
}

export type Move = 'up' | 'down' | 'home' | 'end' | 'pageUp' | 'pageDown';

export type SelectAction =
  /** A press on a row: `toggle` is ⌘ on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere. */
  | { kind: 'click'; id: string; shift: boolean; toggle: boolean }
  /** A right-click (or ⌃-click on macOS) on a row: it selects first. */
  | { kind: 'contextMenu'; id: string }
  /** An arrow, Home/End or PageUp/PageDown; `extend` with ⇧; `page` = the rows a page moves. */
  | { kind: 'move'; to: Move; extend: boolean; page: number }
  /** ⌘A, or the edit menu's 모두 선택 while the table has the focus. */
  | { kind: 'all' }
  /** esc. */
  | { kind: 'clear' };

/** The rows in the table's order with each id's place: built once per row list (a lookup per key press stays O(1)). */
export interface RowOrder {
  readonly ids: readonly string[];
  /** The id's place, -1 when it is not shown (or null). */
  indexOf(id: string | null): number;
}

export function rowOrder(ids: readonly string[]): RowOrder {
  const at = new Map<string, number>();
  ids.forEach((id, i) => at.set(id, i));
  return { ids, indexOf: (id) => (id === null ? -1 : (at.get(id) ?? -1)) };
}

const only = (id: string): SelectionState => ({ selected: new Set([id]), anchorId: id, cursorId: id });

/** The ids from place a to place b, both included, in table order. */
const span = (order: RowOrder, a: number, b: number): readonly string[] => order.ids.slice(Math.min(a, b), Math.max(a, b) + 1);

/**
 * ⇧-click or ⇧-arrow to place `to`: the range from the anchor replaces the range the previous extension made (anchor to
 * cursor), and rows picked apart from it (⌘-click) stay — Finder, NSTableView. Without an anchor on screen the cursor
 * anchors, else the target itself.
 */
function extend(state: SelectionState, order: RowOrder, to: number): SelectionState {
  let anchor = order.indexOf(state.anchorId);
  if (anchor < 0) anchor = order.indexOf(state.cursorId);
  if (anchor < 0) anchor = to;
  const next = new Set(state.selected);
  const cursor = order.indexOf(state.cursorId);
  if (cursor >= 0) for (const id of span(order, anchor, cursor)) next.delete(id);
  for (const id of span(order, anchor, to)) next.add(id);
  return { selected: next, anchorId: order.ids[anchor]!, cursorId: order.ids[to]! };
}

/** Where a move lands; without a cursor ↓ (and a page down) starts at the first row and ↑ at the last. */
function target(to: Move, from: number, last: number, page: number): number {
  switch (to) {
    case 'home':
      return 0;
    case 'end':
      return last;
    case 'up':
      return from < 0 ? last : Math.max(0, from - 1);
    case 'down':
      return from < 0 ? 0 : Math.min(last, from + 1);
    case 'pageUp':
      return Math.max(0, Math.max(from, 0) - page);
    case 'pageDown':
      return from < 0 ? 0 : Math.min(last, from + page);
  }
}

/**
 * One step of the selection model:
 * - click = that row alone (it anchors); ⇧-click = the range from the anchor; ⌘/Ctrl-click = toggle that row (it anchors);
 * - right-click: a row outside the selection becomes the selection; inside, the selection stays and the row is the cursor;
 * - ↑ ↓ Home End PageUp PageDown = move and select that row alone; with ⇧ = extend from the anchor;
 * - ⌘A = every row (anchor and cursor stay); esc = nothing selected (the cursor stays where it is).
 * A row id that is not shown changes nothing. Unchanged parts keep their identity (the store's subscribers compare them).
 */
export function reduceSelection(state: SelectionState, action: SelectAction, order: RowOrder): SelectionState {
  const last = order.ids.length - 1;
  switch (action.kind) {
    case 'click': {
      const at = order.indexOf(action.id);
      if (at < 0) return state;
      if (action.shift) return extend(state, order, at);
      if (!action.toggle) return only(action.id);
      const next = new Set(state.selected);
      if (!next.delete(action.id)) next.add(action.id);
      return { selected: next, anchorId: action.id, cursorId: action.id };
    }
    case 'contextMenu':
      if (order.indexOf(action.id) < 0) return state;
      if (!state.selected.has(action.id)) return only(action.id);
      return state.cursorId === action.id ? state : { ...state, cursorId: action.id };
    case 'move': {
      if (last < 0) return state;
      const to = target(action.to, order.indexOf(state.cursorId), last, Math.max(1, action.page));
      return action.extend ? extend(state, order, to) : only(order.ids[to]!);
    }
    case 'all':
      return last < 0 ? state : { ...state, selected: new Set(order.ids) };
    case 'clear':
      return state.selected.size === 0 && state.anchorId === null ? state : { ...state, selected: new Set(), anchorId: null };
  }
}

/** The item ↩ opens: the selection when it is exactly one row (several tabs at once are M7, spec 3.3). */
export const openTarget = (selected: ReadonlySet<string>): string | null => (selected.size === 1 ? selected.values().next().value! : null);

/** The selected ids in table order (the item menu's targets). */
export const inOrder = (selected: ReadonlySet<string>, order: RowOrder): string[] => order.ids.filter((id) => selected.has(id));
```

`R/library/gridKeys.ts`(새 파일, 전체):
```ts
import type { Move } from './selectionModel';

/** What a key press on the table does (M4 spec 3.3, design-spec 7.1). */
export type GridKey =
  | { kind: 'move'; to: Move; extend: boolean }
  | { kind: 'all' }
  | { kind: 'open' }
  | { kind: 'clear' }
  /** Space: nothing (the scroll view would page down; Quick Look is not a feature). */
  | { kind: 'swallow' };

const MOVES: Readonly<Record<string, Move>> = { ArrowUp: 'up', ArrowDown: 'down', Home: 'home', End: 'end', PageUp: 'pageUp', PageDown: 'pageDown' };

/**
 * The table's keys: ↑ ↓ Home End PageUp PageDown (⇧ extends), ⌘A (Ctrl+A off macOS, by key position so the Korean
 * input source does not matter), ↩ and esc. Nothing during an IME composition (keyCode 229 included, as keymap.ts),
 * nothing with another chord held (the menus own those), and no letters: there is no type-ahead (it fights the Korean
 * IME; ⌘F finds instead). ← / → are left to the scroll view (a table wider than the window scrolls sideways).
 */
export function gridKey(
  e: Pick<KeyboardEvent, 'key' | 'code' | 'shiftKey' | 'altKey' | 'ctrlKey' | 'metaKey' | 'isComposing' | 'keyCode'>,
  mac: boolean,
): GridKey | null {
  if (e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return null;
  const mod = mac ? e.metaKey : e.ctrlKey;
  const other = mac ? e.ctrlKey : e.metaKey;
  if (e.altKey || other) return null;
  if (mod) return e.code === 'KeyA' && !e.shiftKey ? { kind: 'all' } : null;
  const to = MOVES[e.key];
  if (to) return { kind: 'move', to, extend: e.shiftKey };
  if (e.shiftKey) return null;
  if (e.key === 'Enter') return { kind: 'open' };
  if (e.key === 'Escape') return { kind: 'clear' };
  if (e.key === ' ') return { kind: 'swallow' };
  return null;
}
```

`R/state/library-store.ts`(새 파일, 전체):
```ts
import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { SelectionState } from '../library/selectionModel';

/**
 * The library view's own state: the table's selection with its anchor and keyboard cursor now; Tasks 4, 5 and 7 add the
 * last opened row, the query and the edited item. Commands and the item panel read the selection even while the table
 * is not mounted (the reader view).
 */
export interface LibraryState extends SelectionState {
  /** Replaces the selection (programmatic picks): the first id becomes the anchor and the cursor; none keeps the cursor. */
  setSelected(ids: Iterable<string>): void;
  /** The table's selection model step (selectionModel.ts). */
  setSelection(next: SelectionState): void;
  /** Keep only ids still shown (list change, search); an anchor or cursor that is gone goes too. */
  pruneSelected(shown: ReadonlySet<string>): void;
}

const NONE: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set();
const same = (a: ReadonlySet<string>, b: ReadonlySet<string>) => a.size === b.size && [...a].every((id) => b.has(id));

export const useLibrary = create<LibraryState>()((set, get) => ({
  selected: NONE,
  anchorId: null,
  cursorId: null,
  setSelected: (ids) => {
    const next = new Set(ids);
    if (same(next, get().selected)) return;
    const first: string | null = next.values().next().value ?? null;
    set({ selected: next.size === 0 ? NONE : next, anchorId: first, cursorId: first ?? get().cursorId });
  },
  setSelection: (next) => {
    const s = get();
    if (next.selected === s.selected && next.anchorId === s.anchorId && next.cursorId === s.cursorId) return;
    set({ selected: next.selected.size === 0 ? NONE : next.selected, anchorId: next.anchorId, cursorId: next.cursorId });
  },
  pruneSelected: (shown) => {
    const { selected, anchorId, cursorId } = get();
    const keep = (id: string | null) => (id !== null && shown.has(id) ? id : null);
    const kept = [...selected].every((id) => shown.has(id)) ? selected : new Set([...selected].filter((id) => shown.has(id)));
    if (kept === selected && keep(anchorId) === anchorId && keep(cursorId) === cursorId) return;
    set({ selected: kept.size === 0 ? NONE : kept, anchorId: keep(anchorId), cursorId: keep(cursorId) });
  },
}));
```

`R/library/useLibrarySettings.ts`(새 파일, 전체):
```ts
import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { ColumnConfig } from '@learn/domain';
import { ApiError, api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';
import { parseColumnConfig } from './columns';
import { parseSort, type LibrarySort } from './sort';

/**
 * Optimistic: the table follows at once. A refused write keeps the screen as chosen and logs the code only (the next
 * change writes the whole value again).
 */
function save(key: 'library.columns' | 'library.sort', queryKey: readonly unknown[], value: ColumnConfig | LibrarySort): void {
  queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, value);
  void unwrap(api().settings.set({ key, value })).catch((e: unknown) => console.warn(`[library] saving ${key} failed: ${e instanceof ApiError ? e.code : 'INTERNAL'}`));
}

/**
 * The table's columns and sort (library settings, ADR-0007 (b)): parsed values, defaults when unset or unreadable.
 * `ready` once both reads have settled, so the table never paints the default columns for a frame before the stored ones.
 */
export function useLibrarySettings(): {
  columns: ColumnConfig;
  sort: LibrarySort;
  setColumns(next: ColumnConfig): void;
  setSort(next: LibrarySort): void;
  ready: boolean;
} {
  const columnsRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.columns, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.columns' })) });
  const sortRead = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.sort, queryFn: () => unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'library.sort' })) });
  const columns = useMemo(() => parseColumnConfig(columnsRead.data ?? null), [columnsRead.data]);
  const sort = useMemo(() => parseSort(sortRead.data ?? null), [sortRead.data]);
  const setColumns = useCallback((next: ColumnConfig) => save('library.columns', keys.columns, next), []);
  const setSort = useCallback((next: LibrarySort) => save('library.sort', keys.sort, next), []);
  return { columns, sort, setColumns, setSort, ready: !columnsRead.isPending && !sortRead.isPending };
}
```

```ts
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import type { Match } from '../palette/hangul';
import { sortItems } from './sort';
import { useLibrarySettings } from './useLibrarySettings';

/**
 * The rows the table shows: the whole list in the stored sort. `total` is the list's size (Task 5's "N개 / M개");
 * `titleMatches` is Task 5's (the search's matched range per title), null until then.
 */
export function useLibraryRows(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): { rows: readonly LibraryItem[]; total: number; titleMatches: ReadonlyMap<string, Match> | null } {
  const { sort } = useLibrarySettings();
  const rows = useMemo(() => sortItems(items, sort), [items, sort]);
  return { rows, total: items.length, titleMatches: null };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The table row of the item titled exactly `title` (P-19). The table is virtualized: a row far from the viewport is
 * not in the DOM until it is scrolled to.
 */
export const rowByTitle = (page: Page, title: string): Locator => page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-title=${JSON.stringify(title)}]`);

/** The row at `index` in the table's current order (data-index): a virtualized body's DOM order need not be the visual one. */
export const rowAt = (page: Page, index: number): Locator => page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-index="${index}"]`);

/** Opens an item as a user does: a double-click on its row (M4 spec 3.3; P-19). A single click only selects. */
export async function openItem(page: Page, title: string): Promise<void> {
  const row = rowByTitle(page, title);
  await row.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
  await row.dblclick();
}

/**
 * Selects rows by title: a plain click on the first, a modifier-click on each of the rest. `Meta` (the default, toggle)
 * is the platform's: ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere (the table's own rule, LibraryTable).
 */
export async function selectRows(page: Page, titles: readonly string[], opts: { modifier?: 'Meta' | 'Shift' | 'Control' } = {}): Promise<void> {
  const [first, ...rest] = titles;
  if (first === undefined) return;
  await rowByTitle(page, first).click();
  const wanted = opts.modifier ?? 'Meta';
  const modifier = wanted === 'Meta' && process.platform !== 'darwin' ? 'Control' : wanted;
  for (const title of rest) await rowByTitle(page, title).click({ modifiers: [modifier] });
}

/** One seeded item's facts, as main's test hook takes them (apps/desktop/src/main/test-hooks.ts). */
export interface SeedRow {
  title: string;
  creators: string[];
  year: number | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

const SEED_KO = ['세포', '신호', '전달', '단백질', '효소', '반응', '유전자', '발현', '대사', '경로', '면역', '수용체', '광합성', '열역학', '확률', '통계', '강의', '노트'];
const SEED_EN = ['Signal', 'Protein', 'Enzyme', 'Kinetics', 'Bayesian', 'Inference', 'Linear', 'Algebra', 'Membrane', 'Transport', 'Genome', 'Lecture', 'Notes', 'Review'];
const SEED_NAMES = ['김민지', '이서준', '박지훈', '최유나', '정하늘', 'Alice Kim', 'Brian Lee', 'Chen Wei', 'Dana Park', 'Erik Lund'];

/**
 * `count` seeded rows from a fixed generator (mulberry32): Korean and English titles, each ending in its running number
 * (so every title is unique), 0–4 creators, a year or none, and 추가일 one minute apart going back from `base`.
 */
export function seedRows(count: number, seed = 1, base = Date.parse('2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z')): SeedRow[] {
  let a = seed | 0;
  const rand = () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
  const pick = <T>(xs: readonly T[]): T => xs[Math.floor(rand() * xs.length)]!;
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const words = rand() < 0.6 ? SEED_KO : SEED_EN;
    return {
      title: `${pick(words)} ${pick(words)} ${i + 1}`,
      creators: Array.from({ length: Math.floor(rand() * 5) }, () => pick(SEED_NAMES)),
      year: rand() < 0.1 ? null : 1985 + Math.floor(rand() * 41),
      createdAt: new Date(base - i * 60_000).toISOString(),
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Adds `count` items that share `from`'s file — one managed copy, one transaction — through main's E2E hook (P-22).
 * Resolves once main has written them; the list follows its one libraryChanged.
 */
export async function seedLibrary(app: ElectronApplication, opts: { count: number; from: LibraryItem; seed?: number }): Promise<void> {
  const input = { fromItemId: opts.from.id, rows: seedRows(opts.count, opts.seed) };
  const added = await app.evaluate((_electron, arg) => (globalThis as unknown as { __learnTest: { seedItems(i: typeof arg): number } }).__learnTest.seedItems(arg), input);
  if (added !== opts.count) throw new Error(`seedLibrary: ${added} of ${opts.count} items added`);
}
```

```ts
// The library table (M4 spec 3): the selection model, opening, the native column header menu, widths and sort that
// survive a restart, density, a large virtualized library (seeded, P-22), F6 into the table, and the loading state.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { Channels } from '../../packages/domain/src/ipc-channels';
import { LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS } from '../../packages/domain/src/library-columns';
import { expectNoSeriousA11y } from './a11y';
import { FIXTURES, importPaths, launch, mainWindow, recordedPopups, rowAt, rowByTitle, seedLibrary, selectRows, stubContextMenu } from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const MOD = process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'Meta' : 'Control';
const DEFAULT_HEADERS = ['제목', '저자', '연도', '종류', '추가일'];
const dirs = (i: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [i.outputPath('library'), i.outputPath('userdata')] as const;

/** Copies of the sample PDF with distinct content, imported one by one: 추가일 orders them, the last newest. */
async function importInOrder(page: Page, dir: string, names: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  for (const [i, name] of names.entries()) {
    const file = path.join(dir, `${name}.pdf`);
    fs.writeFileSync(file, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(PDF), Buffer.from(`\n% ${name}\n`)]));
    await importPaths(page, [file]);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(i + 1);
  }
}
/** Titles of the selected rows, A to Z. */
const selectedTitles = (page: Page) =>
  page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]').evaluateAll((rows) => rows.map((r) => r.getAttribute('data-title')!).sort());
/** Titles in the table's order (data-index), whatever the DOM order. */
const order = (page: Page) =>
  page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"]').evaluateAll((rows) =>
    rows.sort((a, b) => Number(a.getAttribute('data-index')) - Number(b.getAttribute('data-index'))).map((r) => r.getAttribute('data-title')),
  );
const header = (page: Page, col: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="${col}"]`);
const setting = (page: Page, key: string) => page.evaluate((k) => window.learn.settings.get({ key: k }).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.data : 'failed')), key);
const frames = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))));
/** Clicks an item of the app menu's 편집 menu for the main window, as the menu bar does (a role item acts on the window it is given). */
async function clickEditMenu(app: ElectronApplication, label: string): Promise<void> {
  const win = await mainWindow(app);
  await app.evaluate(({ Menu }, [w, name]) => {
    const item = Menu.getApplicationMenu()!.items.find((i) => i.label === '편집')!.submenu!.items.find((i) => i.label === name)!;
    (item.click as (event: unknown, window: unknown, contents: unknown) => void)(undefined, w, w.webContents);
  }, [win, label] as const);
}

test('a click selects one row, ⇧-click a range, ⌘/Ctrl-click toggles, ⌘A and 모두 선택 all; arrows move, ⇧ extends; Home, End, PageUp, PageDown; esc clears; no type-ahead', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importInOrder(page, testInfo.outputPath('src'), ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma', 'delta', 'epsilon']);
    expect(await order(page)).toEqual(['epsilon', 'delta', 'gamma', 'beta', 'alpha']); // 추가일, newest first
    await rowByTitle(page, 'delta').click();
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['delta']);
    await rowByTitle(page, 'beta').click({ modifiers: ['Shift'] });
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['beta', 'delta', 'gamma']);
    await rowByTitle(page, 'gamma').click({ modifiers: [MOD] });
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['beta', 'delta']);
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'library table, two rows selected');
    await rowByTitle(page, 'epsilon').click();
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['epsilon']);
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['delta']);
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'delta')).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+ArrowDown');
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['delta', 'gamma']);
    await page.keyboard.press('End');
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['alpha']);
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'alpha')).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('Home');
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['epsilon']);
    await page.keyboard.press('PageDown'); // all five rows fit in a page: it goes to the last
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['alpha']);
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+PageUp');
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toHaveLength(5);
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape'); // esc clears the selection; the cursor stays on its row
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual([]);
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'epsilon')).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+a');
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toHaveLength(5);
    // The edit menu's 모두 선택 while the table has the focus: every row, and none of the page's text.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'gamma').click();
    await clickEditMenu(app, '모두 선택');
    await expect.poll(() => selectedTitles(page)).toHaveLength(5);
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => getSelection()?.toString() ?? '')).toBe('');
    // No type-ahead (design-spec 7.1): a letter moves neither the cursor nor the selection; Space pages nothing; ← / →
    // stay on the row.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'epsilon').click();
    for (const key of ['g', 'Space', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft']) {
      await page.keyboard.press(key);
      await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'epsilon')).toBeFocused();
    }
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['epsilon']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('right-click selects the row first, or keeps the selection it is in; the menu judges the whole selection', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importInOrder(page, testInfo.outputPath('src'), ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma', 'delta']);
    await stubContextMenu(app, null);

    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'gamma')).toBeFocused();

    await rowByTitle(page, 'delta').click({ button: 'right' }); // inside the selection: kept
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['beta', 'delta']);
    await rowByTitle(page, 'alpha').click({ button: 'right' }); // outside it: alpha alone
    expect(await selectedTitles(page)).toEqual(['alpha']);

    // 열기 needs exactly one item (the item.open rule): enabled for one row, disabled for the kept pair.
    const open = (await recordedPopups(app)).map((items) => items.find((i) => i.label === '열기')?.enabled);
    expect(open).toEqual([true, false, true]);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the column header menu shows and hides columns (제목 stays) and resets them; a dragged edge trades width with its neighbour, saved on release; all survive a restart', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const [lib, ud] = dirs(testInfo);
  let s = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    await importInOrder(s.page, testInfo.outputPath('src'), ['alpha', 'beta']);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('column-header')).toHaveText(DEFAULT_HEADERS);
    await stubContextMenu(s.app, '크기');
    await header(s.page, 'year').click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('column-header')).toHaveText([...DEFAULT_HEADERS, '크기']);
    const [menu] = await recordedPopups(s.app);
    expect(menu!.map((i) => [i.type === 'separator' ? '-' : i.label, i.checked, i.enabled])).toEqual([
      ['제목', true, false], ['저자', true, true], ['연도', true, true], ['종류', true, true], ['추가일', true, true],
      ['수정일', false, true], ['보관', false, true], ['크기', false, true], ['원래 파일 이름', false, true],
      ['-', false, true], ['열 구성 되돌리기', false, true],
    ]);
    const size = rowAt(s.page, 0).locator('[data-col="size"]');
    await expect(size).toHaveText(/^\d+(\.\d)? KB$/);
    expect(await size.evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).justifyContent)).toBe('flex-end'); // numbers end-aligned
    expect(await setting(s.page, 'library.columns')).toEqual({ visible: ['title', 'creators', 'year', 'type', 'createdAt', 'size'], order: [...LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS], widths: {} });

    // Drag 저자's right edge 40 px left: 저자 140, 연도 64 + 40 = 104; the boundary after 연도 and the title stay.
    const creators = header(s.page, 'creators');
    const typeX = (await header(s.page, 'type').boundingBox())!.x;
    const titleW = (await header(s.page, 'title').boundingBox())!.width;
    const edge = (await s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-resizer"][data-col="creators"]').boundingBox())!;
    const y = edge.y + edge.height / 2;
    await s.page.mouse.move(edge.x + edge.width / 2, y);
    await s.page.mouse.down();
    await s.page.mouse.move(edge.x + edge.width / 2 - 40, y, { steps: 4 });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await creators.boundingBox())?.width).toBe(140);
    expect(((await setting(s.page, 'library.columns')) as { widths: object }).widths).toEqual({}); // nothing saved while dragging
    await s.page.mouse.up();
    await expect.poll(async () => ((await setting(s.page, 'library.columns')) as { widths: object }).widths).toEqual({ creators: 140, year: 104 }); // the two that changed
    expect((await header(s.page, 'year').boundingBox())!.width).toBe(104);
    expect((await header(s.page, 'type').boundingBox())!.x).toBe(typeX);
    expect((await header(s.page, 'title').boundingBox())!.width).toBe(titleW);
    await expect(s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-resizer"][data-col="size"]')).toHaveCount(0); // the last column has no handle
    await s.app.close();

    s = await launch(lib, ud);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('column-header')).toHaveText([...DEFAULT_HEADERS, '크기']);
    await expect.poll(async () => (await header(s.page, 'creators').boundingBox())?.width).toBe(140);
    // An edge also takes ← / → (8 px, saved at once) and a double-click (back to the column's default width), both
    // trading with the next column like a drag.
    const creatorsEdge = s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-resizer"][data-col="creators"]');
    await expect(creatorsEdge).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '140');
    await creatorsEdge.focus();
    await s.page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
    await expect(creatorsEdge).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '148');
    await expect.poll(async () => ((await setting(s.page, 'library.columns')) as { widths: object }).widths).toEqual({ creators: 148, year: 96 });
    await creatorsEdge.dblclick();
    await expect(creatorsEdge).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', '180');
    await expect.poll(async () => ((await setting(s.page, 'library.columns')) as { widths: object }).widths).toEqual({ creators: 180, year: 64 });
    await stubContextMenu(s.app, '열 구성 되돌리기');
    await header(s.page, 'title').click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('column-header')).toHaveText(DEFAULT_HEADERS);
    await expect.poll(async () => (await header(s.page, 'creators').boundingBox())?.width).toBe(180);
    expect(await setting(s.page, 'library.columns')).toEqual({ visible: ['title', 'creators', 'year', 'type', 'createdAt'], order: [...LIBRARY_COLUMN_IDS], widths: {} });
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('a header press sorts by its column (arrow, aria-sort), a second one reverses; dates start newest first; the sort survives a restart', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const [lib, ud] = dirs(testInfo);
  let s = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    await importInOrder(s.page, testInfo.outputPath('src'), ['beta', 'delta', 'alpha', 'gamma']);
    await expect(header(s.page, 'createdAt')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending');
    await expect(header(s.page, 'createdAt').locator('.icon')).toHaveCount(1);
    expect(await order(s.page)).toEqual(['gamma', 'alpha', 'delta', 'beta']);
    await header(s.page, 'title').click();
    await expect(header(s.page, 'title')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'ascending');
    await expect(header(s.page, 'title').locator('.icon')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(header(s.page, 'createdAt')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'none');
    await expect(header(s.page, 'createdAt').locator('.icon')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await order(s.page)).toEqual(['alpha', 'beta', 'delta', 'gamma']);
    await header(s.page, 'title').click();
    await expect(header(s.page, 'title')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending');
    expect(await order(s.page)).toEqual(['gamma', 'delta', 'beta', 'alpha']);
    await expect.poll(() => setting(s.page, 'library.sort')).toEqual({ column: 'title', direction: 'desc' });
    await s.app.close();

    s = await launch(lib, ud);
    await expect(header(s.page, 'title')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending');
    expect(await order(s.page)).toEqual(['gamma', 'delta', 'beta', 'alpha']);
    await header(s.page, 'createdAt').click(); // a date column starts newest first (ruling 7)
    await expect(header(s.page, 'createdAt')).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'descending');
    expect(await order(s.page)).toEqual(['gamma', 'alpha', 'delta', 'beta']);
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('rows follow the density (24 / 32 / 28) under a 28 px header, the first row 4 px below it', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));

    await importInOrder(page, testInfo.outputPath('src'), ['alpha', 'beta']);

      await page.evaluate((d) => window.learn.prefs.set({ density: d }), density);
      await expect.poll(async () => (await rowAt(page, 0).boundingBox())?.height).toBe(height);
      const [a, b] = [(await rowAt(page, 0).boundingBox())!, (await rowAt(page, 1).boundingBox())!];

    await app.close();
  }
});

test('a first list read past 300 ms shows the header and 불러오는 중… in the body, not before; the rows replace it', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const listed = await page.evaluate(() => window.learn.library.list());
    await app.evaluate(({ ipcMain }, [channel, reply]) => {
      const g = globalThis as { __learnReleaseList?: () => void };
      ipcMain.removeHandler(channel);
      ipcMain.handle(channel, () => new Promise((resolve) => (g.__learnReleaseList = () => resolve(reply))));
    }, [Channels.library.list, listed] as const);
    // When the shell and the loading line first appear, from the document's first node on.
    await page.addInitScript(() => {
      const g = globalThis as { __learnSeen?: Record<string, number> };
      g.__learnSeen = {};
      new MutationObserver(() => {
        for (const id of ['shell', 'table-loading', 'empty-state']) if (!(id in g.__learnSeen!) && document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${id}"]`)) g.__learnSeen![id] = performance.now();
      }).observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    });
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('table-loading')).toHaveText('불러오는 중…');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('column-header')).toHaveText(DEFAULT_HEADERS);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(0);
    const seen = await page.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnSeen?: Record<string, number> }).__learnSeen ?? {});
    expect(seen['table-loading']! - seen['shell']!).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(290); // design-spec 6: nothing for 300 ms
    expect(seen['empty-state']).toBeUndefined();
    await app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnReleaseList?: () => void }).__learnReleaseList?.());
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('table-loading')).toHaveCount(0);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

Run: `pnpm build && pnpm fixtures && xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1200x24" pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/table.spec.ts`
Expected: FAIL — 모든 테스트가 `column-header`·`aria-selected`·`table-loading`이 없거나(임시 목록) 더블클릭 대신 한 번 클릭으로 열려 실패한다. (`pnpm typecheck`는 Step 10 때문에 아직 실패 중이다.)

- [ ] **Step 12: `LibraryTable` 새로 쓰기 (TanStack Virtual + 자체 `role="grid"`)**

임시 목록 전체를 아래로 바꾼다. 요점(코드 주석과 같은 내용):
- **구조**: grid 자신이 스크롤 뷰다(`div.library-table[role="grid"]`, `overflow: auto`). 그 안에 sticky 머리 행(`aria-rowindex="1"`)과 모든 행 높이를 합친 몸통(`role="rowgroup"`, 위 4·아래 8 인셋 포함)이 있고, 몸통 안의 행은 `useVirtualizer`가 고른 것만 `transform: translateY`로 놓인다. 행 높이는 밀도 값 하나(`estimateSize` = `density[밀도]`, 밀도가 바뀌면 `measure()`), `overscan` 8, `scrollMargin` = 머리 28, `scrollPaddingStart` = 28 + 4, `scrollPaddingEnd` = 8(키보드로 옮긴 행이 머리 밑에 숨지 않고 마지막 행 아래 8px까지 보인다). 접근성 값은 모두 명시한다: grid `aria-label="자료 목록"`·`aria-multiselectable`·`aria-rowcount`(행 + 머리)·`aria-colcount`, 행 `aria-rowindex`(가상화로 DOM에 없는 행이 있어도 VoiceOver가 위치를 읽는다)·`aria-selected`, 열 머리 `aria-sort`·`aria-colindex`, 제목 셀 `role="rowheader"`(행을 제목으로 읽는다), 나머지 `gridcell`.
- **열**: 머리와 행이 같은 CSS grid 트랙을 쓴다(`columnTemplates` → grid의 `--head-cols`·`--row-cols`·`--table-min-width`). 제목은 `minmax(200px, 1fr)`(나머지 폭), 나머지는 저장값 또는 기본값. 끄는 동안의 폭(`live`)도 같은 변수로만 바뀌므로 행은 다시 그려지지 않는다. 너비가 열 최소 합보다 좁으면 표가 옆으로 스크롤된다.
- **선택**: 저장소(`useLibrary`)의 선택·기준점·커서를 `selectionModel.ts`의 `reduceSelection`으로만 바꾼다. 행 누르기(mousedown, 왼쪽 단추) = 클릭·⇧클릭·⌘(Linux Ctrl)클릭, macOS의 ⌃클릭은 누르기로 고르지 않고 `contextmenu`가 "먼저 고르기"를 한다. 키는 `gridKeys.ts`(↑↓·Home/End·PageUp/PageDown, ⇧ 확장, ⌘A, ↩, esc, Space는 아무것도 안 함, 글자는 type-ahead 없음, IME 조합 중에는 무시). PageUp/PageDown의 한 쪽 = 지금 다 보이는 행 수.
- **열기**: 더블클릭(수정 키 없이)이 그 행을 연다(첫 누르기가 그 행 하나를 골랐다). ↩는 선택이 정확히 하나일 때만 연다(여럿이면 아무것도 하지 않는다, 명세 3.3).
- **오른쪽 클릭**: 선택 밖의 행이면 그 행만 고르고, 안이면 선택을 두고 커서만 그 행으로 옮긴 뒤, 표 순서의 선택 id 전부로 메뉴를 연다.
- **포커스(판정 13)**: roving tabindex — 정지 행(커서, 없으면 첫 선택 행, 없으면 첫 행)만 `tabindex="0"`이고 `rangeExtractor`로 늘 그려진다. 키보드 이동은 저장소를 바꾼 뒤 레이아웃 효과에서 `scrollToIndex` + 그 행 `focus({ preventScroll: true })`. grid 자신이 포커스를 받으면(창의 인계, 몸통 빈 곳 누르기) 곧바로 정지 행에 넘긴다. 커서가 없을 때 들어온 포커스는 그 행을 커서로(선택이 비었으면 선택으로도) 만든다.
- **커서 고리**: 키보드로만(디자인 명세 6 "마우스 클릭으로는 링을 띄우지 않는다"). 표 안의 탐색 키(`isNavigationKey` — 수정 키 없는 키, ⇧ 포함)가 켜고, 표 안의 포인터 누르기가 끄고, 밖에서 들어온 포커스는 마지막 입력이 키보드였을 때 켠다(`lastInput()`, F6·Tab). 포커스를 가진 행에만 `data-focus-visible`.
- **모두 선택**: ⌘A(Linux Ctrl+A)는 키로 온다. 편집 메뉴의 "모두 선택"(role `selectAll`)은 페이지의 모두 선택 명령이고, Chromium은 그 전에 `<body>`에 `selectstart`를 보낸다 — 표에 포커스가 있으면 그것을 막고 모든 행을 고른다(페이지 글자가 칠해지지 않는다).
- **열 경계**: 자체 `role="separator"`(값 = 그 열의 폭, 최소, 1200). 포인터 끌기는 포인터 캡처, 매 이동마다 `tradeWidths`(판정 6)의 값을 `live`로 보이고 놓을 때 바뀐 열만 한 번 저장한다. 저장된 열이 props로 돌아온 뒤에 `live`를 지운다(놓는 순간 옛 폭이 한 프레임 보이지 않게). ←/→ = 8px, 더블클릭 = 그 열의 기본 폭(둘 다 곧바로 저장). 마지막 열에는 경계가 없다. 경계와 정렬 단추는 `tabIndex={-1}`이고 누르기가 포커스를 옮기지 않는다(판정 14).
- **머리**: 정렬 단추 = 열 이름 + 정렬 열이면 12px 화살표. 누르면 그 열로(처음은 `firstDirection`, 같은 열은 뒤집기, 판정 7). 머리 오른쪽 클릭 = 네이티브 열 메뉴(`ui.showColumnMenu`), 실패하면 오류 토스트(`action-error`, MainWindow의 다른 메뉴 실패와 같다).
- **행 메모(명세 3.4)**: 행 컴포넌트(`ItemRow`, `memo`)의 props는 항목·자리·위치·선택 여부·정지점 여부·고리·열 목록·오늘 날짜뿐이다. 다시 읽은 목록은 바뀐 항목의 행만, 클릭은 선택이 바뀐 두 행만 다시 그린다. 행에는 처리기가 없다(몸통 하나가 위임으로 받는다). 행의 React key는 항목 id라 정렬해도 포커스를 가진 행의 DOM이 그대로 남는다.

`R/library/LibraryTable.tsx`(전체 교체):
```tsx
import { defaultRangeExtractor, useVirtualizer, type Range } from '@tanstack/react-virtual';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Clapperboard, FileText, Link, TriangleAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState,
  type CSSProperties, type FocusEvent, type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent, type PointerEvent, type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { COLUMN_WIDTH_MAX, type ColumnConfig, type LibraryColumnId, type LibraryColumnSpec, type LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { usePrefs } from '../data/queries';
import { defaultDensity, density as ROW_HEIGHT, layout } from '../design/tokens';
import { formatDate, formatSize } from '../format';
import type { Match } from '../palette/hangul';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { cx } from '../ui/cx';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { isNavigationKey, lastInput } from '../ui/inputModality';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { showToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { useNow } from '../useNow';
import { columnTemplates, defaultColumns, fixedWidths, toggleColumn, tradeWidths, visibleColumns, withWidths } from './columns';
import { gridKey } from './gridKeys';
import { inOrder, openTarget, reduceSelection, rowOrder, type SelectAction, type SelectionState } from './selectionModel';
import { firstDirection, type LibrarySort, type LibrarySortColumn } from './sort';

export interface LibraryTableProps {
  rows: readonly LibraryItem[];
  columns: ColumnConfig;
  sort: LibrarySort;
  onSortChange(sort: LibrarySort): void;
  /** Resize release, column-menu toggle / reset. */
  onColumnsChange(next: ColumnConfig): void;
  onOpen(itemId: string): void;
  onContextMenu(itemIds: readonly string[], x: number, y: number): void;
  /** Task 5: matched range per title, for <mark>. */
  titleMatches?: ReadonlyMap<string, Match> | null;
  /** Task 4: scroll this row into view once after mount (return from the reader). */
  revealId?: string | null;
  /** What the body shows while there are no rows (the loading line; Task 5's no-results state). The header stays. */
  empty?: ReactNode;
}

/** design-spec 6 표 (M3 .table-body): the first row starts 4 px under the header; the scroll ends 8 px past the last. */
const BODY_TOP = 4;
const BODY_BOTTOM = 8;
/** Rows drawn beyond each edge of the view, so a fast scroll does not show empty slots. */
const OVERSCAN = 8;
/** ← / → on a focused column edge. */
const RESIZE_STEP = 8;
/** Tabular figures (design-spec 6 표: 숫자는 tabular). */
const NUMERIC: ReadonlySet<LibraryColumnId> = new Set<LibraryColumnId>(['year', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt', 'size']);
const ROW = '[data-testid="item-row"]';
const rowIdOf = (target: EventTarget): string | null =>
  target instanceof Element ? (target.closest<HTMLElement>(ROW)?.dataset['itemId'] ?? null) : null;
const isMac = () => currentPlatform() === 'darwin';
const snapshot = (s: SelectionState): SelectionState => ({ selected: s.selected, anchorId: s.anchorId, cursorId: s.cursorId });

/** A cell's text (spec §3.1). An empty value leaves the cell empty: "—" is the progress column's mark (M7). */
function cellText(column: LibraryColumnId, item: LibraryItem, now: Date): string {
  switch (column) {
    case 'title':
      return item.title;
    case 'creators':
      return item.creators.join(', ');
    case 'year':
      return item.year === null ? '' : String(item.year);
    case 'type':
      return t.library.type[item.type];
    case 'createdAt':
      return formatDate(item.createdAt, now);
    case 'updatedAt':
      return formatDate(item.updatedAt, now);
    case 'storageMode':
      return t.library.storage[item.storageMode];
    case 'size':
      return formatSize(item.size);
    case 'originalName':
      return item.originalName;
  }
}

/** Kind icon 16 + 8 + the title (its full text as the tooltip: the cell truncates), the link mark, the 파일 없음 flag. */
function TitleCell({ item }: { item: LibraryItem }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Icon icon={item.type === 'video' ? Clapperboard : FileText} />
      <span className="item-title ellipsis" title={item.title}>
        {item.title}
      </span>
      {item.storageMode === 'linked' && (
        <span className="linked-mark c-tertiary" title={t.library.linked}>
          <Icon icon={Link} size="sm" label={t.library.linked} />
        </span>
      )}
      {item.availability === 'missing' && (
        <span className="inline-flag c-warning" title={t.library.missingTitle} data-testid="missing-flag">
          <Icon icon={TriangleAlert} size="sm" />
          {t.library.missing}
        </span>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

interface ItemRowProps {
  item: LibraryItem;
  index: number;
  /** The row's offset in the body (the virtualizer's place for it). */
  top: number;
  selected: boolean;
  /** The table's one Tab / F6 stop (roving tabindex). */
  tabStop: boolean;
  /** The keyboard cursor ring: this row has the focus and the keyboard moved it. */
  ring: boolean;
  columns: readonly LibraryColumnSpec[];
  now: Date;
}

/**
 * One row (spec §3.4): it redraws only when its item, its place or its state changed — a re-read list redraws the rows
 * whose items changed, a click the two rows whose selection changed. Widths are not a prop: the grid tracks come from
 * the table's CSS variables, so a column drag redraws no row.
 */
const ItemRow = memo(function ItemRow({ item, index, top, selected, tabStop, ring, columns, now }: ItemRowProps) {
  const last = columns.length - 1;
  return (
    <div
      role="row"
      aria-rowindex={index + 2}
      aria-selected={selected}
      tabIndex={tabStop ? 0 : -1}
      className="table-row"
      style={{ transform: `translateY(${top}px)` }}
      data-testid="item-row"
      data-item-id={item.id}
      data-title={item.title}
      data-index={index}
      data-selected={selected || undefined}
      data-focus-visible={ring || undefined}
      data-missing={item.availability === 'missing' || undefined}
    >
      {columns.map((c, i) => (
        <div
          key={c.id}
          role={c.id === 'title' ? 'rowheader' : 'gridcell'}
          aria-colindex={i + 1}
          className={cx('td', c.align === 'end' && 'end', NUMERIC.has(c.id) && 'num', i === 0 && 'is-first', i === last && 'is-last')}
          data-col={c.id}
        >
          {c.id === 'title' ? (
            <TitleCell item={item} />
          ) : (
            <span className="ellipsis" title={c.id === 'originalName' ? item.originalName : undefined}>
              {cellText(c.id, item, now)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
});

/**
 * The library table (M4 spec 3; ADR-0004 "M4 표": TanStack Virtual + our own grid): a `role="grid"` whose rows the
 * virtualizer places, columns from the catalogue on one CSS grid template, header sort, column edges that trade width
 * with the next column (ruling 6), the native column header menu, and the selection model of design-spec 7.1
 * (selectionModel.ts) — the selection itself lives in useLibrary, so commands and the item panel read it without the
 * table. The focus is a roving one: the cursor row is the table's only Tab and F6 stop.
 */
export function LibraryTable(props: LibraryTableProps) {
  const { rows, columns, sort } = props;
  const now = useNow(); // 오늘/어제 move on at midnight
  const selected = useLibrary((s) => s.selected);
  const cursorId = useLibrary((s) => s.cursorId);
  const rowHeight = ROW_HEIGHT[usePrefs().data?.density ?? defaultDensity];
  const header = layout.tableHeaderHeight;
  const visible = useMemo(() => visibleColumns(columns), [columns]);
  const last = visible.length - 1;
  const order = useMemo(() => rowOrder(rows.map((r) => r.id)), [rows]);
  const cursorIndex = order.indexOf(cursorId);
  // The one stop: the cursor row; before there is one, the first selected row, else the first row.
  const stop = cursorIndex >= 0 ? cursorIndex : Math.max(0, rows.findIndex((r) => selected.has(r.id)));

  const grid = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const getItemKey = useCallback((i: number) => rows[i]!.id, [rows]);
  // The stop row is always drawn, however far the view scrolled from it: a focused row that left the DOM would drop
  // the focus to <body>.
  const rangeExtractor = useCallback(
    (range: Range) => {
      const shown = defaultRangeExtractor(range);
      if (stop < range.count && !shown.includes(stop)) return [...shown, stop].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      return shown;
    },
    [stop],
  );
  const virtualizer = useVirtualizer({
    count: rows.length,
    getScrollElement: () => grid.current,
    estimateSize: () => rowHeight,
    overscan: OVERSCAN,
    getItemKey,
    rangeExtractor,
    paddingStart: BODY_TOP,
    paddingEnd: BODY_BOTTOM,
    // The sticky header sits above the rows in the same scroll view; a row brought into view clears it by the 4 px inset.
    scrollMargin: header,
    scrollPaddingStart: header + BODY_TOP,
    scrollPaddingEnd: BODY_BOTTOM,
  });
  // Rows have one height, the density's: a new density measures every row again (spec §3.4).
  useLayoutEffect(() => virtualizer.measure(), [virtualizer, rowHeight]);

  // The title takes what the other columns leave (at least its minimum): its width, for its edge, is computed.
  const viewWidth = virtualizer.scrollRect?.width ?? 0;
  const [live, setLive] = useState<ReadonlyMap<LibraryColumnId, number> | null>(null);
  const widths = useMemo(() => live ?? fixedWidths(columns, visible), [live, columns, visible]);
  const tracks = useMemo(() => columnTemplates(visible, widths), [visible, widths]);
  const titleWidth = Math.max(visible[0]!.minWidth, viewWidth - (tracks.minWidth - visible[0]!.minWidth));

  // Handlers read the newest props and values here (set after each commit, before any later event).
  const latest = useRef({ props, order, visible, widths, titleWidth, rowHeight, stop });
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    latest.current = { props, order, visible, widths, titleWidth, rowHeight, stop };
  });

  // ---- selection --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const follow = useRef(false);
  /** One model step into the store; `move` also brings the new cursor into view and gives it the focus. */
  const apply = useCallback((action: SelectAction, move = false) => {
    const store = useLibrary.getState();
    const before = snapshot(store);
    const next = reduceSelection(before, action, latest.current.order);
    store.setSelection(next);
    if (!move) return;
    if (next.cursorId !== before.cursorId) follow.current = true;
    else virtualizer.scrollToIndex(latest.current.order.indexOf(next.cursorId)); // at an end already: just show it
  }, [virtualizer]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!follow.current || cursorIndex < 0) return;
    follow.current = false;
    virtualizer.scrollToIndex(cursorIndex);
    grid.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`${ROW}[data-index="${cursorIndex}"]`)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [cursorIndex, virtualizer]);

  // ---- focus and the keyboard cursor ring ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const [focusedId, setFocusedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // The ring shows for keyboard use only (design-spec 6: 마우스 클릭으로는 링을 띄우지 않는다): a key turns it on, a
  // press turns it off, and focus that enters the table brings it when the last input was a key (F6, Tab).
  const [ring, setRing] = useState(false);
  const focusStop = useCallback(() => {
    grid.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`${ROW}[data-index="${latest.current.stop}"]`)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, []);
  const onFocus = useCallback((e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const from = e.relatedTarget;
    if (!(from instanceof Node && e.currentTarget.contains(from))) setRing(lastInput() === 'keyboard');
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) return focusStop(); // the grid passes its focus on to the stop row
    const id = rowIdOf(e.target);
    if (id === null) return;
    setFocusedId(id);
    // Focus that enters the table (F6, Tab, the hand-over) on a row that is not the cursor yet makes it the cursor, and
    // the selection when there is none (the arrows then go on from there).
    const store = useLibrary.getState();
    if (store.cursorId === id) return;
    store.setSelection(store.selected.size === 0 ? { selected: new Set([id]), anchorId: id, cursorId: id } : { ...snapshot(store), cursorId: id });
  }, [focusStop]);
  const onBlur = useCallback((e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const to = e.relatedTarget;
    if (!(to instanceof Node && e.currentTarget.contains(to))) setFocusedId(null);
  }, []);
  // The grid can hold the focus itself (the window's hand-over, a press on the empty body): the stop row takes it as
  // soon as there is one.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (rows.length > 0 && document.activeElement === grid.current) focusStop();
  });

  const onKeyDown = useCallback((e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (isNavigationKey(e)) setRing(true);
    if (e.target instanceof Element && e.target.closest('[role="separator"]')) return; // a column edge has its own keys
    const key = gridKey(e.nativeEvent, isMac());
    if (!key) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    switch (key.kind) {
      case 'move': {
        const view = grid.current?.clientHeight ?? 0;
        const page = Math.floor((view - header - BODY_TOP) / latest.current.rowHeight);
        return apply({ kind: 'move', to: key.to, extend: key.extend, page }, true);
      }
      case 'all':
      case 'clear':
        return apply(key);
      case 'open': {
        // ↩ opens one selected item; with several it does nothing (several tabs are M7, spec §3.3).
        const id = openTarget(useLibrary.getState().selected);
        if (id !== null) latest.current.props.onOpen(id);
        return;
      }
      case 'swallow':
        return;
    }
  }, [apply, header]);

  // The edit menu's 모두 선택 (role selectAll) runs the page's select-all, which asks <body> first (selectstart): while
  // the table has the focus it selects every row instead of the page's text. ⌘A itself comes as a key (onKeyDown).
  useEffect(() => {
    const onSelectStart = (e: Event) => {
      if (e.target !== document.body || !grid.current?.contains(document.activeElement)) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      apply({ kind: 'all' });
    };
    document.addEventListener('selectstart', onSelectStart);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('selectstart', onSelectStart);
  }, [apply]);

  // ---- rows: press, double-click, right-click (delegated: the rows keep no handlers of their own) ----------------
  const onBodyMouseDown = useCallback((e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    const mac = isMac();
    if (mac && e.ctrlKey) return; // ⌃-click is the context menu on macOS (onContextMenu)
    const id = rowIdOf(e.target);
    if (id !== null) apply({ kind: 'click', id, shift: e.shiftKey, toggle: mac ? e.metaKey : e.ctrlKey });
  }, [apply]);
  // A double-click opens its row, which the first press selected alone (spec §3.3; M3's single-click open is gone).
  const onBodyDoubleClick = useCallback((e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.shiftKey || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
    const id = rowIdOf(e.target);
    if (id !== null) latest.current.props.onOpen(id);
  }, []);
  // Right-click selects first (design-spec 7.1, Finder): a row outside the selection becomes the selection; inside it,
  // the menu acts on every selected item, in table order.
  const onBodyContextMenu = useCallback((e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const id = rowIdOf(e.target);
    if (id === null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    apply({ kind: 'contextMenu', id });
    (e.target as Element).closest<HTMLElement>(ROW)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    latest.current.props.onContextMenu(inOrder(useLibrary.getState().selected, latest.current.order), e.clientX, e.clientY);
  }, [apply]);

  // ---- header: sort, column menu, column edges -------------------------------------------------------------------
  const onSort = useCallback((column: LibrarySortColumn) => {
    const p = latest.current.props;
    const flipped = p.sort.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    p.onSortChange({ column, direction: column === p.sort.column ? flipped : firstDirection(column) });
  }, []);
  const onHeaderMenu = useCallback((e: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const at = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const picked = await unwrap(api().ui.showColumnMenu({ visible: latest.current.props.columns.visible, ...at }));
        if (!picked) return;
        const { columns: cfg, onColumnsChange } = latest.current.props;
        onColumnsChange('reset' in picked ? defaultColumns() : toggleColumn(cfg, picked.toggle));
      } catch (err) {
        showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.toast.actionFailed, body: (err as Error).message, testId: 'action-error' });
      }
    })();
  }, []);

  /** Every shown column's width now, the title's included. */
  const currentWidths = useCallback(() => new Map(latest.current.widths).set('title', latest.current.titleWidth), []);
  /** Stores the widths that changed (the others keep following their defaults); false when none did. */
  const saveWidths = useCallback((next: ReadonlyMap<LibraryColumnId, number>): boolean => {
    const { columns: cfg, onColumnsChange } = latest.current.props;
    const before = fixedWidths(cfg, latest.current.visible); // the configured ones, not a drag's live widths
    const changed = new Map([...next].filter(([id, w]) => before.get(id) !== w));
    if (changed.size > 0) onColumnsChange(withWidths(cfg, changed));
    return changed.size > 0;
  }, []);
  // A drag shows its widths at once (live) and is saved once, on release (spec §3.2).
  const drag = useRef<{ id: LibraryColumnId; x: number; start: Map<LibraryColumnId, number>; widths: Map<LibraryColumnId, number> | null } | null>(null);
  const onEdgeDown = useCallback((e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>, id: LibraryColumnId) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    e.preventDefault(); // neither the focus nor a text selection moves
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    drag.current = { id, x: e.clientX, start: currentWidths(), widths: null };
  }, [currentWidths]);
  const onEdgeMove = useCallback((e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const d = drag.current;
    if (!d) return;
    d.widths = tradeWidths(latest.current.visible, d.start, d.id, d.start.get(d.id)! + e.clientX - d.x);
    setLive(d.widths);
  }, []);
  const onEdgeUp = useCallback(() => {
    const d = drag.current;
    if (!d) return; // the release and the lost capture both end a drag
    drag.current = null;
    if (!d.widths || !saveWidths(d.widths)) setLive(null);
  }, [saveWidths]);
  // The saved widths come back as new columns: only then do the live ones go, so no frame shows the widths from before.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!drag.current) setLive(null);
  }, [columns]);
  // A double-click puts the column back at its default width; ← / → move the edge by 8 px. Both trade with the next
  // column like a drag, and are saved at once.
  const onEdgeDoubleClick = useCallback((spec: LibraryColumnSpec) => {
    if (spec.defaultWidth !== null) saveWidths(tradeWidths(latest.current.visible, currentWidths(), spec.id, spec.defaultWidth));
  }, [currentWidths, saveWidths]);
  const onEdgeKey = useCallback((e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>, id: LibraryColumnId) => {
    const step = e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? RESIZE_STEP : e.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -RESIZE_STEP : 0;
    if (step === 0 || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.shiftKey) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const start = currentWidths();
    saveWidths(tradeWidths(latest.current.visible, start, id, start.get(id)! + step));
  }, [currentWidths, saveWidths]);

  const items = virtualizer.getVirtualItems();
  const showEmpty = rows.length === 0 && props.empty !== undefined && props.empty !== null;
  const vars = { '--head-cols': tracks.head, '--row-cols': tracks.row, '--table-min-width': `${tracks.minWidth}px` } as CSSProperties;
  return (
    <div
      ref={grid}
      role="grid"
      aria-label={t.library.table}
      aria-multiselectable="true"
      aria-rowcount={rows.length + (showEmpty ? 2 : 1)}
      aria-colcount={visible.length}
      tabIndex={-1}
      className="library-table"
      data-testid="library-table"
      style={vars}
      onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      onFocus={onFocus}
      onBlur={onBlur}
      onPointerDownCapture={() => setRing(false)}
    >
      <div role="row" aria-rowindex={1} className="table-head" onContextMenu={onHeaderMenu}>
        {visible.map((c, i) => {
          const direction = sort.column === c.id ? sort.direction : null;
          const width = c.id === 'title' ? titleWidth : widths.get(c.id)!;
          return (
            <div
              key={c.id}
              role="columnheader"
              aria-colindex={i + 1}
              aria-sort={direction === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : direction === 'desc' ? 'descending' : 'none'}
              className={cx('th', c.align === 'end' && 'end', i === 0 && 'is-first', i === last && 'is-last')}
              data-testid="column-header"
              data-col={c.id}
              data-sorted={direction !== null || undefined}
            >
              {/* Out of the Tab order (the grid is one stop) and pressed without taking the focus from the rows. */}
              <button type="button" tabIndex={-1} className="th-sort" onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()} onClick={() => onSort(c.id)}>
                <span className="ellipsis">{c.label}</span>
                {direction && <Icon icon={direction === 'asc' ? ChevronUp : ChevronDown} size="xs" />}
              </button>
              {/* A column edge (design-spec 2.1): the last column has none (no next column to trade with, ruling 6). */}
              {i < last && (
                <div
                  role="separator"
                  aria-orientation="vertical"
                  aria-label={t.library.resizeColumn(c.label)}
                  aria-valuenow={Math.round(width)}
                  aria-valuemin={c.minWidth}
                  aria-valuemax={COLUMN_WIDTH_MAX}
                  tabIndex={-1}
                  className="col-resizer"
                  data-testid="column-resizer"
                  data-col={c.id}
                  onPointerDown={(e) => onEdgeDown(e, c.id)}
                  onPointerMove={onEdgeMove}
                  onPointerUp={onEdgeUp}
                  onLostPointerCapture={onEdgeUp}
                  onDoubleClick={() => onEdgeDoubleClick(c)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => onEdgeKey(e, c.id)}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {showEmpty ? (
        <div role="row" aria-rowindex={2} className="table-empty">
          <div role="gridcell" className="table-empty-cell">
            {props.empty}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          role="rowgroup"
          className="table-body"
          style={{ height: virtualizer.getTotalSize() }}
          onMouseDown={onBodyMouseDown}
          onDoubleClick={onBodyDoubleClick}
          onContextMenu={onBodyContextMenu}
        >
          {items.map((v) => {
            const item = rows[v.index]!;
            return (
              <ItemRow
                key={v.key}
                item={item}
                index={v.index}
                top={v.start - header}
                selected={selected.has(item.id)}
                tabStop={v.index === stop}
                ring={ring && focusedId === item.id}
                columns={visible}
                now={now}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

Expected: `LibraryTable.tsx`는 통과하고, 남은 오류는 `R/app/MainWindow.tsx`의 옛 `<LibraryTable items=… firstTitleRef=… />` 호출뿐이다(Step 13).

- [ ] **Step 13: `LibraryView`·`LibraryLoading`과 `MainWindow` (P-17, 포커스 인계, 메뉴 대상)**

`R/library/LibraryView.tsx`(새 파일, 전체):
```tsx
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { LibraryTable } from './LibraryTable';
import { useLibraryRows } from './useLibraryRows';
import { useLibrarySettings } from './useLibrarySettings';

/** The library view's content area: the table in the stored columns and sort (Task 4 adds revealId, Task 5 the search). */
export function LibraryView({ items, onOpen, onItemMenu }: { items: readonly LibraryItem[]; onOpen(itemId: string): void; onItemMenu(itemIds: readonly string[], x: number, y: number): void }) {
  const settings = useLibrarySettings();
  const { rows } = useLibraryRows(items);
  if (!settings.ready) return null; // one IPC round trip, already in flight while the list loaded (LibraryLoading)
  return (
    <LibraryTable
      rows={rows}
      columns={settings.columns}
      sort={settings.sort}
      onSortChange={settings.setSort}
      onColumnsChange={settings.setColumns}
      onOpen={onOpen}
      onContextMenu={onItemMenu}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Spinner } from '../ui/Spinner';
import { BUSY_DELAY_MS } from './busyScreen';
import { LibraryTable } from './LibraryTable';
import { useLibrarySettings } from './useLibrarySettings';

const NO_ROWS: readonly LibraryItem[] = [];
const ignore = () => {};

/**
 * Before the first list read has answered (M4 spec 3.5, design-spec 6): nothing for 300 ms, then the table's header with
 * "불러오는 중…" where the rows go. It also starts the column and sort reads, so the table that follows is ready at once.
 */
export function LibraryLoading() {
  const settings = useLibrarySettings();
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setShown(true), BUSY_DELAY_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);
  if (!shown || !settings.ready) return null;
  return (
    <LibraryTable
      rows={NO_ROWS}
      columns={settings.columns}
      sort={settings.sort}
      onSortChange={settings.setSort}
      onColumnsChange={settings.setColumns}
      onOpen={ignore}
      onContextMenu={ignore}
      empty={
        <div className="pane-empty top" data-testid="table-loading">
          <div className="loading" role="status">
            <Spinner />
            {t.library.loading}
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

`R/app/MainWindow.tsx` — 아래 일곱 군데를 바꾼다(M3 코드 기준. Task 2가 같은 `useMemo` 안에 `libraryCount` 등을 더했으면 그 줄들은 그대로 둔다).

```ts
import { LibraryView } from '../library/LibraryView';
```


Task 2가 `libraryCount: list.length`처럼 `list`로 값을 만들었다면 그 줄을 `libraryCount: count`로 바꾸고 `count`를 의존성에 넣는다(`count`는 `list.length`이므로 같은 값이고, 목록 배열이 바뀌어도 개수가 같으면 env가 그대로다). 이를 위해 `const count = list.length;` 줄을 `env` 정의 **앞**(2번 블록 바로 다음)으로 옮긴다.
5. `showItemMenu`를 통째로 바꾼다:
```ts
  /** The item menu for the table's selection, in table order (right-click selected first, design-spec 7.1). */
  const showItemMenu = useCallback(async (itemIds: readonly string[], x: number, y: number) => {
    try {
      const picked = await unwrap(api().ui.showContextMenu({ kind: 'item', itemIds: [...itemIds], x, y }));
      if (picked) runPicked(picked.commandId, envRef.current, itemIds);
    } catch (e) {
      actionFailed(e);
    }
  }, []);
```
6. 포커스 인계(`leftWithFocus`·`firstTitle`·그 `useLayoutEffect`)를 통째로 바꾼다:
```ts
  // The screen before the list (first run, or the list-failed notice) had focus and left with it, so focus fell to
  // <body>: hand it to the table, whose grid passes it on to its first row; keyboard users keep their place. The
  // virtualizer draws the rows once it has measured its view, so the hand-over waits one frame (and does nothing if
  // the focus went somewhere meanwhile).
  const leftWithFocus = useRef(false);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const hadFocus = leftWithFocus.current;
    leftWithFocus.current = false;
    if (!hadFocus || view.kind !== 'library' || count === 0) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (document.activeElement === null || document.activeElement === document.body) document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="library-table"]')?.focus();
    });
  }, [view.kind, count]);
```
7. `library` 삼항: 첫 읽기 전이면서 실패가 아닐 때 `null` 대신 `<LibraryLoading />`, 표 자리는 `LibraryView`:
```tsx
  const library =
    items.data === undefined ? (
      listFailure !== null ? (
        <ListFailed message={listFailure} retrying={items.isFetching} onRetry={() => void items.refetch()} focusOnLeave={leftWithFocus} />
      ) : (
        <LibraryLoading />
      )
    ) : count === 0 || busy?.holding ? (
      <EmptyLibrary busy={busy} focusOnLeave={leftWithFocus} />
    ) : (
      <LibraryView items={list} onOpen={openFromList} onItemMenu={(itemIds, x, y) => void showItemMenu(itemIds, x, y)} />
    );
```
(N-5는 그대로다: `LibraryLoading`은 첫 300ms 동안 아무것도 그리지 않고, 그 뒤에도 빈 라이브러리 화면이 아니라 표 머리를 그린다.)

`R/shell/panes.ts` — `FOCUSABLE` 정의 바로 다음에 더한다:
```ts
/**
 * A grid (the library table) is one stop with a roving focus (P-31): F6 lands on its stop row (tabindex 0: the cursor,
 * or the first row before there is one), never on a header button or a column edge inside it (tabindex -1).
 */
const landsOn = (el: Element): boolean => el.closest('[role="grid"]') === null || el.getAttribute('tabindex') === '0';
```

```ts
    target.focus();
    // Landed once the focus is in the target.
    if (target.contains(document.activeElement)) return;
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 15: 표 CSS 재작성(P-16), 빈·로딩 상태 CSS, Gallery 표 행**

값은 목업 `docs/design/mockups/assets/mockup.css` l.861–990(표), l.2408–2417(커서), l.2562–2600(`.pane-empty`, `.loading`)에서 왔다. 바뀐 문법: 줄무늬는 `data-index` 끝자리, 열 폭은 표가 계산한 CSS grid 트랙(`--head-cols`·`--row-cols`), 행의 채움은 좌우 8px 안쪽이되 첫·마지막 셀은 머리와 맞게 8px 밖으로, 호버는 `:hover`, 정렬 열은 `data-sorted`, 커서 고리는 행의 `data-focus-visible`, 선택 색은 `.library-table:focus-within`과 키 창일 때만, Gallery는 `data-force`(`stripe`·`hover`·`selected`·`focused`·`cursor`·`sorted`)로 같은 규칙을 탄다.

`R/styles/components/list.css` — l.84(`.table-head,\n  .table-row {`)부터 `.row-open {…}` 블록 끝(l.169)까지를 지우고 그 자리에 넣는다(`.inline-flag` 블록은 그대로 둔다):
```css
  /* Table (design-spec 6 표; M4 spec 3). These rules draw a header cell, a row and a cell; how they are laid out is the
     library table's (screens/library.css: one CSS grid of columns, rows placed by the virtualizer) or the state board's
     (screens/gallery.css: static flex rows). A row's fill is inset 8 px from the table's sides while its cells line up
     with the header's (the first and last cells reach back out 8 px), so the first column's content starts 16 px in
     (the header text over the icon) and the last column's ends 24 px in. */
  .table-head {
    height: var(--table-header-height);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--separator);
    background: var(--bg-content); /* the rows scroll under the sticky header */
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
  }
  .table-head .th {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 var(--space-8);
  }
  /* The header's sort button fills its cell: the label and, on the sorted column, the arrow. */
  .table-head .th-sort {
    appearance: none;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: none;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: inherit;
    cursor: default;
  }
  .table-head .th.end .th-sort {
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
  .table-head .th-sort > .icon {
    flex: none;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .table-head .th.is-first,
  .table-row .td.is-first {
    padding-left: var(--space-16);
  }
  .table-head .th.is-last,
  .table-row .td.is-last {
    padding-right: var(--space-24);
  }
  .table-row .td.is-first {
    margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--space-8));
  }
  .table-row .td.is-last {
    margin-right: calc(-1 * var(--space-8));
  }
  .table-head .th:not(.is-first)::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 6px; /* local: a 16 px divider in the 27 px above the header's 1 px line (6 + 16 + 5) */
    bottom: 6px; /* local: 5 px + the line */
    width: 1px;
    background: var(--separator);
  }
  /* The sorted column (spec §3.1): primary text at 500 and a 12 px arrow. */
  .table-head .th:is([data-sorted], [data-force~='sorted']) {
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-weight: var(--weight-medium);
  }
  /* A column edge (design-spec 2.1, the pane boundary's grammar): only the cursor changes, never the line. The 8 px
     left of the edge: a column clips what lies past its own box. */
  .table-head .col-resizer {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 8px; /* local: hit area */
    cursor: col-resize;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  .table-row {
    height: var(--row-height);
    margin: 0 var(--space-8);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    outline: none;
    cursor: default;
  }
  .table-row .td {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-8);
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 var(--space-8);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .table-row .td[data-col='title'] {
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
  /* The kind icon (first in the title cell); later glyphs carry their own colour wrapper (.c-tertiary, .inline-flag).
     :where keeps it below the selection's white so a filled row whitens it. */
  :where(.table-row .td[data-col='title']) > .icon:first-child {
    flex: none;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .table-row .td.end {
    justify-content: flex-end;
    text-align: right;
  }
  .table-row[data-missing] .item-title {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  /* Stripes by the row's place in the list — data-index ending in an odd digit is the 2nd, 4th … row — never by DOM
     order: a virtualized body holds some rows only, in any order (P-16). */
  .table-row:is([data-index$='1'], [data-index$='3'], [data-index$='5'], [data-index$='7'], [data-index$='9'], [data-force~='stripe']) {
    background: var(--bg-content-alt);
  }
  .table-row:is(:hover, [data-force~='hover']) {
    background: var(--fill-hover);
  }
  /* Selection (design-spec 3.1): neutral without the focus; the accent fill and white text (icons, flags too) while the
     table has the focus in the key window. One accent selection per screen. */
  .table-row:is([data-selected], [data-force~='selected']) {
    background: var(--fill-selected);
  }
  :root:not([data-window-inactive]) .library-table:focus-within .table-row[data-selected],
  .table-row[data-force~='focused'] {
    background: var(--accent);
  }
  :root:not([data-window-inactive]) .library-table:focus-within .table-row[data-selected] :is(.td, .icon, .item-title, .c-tertiary, .c-warning),
  .table-row[data-force~='focused'] :is(.td, .icon, .item-title, .c-tertiary, .c-warning) {
    color: var(--text-on-accent);
  }
  /* Keyboard cursor (design-spec 6): an inset 2 px focus ring, keyboard only (data-focus-visible, LibraryTable). On the
     accent fill a 75 % white ring, which tells the cursor from the other filled rows of a multiple selection. */
  .table-row:is([data-focus-visible], [data-force~='cursor']) {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--focus);
  }
  :root:not([data-window-inactive]) .library-table:focus-within .table-row[data-selected][data-focus-visible],
  .table-row[data-force~='focused'][data-force~='cursor'] {
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--text-on-accent) 75%, transparent);
  }
```

```css
  /* The table fills the content column and is its own scroll view (the virtualizer's): the header sticks to its top,
     the body is as tall as every row and the virtualizer draws the rows near the view, each on the grid tracks the table
     computes (columns.ts columnTemplates, as --head-cols / --row-cols). Narrower than the columns' least width, it
     scrolls sideways. */
  .library-table {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: auto;
    outline: none;
  }
  .library-table .table-head {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    flex: none;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: var(--head-cols);

    flex: none;

  .library-table .table-body > .table-row {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: var(--row-cols);
  }
  /* The loading line (and Task 5's no-results state) takes the body's place under the header. */
  .library-table :is(.table-empty, .table-empty-cell) {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
```
