`V/library.evidence.ts`(새 파일, 전체) — `shell.evidence.ts` l.35–58과 같은 모양(모듈 수준 `TAG`·`results`·`checks`·`save`·`check`·`guard`, 하나의 세션, 마지막 판정). 뒤 작업(4–9)은 **판정 테스트 위에** 자기 `test(…, TAG, …)`를 더하고 `results`에 자기 키를 넣는다:
```ts
// @library — M4 library table, quick search and item panel on macOS (the Mac suite `library`, P-24); Linux CI runs it
// too, with the macOS-only captures recorded as skipped.
//
// One shared session in serial mode. As in shell.evidence.ts, no check stops the run: each is recorded in
// m4-library.json (`checks`) as it is measured, and the last test asserts them all with expect.soft. Later M4 tasks add
// their tests above the verdict and their measurements to `results`.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  FIXTURES, NativeInputNotPermitted, bringAppToFront, bringFinderToFront, importPaths, launch, nativeKeystroke, recordedPopups, rowAt, seedLibrary,
  stubContextMenu, type Session,
} from '../e2e/helpers';
import { LIBRARY_COLUMNS } from '../../packages/domain/src/library-columns';
import { IS_MAC, allShots, focusApp, fullScreenShot, movePointer, nativeWindowShot, pressEscape, writeJson } from './capture';

const TAG = { tag: '@library' };
const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const MP4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4');
const MPEG4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-mpeg4part2.mp4');
const results: Record<string, unknown> = {};
/** Every check's verdict and the value it was judged on, in the order measured (asserted by the last test). */
const checks: Record<string, { ok: boolean; value: unknown }> = {};
const save = () => writeJson('m4-library.json', { ...results, checks, platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`, at: new Date().toISOString() }, 'M4 library measurements');

/** Record one check (judged later, never here). */
function check(name: string, ok: boolean, value: unknown): void {
  checks[name] = { ok, value };
}

const errorText = (e: unknown) => (e instanceof Error ? `${e.name}: ${e.message.split('\n')[0]}` : String(e));

/** Run a carried check; a throw becomes a failed check with the error (codes and messages only, never a path). */
async function guard(name: string, run: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await run();
  } catch (e) {
    check(name, false, { error: errorText(e), notPermitted: e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted });
  }
}

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
/** The colour a token resolves to here (light-dark() resolved by the page's scheme), as getComputedStyle writes it. */
const tokenColor = (page: Page, token: string) =>
  page.evaluate((t) => {
    const probe = document.createElement('div');
    probe.style.background = `var(${t})`;
    document.body.append(probe);
    const c = getComputedStyle(probe).backgroundColor;
    probe.remove();
    return c;
  }, token);
const setTheme = async (page: Page, theme: 'light' | 'dark') => {
  await page.evaluate((t) => window.learn.prefs.set({ theme: t }), theme);
  await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-theme', theme);
};

test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });
let s: Session;
let tmp = '';

test.beforeAll(async () => {
  tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'learn-m4-library-'));
  s = await launch(path.join(tmp, 'library'), path.join(tmp, 'userdata'), { colorScheme: null });
  const [pdf] = await importPaths(s.page, [PDF, KO_PDF, MP4, MPEG4]);
  await seedLibrary(s.app, { count: 44, from: pdf! }); // 48 items, as the mockup's library
  await expect(s.page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('48개');
  if (IS_MAC) await movePointer(512, 620);
});

test.afterAll(async () => {
  save();
  await s?.app.close().catch(() => {});
  if (tmp) fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
});

test('M4 table: header, default columns, sorted 추가일, row metrics and stripes, light and dark', TAG, async () => {
  await guard('header 28 px, rows 28 px at 보통, first row 4 px under the header', async () => {
    const head = (await s.page.locator('.table-head').boundingBox())!;
    const [r0, r1] = [(await rowAt(s.page, 0).boundingBox())!, (await rowAt(s.page, 1).boundingBox())!];
    const v = { header: head.height, row: r0.height, pitch: r1.y - r0.y, gap: r0.y - (head.y + head.height) };
    results['table'] = { ...(results['table'] as object), metrics: v };
    check('header 28 px, rows 28 px at 보통, first row 4 px under the header', v.header === 28 && v.row === 28 && v.pitch === 28 && v.gap === 4, v);
  });
  await guard('header labels follow the column catalogue: 제목 · 저자 · 연도 · 종류 · 추가일', async () => {
    const labels = await s.page.getByTestId('column-header').allTextContents();
    const want = LIBRARY_COLUMNS.filter((c) => c.defaultVisible).map((c) => c.label);
    check('header labels follow the column catalogue: 제목 · 저자 · 연도 · 종류 · 추가일', JSON.stringify(labels) === JSON.stringify(want), { labels, want });
  });
  await guard('the sorted header (추가일, newest first) is primary 500 with a 12 px chevron', async () => {
    const h = s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="createdAt"]');
    const v = {
      ariaSort: await h.getAttribute('aria-sort'),
      weight: await h.evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).fontWeight),
      color: await h.evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).color),
      primary: await tokenColor(s.page, '--text-primary'),
      arrow: (await h.locator('.icon').boundingBox())?.width ?? null,
    };
    check('the sorted header (추가일, newest first) is primary 500 with a 12 px chevron', v.ariaSort === 'descending' && v.weight === '500' && v.color === v.primary && v.arrow === 12, v);
  });
  await guard('stripes on every second row', async () => {
    await s.page.mouse.move(5, 5);
    const bg = (i: number) => rowAt(s.page, i).evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor);
    const v = { row0: await bg(0), row1: await bg(1), row2: await bg(2), alt: await tokenColor(s.page, '--bg-content-alt') };
    check('stripes on every second row', v.row1 === v.alt && v.row0 === v.row2 && v.row0 !== v.row1, v);
  });
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(s.page, theme);
    if (IS_MAC) await focusApp(s.app);
    await allShots(s.app, s.page, `m4-01-table-${theme}`, `library table, 48 items, default columns, ${theme}`);
  }
  await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
});

test('M4 table: selection — focused accent, unfocused neutral, the cursor rings, a real ⌘A, an inactive window', TAG, async () => {
  const fill = (i: number) => rowAt(s.page, i).evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor);
  await guard('focused selection: accent fill and white text', async () => {
    await rowAt(s.page, 0).click();
    const v = {
      fill: await fill(0),
      accent: await tokenColor(s.page, '--accent'),
      text: await rowAt(s.page, 0).locator('[data-col="creators"]').evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).color),
      onAccent: await s.page.evaluate(() => {
        const probe = document.createElement('div');
        probe.style.color = 'var(--text-on-accent)';
        document.body.append(probe);
        const c = getComputedStyle(probe).color;
        probe.remove();
        return c;
      }),
    };
    check('focused selection: accent fill and white text', v.fill === v.accent && v.text === v.onAccent, v);
  });
  await guard('multiple selection with the keyboard cursor: a 75 % white ring on the filled cursor row', async () => {
    const mod = IS_MAC ? 'Meta' : 'Control';
    await rowAt(s.page, 0).click();
    await rowAt(s.page, 2).click({ modifiers: [mod] });
    await rowAt(s.page, 5).click({ modifiers: [mod] });
    await s.page.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft'); // does nothing in the table, but it is a key: the cursor shows its ring
    const ring = await rowAt(s.page, 5).evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).boxShadow);
    const selected = await s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]').count();
    check('multiple selection with the keyboard cursor: a 75 % white ring on the filled cursor row', selected === 3 && /inset/.test(ring) && ring !== 'none', { selected, ring });
    await allShots(s.app, s.page, 'm4-02-multi-light', 'three rows selected (1, 3, 6), the keyboard cursor on the sixth');
  });
  await guard('unfocused selection: neutral fill', async () => {
    await s.page.getByTestId('nav-library').focus();
    const v = { fill: await fill(0), neutral: await tokenColor(s.page, '--fill-selected') };
    check('unfocused selection: neutral fill', v.fill === v.neutral, v);
    await allShots(s.app, s.page, 'm4-02-unfocused-light', 'the selection while the sidebar has the focus');
  });
  if (IS_MAC) {
    // A real ⌘A meets the menu bar too (its 모두 선택 has ⌘A): either way the table takes it — every row, no page text.
    await guard('⌘A on the keyboard selects every row, not the page text', async () => {
      await rowAt(s.page, 2).click();
      await nativeKeystroke(s.app, 'a', ['command']);
      const drawn = s.page.getByTestId('item-row');
      await expect.poll(async () => s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]').count()).toBe(await drawn.count());
      const v = { drawn: await drawn.count(), pageText: await s.page.evaluate(() => getSelection()?.toString().length ?? 0) };
      check('⌘A on the keyboard selects every row, not the page text', v.drawn > 1 && v.pageText === 0, v);
    });
    await guard('inactive window: neutral selection and no cursor ring', async () => {
      await rowAt(s.page, 5).click();
      await s.page.keyboard.press('ArrowUp'); // the keyboard cursor (its ring) on row 5 again
      await s.page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
      await bringFinderToFront();
      await expect(s.page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
      const v = { fill: await fill(5), ring: await rowAt(s.page, 5).evaluate((e) => getComputedStyle(e).boxShadow), neutral: await tokenColor(s.page, '--fill-selected') };
      await nativeWindowShot(s.app, 'm4-02-inactive-light', 'library table, window inactive (Finder in front)', { focus: false });
      check('inactive window: neutral selection and no cursor ring', v.fill === v.neutral && v.ring === 'none', v);
      await bringAppToFront(s.app);
    });
  }
});

test('M4 table: the column header menu — every column, the shown ones checked, 제목 fixed, then 열 구성 되돌리기', TAG, async () => {
  const yearHeader = s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="year"]');
  if (IS_MAC) {
    // The real native menu (no stub): open it, capture the screen, close it with esc.
    await guard('column menu: the real native menu was captured', async () => {
      await focusApp(s.app);
      const box = (await yearHeader.boundingBox())!;
      await s.page.mouse.click(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2, { button: 'right' });
      await sleep(1200);
      const shot = await fullScreenShot('m4-03-column-menu', 'the column header menu (native, check marks)');
      await pressEscape();
      check('column menu: the real native menu was captured', shot.file !== null, shot);
    });
  }
  await guard('column menu: every catalogue column, the shown ones checked, 제목 fixed, then 열 구성 되돌리기', async () => {
    await stubContextMenu(s.app, null);
    await yearHeader.click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(async () => (await recordedPopups(s.app)).length).toBe(1);
    const items = (await recordedPopups(s.app))[0]!.map((i) => [i.type === 'separator' ? '-' : i.label, i.checked, i.enabled]);
    const want = [
      ...LIBRARY_COLUMNS.map((c) => [c.label, c.defaultVisible, c.required !== true]),
      ['-', false, true],
      ['열 구성 되돌리기', false, true],
    ];
    results['columnMenu'] = items;
    check('column menu: every catalogue column, the shown ones checked, 제목 fixed, then 열 구성 되돌리기', JSON.stringify(items) === JSON.stringify(want), { items, want });
  });
});

// Later M4 tasks add their tests here, above the verdict.

test('M4 library: verdict of every check above (m4-library.json checks)', TAG, async () => {
  save();
  for (const [name, c] of Object.entries(checks)) expect.soft(c.ok, `${name}: ${JSON.stringify(c.value)}`).toBe(true);
});
```

(이 파일이 쓰는 `capture.ts` export — `IS_MAC`, `allShots`, `focusApp`, `fullScreenShot`, `movePointer`, `nativeWindowShot`, `pressEscape`, `writeJson` — 와 helpers의 `NativeInputNotPermitted`, `bringAppToFront`, `bringFinderToFront`, `nativeKeystroke`는 모두 이미 있다. macOS가 아닌 곳에서 `allShots`·`nativeWindowShot`·`fullScreenShot`은 skipped로 기록하고 page 캡처만 남긴다.)

```ts
test('table: several rows selected with the keyboard cursor, sorted by title, and the window not key', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  const dates = () => [s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]')];
  try {
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(s.page, [path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf')]);
    await seedLibrary(s.app, { count: 11, from: pdf! });
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('12개');
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      // library.html?state=multi: rows 1, 3 and 6 selected, the keyboard cursor on 6 (← does nothing in the table, but
      // it is a key: the cursor shows its ring).
      await rowAt(s.page, 0).click();
      await rowAt(s.page, 2).click({ modifiers: ['Control'] });
      await rowAt(s.page, 5).click({ modifiers: ['Control'] });
      await s.page.keyboard.press('ArrowLeft');
      await expect(rowAt(s.page, 5)).toHaveAttribute('data-focus-visible', 'true');
      await expect(s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]')).toHaveCount(3);
      await shoot(s.page, `table-multi-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
    }
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    const title = s.page.locator('[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="title"]');
    await title.click();
    await expect(title).toHaveAttribute('aria-sort', 'ascending');
    await rowAt(s.page, 0).click();
    await shoot(s.page, 'table-sorted-light', { mask: dates() });
    // Another window takes the key: the selection turns neutral and the cursor ring goes (design-spec 2.1, 3.1).
    await s.page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    await expect(rowAt(s.page, 1)).toHaveAttribute('data-focus-visible', 'true');
    await s.app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => {
      const w = new BrowserWindow({ width: 300, height: 200, show: true });
      void w.loadURL('about:blank');
      w.focus();
      (globalThis as { __probeWindow?: unknown }).__probeWindow = w;
    });
    await expect(s.page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
    await shoot(s.page, 'table-inactive-light', { mask: dates() });
    await s.app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __probeWindow?: { close(): void } }).__probeWindow?.close());
    await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.focus());
    await expect(s.page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});

test('table: loading — the header stays and 불러오는 중… comes after 300 ms', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  try {
    await importPaths(s.page, [path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf')]);
    await s.app.evaluate(({ ipcMain }) => {
      ipcMain.removeHandler('library:list');
      ipcMain.handle('library:list', () => new Promise(() => {})); // never answers: the loading state holds for the shot
    });
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await s.page.reload();
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('table-loading')).toBeVisible();
      await shoot(s.page, `table-loading-${theme}`);
    }
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

### Task 4: 선택 → 명령 — 보고되는 선택 개수, ⇧⌘R·파일 메뉴, 팔레트의 자료 명령, ⌘/ 시트의 자료 묶음, 선택 정리, 돌아왔을 때 스크롤

#### 계약과 다른 점 (판정 기록)

한 줄 = 하나. 각 줄 끝의 "권고"를 아래 단계에 그대로 적용했다. 컨트롤러 판정(Q-23~Q-29)으로 해소된 항목은 그렇게 표시했다(K-8만 이웃 초안과 맞출 이름으로 남는다).

이웃 작업 초안과 맞춘 이름(충돌 아님): Task 2의 `CommandEnv.selection()`·`menuTarget(id, env)`(메뉴 막대의 자료 명령은 라이브러리 보기에서만 선택을 대상으로), Task 3의 `LibraryTableProps.empty`(머리 아래 몸통 자리 — Task 5의 결과 없음이 쓴다), `useLibrary.pruneSelected`, `R/styles/components/pane-empty.css`, `MainWindow`의 `listRef`, `LibraryView`의 `settings`·`if (!settings.ready) return null`, `TitleCell`·`.item-title`, 강조 선택 선택자 `:root:not([data-window-inactive]) .library-table:focus-within .table-row[data-selected]`. 번호는 처음 초안의 것을 그대로 둔다(빠진 번호는 이웃 초안과 맞춰 없어진 항목이다).

- **K-3 ⌘/ 시트 높이 — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-23으로 해소.** 처음 권고("맞는다" 확인을 1440×1100 창으로 옮김)는 받아들여지지 않았다. 판정: 시트는 넓은 폭(560) 그대로 묶음을 두 열로 놓고(묶음은 나누지 않음, 위→아래 다음 왼→오, `ORDER` 순서), 본문은 M3처럼 스크롤 영역·키보드 정지점으로 남으며, `sheets.spec`의 "1440×900에서 스크롤 없이 맞는다" 단언을 지킨다. Task 4 Step 3·11·12·13·14에 반영했다(추정 높이 ≈562px, ⌘F 뒤 ≈591, ⌥⌘I 뒤 ≈620).
- **K-4 `publisher`를 `json_extract`로 읽기(B.3). — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-24으로 해소.** SQLite의 `json_extract`는 잘 빚어지지 않은 JSON에서 오류를 던진다. 손상된 `metadata_json` 행 하나가 `library.list` 전체를 실패시킨다(지금 `library-repository.test.ts`의 "degrades corrupt stored metadata to empty without failing the list"가 지키는 성질). 권고: SQL은 바꾸지 않고, 이미 zod로 읽은 메타데이터에서 `toItem`이 `publisher: meta.publisher || null`을 채운다(손상·무효 메타데이터는 `null`). `searchTexts()`는 `CASE WHEN json_valid(...)`로 거른 뒤 같은 파서로 확인한다.
- **K-5 `library.find`의 이름. — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-25으로 해소.** 명세 4.1·6절은 편집 메뉴 항목을 "찾기"라 부르고, 계약 B.2는 레이블 '빠른 검색'이다(메뉴는 레이블을 그대로 쓴다). 권고: 계약대로 '빠른 검색'(키워드 검색·찾기·search·find). Task 13이 명세 4.1·6절 문장을 "편집 › 빠른 검색"으로 고친다.
- **K-7 조사 ‘…’와/과. — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-26으로 해소.** 명세 4.3 문구는 "‘<질의>’와"로 고정이지만 받침 있는 낱말 뒤에서는 틀린 한국어다("‘증폭’과"). 권고: `R/strings/josa.ts`의 `waGwa(word)`(한글 받침·숫자 읽기로 와/과, 그 밖은 와)로 고른다. Task 9의 팔레트 결과 없음 제목("‘<질의>’와 일치하는 자료·명령이 없습니다")도 같은 도우미를 쓴다.
- **K-8 `V/library.evidence.ts`의 공유 이름.** B.9는 각 작업이 절을 덧붙인다고만 한다. 권고: Task 3이 `shell.evidence.ts`와 같은 이름(`TAG = { tag: '@library' }`, 직렬 모드의 공유 세션 `s`, `results`, `check(name, ok, value)`, `guard(name, run)`, `save()` → `m4-library.json`)을 쓴다고 보고, 아래 절은 그 이름으로 썼다. 다르면 그 이름으로 바꾼다.
- **K-10 결과 개수의 자리. — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-27으로 해소.** "3개 / 48개"는 도구 막대(`MainWindow`)에, 걸러진 행은 `LibraryView`(`useLibraryRows`)에 있다. 권고: 두 곳이 같이 쓰는 `useSearch(items)` 훅(모듈 수준 캐시: 목록 배열마다 색인 하나, 색인마다 마지막 질의 하나)을 두고 `useLibraryRows`가 그것을 쓴다. B.4의 시그니처는 그대로다.
- **K-11 `seedMetadata`. — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-28으로 해소.** B.8의 `seedMetadata(page, itemId, metadata)`에 선택 인자 `title?: string`을 더한다(검색 E2E가 한국어 제목을 만든다). 기존 호출 모양은 그대로 유효하다.
- **K-13 `matchKorean`을 "함께 쓴다"(명세 4.2). — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-29으로 해소.** 후보 자리마다 `matchKorean`을 부르는 설계를 1만 항목(초록 30%)에서 재 보니 조합 중 낱말(신, 신ㅎ, 신호 전)이 질의마다 25–42ms였다(호출마다 로캘 소문자화와 배열 펼치기). 권고: 규칙은 `palette/hangul.ts` 그대로(`CHOSEONG`, `splitFinal`, `WORD_START`, `MATCH_RANK`)이되 색인이 그 규칙을 직접 적용하고, 단위 테스트가 제목 강조의 위치·종류가 `matchKorean`과 같음을 지킨다(재측정: p95 ≈6–8ms). `matchKorean`은 접기로 오프셋이 바뀐 제목에만 직접 쓴다. Task 13이 명세 4.2 문장을 "같은 규칙(`hangul.ts`)"으로 고친다.

---

Task 3이 만든 선택(`useLibrary.selected`)을 명령에 잇는다. 명세 3.3("선택 상태는 렌더러 저장소 하나가 가진다 … 목록이 바뀌어 사라진 id와 검색으로 가려진 id는 그 자리에서 선택에서 뺀다", "돌아왔을 때 마지막으로 연 자료의 행을 보이게 스크롤한다"), 명세 6절(⇧⌘R, 파일 메뉴, "메뉴 막대 항목은 리더 보기에서 비활성", "⌘/ 단축키 시트는 레지스트리에서 나오므로 새 단축키가 저절로 들어간다(시트 높이가 커지는지 확인한다)" — 시트는 넓은 폭에 두 열로 놓여 1440×900에 스크롤 없이 맞는다), 디자인 명세 7.3·7.4(라이브러리 ⇧⌘R)와 판정 P-2(실제 선택), P-14, P-15, P-17(개수는 저장소 선택자에서), P-18, P-30을 구현한다. 렌더러는 선택을 세 개수(`selectionCount`·`selectionAvailable`·`selectionRelinkable`)로 보고하고, main의 메뉴 막대는 Task 2의 `selectionTargets`로(라이브러리 보기에서만 — 리더에서는 Task 2가 끈다) 판정하며, 메뉴·팔레트에서 실행된 자료 명령은 표 순서의 선택 id로 돈다(Task 2의 `menuTarget`, 이 작업의 팔레트). 범위 밖: 새 명령(`item.exportCopy`는 Task 8, `item.editInfo`는 Task 7), 검색으로 가려진 행의 정리(`LibraryView`가 행이 바뀔 때마다 Task 3의 `pruneSelected`를 부르게 여기서 잇고, Task 5가 검색으로 행을 바꾼다), 인스펙터(Task 6), 열기 동작 자체(Task 3).

- [ ] **Step 3: ⌘/ 시트 — '자료' 묶음(P-14)과 두 열(K-3 판정)**

'자료' 묶음이 더해지면 한 열의 시트는 ≈772px에서 ≈848px가 되어 1440×900 창(Linux 시트 최대 900 − 76 = 824px, Mac은 806pt 부모에서 806 − 32 = 774pt)을 넘는다. 시트 창은 이미 넓은 폭이다(`SHEET_WIDTH.shortcuts = 560`, 디자인 명세 6 시트 "폭 440(넓게 560)"). 그 폭에 묶음을 **두 열**로 놓는다: 묶음은 나누지 않고, 첫 열을 위에서 아래로 읽은 뒤 둘째 열(`ORDER` 순서 그대로), 높은 쪽 열이 가장 낮아지는 자리에서 나눈다. 본문(`.d-body`)은 M3처럼 스크롤 영역이자 키보드 정지점으로 남는다(내용보다 작은 창에서). 높이 추정(묶음 = 머리 24 + 카드 8 + 행 28 × n + 구분선, 묶음 사이 16; 제목 줄 53, 본문 여백 27, 아래 줄 56): 이 작업 ≈562px(왼쪽 앱 7 + 라이브러리 5 = 426, 오른쪽 자료·리더·대화상자 = 270), Task 5의 ⌘F 뒤 ≈591px, Task 6의 ⌥⌘I 뒤 ≈620px(Linux는 "사이드바 보기/가리기"가 `Ctrl Shift S` 옆에서 두 줄이 되어 +8). 모두 824px·774pt 안이다.

`t.sheets.groups.item`('자료')은 이미 있다(`R/strings/sheets.ts:10`). 파일 끝에:
```ts
/** A group's height as sheet.css draws it: its label (16 + 8), the card (4 + 4) and 28 px rows with 1 px between. */
const groupHeight = (g: ShortcutGroup): number => 31 + 29 * g.rows.length;
const GROUP_GAP = 16;
const columnHeight = (groups: readonly ShortcutGroup[]): number => groups.reduce((h, g, i) => h + groupHeight(g) + (i > 0 ? GROUP_GAP : 0), 0);

/**
 * The wide sheet's two columns (design-spec 6 시트, 넓게 560): the groups in ORDER, read down the first column and then
 * the second, never split; cut where the taller column is shortest, so the sheet stays short as commands are added.
 */
export function shortcutColumns(groups: readonly ShortcutGroup[]): [ShortcutGroup[], ShortcutGroup[]] {
  if (groups.length < 2) return [[...groups], []];
  let cut = 1;
  let best = Infinity;
  for (let k = 1; k < groups.length; k++) {
    const taller = Math.max(columnHeight(groups.slice(0, k)), columnHeight(groups.slice(k)));
    if (taller < best) {
      best = taller;
      cut = k;
    }
  }
  return [groups.slice(0, cut), groups.slice(cut)];
}
```

```ts
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { sortItems, type LibrarySort } from './sort';

/** The table selection as the command context reports it: flat numbers, so a report compares field by field. */
export interface SelectionCounts {
  count: number;
  /** Of those: the file is there (what Finder에서 보기 and 기본 앱으로 열기 need). */
  available: number;
  /** Of those: a linked file that went missing (what 다시 연결… needs). */
  relinkable: number;
}

const NONE: SelectionCounts = Object.freeze({ count: 0, available: 0, relinkable: 0 });

/** Counts only the selected rows still in the list: an id the list lost enables nothing. */
export function selectionCounts(items: readonly LibraryItem[], selected: ReadonlySet<string>): SelectionCounts {
  if (selected.size === 0) return NONE;
  let count = 0;
  let available = 0;
  let relinkable = 0;
  for (const i of items) {
    if (!selected.has(i.id)) continue;
    count += 1;
    if (i.availability === 'available') available += 1;
    else if (i.storageMode === 'linked') relinkable += 1;
  }
  return { count, available, relinkable };
}

/**
 * The selection in table order: the sort is a total order (ties by date added, then id), so the selected rows keep
 * the places they have among all rows. Menu and palette commands get their targets in this order.
 */
export function inTableOrder(items: readonly LibraryItem[], selected: ReadonlySet<string>, sort: LibrarySort): string[] {
  if (selected.size === 0) return [];
  return sortItems(items.filter((i) => selected.has(i.id)), sort).map((i) => i.id);
}
```

`R/data/targets.ts` 전체:
```ts
import type { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { keys } from './queries';

/** One id index per list array: a refetched list is a new array, so its index is built once and dropped with it. */
const indexes = new WeakMap<readonly LibraryItem[], ReadonlyMap<string, LibraryItem>>();
function byId(list: readonly LibraryItem[]): ReadonlyMap<string, LibraryItem> {
  let index = indexes.get(list);
  if (!index) {
    index = new Map(list.map((i) => [i.id, i]));
    indexes.set(list, index);
  }
  return index;
}

/**
 * Command targets for `itemIds` from the freshest fact: the item's own read (library.get re-checks the file on disk)
 * while it is current, otherwise the list row. An invalidated read is a change announced since (libraryChanged) that
 * the inactive item query has not re-read: the list, read again, knows better.
 */
export function freshTargets(client: QueryClient, list: readonly LibraryItem[], itemIds: readonly string[]): LibraryItem[] {
  const rows = byId(list);
  return itemIds.flatMap((id) => {
    const read = client.getQueryState<LibraryItem>(keys.item(id));
    const current = read && !read.isInvalidated ? read.data : undefined;
    return current ?? rows.get(id) ?? [];
  });
}
```

`R/library/tableDom.ts`(새):
```ts
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { afterPaint } from '../ui/afterPaint';

/** One table per window. Its rows outside the viewport are not in the DOM: the virtualizer draws them on scroll. */
const GRID = '[data-testid="library-table"]';
const rowEl = (id: string) => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`${GRID} [data-testid="item-row"][data-item-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);

/** What scrolls the rows: the grid itself (`div.library-table[role=grid]` is the scroll element; its header is sticky). */
export function tableScroller(): HTMLElement | null {
  return document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(GRID);
}

/** The scrollTop that puts row `index` in the middle of a `viewport`-tall view (never above the top). */
export function centredScrollTop(index: number, rowHeight: number, viewport: number): number {
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(index * rowHeight - (viewport - rowHeight) / 2));
}

/** Whole below the sticky column header and above the view's bottom edge. */
function fullyShown(row: HTMLElement, scroller: HTMLElement): boolean {
  const r = row.getBoundingClientRect();
  const view = scroller.getBoundingClientRect();
  const top = scroller.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="columnheader"]')?.getBoundingClientRect().bottom ?? view.top;
  return r.top >= top && r.bottom <= view.bottom;
}

/**
 * Brings row `index` (`id`) fully into view, centred, unless it already is. A row that is not drawn yet is first
 * scrolled near its place (rows have one height), so the virtualizer draws it; the next painted frame centres it exactly.
 */
export function revealRow(index: number, id: string): void {
  const scroller = tableScroller();
  if (!scroller) return;
  const shown = rowEl(id);
  if (shown && fullyShown(shown, scroller)) return;
  if (!shown) {
    const height = scroller.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="item-row"]')?.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? 28;
    scroller.scrollTop = centredScrollTop(index, height, scroller.clientHeight);
  }
  afterPaint(() => rowEl(id)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }));
}

/**
 * Once per mount (the table mounts again on the return from the reader): shows `revealId`'s row after a painted frame,
 * when the virtualizer has measured its viewport. Marked done only when it ran: StrictMode's second mount cancels the
 * first mount's pending frame.
 */
export function useRevealRow(rows: readonly LibraryItem[], revealId: string | null | undefined): void {
  const done = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (done.current || !revealId) return;
    const index = rows.findIndex((r) => r.id === revealId);
    if (index < 0) {
      done.current = true;
      return;
    }
    return afterPaint(() => {
      done.current = true;
      revealRow(index, revealId);
    });
  }, [rows, revealId]);
}
```

```ts
// 기본 앱으로 열기, their palette rows, the ⌘/ sheet's 자료 group, rows that leave the list, and the return from the

import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  FIXTURES, closeSheet, expectWindow, importPaths, launch, menuItemEnabled, menuSnapshot, openItem, rowAt, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, seedLibrary, selectRows,
} from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const KO_TITLE = '한글 경로 (테스트) #1';
const IS_MAC = process.platform === 'darwin';
const REVEAL = IS_MAC ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기';
const dirs = (i: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [i.outputPath('library'), i.outputPath('userdata')] as const;

test.beforeAll(() => {
  for (const f of [PDF, KO_PDF]) if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`fixture missing: ${f} — run \`pnpm fixtures\``);
});

/** Record shell calls in main instead of opening Finder or another app. */
async function stubShell(app: ElectronApplication): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ shell }) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __learnShell?: Array<[string, string]> };
    g.__learnShell = [];
    shell.showItemInFolder = (p: string) => void g.__learnShell!.push(['reveal', p]);
    shell.openPath = async (p: string) => {
      g.__learnShell!.push(['open', p]);
      return '';
    };
  });
}
const shellCalls = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnShell?: Array<[string, string]> }).__learnShell ?? []);
/** 파일 › Finder에서 보기 and 기본 앱으로 열기: enabled or not, in that order. */
const fileItems = (app: ElectronApplication) => Promise.all([menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.showInFolder'), menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.openExternally')]);
const selectedRows = (page: import('@playwright/test').Page) => page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]');

test('파일 › Finder에서 보기 (⇧⌘R) and 기본 앱으로 열기 follow the selection: one row whose file is there, never none, two, a missing file or the reader', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await stubShell(app);
    await importPaths(page, [PDF, KO_PDF]);
    // A linked copy whose file then goes: 파일 없음 once main has checked it again.
    const gone = testInfo.outputPath('gone.pdf');
    fs.copyFileSync(PDF, gone);
    const linked = await page.evaluate((p) => window.learn.library.import({ paths: [p], mode: 'linked', allowDuplicate: true }), gone);
    if (!linked.ok || linked.data[0]?.status !== 'imported') throw new Error('linked import failed');
    const goneId = linked.data[0].item.id;
    fs.rmSync(gone);
    await page.evaluate((itemId) => window.learn.library.get({ itemId }), goneId);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('missing-flag')).toHaveCount(1);

    // The menu bar carries both, with ⇧⌘R, greyed while nothing is selected.
    const file = (await menuSnapshot(app)).find((m) => m.label === '파일')!.submenu!;
    expect(file.find((n) => n.id === 'item.showInFolder')).toMatchObject({ label: REVEAL, accelerator: 'Shift+CmdOrCtrl+R', enabled: false });
    expect(file.find((n) => n.id === 'item.openExternally')).toMatchObject({ label: '기본 앱으로 열기', accelerator: null, enabled: false });

    // One row whose file is there: both run on it, each with the named copy the OS can open (design-spec 10.7).
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await expect.poll(() => fileItems(app)).toEqual([true, true]);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.showInFolder');
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.openExternally');
    await expect.poll(() => shellCalls(app)).toHaveLength(2);
    const calls = await shellCalls(app);
    expect(calls.map(([kind]) => kind)).toEqual(['reveal', 'open']);
    for (const [, p] of calls) expect(p).toMatch(/[\\/]derived[\\/]open[\\/][0-9a-f-]{36}[\\/]sample\.pdf$/);

    // Two rows: the one-item commands grey (a menu item that cannot run now is grey, the macOS way).
    await selectRows(page, ['sample', KO_TITLE], { modifier: 'Meta' });
    await expect(selectedRows(page)).toHaveCount(2);
    await expect.poll(() => fileItems(app)).toEqual([false, false]);

    // The linked row whose file went missing: nothing to show or open (다시 연결… is in its context menu).
    await rowByTitle(page, 'gone').click();
    await expect(selectedRows(page)).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect.poll(() => fileItems(app)).toEqual([false, false]);

    // In the reader the table is not on screen: the selection waits, and the menu bar's item commands grey.
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await expect.poll(() => fileItems(app)).toEqual([true, true]);
    await openItem(page, 'sample');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('pdf-canvas')).toBeVisible();
    await expect.poll(() => fileItems(app)).toEqual([false, false]);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'nav.back');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'sample')).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect.poll(() => fileItems(app)).toEqual([true, true]);
    expect((await shellCalls(app)).length).toBe(2); // nothing else ran on the way
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the palette lists 폴더에서 보기 and 기본 앱으로 열기 for one selected row and runs them on it; never 열기 or 다시 연결…', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  const ids = () => page.getByTestId('palette-item').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-command-id')));
  try {
    await stubShell(app);
    await importPaths(page, [PDF, KO_PDF]);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(2);
    // Nothing selected: no item rows.
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-item').first()).toBeVisible();
    expect(await ids()).not.toContain('item.showInFolder');
    expect(await ids()).not.toContain('item.openExternally');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    // Two selected: still none (each needs exactly one row).
    await selectRows(page, ['sample', KO_TITLE], { modifier: 'Meta' });
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-item').first()).toBeVisible();
    expect(await ids()).not.toContain('item.showInFolder');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    // One selected: both rows; 열기 and 다시 연결… belong to the table and the notices.
    await rowByTitle(page, KO_TITLE).click();
    await expect(selectedRows(page)).toHaveCount(1);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    await expect.poll(ids).toContain('item.showInFolder');
    const listed = await ids();
    expect(listed).toContain('item.openExternally');
    expect(listed).not.toContain('item.open');
    expect(listed).not.toContain('item.relink');
    // ㄱㅂ: 기본 앱으로 열기 by its 초성, run on the selected row.
    await page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill('ㄱㅂ');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-item').first()).toHaveAttribute('data-command-id', 'item.openExternally');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette')).toBeHidden();
    await expect.poll(() => shellCalls(app)).toHaveLength(1);
    const [[kind, p]] = (await shellCalls(app)) as [[string, string]];
    expect(kind).toBe('open');
    expect(p).toMatch(/[\\/]한글 경로 \(테스트\) #1\.pdf$/);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the ⌘/ sheet lists the selected row’s shortcut under 자료 (design-spec 7.4)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const sheet = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.shortcuts'));
    const group = sheet.locator('section[aria-label="자료"]');
    await expect(group.getByTestId('shortcut-row')).toHaveText([new RegExp(`^${REVEAL}`)]);
    await expect(group.locator('.visually-hidden')).toHaveText(IS_MAC ? '⇧⌘R' : 'Ctrl+Shift+R');
    // 자료 follows 라이브러리 (design-spec 7.4 lists ⇧⌘R with the library keys).
    const titles = await sheet.locator('section[aria-label]').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('aria-label')));
    expect(titles).toEqual(['앱', '라이브러리', '자료', '리더', '팔레트·대화상자']);
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('rows that leave the list leave the selection: nothing then targets them, and a row that comes back is not selected (spec 3.3)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [sample] = await importPaths(page, [PDF, KO_PDF]);
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.showInFolder')).toBe(true);
    // Main moves it to the trash (the command comes with M6; the channel is there): the list is read again without it.
    expect(await page.evaluate((itemId) => window.learn.library.trash({ itemIds: [itemId] }), sample!.id)).toMatchObject({ ok: true, data: 1 });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(selectedRows(page)).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.showInFolder')).toBe(false);
    expect(await menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.openExternally')).toBe(false);
    expect(await page.evaluate((itemId) => window.learn.library.restore({ itemIds: [itemId] }), sample!.id)).toMatchObject({ ok: true, data: 1 });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(2);
    await expect(selectedRows(page)).toHaveCount(0);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('back from the reader the selection stays and the last opened row is scrolled into view (spec 3.3)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [first] = await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await seedLibrary(app, { count: 300, from: first! });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText(/^3\d\d개$/);
    // The last row, by keyboard: End moves the cursor and the selection there (spec 3.3), ↩ opens it.
    await rowAt(page, 0).click(); // by data-index: the DOM order of a virtual table is not the screen order
    await page.keyboard.press('End');
    await expect(selectedRows(page)).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(selectedRows(page)).toHaveAttribute('data-index', /^3\d\d$/);
    const id = (await selectedRows(page).getAttribute('data-item-id'))!;
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('pdf-canvas')).toBeVisible();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'nav.back');
    // The table mounted again at its top, where that row is not even drawn: it is brought back into view.
    const row = page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-item-id="${id}"]`);
    await expect(row).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(row).toBeInViewport({ ratio: 1 });
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```
Run: `pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/selection-commands.spec.ts`
Expected: 5 passed. 하나라도 실패하면 그 테스트의 주석이 가리키는 단계를 고친다(메뉴 상태는 Step 7, 팔레트는 Step 8, 정리·스크롤은 Step 9).

- [ ] **Step 11: 깨지는 기존 테스트 고치기**

1. `E/platform.spec.ts`의 `menu: Korean top-level menus …` 테스트에서 `파일` 기대값:
```ts
    expect(entries(topMenu(menu, '파일'))).toEqual([
      [null, '파일 가져오기…'], [null, '외부 파일 연결…'], ['-', ''],
      [null, IS_MAC ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기'], [null, '기본 앱으로 열기'], ['-', ''],
      ...(IS_MAC ? [] : [[null, '설정…'], ['-', '']]), ['close', IS_MAC ? '윈도우 닫기' : '창 닫기'],
    ]);
```
   (그 위의 레지스트리 반복문은 그대로 맞다: 빈 라이브러리에서 두 항목은 `enabled: false`이고 `isCommandAvailable(c.id, …)`도 표적 없이 거짓이다.)

2. `E/sheets.spec.ts`(K-3 판정: 1440×900에서 스크롤 없이 맞는다는 단언은 그대로 지킨다)
   - `a ⌘/ sheet whose list scrolls (a short window) …` 테스트의 앞 절반 — 두 열이 된 시트는 최소 높이(600) 창에서 Mac 방(600 − 32 = 568)에 맞을 수 있어(≈562) 스크롤을 만들지 못한다. 첫 줄 주석 다음의
```ts
    await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.setContentSize(1200, 600));
```
   을
```ts
    // Two columns (Task 4) fit even a 600-tall window on macOS (room 568): the minimum goes down for this half only.
    await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => {
      w.setMinimumSize(800, 400);
      w.setContentSize(1200, 480);
    });
```
   로(그 위 주석 "A window as short as the minimum makes it scroll here too."는 "A 480-tall window makes it scroll on every platform."로).
   - 같은 테스트의 끝 절반 — 지금
```ts
    // The ⌘/ sheet as well, in a window tall enough for the whole list (1440 × 900). The 768-tall Mac runner has no such
    // room (its work area is 684 tall): there the list scrolls at any size, which the first half covers; an ≈806-tall
    // parent stays a manual check (critique, m3-08b-806).
    await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.setContentSize(1440, 900));
    const room = await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.getContentSize()[1] ?? 0);
    sheet = await open();
    if (room >= 900) await fitsNoStop(sheet);
    else {
      expect(process.platform, 'only the Mac runner lacks the room').toBe('darwin');
      await expect(sheet.locator('.d-body')).toHaveAttribute('role', 'region');
    }
```
   을
```ts
    // The ⌘/ sheet as well, in a window as tall as 1440 × 900 allows: in two columns (≈ 562 px with 자료, ≈ 591 with ⌘F,
    // ≈ 620 with ⌥⌘I) it fits with no scrolling everywhere — Linux (room 824), the 768-tall Mac runner (work area 684,
    // room 652) and a 1440 × 900 Mac's ≈ 806-tall parent (room 774; critique, m3-08b-806).
    await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.setContentSize(1440, 900));
    sheet = await open();
    await fitsNoStop(sheet);
```
   로 바꾼다.
   - 같은 파일에 새 테스트(가져오기에 이미 있는 `launch`, `mainWindow`, `expectWindow`, `runMenuCommand`, `closeSheet`):
```ts
test('the ⌘/ sheet lays its groups out in two columns, read down then across, none split, and fits a 1440 × 900 window', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.setContentSize(1440, 900));
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.shortcuts'));
    const columns = await sheet.evaluate(() =>
      [...document.querySelectorAll('.shortcut-column')].map((column) =>
        [...column.querySelectorAll('section')].map((section) => {
          const box = section.getBoundingClientRect();
          const rows = [...section.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="shortcut-row"]')].map((row) => row.getBoundingClientRect());
          return {
            title: section.getAttribute('aria-label'),
            left: Math.round(box.left),
            right: Math.round(box.right),
            whole: rows.length > 0 && rows.every((r) => r.left >= box.left - 0.5 && r.right <= box.right + 0.5 && r.top >= box.top - 0.5 && r.bottom <= box.bottom + 0.5),
          };
        }),
      ),
    );
    // Read down the first column, then the second, in the sheet's order (shortcuts.ts ORDER).
    expect(columns.map((c) => c.map((g) => g.title))).toEqual([['앱', '라이브러리'], ['자료', '리더', '팔레트·대화상자']]);
    // A group never splits: every section lies in one column with all its rows; the columns sit side by side.
    for (const g of columns.flat()) expect(g.whole, `${g.title}`).toBe(true);
    expect(new Set(columns[0]!.map((g) => g.left)).size).toBe(1);
    expect(new Set(columns[1]!.map((g) => g.left)).size).toBe(1);
    expect(columns[1]![0]!.left).toBeGreaterThan(columns[0]![0]!.right);
    // Short enough for every 1440 × 900 room (estimate ≈ 562 px now; ≈ 620 after ⌘F and ⌥⌘I): no scrolling.
    const body = sheet.locator('.d-body');
    expect(await body.evaluate((el) => el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight)).toBe(false);
    const natural = await sheet.evaluate(() => Math.ceil(document.querySelector('[data-sheet-root]')!.getBoundingClientRect().height));
    expect(natural).toBeLessThanOrEqual(700);
    console.log(`[measure] ⌘/ sheet natural height: ${natural} px`);
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```
   (구현자는 콘솔의 `[measure]` 값을 커밋 본문에 적는다 — 추정 ≈562px와 다르면 Step 3의 추정과 이 경계를 고친다.)

3. `E/commands-coverage.spec.ts`(P-30) — 메뉴 막대의 자료 명령은 선택이 있어야 켜진다.
   - 가져오기 줄에 `menuItemEnabled`, `rowByTitle`를 더한다(`./helpers`).
   - `try {` 안에 있는 두 줄 `const shellCalls = () => …`와 `const shellPaths = () => …`(지금 101·103행, 주석 포함)를 `const effects` 바로 위로 옮긴다(`app`만 쓴다). `effects`에 두 줄을 더한다:
```ts
    // On the selected sample row: the OS is asked to show, then to open, its named copy (파일 menu order).
    'item.showInFolder': () => expect.poll(shellCalls).toEqual(['reveal']),
    'item.openExternally': () => expect.poll(shellCalls).toEqual(['reveal', 'open']),
```
   - 반복문 `for (const view of ['library', 'reader'] as const) {` 의 첫 줄 `if (view === 'reader') await openItem(page, 'sample');` 다음에:
```ts
      // 파일 › Finder에서 보기 and 기본 앱으로 열기 act on the table selection: select the row first, wait for main's menu.
      if (view === 'library') {
        await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
        await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.showInFolder')).toBe(true);
      }
```
   - 반복문 뒤 `await expect(page.getByTestId('library-table')).toBeVisible(); // nav.back ran last` 다음에:
```ts
    // The menu-bar runs handed the OS the named copy (final review I1), like the item menu below.
    for (const p of (await shellPaths()).slice(0, 2)) expect(p).toMatch(/[\\/]derived[\\/]open[\\/][0-9a-f-]{36}[\\/]sample\.pdf$/);
```
   - 항목 컨텍스트 메뉴의 Finder에서 보기 단언 `await expect.poll(shellCalls).toEqual(['reveal']);`을 `['reveal', 'open', 'reveal']`로, 바로 아래 `(await shellPaths())[0]`을 `(await shellPaths())[2]`로.
   - `codec-open` 단언 `await expect.poll(shellCalls).toEqual(['reveal', 'open']);`을 `['reveal', 'open', 'reveal', 'open']`로, 아래 두 곳의 `(await shellPaths())[1]`을 `(await shellPaths())[3]`로.
   - 리더 반복에서는 Task 2의 `availableMenuCommands`가 자료 명령을 끄므로(선택은 남아 있어도) 두 명령이 `enabledMenuCommands`에 나오지 않는다 — 고칠 것 없음.

- [ ] **Step 13: 증거** `V/library.evidence.ts`

Task 3이 만든 파일의 마지막(판정) 테스트 앞에 더한다(K-8의 이름: `s`, `TAG`, `results`, `check`, `guard`, `save`). 파일의 가져오기에 없는 것을 더한다: `../e2e/helpers`에서 `NativeInputNotPermitted, bringAppToFront, closeSheet, expectWindow, menuItemEnabled, nativeKeystroke, runMenuCommand`, `./capture`에서 `IS_MAC, captureOpenMenu, fullScreenShot`, 그리고 `path`·`FIXTURES`(`const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');`가 없으면 그 줄도).
```ts
// Task 4: the selection's commands. On macOS: the 파일 menu with one selected row and with none, a real ⇧⌘R
// (System Events), the ⌘/ sheet's 자료 group. Elsewhere the same states through the menu path, captures skipped.
test('M4 library: 파일 › Finder에서 보기 ⇧⌘R and 기본 앱으로 열기 with one selected row and with none; a real ⇧⌘R; ⌘/ lists it under 자료', TAG, async () => {
  test.setTimeout(180_000);
  const v: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  results['selection'] = v;
  await s.app.evaluate(({ shell }) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __learnShell?: Array<[string, string]> };
    g.__learnShell = [];
    shell.showItemInFolder = (p: string) => void g.__learnShell!.push(['reveal', p]);
    shell.openPath = async (p: string) => {
      g.__learnShell!.push(['open', p]);
      return '';
    };
  });
  const shellCalls = () => s.app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnShell?: Array<[string, string]> }).__learnShell ?? []);
  const fileItems = async () => [await menuItemEnabled(s.app, 'item.showInFolder'), await menuItemEnabled(s.app, 'item.openExternally')];
  // A row of its own, whatever the session already holds (same content: allowDuplicate).
  const imported = await s.page.evaluate((p) => window.learn.library.import({ paths: [p], mode: 'managed', allowDuplicate: true }), PDF);
  const id = imported.ok && imported.data[0]?.status === 'imported' ? imported.data[0].item.id : null;
  check('selection: a row to select was imported', id !== null, imported.ok ? imported.data.map((o) => o.status) : imported.code);
  if (id === null) return void save();
  const row = s.page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-item-id="${id}"]`);
  const pid = s.app.process().pid!;

  await guard('selection: one selected row enables both 파일 items', async () => {
    await row.click();
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(s.app, 'item.showInFolder')).toBe(true);
    v['enabledWithOne'] = await fileItems();
    check('selection: one selected row enables both 파일 items', (v['enabledWithOne'] as boolean[]).every(Boolean), v['enabledWithOne']);
  });
  if (IS_MAC) {
    await guard('selection: the 파일 menu with one selected row', async () => {
      await bringAppToFront(s.app);
      const captured = await captureOpenMenu(s.app, pid, 3, 'm4-04-menu-file-one', '파일 menu, one selected row');
      const names = captured.keyboard.open.names ?? [];
      v['fileMenuOne'] = { names, shots: [captured.click.shot, captured.keyboard.shot] };
      check('selection: 파일 lists Finder에서 보기 and 기본 앱으로 열기', names.includes('Finder에서 보기') && names.includes('기본 앱으로 열기'), v['fileMenuOne']);
    });
    await guard('selection: a real ⇧⌘R reveals the selected row', async () => {
      const before = (await shellCalls()).length;
      let note: string | undefined;
      try {
        await bringAppToFront(s.app);
        await nativeKeystroke(s.app, 'r', ['shift', 'command']);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted)) throw e;
        note = 'keystroke not permitted: ran from the menu instead';
        await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'item.showInFolder');
      }
      await expect.poll(async () => (await shellCalls()).length, { timeout: 5_000 }).toBeGreaterThan(before);
      const call = (await shellCalls())[before];
      v['realShiftCmdR'] = { native: note === undefined, kind: call?.[0] ?? null, namedCopy: /[\\/]sample\.pdf$/.test(call?.[1] ?? ''), ...(note ? { note } : {}) };
      check('selection: ⇧⌘R reveals the selected row', call?.[0] === 'reveal' && /[\\/]sample\.pdf$/.test(call[1]), v['realShiftCmdR']);
    });
  } else {
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'item.showInFolder');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await shellCalls()).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  }
  await guard('selection: no selected row greys both 파일 items', async () => {
    await row.click({ modifiers: [IS_MAC ? 'Meta' : 'Control'] }); // toggles the one selected row off
    await expect(row).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(s.app, 'item.showInFolder')).toBe(false);
    v['enabledWithNone'] = await fileItems();
    check('selection: no selected row greys both 파일 items', (v['enabledWithNone'] as boolean[]).every((e) => !e), v['enabledWithNone']);
    if (IS_MAC) {
      const captured = await captureOpenMenu(s.app, pid, 3, 'm4-04b-menu-file-none', '파일 menu, nothing selected');
      v['fileMenuNone'] = { names: captured.keyboard.open.names, shots: [captured.click.shot, captured.keyboard.shot] };
    }
  });
  await guard('selection: ⌘/ lists ⇧⌘R under 자료', async () => {
    const sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.shortcuts'));
    const rows = await sheet.locator('section[aria-label="자료"] [data-testid="shortcut-row"]').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.textContent ?? ''));
    v['sheetItemGroup'] = rows;
    check('selection: ⌘/ lists ⇧⌘R under 자료', rows.length === 1 && rows[0]!.startsWith(IS_MAC ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기'), rows);
    // Two columns, groups whole, and a natural height that fits a 1440 × 900 Mac's ≈ 806 pt parent (room 774).
    const layout = await sheet.evaluate(() => ({
      columns: [...document.querySelectorAll('.shortcut-column')].map((c) => [...c.querySelectorAll('section')].map((g) => g.getAttribute('aria-label'))),
      natural: Math.ceil(document.querySelector('[data-sheet-root]')!.getBoundingClientRect().height),
    }));
    v['sheetLayout'] = layout;
    check('selection: the ⌘/ sheet has two columns and fits the 806 pt room', layout.columns.length === 2 && layout.natural <= 774, layout);
    if (IS_MAC) await fullScreenShot('m4-04c-sheet-shortcuts', '⌘/ sheet: two columns, the 자료 group after 라이브러리');
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
  });
  save();
});
```

### Task 5: 빠른 검색 — 색인, 출판사와 긴 글, ⌘F, 도구 막대 필드, "N개 / M개", 결과 없음, 제목 강조, IME

명세 4.1–4.3(자리와 동작, 일치 규칙, 결과 없음), 4.2의 규칙(NFC → 소문자 → 공백 하나, 초성, 낱말 AND, 2글자 부분 일치, 정렬은 표 그대로, 제목 `<mark>`, `useDeferredValue`), 3.5(빈 라이브러리에는 필드가 없다), 6절 `library.find`(⌘F, 편집 메뉴), 9절(검색 입력 → 그리기 p95 ≤ 50ms, 메타데이터 검색 p95 ≤ 300ms at 1만), 디자인 명세 2.4(가져오기 → 검색 필드 240 → 패널 토글, 검색 중 개수 "0개 / 48개"), 6(검색 필드, 빈 상태 형식), 7.1(type-ahead 대신 ⌘F), 7.4(⌘F, IME 조합 중 무시), 10.1(빠른 검색, 검색 결과 없음)과 판정 P-7, P-26, P-27을 구현한다. 색인은 목록이 바뀔 때 한 번(그리고 긴 글이 처음 올 때 한 번 더) 만들고, 질의는 종류마다 이어 붙인 문자열 하나를 브라우저의 `indexOf`로 훑는다(짧은 필드 문자열, 그 초성 문자열, 긴 필드 문자열). 낱말은 팔레트의 `matchKorean`과 같은 읽기로 찾는다(글자는 그 글자, 초성은 그 초성으로 시작하는 음절, 마지막 음절이 아직 조합 중일 수 있으면 나눈 읽기도: 갖 → 가ㅈ). 초성이 든 읽기는 초성 문자열에서 자리를 찾고 그 자리의 글자만 비교한다(K-13: 후보마다 `matchKorean`을 부르면 1만 항목에서 질의마다 25–42ms였다). `matchKorean`은 접기로 오프셋이 바뀐 드문 제목의 강조에 쓰고, 일치 테스트가 둘의 위치·종류가 같음을 지킨다. 이 계획 작성 중 측정(노드, 1만 항목·초록 30%): 색인 ≈150–240ms(창이 한가할 때 미리), 질의 p95 ≈6–8ms. 검색으로 가려진 행은 Task 4의 정리로 선택에서 빠진다. 팔레트 규칙과 같아서 "시"는 "신호"를 찾지 않는다(받침이 붙기 전의 음절은 그 음절 그대로 찾는다 — 명세 4.2, M3 `matchKorean`). 범위 밖: 팔레트의 자료 결과와 "라이브러리에서 ‘…’ 검색 ⌘F" 행(Task 9 — 이 작업의 `search.ts`·`focusQuickSearch`를 쓴다), 태그(M5, 자리표시 문구도), 본문 검색(M7), "내 라이브러리 전체에서 찾기"(M5), 1만 항목 `@perf` 측정(Task 10 — 여기서는 단위 벤치만).

`packages/db/src/library-repository.ts` — 가져오기에 `type SearchText`(`@learn/domain`)를 더한다. `toItem`의 `year: yearOf(meta),` 다음에 `publisher: meta.publisher || null,`(K-4: SQL은 그대로, 이미 읽은 메타데이터에서). `listItems()` 다음에:
```ts
  /**
   * Quick search's long fields (spec 4.2): abstract and memo of the live items that have either. SQLite drops the rest
   * first; `json_valid` comes first in a CASE because json_extract throws on malformed JSON. The schema still decides
   * (a stored value that no longer parses reads as empty, as everywhere else).
   */
  searchTexts(): SearchText[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT id, metadata_json FROM items
         WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
           AND CASE WHEN json_valid(metadata_json)
                    THEN coalesce(json_extract(metadata_json, '$.abstract'), '') || coalesce(json_extract(metadata_json, '$.extra'), '')
                    ELSE '' END <> ''`,
      )
      .all() as Array<{ id: string; metadata_json: string }>;
    return rows.flatMap((r) => {
      const meta = parseItemMetadata(r.metadata_json);
      const abstract = meta.abstract || null;
      const extra = meta.extra || null;
      return abstract || extra ? [{ id: r.id, abstract, extra }] : [];
    });
  }
```
Run: 같은 명령 → PASS. (기존 "round-trips metadata" 테스트의 `toEqual(updated)`는 양쪽에 `publisher: 'MIT'`가 함께 들어가 그대로 맞다.)

먼저 `R/palette/hangul.ts` 40행 `const WORD_START = /[\s(‘“/·-]/;`를 `export const WORD_START = /[\s(‘“/·-]/;`로(제목 일치의 종류를 팔레트와 같은 규칙으로 정한다). 그리고 Task 4의 `R/library/selection.test.ts` 고정물 `item(…)`에 `publisher: null,`을 더한다(`year: null,` 다음, Step 2로 필수 필드가 됐다). Task 3이 만든 다른 `LibraryItem` 고정물(예: `sort.test.ts`)도 `pnpm typecheck`가 알리는 곳마다 같은 한 줄을 더한다.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { LibraryItem, SearchText } from '@learn/domain';
import { matchKorean } from '../palette/hangul';
import { buildSearchIndex, foldText, parseQuery, search, searchCached, searchIndexFor } from './search';

let seq = 0;
const item = (over: Partial<LibraryItem> & { title: string }): LibraryItem => {
  seq += 1;
  const id = `id-${seq}`;
  return {
    id, type: 'pdf', mime: 'application/pdf', size: 1, storageMode: 'managed', availability: 'available', assetId: `a-${id}`, revisionId: `r-${id}`,
    originalName: `${id}.pdf`, createdAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', updatedAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', creators: [], year: null,
    publisher: null, tagIds: [], progress: null, openedAt: null, ...over,
  };
};

const SIGNAL = item({ title: '세포 신호 전달 개요', creators: ['김철수'], year: 2024, publisher: '분자생물학회', originalName: 'cell-signal.pdf' });
const FOLD = item({ title: '단백질 접힘 강의 노트', creators: ['이영희', 'Lee'], year: 2023, publisher: 'Learn Press', originalName: '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf' });
const BAYES = item({ title: 'Intro to Bayesian Inference', creators: ['Jane Smith'], year: 2021, originalName: 'sample-h264-aac.mp4' });
const PHOTO = item({ title: '광합성 명반응', originalName: 'photo.mp4' });
const JOINED = item({ title: '세포신호전달', originalName: 'joined.pdf' });
const PRACTICE = item({ title: '가져오기 연습', originalName: 'practice.pdf' });
const ITEMS = [SIGNAL, FOLD, BAYES, PHOTO, JOINED, PRACTICE];
const TEXTS: SearchText[] = [{ id: SIGNAL.id, abstract: '수용체가 신호를 증폭하는 과정을 다룹니다.', extra: '시험 범위' }];
const index = buildSearchIndex(ITEMS, TEXTS);
/** The titles a query finds, in list order; null for an empty query (no filtering). */
const found = (q: string, i = index, items = ITEMS) => {
  const r = search(i, q);
  return r === null ? null : items.filter((x) => r.ids.has(x.id)).map((x) => x.title);
};
const mark = (q: string, it: LibraryItem, i = index) => search(i, q)?.titleMatches.get(it.id) ?? null;

describe('quick search: folding and words (spec 4.2)', () => {
  it('folds NFC, lower case, whitespace and control runs to one space, trimmed', () => {
    expect(foldText('  Signal 전달\n\t노트  ')).toBe('signal 전달 노트');
    expect(foldText('신호'.normalize('NFD'))).toBe('신호');
  });
  it('splits the query into distinct words; a last syllable that may still be composing also reads split', () => {
    expect(parseQuery('ㅅㅎ 신ㅎ 갖 Bayes 신호 신호')).toEqual([
      { text: 'ㅅㅎ', readings: ['ㅅㅎ'] },
      { text: '신ㅎ', readings: ['신ㅎ'] },
      { text: '갖', readings: ['갖', '가ㅈ'] }, // on the way to 가져
      { text: 'bayes', readings: ['bayes'] },
      { text: '신호', readings: ['신호'] },
    ]);
    expect(parseQuery('  \u3000 ')).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('an empty query filters nothing', () => {
    expect(search(index, '')).toBeNull();
    expect(search(index, '   ')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('quick search: matching (spec 4.2)', () => {
  it('is NFC-normalised on both sides', () => {
    expect(found('신호'.normalize('NFD'))).toEqual(['세포 신호 전달 개요', '세포신호전달']);
    const nfd = item({ title: '세포 신호'.normalize('NFD') });
    const i = buildSearchIndex([nfd]);
    expect(found('신호', i, [nfd])).toEqual(['세포 신호'.normalize('NFD')]);
    expect(mark('신호', nfd, i)).toEqual({ start: 3, end: 5, kind: 'word' }); // NFC code points, as highlight() slices
  });
  it('ignores case', () => {
    expect(found('BAYES')).toEqual(['Intro to Bayesian Inference']);
    expect(mark('BAYES', BAYES)).toEqual({ start: 9, end: 14, kind: 'word' });
  });
  it('finds 초성 in the short fields only (not in abstracts or memos)', () => {
    expect(found('ㅅㅎ')).toEqual(['세포 신호 전달 개요', '세포신호전달']);
    expect(mark('ㅅㅎ', SIGNAL)).toEqual({ start: 3, end: 5, kind: 'initials' });
    expect(found('ㄱㅊㅅ')).toEqual(['세포 신호 전달 개요']); // 김철수, a creator
    expect(found('ㅈㅍ')).toEqual([]); // 증폭 is in the abstract
    expect(found('증폭')).toEqual(['세포 신호 전달 개요']);
  });
  it('finds two-letter Korean words inside longer ones (no trigram limit)', () => {
    expect(found('신호')).toEqual(['세포 신호 전달 개요', '세포신호전달']);
    expect(mark('신호', JOINED)).toEqual({ start: 2, end: 4, kind: 'substring' });
    expect(found('포신')).toEqual(['세포신호전달']); // never across the space of 세포 신호
  });
  it('needs every word in some field (AND): title, creators, publisher, original file name, year, abstract, memo', () => {
    expect(found('신호 김철')).toEqual(['세포 신호 전달 개요']);
    expect(found('신호 이영희')).toEqual([]);
    expect(found('노트 learn press')).toEqual(['단백질 접힘 강의 노트']);
    expect(found('2024')).toEqual(['세포 신호 전달 개요']);

/** A 10,000-item library: Korean and English titles, 1–4 creators, publishers, years; 30 % with an abstract. */
function library(n: number): { items: LibraryItem[]; texts: SearchText[] } {
  let s = 42;
  const rand = () => (s = (Math.imul(s, 1103515245) + 12345) & 0x7fffffff) / 0x7fffffff;
  const pick = <T,>(xs: readonly T[]): T => xs[Math.floor(rand() * xs.length)]!;
  const KO = ['세포', '신호', '전달', '단백질', '접힘', '효소', '반응', '속도론', '열역학', '광합성', '명반응', '암반응', '유전자', '발현', '조절', '강의', '노트', '요약', '정리', '실험'];
  const EN = ['Linear', 'Algebra', 'Bayesian', 'Inference', 'Signal', 'Protein', 'Kinetics', 'Notes', 'Lecture', 'Review'];
  const NAMES = ['김철수', '이영희', '박민수', '최지우', 'Jane Smith', 'John Doe', 'Lee', 'Kim'];
  const PUBLISHERS = ['분자생물학회', 'Learn Press', 'MIT Press', '대한화학회', null];
  const items: LibraryItem[] = [];
  const texts: SearchText[] = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const words = Array.from({ length: 3 + Math.floor(rand() * 4) }, () => (rand() < 0.7 ? pick(KO) : pick(EN)));
    const it = item({
      title: words.join(' '),
      creators: Array.from({ length: 1 + Math.floor(rand() * 4) }, () => pick(NAMES)),
      year: 1990 + Math.floor(rand() * 36),
      publisher: pick(PUBLISHERS),
      originalName: `${words[0]}-${k}.pdf`,
    });
    items.push(it);
    if (rand() < 0.3) texts.push({ id: it.id, abstract: Array.from({ length: 150 }, () => pick(KO)).join(' '), extra: rand() < 0.5 ? '시험 범위' : null });
  }
  return { items, texts };
}

describe('quick search at 10,000 items (spec 9: input → paint p95 ≤ 50 ms; this is the search part of it)', () => {
  it('builds its index in well under a second and answers typing-like queries far inside the budget', () => {
    const { items, texts } = library(10_000);
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const big = buildSearchIndex(items, texts);
    const buildMs = performance.now() - t0;
    // The keystrokes of 신호 전달 through an IME, 초성, Latin letters, a year, words of the long fields, AND.
    const queries = ['ㅅ', '시', '신', '신ㅎ', '신호', '신호 ', '신호 ㅈ', '신호 저', '신호 전', '신호 전ㄷ', '신호 전달', 'ㅅㅎ', 'ㅅㅎㅈㄷ', 'b', 'ba', 'bay', 'baye', 'bayes', '2024', '증폭', '시험', '김철수 효소', 'press 2001', 'ㄱ', '갖'];
    const times: number[] = [];
    for (let round = 0; round < 4; round++) {
      for (const q of queries) {
        const t = performance.now();
        search(big, q);
        times.push(performance.now() - t);
      }
    }
    times.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const p95 = times[Math.floor(times.length * 0.95)]!;
    expect(buildMs).toBeLessThan(2_000); // generous for CI; a few hundred ms locally at most
    expect(p95).toBeLessThan(40); // generous for CI; single-digit ms locally
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { LibraryItem, SearchText } from '@learn/domain';
import { CHOSEONG, MATCH_RANK, WORD_START, matchKorean, splitFinal, type Match, type MatchKind } from '../palette/hangul';

/**
 * Quick search over the library list (spec 4.2). Every query word must be in some field (AND). Fields compare NFC and
 * lower-cased, with whitespace runs as one space. The short fields (title, creators, publisher, original file name,
 * year) also have a 초성 string, so ㅅㅎ finds 신호; the long ones (abstract, memo) are matched literally.
 *
 * Built once per list (once more when the long texts arrive), the index keeps each kind of text as ONE string with a
 * separator between fields and items. A query word is then a few native indexOf scans of those strings, not a loop over
 * items and fields: at 10,000 items a few milliseconds, inside the 50 ms from a keystroke to the painted rows.
 *
 * A word reads as the palette's matchKorean reads a query (one rule for both): letters match themselves, a 초성
 * matches any syllable with that initial, and a last syllable that may still be composing also reads split (갖 → 가ㅈ).
 * The index applies that rule itself, on the spot its 초성 string points to: calling matchKorean for every candidate
 * costs a locale-aware lower-casing per call, tens of milliseconds per keystroke at this size.
 */

/** Between fields and after each item. No query word contains it: folding turns control characters into spaces. */
const SEP = '\u0001';
const S_BASE = 0xac00;
const S_END = 0xd7a4;
const N_COUNT = 588; // 21 vowels × 28 finals
const CHO_CODES = CHOSEONG.map((c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
const CHO = new Set<number>(CHO_CODES);
const SPACES = /[\s\u0000-\u001f\u007f]+/g;
/**
 * The same for a whole joined text, which keeps its SEPs: only what changes (runs of two or more, a whitespace other than
 * the space, a control) is matched — replacing every single space of a 1.5 M-character text took 150 ms, this 15.
 */
const FIELD_SPACES = /[\s\u0000\u0002-\u001f\u007f]{2,}|[^\S ]|[\u0000\u0002-\u001f\u007f]/g;
const SURROGATE = /[\uD800-\uDFFF]/;

/**
 * NFC, lower case, controls and whitespace runs as one space, trimmed (spec 4.2). toLowerCase gives what
 * toLocaleLowerCase('ko') gives for every character (Korean has no case tailoring) without a locale lookup per call.
 */
export function foldText(s: string): string {
  return s.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase().replace(SPACES, ' ').trim();
}

/** A field's own SEP (never in practice) would split it: it becomes a space. */
const clean = (s: string): string => (s.includes(SEP) ? s.replaceAll(SEP, ' ') : s);
/** foldText over a whole joined text at once (a few ms for 10,000 items, against ~100 ms field by field); not trimmed per field. */
const foldJoined = (s: string): string => s.normalize('NFC').toLowerCase().replace(FIELD_SPACES, ' ');

/** Each UTF-16 unit's 초성 (a precomposed syllable's initial consonant), every other unit as it is: offsets carry over. */
function initialsOf(s: string): string {
  const out = new Uint16Array(s.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    out[i] = c >= S_BASE && c < S_END ? CHO_CODES[Math.floor((c - S_BASE) / N_COUNT)]! : c;
  }
  let text = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i += 8192) text += String.fromCharCode(...out.subarray(i, i + 8192));
  return text;
}

/** One word of the query. */
export interface SearchTerm {
  /** The word folded like the fields: what the long fields must contain, literally. */
  text: string;
  /**
   * How the short fields may contain it: the word itself and, when its last syllable may still be composing, that
   * syllable split (갖 → 가ㅈ, on its way to 가져). In a reading a 초성 matches any syllable with that initial.
   */
  readings: string[];
}

/** The distinct words of a query (whitespace splits; an all-space query has none). */
export function parseQuery(query: string): SearchTerm[] {
  const words = foldText(query).split(' ').filter((w) => w !== '');
  return [...new Set(words)].map((text) => {
    const split = splitFinal(text.at(-1)!);
    return { text, readings: split ? [text, text.slice(0, -1) + split[0] + split[1]] : [text] };
  });
}

/** A reading prepared for the scans. */
interface Reading {
  text: string;
  /** Its 초성 form: where a match must sit in a 초성 string. */
  initials: string;
  /** No 초성 in it: a plain substring. */
  plain: boolean;
}
function readingOf(text: string): Reading {
  let plain = true;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length && plain; i++) if (CHO.has(text.charCodeAt(i))) plain = false;
  return { text, initials: initialsOf(text), plain };
}

/** Whether `r` reads at offset p of `text` (its 초성 form `initials`): letters equal, each 초성 the syllable's initial. */
function readsAt(text: string, initials: string, p: number, r: Reading): boolean {
  if (!initials.startsWith(r.initials, p)) return false;
  for (let j = 0; j < r.text.length; j++) {
    const c = r.text.charCodeAt(j);
    if (!CHO.has(c) && text.charCodeAt(p + j) !== c) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/** The first offset from `from` where `r` reads in `text`, or -1. */
function findReading(text: string, initials: string, r: Reading, from = 0): number {
  if (r.plain) return text.indexOf(r.text, from);
  for (let p = initials.indexOf(r.initials, from); p !== -1; p = initials.indexOf(r.initials, p + 1)) {
    if (readsAt(text, initials, p, r)) return p;
  }
  return -1;
}

/** Opaque outside this module (search() reads it). */
export interface SearchIndex {
  readonly items: readonly LibraryItem[];
  /** The short fields of every item: title first, SEP between fields and after each item. */
  readonly short: string;
  /** `short` with each syllable replaced by its 초성 (same offsets). */
  readonly initials: string;
  /** Where item k's text starts in `short`; [items.length] is the end. */
  readonly starts: Int32Array;
  /** Where item k's title ends in `short`. */
  readonly titleEnds: Int32Array;
  /** 1 when item k's folded title keeps the offsets of the title as shown (no collapsed space, no case change of length, no surrogate pair). */
  readonly plainTitle: Uint8Array;
  /** Abstract SEP memo SEP, for the items that have either. */
  readonly long: string;
  /** Where each long segment starts; the last entry is the end. */
  readonly longStarts: Int32Array;
  /** The item index of each long segment. */
  readonly longItems: Int32Array;
}
type ShortPart = Omit<SearchIndex, 'long' | 'longStarts' | 'longItems'>;
type LongPart = Pick<SearchIndex, 'long' | 'longStarts' | 'longItems'>;
const NO_LONG: LongPart = { long: '', longStarts: new Int32Array(1), longItems: new Int32Array(0) };

function shortPart(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): ShortPart {
  const n = items.length;
  const raw: string[] = [];
  for (const it of items) {
    raw.push(clean(it.title));
    for (const name of it.creators) raw.push(SEP, clean(name));
    raw.push(SEP, clean(it.publisher ?? ''), SEP, clean(it.originalName), SEP, it.year === null ? '' : String(it.year), SEP);
  }
  const short = foldJoined(raw.join(''));
  const starts = new Int32Array(n + 1);
  const titleEnds = new Int32Array(n);
  const plainTitle = new Uint8Array(n);
  let at = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const it = items[k]!;
    starts[k] = at;
    const titleEnd = short.indexOf(SEP, at);
    titleEnds[k] = titleEnd;
    let end = titleEnd;
    for (let f = 0; f < it.creators.length + 3; f++) end = short.indexOf(SEP, end + 1); // creators, publisher, file name, year
    at = end + 1;
    const nfc = it.title.normalize('NFC');
    plainTitle[k] = titleEnd - starts[k]! === nfc.length && !SURROGATE.test(nfc) ? 1 : 0;
  }
  starts[n] = at;
  return { items, short, initials: initialsOf(short), starts, titleEnds, plainTitle };
}

function longPart(items: readonly LibraryItem[], texts: readonly SearchText[] | undefined): LongPart {
  if (!texts || texts.length === 0) return NO_LONG;
  const at = new Map<string, number>();
  items.forEach((it, k) => at.set(it.id, k));
  const raw: string[] = [];
  const owners: number[] = [];
  for (const t of texts) {
    const k = at.get(t.id);
    if (k === undefined) continue; // trashed, or not in this list
    owners.push(k);
    raw.push(clean(t.abstract ?? ''), SEP, clean(t.extra ?? ''), SEP);
  }
  const long = foldJoined(raw.join(''));
  const longStarts = new Int32Array(owners.length + 1);
  let p = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < owners.length; i++) {
    longStarts[i] = p;
    p = long.indexOf(SEP, long.indexOf(SEP, p) + 1) + 1; // past the abstract's SEP and the memo's
  }
  longStarts[owners.length] = p;
  return { long, longStarts, longItems: Int32Array.from(owners) };
}

const shortParts = new WeakMap<readonly LibraryItem[], ShortPart>();
/** The short part of this list array, built once: the long texts arriving later rebuild only their own part. */
function shortPartFor(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): ShortPart {
  let short = shortParts.get(items);
  if (!short) {
    short = shortPart(items);
    shortParts.set(items, short);
  }
  return short;
}

export function buildSearchIndex(items: readonly LibraryItem[], texts?: readonly SearchText[]): SearchIndex {
  return { ...shortPartFor(items), ...longPart(items, texts) };
}

const indexes = new WeakMap<readonly LibraryItem[], { texts: readonly SearchText[] | undefined; index: SearchIndex }>();
/**
 * The index of this list array and these long texts, built once and shared: the toolbar count and the table ask for it
 * in the same frame. A list read again is a new array, so a new index.
 */
export function searchIndexFor(items: readonly LibraryItem[], texts?: readonly SearchText[]): SearchIndex {
  const hit = indexes.get(items);
  if (hit && hit.texts === texts) return hit.index;
  const index = buildSearchIndex(items, texts);
  indexes.set(items, { texts, index });
  return index;
}

export interface SearchResult {
  /** The items every query word is in. */
  ids: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /** Where the title matched (for <mark>): the first query word found in it; absent when only other fields matched. */
  titleMatches: ReadonlyMap<string, Match>;
}

const lastResults = new WeakMap<SearchIndex, { query: string; result: SearchResult | null }>();
/** search(), answered from memory when this index was just asked the same query. */
export function searchCached(index: SearchIndex, query: string): SearchResult | null {
  const hit = lastResults.get(index);
  if (hit && hit.query === query) return hit.result;
  const result = search(index, query);
  lastResults.set(index, { query, result });
  return result;
}

/** The segment holding offset `p`: the last k with starts[k] <= p. */
function segmentAt(starts: Int32Array, p: number): number {
  let lo = 0;
  let hi = starts.length - 2;
  while (lo < hi) {
    const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1;
    if (starts[mid]! <= p) lo = mid;
    else hi = mid - 1;
  }
  return lo;
}

/** Marks every item whose short fields hold reading `r`: one scan, which skips the rest of an item once marked. */
function markShort(index: SearchIndex, r: Reading, marks: Uint8Array): void {
  const { short, initials, starts } = index;
  let p = findReading(short, initials, r);
  while (p !== -1) {
    const k = segmentAt(starts, p);
    marks[k] = 1;
    p = findReading(short, initials, r, starts[k + 1]!);
  }
}

/** Marks every item whose abstract or memo holds `text` literally. */
function markLong(index: SearchIndex, text: string, marks: Uint8Array): void {
  const { long, longStarts, longItems } = index;
  let p = long.indexOf(text);
  while (p !== -1) {
    const k = segmentAt(longStarts, p);
    marks[longItems[k]!] = 1;
    p = long.indexOf(text, longStarts[k + 1]!);
  }
}

interface Prepared {
  text: string;
  readings: Reading[];
}

function matchTerm(index: SearchIndex, t: Prepared): Uint8Array {
  const marks = new Uint8Array(index.items.length);
  for (const r of t.readings) markShort(index, r, marks);
  if (index.long.length > 0) markLong(index, t.text, marks);
  return marks;
}

/** The match kinds of a literal hit, ranked as the palette ranks them (exact, prefix, word start, substring). */
function literalKind(title: string, start: number, end: number): MatchKind {
  if (start === 0) return end === title.length ? 'exact' : 'prefix';
  return WORD_START.test(title[start - 1]!) ? 'word' : 'substring';
}

/** matchKorean on a folded title: each reading's first place, the best kind (the first reading on a tie). */
function readTitle(title: string, initials: string, t: Prepared): Match | null {
  let best: Match | null = null;
  for (const r of t.readings) {
    const start = findReading(title, initials, r);
    if (start === -1) continue;
    const end = start + r.text.length;
    const m: Match = { start, end, kind: title.startsWith(r.text, start) ? literalKind(title, start, end) : 'initials' };
    if (!best || MATCH_RANK[m.kind] < MATCH_RANK[best.kind]) best = m;
  }
  return best;
}

/** The first query word found in item k's title, in code points of the title as shown. */
function titleMatch(index: SearchIndex, k: number, terms: readonly Prepared[]): Match | null {
  if (index.plainTitle[k] !== 1) {
    // Folding moved its offsets: the palette's matchKorean reads the title as shown (rare: kept off the fast path).
    const title = index.items[k]!.title;
    for (const t of terms) {
      const m = matchKorean(t.text, title);
      if (m) return m;
    }
    return null;
  }
  const from = index.starts[k]!;
  const to = index.titleEnds[k]!;
  const title = index.short.slice(from, to);
  const initials = index.initials.slice(from, to);
  for (const t of terms) {
    const m = readTitle(title, initials, t);
    if (m) return m;
  }
  return null;
}

/** The items every word of `query` is in, and their title highlights; null for an empty query (no filtering). */
export function search(index: SearchIndex, query: string): SearchResult | null {
  const terms = parseQuery(query).map((t): Prepared => ({ text: t.text, readings: t.readings.map(readingOf) }));
  if (terms.length === 0) return null;
  const all = matchTerm(index, terms[0]!);
  for (const t of terms.slice(1)) {
    const marks = matchTerm(index, t);
    for (let k = 0; k < marks.length; k++) if (marks[k] === 0) all[k] = 0;
  }
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  const titleMatches = new Map<string, Match>();
  for (let k = 0; k < all.length; k++) {
    if (all[k] !== 1) continue;
    const id = index.items[k]!.id;
    ids.add(id);
    const m = titleMatch(index, k, terms);
    if (m) titleMatches.set(id, m);
  }
  return { ids, titleMatches };
}
```

`R/library/useSearch.ts`(새):
```ts
import { useDeferredValue, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { useSearchTexts } from '../data/queries';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { searchCached, searchIndexFor, type SearchResult } from './search';

/**
 * The quick search result for this list, or null with an empty query (no filtering). The query comes deferred
 * (spec 4.2), so typing never waits for the table. The toolbar's count and the table call it in the same frame: they
 * share the index of this list array and the last answer (search.ts caches).
 */
export function useSearch(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): SearchResult | null {
  const query = useLibrary((s) => s.query);
  const texts = useSearchTexts(query.trim() !== '').data;
  const deferred = useDeferredValue(query);
  // The index of a new list is built while the window is idle, so the first keystroke does not pay for it.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (items.length === 0) return;
    const id = requestIdleCallback(() => void searchIndexFor(items, texts));
    return () => cancelIdleCallback(id);
  }, [items, texts]);
  return useMemo(() => (deferred.trim() === '' ? null : searchCached(searchIndexFor(items, texts), deferred)), [items, texts, deferred]);
}
```

```ts
  const sorted = useMemo(() => sortItems(items, sort), [items, sort]);
  // Quick search filters the sorted rows: the order stays the table's (spec 4.2); relevance ranks only the palette.
  // The index is built once per list (buildSearchIndex) and each query searched once (search), shared with the toolbar.
  const found = useSearch(items);
  const rows = useMemo(() => (found ? sorted.filter((i) => found.ids.has(i.id)) : sorted), [sorted, found]);
  return { rows, total: items.length, titleMatches: found?.titleMatches ?? null };
```
