`R/ui/SearchField.tsx` 전체:
```tsx
import type { Ref } from 'react';
import { CircleX, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { Input, SearchField as AriaSearchField, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react-aria-components';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { ForcedState } from './Button';
import { IconButton } from './Button';
import { cx } from './cx';
import { Icon } from './Icon';

/** A key that belongs to a Korean composition: isComposing, or the keyCode 229 macOS IMEs send without it. */
const composing = (e: { nativeEvent: { isComposing: boolean }; keyCode: number }): boolean => e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229;

/**
 * Search field (design-spec 6 검색 필드): 28 (small 24, footnote), 14 px magnifier and placeholder in tertiary colour,
 * a clear button (circle-x) only while there is a value. RAC wires the clear button: it empties the field and puts
 * focus back in it, and is skipped by Tab (Escape clears from the keyboard). Keys a Korean composition owns never act
 * (design-spec 7.4): RAC's own esc (clear) and ↩ (submit) stop before they run, and `onKeyDown` never sees them.
 */
export function SearchField(props: {
  'aria-label': string;
  'aria-keyshortcuts'?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  onChange?(value: string): void;
  onSubmit?(value: string): void;
  /** Esc or the clear button emptied the field. */
  onClear?(): void;
  /** Keys after the field's own (RAC has emptied it on esc by then), never those of a composition. */
  onKeyDown?(e: KeyboardEvent): void;
  onFocus?(): void;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  inputRef?: Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
  size?: 'regular' | 'small';
  className?: string;
  testId?: string;
  force?: ForcedState[];
}) {
  return (
    <AriaSearchField
      aria-label={props['aria-label']}
      value={props.value}
      defaultValue={props.defaultValue}
      onChange={props.onChange}
      onSubmit={props.onSubmit}
      onClear={props.onClear}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (!composing(e)) props.onKeyDown?.(e);
      }}
      onFocus={props.onFocus && (() => props.onFocus!())}
      autoFocus={props.autoFocus}
      className={cx('field', props.size === 'small' && 'small', props.className)}
      data-testid={props.testId}
      data-force={props.force?.join(' ')}
    >
      {({ isEmpty }) => (
        <>
          <Icon icon={Search} size="sm" />
          <Input
            ref={props.inputRef}
            className="field-input"
            placeholder={props.placeholder}
            aria-keyshortcuts={props['aria-keyshortcuts']}
            // RAC clears on esc and submits on ↩ without asking whether a composition owns the key.
            onKeyDownCapture={(e) => {
              if (composing(e) && (e.key === 'Escape' || e.key === 'Enter')) e.stopPropagation();
            }}
          />
          {!isEmpty && <IconButton icon={CircleX} label={t.common.clear} size="small" testId={props.testId && `${props.testId}-clear`} />}
        </>
      )}
    </AriaSearchField>
  );
}
```

`R/strings/josa.ts`(새):
```ts
/** Does each digit's Korean reading end in a final consonant (영 일 이 삼 사 오 육 칠 팔 구)? */
const DIGIT_FINAL = [true, true, false, true, false, false, true, true, true, false];

/**
 * 와 or 과 after `word` (‘증폭’과, ‘효소 억제제’와): 과 when its last syllable has a final consonant. Digits are read as
 * Korean numbers; any other ending (Latin letters, 초성) takes 와, as it is usually read.
 */
export function waGwa(word: string | number): '와' | '과' {
  const text = String(word).normalize('NFC').trim();
  const c = text.charCodeAt(text.length - 1);
  if (c >= 0xac00 && c < 0xd7a4) return (c - 0xac00) % 28 === 0 ? '와' : '과';
  if (c >= 0x30 && c <= 0x39) return DIGIT_FINAL[c - 0x30] ? '과' : '와';
  return '와';
}
```

```tsx
import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';

/**
 * A pane's empty state (design-spec 6): a 24 px icon in tertiary colour, a headline title, a footnote (≤ 280), at most
 * one action. `top` hangs it under the pane's head instead of centring it (the table's body: mockup `pane-empty top`).
 * A polite status: it replaces the pane's content and says why.
 */

    <div className={cx('pane-empty', props.top && 'top')} role="status" data-testid={props.testId}>
```

`R/shell/panes.ts` — F6의 착지 규칙을 다른 길에서도 쓰게 떼어 낸다. `PANES`와 `FOCUSABLE`은 Task 3이 둔 그대로 두고, `focusPane` 함수를 다음 셋으로 바꾼다(Task 3이 한 페인 안의 착지를 바꿨다면 그 내용이 `landIn` 안으로 그대로 옮겨 간다):
```ts
/** The pane's element when F6 can visit it: there, not folded (inert or zero-wide); the toasts only with a toast. */
function usablePane(name: (typeof PANES)[number]): HTMLElement | null {
  const el = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-pane="${name}"]`);
  const usable = el !== null && el.closest('[inert]') === null && el.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0 && (name !== 'toasts' || el.querySelector('.toast') !== null);
  return usable ? el : null;
}

/** Where F6 lands in a pane: its first control that takes the focus now, else the pane itself. */
function landIn(pane: HTMLElement): void {
  for (const target of pane.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)) {
    target.focus();
    if (document.activeElement === target) return;
  }
  pane.tabIndex = -1; // nothing to land on: the pane itself
  pane.focus();
}

/** F6 / ⇧F6: next / previous pane; folded (inert) and absent panes are skipped. */
export function focusPane(direction: 1 | -1): void {
  const panes = PANES.flatMap((name) => usablePane(name) ?? []);
  if (panes.length === 0) return;
  const at = panes.findIndex((p) => p.contains(document.activeElement));
  landIn(panes[at === -1 ? (direction === 1 ? 0 : panes.length - 1) : (at + direction + panes.length) % panes.length]!);
}

/** The focus where F6 would land in pane `name` (quick search's esc hands it to the table); false when it is not there. */
export function focusPaneNamed(name: (typeof PANES)[number]): boolean {
  const pane = usablePane(name);
  if (pane) landIn(pane);
  return pane !== null;
}
```

```ts
const firstRow = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`${GRID} [data-testid="item-row"][data-index="0"]`);

/**
 * Quick search's ↓ (spec 4.1): the first result takes the keyboard focus, selected alone, as an arrow key selects in
 * the table. A table scrolled down has no first row drawn: it scrolls to the top and focuses the row once drawn.
 */
export function focusFirstRow(): void {
  const focus = () => {
    const row = firstRow();
    const id = row?.dataset['itemId'];
    if (!row || !id) return;
    useLibrary.getState().setSelected([id]);
    row.focus();
  };
  if (firstRow()) return focus();
  const scroller = tableScroller();
  if (scroller) scroller.scrollTop = 0;
  afterPaint(focus);
}
```

```tsx
import { ariaKeyShortcuts, commandById, commandLabel, type LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { useItems } from '../data/queries';
import { focusPaneNamed } from '../shell/panes';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { SearchField } from '../ui/SearchField';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { focusFirstRow } from './tableDom';
import { useSearch } from './useSearch';

const NO_ITEMS: readonly LibraryItem[] = [];
/** The field's input while it is mounted (one toolbar per window): ⌘F reaches it from the registry. */
const field: { current: HTMLInputElement | null } = { current: null };

/** ⌘F (`library.find`): the quick search field takes the focus with its text selected (spec 4.1). */
export function focusQuickSearch(): void {
  field.current?.focus();
  field.current?.select();
}

/**
 * The toolbar's quick search (spec 4.1, design-spec 2.4): 240 wide after 가져오기, bound to the session's query.
 * esc empties it (RAC), and on an empty field hands the focus to the table, as F6 would land there; ↓ goes to the first
 * result. Named after its command, with ⌘F as its shortcut.
 */
export function LibrarySearch() {
  const query = useLibrary((s) => s.query);
  const setQuery = useLibrary((s) => s.setQuery);
  const found = useSearch(useItems().data ?? NO_ITEMS);
  const find = commandById('library.find');
  const platform = currentPlatform();
  return (
    <>
      <SearchField
        aria-label={commandLabel(find, platform)}
        aria-keyshortcuts={ariaKeyShortcuts(find.accelerator!, platform)}
        placeholder={t.library.searchPlaceholder}
        value={query}
        onChange={setQuery}
        inputRef={field}
        className="library-search"
        testId="search-field"
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && query === '') focusPaneNamed('content');
          else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
            e.preventDefault(); // not the caret's end
            focusFirstRow();
          }
        }}
      />
      <span role="status" className="visually-hidden" data-testid="search-status">
        {found !== null && found.ids.size > 0 ? t.library.searchStatus(found.ids.size) : ''}
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

가져오기에 `import type { UpdateMetadataInput } from '../../packages/domain/src/ipc';`(기존 `LearnApi` 줄에 함께), `importPaths` 다음에:
```ts
/**
 * Metadata (and, when given, a title) for an item through `learn.library.updateMetadata` from the page. Main
 * broadcasts libraryChanged{metadata}, so the list is read again; the updated row comes back.
 */
export async function seedMetadata(page: Page, itemId: string, metadata: NonNullable<UpdateMetadataInput['metadata']>, title?: string): Promise<LibraryItem> {
  const r = await page.evaluate((input) => window.learn.library.updateMetadata(input), { itemId, metadata, ...(title === undefined ? {} : { title }) });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.updateMetadata failed: ${r.code}`);
  return r.data;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 13: E2E — 빠른 검색** `E/search.spec.ts`(새)

```ts
// Quick search (spec 4.1–4.3): ⌘F and the toolbar field, its count, 초성 and AND across the fields, the abstract and
// memo read on the first query, the title mark, esc and ↓, the no-results state, IME composition, hidden rows leaving
// the selection, a query that lasts the session only. ⌘F goes through runMenuCommand (CDP keys never reach native
// accelerators on Linux); a real ⌘F is checked on macOS by tests/evidence/library.evidence.ts.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { expectNoSeriousA11y } from './a11y';
import { FIXTURES, importPaths, launch, menuItemEnabled, openItem, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, seedMetadata } from './helpers';

const FILES = [
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4'),
  path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-mpeg4part2.mp4'),
];
const SIGNAL = '세포 신호 전달 개요';
const FOLD = '단백질 접힘 강의 노트';
const BAYES = 'Intro to Bayesian Inference';
const PHOTO = '광합성 명반응';
const IS_MAC = process.platform === 'darwin';
const dirs = (i: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [i.outputPath('library'), i.outputPath('userdata')] as const;

test.beforeAll(() => {
  for (const f of FILES) if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`fixture missing: ${f} — run \`pnpm fixtures\``);
});

/** Four items with known titles and metadata; the first has an abstract and a memo. */
async function library(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const [a, b, c, d] = await importPaths(page, FILES);
  await seedMetadata(page, a!.id, { creators: [{ name: '김철수', role: 'author' }], date: '2024', publisher: '분자생물학회', abstract: '수용체가 신호를 증폭하는 과정을 다룹니다.', extra: '시험 범위' }, SIGNAL);
  await seedMetadata(page, b!.id, { creators: [{ name: '이영희', role: 'author' }], date: '2023', publisher: 'Learn Press' }, FOLD);
  await seedMetadata(page, c!.id, { creators: [{ name: 'Jane Smith', role: 'lecturer' }], date: '2021' }, BAYES);
  await seedMetadata(page, d!.id, { creators: [] }, PHOTO);
  await expect(rowByTitle(page, PHOTO)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(rowByTitle(page, SIGNAL)).toBeVisible();
}
const input = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input');
/** The titles of the table's rows (all four fit on screen, so every row is drawn). */
const titles = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('item-row').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-title')).sort());
/** A CSS colour token as the page computes it. */
const tokenIn = (page: Page, name: string) =>
  page.evaluate((v) => {
    const p = document.createElement('span');
    document.body.append(p);
    p.style.color = `var(${v})`;
    const c = getComputedStyle(p).color;
    p.remove();
    return c;
  }, name);

test('the field: after 가져오기, 240 wide, clickable in the drag strip, named after ⌘F; none in the empty library, and ⌘F is off there and in the reader', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    // Nothing to find in an empty library: no field, ⌘F greyed (spec 3.5).
    await expect(page.getByTestId('empty-state')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-field')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await menuItemEnabled(app, 'library.find')).toBe(false);
    await library(page);
    const field = page.getByTestId('search-field');
    await expect(field).toBeVisible();
    expect(Math.round((await field.boundingBox())!.width)).toBe(240);
    expect(await page.locator('.tb-actions').evaluate((el) => [...el.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="import-menu"], [data-testid="search-field"]')].map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-testid')))).toEqual(['import-menu', 'search-field']);
    // The toolbar is a drag strip: the field must take the click.
    expect(await field.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('-webkit-app-region') || getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('app-region'))).toBe('no-drag');
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveAttribute('placeholder', '제목, 저자 검색');
    await expect(page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: '빠른 검색' })).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveAttribute('aria-keyshortcuts', IS_MAC ? 'Meta+F' : 'Control+F');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('4개');
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'library.find')).toBe(true);
    await openItem(page, SIGNAL);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('pdf-canvas')).toBeVisible();
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'library.find')).toBe(false);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-field')).toHaveCount(0); // the reader's toolbar has none
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('⌘F selects the field; 초성, two letters, AND over every field, the abstract and memo, the count and the title mark; no results', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await library(page);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.type('신호');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('1개 / 4개');
    const mark = rowByTitle(page, SIGNAL).locator('mark');
    await expect(mark).toHaveText('신호');
    expect(await mark.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).color)).toBe(await tokenIn(page, '--accent-text'));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-status')).toHaveText('일치하는 자료 1개');
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'quick search, results');
    // ⌘F again selects what is typed, so the next keys replace it.
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    expect(await input(page).evaluate((el) => [(el as HTMLInputElement).selectionStart, (el as HTMLInputElement).selectionEnd])).toEqual([0, 2]);
    await page.keyboard.type('ㅅㅎ');
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('ㅅㅎ');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);
    await expect(mark).toHaveText('신호');
    // A creator, a year, a publisher (two words, AND), the original file name, Latin letters in any case.
    for (const [q, expected] of [['김철', [SIGNAL]], ['2023', [FOLD]], ['learn press', [FOLD]], ['h264', [BAYES]], ['BAYES', [BAYES]]] as const) {
      await input(page).fill(q);
      await expect.poll(() => titles(page), q).toEqual(expected);
    }
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, BAYES).locator('mark')).toHaveText('Bayes');
    // Matched in another field only: no mark in the title.
    await input(page).fill('김철');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, SIGNAL).locator('mark')).toHaveCount(0);
    // The abstract and the memo arrive with the first query; 초성 does not apply to them (ㅈㅍ is 증폭's).
    await input(page).fill('증폭');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);
    await input(page).fill('시험');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);
    await input(page).fill('ㅈㅍ');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-empty')).toBeVisible();
    // No results: the state in the table body's place, its particle chosen by the last syllable (‘…’과 / ‘…’와).
    await input(page).fill('효소 반응');
    const empty = page.getByTestId('search-empty');
    await expect(empty.locator('.pe-title')).toHaveText('‘효소 반응’과 일치하는 자료가 없습니다');
    await input(page).fill('신호 이영희');
    await expect(empty.locator('.pe-title')).toHaveText('‘신호 이영희’와 일치하는 자료가 없습니다');
    await expect(empty.locator('.pe-text')).toHaveText('제목·저자·출판사·원래 파일 이름·초록·메모에서 찾았습니다.');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('0개 / 4개');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expectNoSeriousA11y(page, 'quick search, no results');
    await page.getByTestId('search-empty-clear').click();
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('');
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(4);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('toolbar-count')).toHaveText('4개');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('esc empties the field, then hands the focus to the table; ↓ moves to the first result, selected alone, its mark on the accent', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await library(page);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    await page.keyboard.type('노트');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([FOLD]);
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('');
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(4);
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.closest('[data-testid="library-table"]') !== null)).toBe(true);
    // ↓ from the field: the first result takes the focus and the selection (as an arrow key selects in the table).
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    await page.keyboard.type('광합');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([PHOTO]);
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    const row = rowByTitle(page, PHOTO);
    await expect(row).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.closest('[data-testid="item-row"]')?.getAttribute('data-title') ?? null)).toBe(PHOTO);
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('광합');
    // On the accent selection the mark is the row's own text colour (the palette's cursor row does the same).
    await expect(row.locator('mark')).toHaveText('광합');
    expect(await row.locator('mark').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).color)).toBe(await tokenIn(page, '--text-on-accent'));
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('rows the query hides leave the selection; back from the reader the query is still there; a restart starts empty', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const ud = testInfo.outputPath('userdata');
  let { app, page } = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    await library(page);
    await rowByTitle(page, PHOTO).click();
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.showInFolder')).toBe(true);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    await page.keyboard.type('신호');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);
    // The hidden row left the selection: no command acts on a row that is not on screen (spec 3.3).
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.showInFolder')).toBe(false);
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(4);
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]')).toHaveCount(0);
    // The query lasts the session: the reader and back keep it.
    await input(page).fill('광합');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([PHOTO]);
    await openItem(page, PHOTO);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('video-error')).toBeVisible(); // the unplayable video's notice: the reader is up
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'nav.back');
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('광합');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([PHOTO]);
    await app.close();
    // A restart starts with an empty query (spec 4.1).
    ({ app, page } = await launch(lib, ud));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(4);
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('');
  } finally {
    await app.close().catch(() => {});
  }
});

test('a Korean composition filters as it goes; esc, ↓ and ↩ that the IME owns do nothing (isComposing, keyCode 229)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await library(page);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'library.find');
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused();
    const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
    // ㅅ (초성: 세포, 광합성, and 테스트 in an original file name) → 신 → 신ㅎ (the next syllable still composing).
    for (const [stage, rows] of [['ㅅ', 3], ['신', 1], ['신ㅎ', 1]] as const) {
      await cdp.send('Input.imeSetComposition', { text: stage, selectionStart: stage.length, selectionEnd: stage.length });
      await expect.poll(() => page.getByTestId('item-row').count(), stage).toBe(rows);
    }
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, SIGNAL).locator('mark')).toHaveText('신호');
    // Keys the composition owns: the field keeps the focus, nothing in the table is selected.
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]')).toHaveCount(0);
    await cdp.send('Input.insertText', { text: '신호' }); // commits the composition
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('신호');
    await expect.poll(() => titles(page)).toEqual([SIGNAL]);
    // keyCode 229 without isComposing (the macOS IME's confirming keys): esc does not empty, ↓ does not move.
    for (const key of ['Escape', 'ArrowDown', 'Enter'] as const) {
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyDown', key, code: key, windowsVirtualKeyCode: 229, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 229 });
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type: 'keyUp', key, code: key, windowsVirtualKeyCode: 229, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 229 });
    }
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('신호');
    await expect(input(page)).toBeFocused();
    // Control: a plain esc does empty it.
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(input(page)).toHaveValue('');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

```ts
// Task 5: quick search. On macOS a real ⌘F (System Events), the 편집 menu with 빠른 검색; on every platform the 초성
// result with its count and mark, and the no-results state in dark (page shots; window and screen shots on macOS).
test('M4 library: quick search — a real ⌘F, 초성 ㅅㅎ with the count and the mark, 편집 › 빠른 검색, no results in dark', TAG, async () => {
  test.setTimeout(180_000);
  const v: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  results['search'] = v;
  const field = s.page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input');
  const imported = await s.page.evaluate((p) => window.learn.library.import({ paths: [p], mode: 'managed', allowDuplicate: true }), PDF);
  const id = imported.ok && imported.data[0]?.status === 'imported' ? imported.data[0].item.id : null;
  check('search: a row to find was imported', id !== null, imported.ok ? imported.data.map((o) => o.status) : imported.code);
  if (id === null) return void save();
  await seedMetadata(s.page, id, { creators: [{ name: '김철수', role: 'author' }], date: '2024' }, '세포 신호 전달 개요');
  const row = s.page.locator(`[data-testid="item-row"][data-item-id="${id}"]`);
  await expect(row).toBeVisible();
  const theme = (shade: 'light' | 'dark') => s.page.evaluate((t) => window.learn.prefs.set({ theme: t }), shade).then(() => expect.poll(() => s.page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset['theme'])).toBe(shade));

  await guard('search: ⌘F focuses the quick search field', async () => {
    let note: string | undefined;
    if (IS_MAC) {
      try {
        await bringAppToFront(s.app);
        await nativeKeystroke(s.app, 'f', ['command']);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted)) throw e;
        note = 'keystroke not permitted: ran from the menu instead';
        await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'library.find');
      }
    } else await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'library.find');
    await expect(field).toBeFocused({ timeout: 5_000 });
    v['cmdF'] = { native: IS_MAC && note === undefined, ...(note ? { note } : {}) };
    check('search: ⌘F focuses the quick search field', true, v['cmdF']);
  });
  await guard('search: 초성 ㅅㅎ finds the row and marks 신호', async () => {
    await field.fill('ㅅㅎ');
    await expect(row.locator('mark')).toHaveText('신호');
    const count = await s.page.getByTestId('toolbar-count').textContent();
    v['initials'] = { count, mark: await row.locator('mark').textContent() };
    await allShots(s.app, s.page, 'm4-05-search-initials', 'quick search: 초성 ㅅㅎ, the count and the title mark');
    check('search: 초성 ㅅㅎ finds the row and marks 신호', /^\d+개 \/ \d+개$/.test(count ?? ''), v['initials']);
  });
  if (IS_MAC) {
    await guard('search: 편집 lists 빠른 검색', async () => {
      const captured = await captureOpenMenu(s.app, s.app.process().pid!, 4, 'm4-05b-menu-edit', '편집 menu: 빠른 검색 after the system items');
      const names = captured.keyboard.open.names ?? [];
      v['editMenu'] = { names, shots: [captured.click.shot, captured.keyboard.shot] };
      check('search: 편집 lists 빠른 검색', names.includes('빠른 검색'), v['editMenu']);
    });
  }
  await guard('search: no results in dark says which query', async () => {
    await theme('dark');
    await field.fill('효소 억제제');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('search-empty')).toBeVisible();
    const title = await s.page.getByTestId('search-empty').locator('.pe-title').textContent();
    v['none'] = { title };
    await allShots(s.app, s.page, 'm4-05c-search-none-dark', 'quick search: no results, dark');
    check('search: no results in dark says which query', title === '‘효소 억제제’와 일치하는 자료가 없습니다', v['none']);
  });
  await field.fill('');
  await theme('light');
  save();
});
```

### Task 6: 인스펙터 그릇과 정보 모드 — 한 패널 기록, ⌥⌘I, 자동 접힘, 머리·정보 절·파일 절, 해시 복사

#### 계약과 다른 점 (판정 기록)

1. **연필(`info-edit`)은 Task 7에서 그린다.** B.6은 `info-edit`를 Task 6의 testid 목록에 두지만, 연필의 처리기는 `item.editInfo`(Task 7)다. 가짜 금지(디자인 명세 1.2 #5, drafting brief "a control appears only in the task that gives it a handler")에 따라 Task 6의 정보 절 머리에는 접기 단추만 있고, 연필은 Task 7이 `item.editInfo`와 함께 더한다. 권장 판정: 이대로. — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-18로 해소.
2. **인스펙터가 있는 조건 = 표가 보일 때.** B.10은 `inspector={view.kind === 'library' && count > 0 ? … : undefined}`라고 적었다. 빈 라이브러리에 드롭하는 동안 `busy.holding`이면 행이 와도(`count > 0`) `EmptyLibrary`가 남는다(M3 `useBusyScreen`). 그때 오른쪽에 항목 패널이 붙으면 디자인 명세 2.4("빈 라이브러리에는 … 항목 패널 토글은 없다")와 어긋난다. 권장 판정: `showsTable = view.kind === 'library' && items.data !== undefined && count > 0 && !busy?.holding`을 인스펙터·도구 막대 토글·보고 상태가 함께 쓴다(아래 Task 6 Step 14 — Task 5가 같은 식을 `tableShown`으로 이미 두므로 `showsTable = view.kind === 'library' && tableShown`). — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-19로 해소.
3. **보고하는 `inspector` 상태는 패널이 있을 때만.** B.1은 `inspector?: PaneShown`("library view only")만 정했다. 빈 라이브러리·리더에서는 필드를 빼서(메뉴 항목은 어차피 비활성) 메뉴가 중립 이름 "항목 패널 보기/가리기"를 쓴다(디자인 명세 7.4 "상태와 무관한 곳은 중립 이름"). 권장 판정: 이대로. 그래서 `platform.spec.ts`의 빈 라이브러리 기대값은 중립 이름이다. — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-20으로 해소.
4. **`item.editInfo`의 조건.** 명세 §6은 "`count === 1`, 인스펙터가 보임"이고 계약 B.2는 `t.length === 1 && ctx.view === 'library'`다. 계약을 따른다(계약 우선). 패널이 접혀 있으면 처리기가 먼저 패널을 보인다(Task 7 `startEditing`). 권장 판정: 이대로, Task 13이 명세 §6 문장을 고친다. — 컨트롤러 판정 Q-21로 해소.

이웃 초안과 맞춘 것(충돌 아님): Task 3의 TanStack 표(Q-34·Q-35) — 선택은 `useLibrary`의 `selected`·`anchorId`·`cursorId`이고 표가 `selectionModel.ts`의 `reduceSelection` → `setSelection`으로 바꾼다(Q-47; `setSelected(ids)`는 첫 id를 기준점·커서로 삼는다), 행 누르기(mousedown)가 고르고 더블클릭·↩가 열며 프로그램의 `click()`은 아무것도 하지 않는다, 표의 esc는 선택을 비운다(Q-43), 포커스는 커서 행의 roving tabindex이고 커서 없이 들어온 포커스가 첫 행을 고른다(Q-48 — 페이지에서 가져온 직후에는 포커스가 표에 들어오지 않아 선택이 없다), 행은 절대 위치라 순서는 `data-index`로 읽는다, `.library-table`이 스크롤 요소다, 같은 값의 정렬은 목록 순서(Q-46), 투어 마스크는 `[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]`(Q-40); Task 3의 `pane-empty.css`와 Task 5의 `PaneEmpty`(선택 없음), Task 3·5의 `panes.ts`(`landsOn`·`landIn`), Task 5의 `tableShown`, `V/library.evidence.ts`의 `TAG`·`s`·`results`·`check`·`guard`·`save`·`setTheme`·`PDF`.

#### 컨트롤러 판정으로 해소 (resolved by controller)

5. **창 닫기·⌘Q와 고친 정보 — resolved by controller (Q-22): 권장안 기각, main이 이끄는 flush(컨트롤러 판정 Q-22로 해소).** 처음 안은 렌더러의 `beforeunload` 취소 → 저장 → `window.close()`였고, macOS에서 ⌘Q가 창만 닫고 앱을 남겼다. 판정: main이 이끄는 flush로 바꾼다 — 편집기가 열린 동안 렌더러가 `window.__learnFlushEdits(): Promise<'saved' | 'clean' | 'invalid'>`를 두고(닫히면 지운다), main은 메인 창의 `close`와 `before-quit`에서 그 시도를 `preventDefault()`로 멈춘 뒤 `executeJavaScript('window.__learnFlushEdits ? window.__learnFlushEdits() : "clean"', true)`를 3초 제한으로 부르고(넘으면 `'clean'`), `'saved'`·`'clean'`이면 원래 동작(창 닫기 또는 `app.quit()`)을 다시 하며 `'invalid'`면 멈춘다(창이 남고 종료 취소, 폼이 까닭을 보인다). 시도마다 한 번만 묻고(재진입 없음), `beforeunload`는 쓰지 않는다. main 쪽은 `M/edit-flush.ts`(+ 단위 테스트), 새 IPC 채널 없음. Task 12의 숨은 설정 창 정리(`before-quit`)는 이 관문 **다음에** 등록하고 `event.defaultPrevented`이면 건너뛴다(Q-30). Task 7 Step 5·5b·8·11·13에 반영했다.

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  CONTENT_MIN, INSPECTOR, SIDEBAR, afterViewportChange, autoCollapses, clampInspector, clampSidebar, draggedInspectorWidth, hiddenPanes,
  inspectorAfterViewportChange, inspectorAutoCollapses, parsePanes, serializePanes, sidebarHidden, toggledInspector, toggledSidebar,
  type PaneState, type PanesState,
} from './layout';

const s = (over: Partial<PaneState> = {}): PaneState => ({ width: 240, collapsed: false, forceShown: false, ...over });
const i = (over: Partial<PaneState> = {}): PaneState => ({ width: 320, collapsed: false, forceShown: false, ...over });
const panes = (sidebar: Partial<PaneState> = {}, inspector: Partial<PaneState> = {}): PanesState => ({ sidebar: s(sidebar), inspector: i(inspector) });

describe('sidebar layout rules (design-spec 2.1)', () => {
  it('clamps the width to 180–360', () => {
    expect([clampSidebar(100), clampSidebar(240.4), clampSidebar(999)]).toEqual([180, 240, 360]);
    expect(SIDEBAR).toEqual({ default: 240, min: 180, max: 360 });
  });
  it('folds away automatically when the content column would drop below 520 px', () => {
    expect(CONTENT_MIN).toBe(520);
    expect(autoCollapses(760, 240)).toBe(false);
    expect(autoCollapses(759, 240)).toBe(true);
    expect(sidebarHidden(s(), 720)).toBe(true); // 1440 window at 200 % zoom
    expect(sidebarHidden(s(), 1440)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('toggling shows a folded sidebar on demand and hides a shown one as the user choice', () => {
    const shownOnDemand = toggledSidebar(s(), 720);
    expect(shownOnDemand).toEqual(s({ forceShown: true }));
    expect(sidebarHidden(shownOnDemand, 720)).toBe(false);
    expect(toggledSidebar(s(), 1440)).toEqual(s({ collapsed: true }));
    expect(toggledSidebar(s({ collapsed: true }), 1440)).toEqual(s());
  });
  it('folding a sidebar shown on demand only gives the fold back to the window width (not a user collapse, M-5)', () => {
    expect(toggledSidebar(s({ forceShown: true }), 720)).toEqual(s());
    expect(sidebarHidden(toggledSidebar(s({ forceShown: true }), 720), 720)).toBe(true);
    expect(sidebarHidden(toggledSidebar(s({ forceShown: true }), 720), 1440)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('forgets "shown on demand" once there is room again (automatic folding is never persisted)', () => {
    expect(afterViewportChange(s({ forceShown: true }), 1440)).toEqual(s());
    const same = s({ forceShown: true });
    expect(afterViewportChange(same, 720)).toBe(same);
  });
});

describe('item panel layout rules (design-spec 2.1, 2.5; spec §5.2)', () => {
  it('clamps the width to 260–480 (정보 320)', () => {
    expect(INSPECTOR).toEqual({ default: 320, min: 260, max: 480 });
    expect([clampInspector(100), clampInspector(320.4), clampInspector(999)]).toEqual([260, 320, 480]);
  });
  it('folds before the sidebar: first the item panel, then the sidebar, as the window narrows', () => {
    // 240 + 320 + 520 = 1080: both fit.
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes(), 1080, true)).toEqual({ sidebar: false, inspector: false });
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes(), 1079, true)).toEqual({ sidebar: false, inspector: true });
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes(), 760, true)).toEqual({ sidebar: false, inspector: true });
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes(), 759, true)).toEqual({ sidebar: true, inspector: true });
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes(), 720, true)).toEqual({ sidebar: true, inspector: true }); // 1440 window at 200 % zoom
    // A sidebar the user hid leaves its width to the item panel: 320 + 520 = 840.
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes({ collapsed: true }), 840, true)).toEqual({ sidebar: true, inspector: false });
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes({ collapsed: true }), 839, true).inspector).toBe(true);
    expect(inspectorAutoCollapses(panes(), 1079)).toBe(true);
    expect(inspectorAutoCollapses(panes(), 1080)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('is hidden where the view has no item panel, and where the user hid it', () => {
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes(), 1440, false)).toEqual({ sidebar: false, inspector: true });
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes({}, { collapsed: true }), 1440, true).inspector).toBe(true);
  });
  it('toggling shows a folded panel on demand and hides a shown one as the user choice', () => {
    expect(toggledInspector(panes(), 1000)).toEqual(i({ forceShown: true }));
    expect(hiddenPanes(panes({}, { forceShown: true }), 1000, true).inspector).toBe(false);
    expect(toggledInspector(panes(), 1440)).toEqual(i({ collapsed: true }));
    expect(toggledInspector(panes({}, { collapsed: true }), 1440)).toEqual(i());
    expect(toggledInspector(panes({}, { collapsed: true }), 1000)).toEqual(i({ forceShown: true }));
  });
  it('hiding a panel shown on demand gives the fold back to the window width (not a user collapse, M-5)', () => {
    expect(toggledInspector(panes({}, { forceShown: true }), 1000)).toEqual(i());
    expect(hiddenPanes({ ...panes(), inspector: toggledInspector(panes({}, { forceShown: true }), 1000) }, 1440, true).inspector).toBe(false);
  });
  it('forgets "shown on demand" once there is room again', () => {
    expect(inspectorAfterViewportChange(panes({}, { forceShown: true }), 1440)).toEqual(i());
    const same = panes({}, { forceShown: true });
    expect(inspectorAfterViewportChange(same, 1000)).toBe(same.inspector);
  });
  it('a drag never leaves the content column under 520 px, except for a panel shown on demand', () => {
    expect(draggedInspectorWidth(panes(), 1200, 470)).toBe(440); // 1200 − 240 − 520
    expect(draggedInspectorWidth(panes(), 1200, 400)).toBe(400);
    expect(draggedInspectorWidth(panes(), 1440, 600)).toBe(480);
    expect(draggedInspectorWidth(panes(), 1440, 100)).toBe(260);
    expect(draggedInspectorWidth(panes({}, { forceShown: true }), 1000, 470)).toBe(470);
  });
});

describe('layout.panes: one record for both panes (P-10)', () => {
  it('reads both panes, clamps the widths and defaults what is missing', () => {
    expect(parsePanes({ sidebar: 300, sidebarCollapsed: 1, 'inspector.info': 400, inspectorCollapsed: 1 })).toEqual(panes({ width: 300, collapsed: true }, { width: 400, collapsed: true }));
    expect(parsePanes(null)).toEqual(panes());
    expect(parsePanes({ sidebar: 9999, 'inspector.info': 9999 })).toEqual(panes({ width: 360 }, { width: 480 }));
    expect(parsePanes({ sidebar: 280, sidebarCollapsed: 0 })).toEqual(panes({ width: 280 })); // an M3 record: sidebar keys only
  });
  it('writes both panes every time, never one alone, and no session-only state', () => {
    expect(serializePanes(panes({ width: 280, collapsed: true, forceShown: true }, { width: 360, forceShown: true }))).toEqual({
      sidebar: 280, sidebarCollapsed: 1, 'inspector.info': 360, inspectorCollapsed: 0,
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import { layout } from '../design/tokens';

/** Sidebar width in px: one width for every view (design-spec 2.1, layout B invariant). */
export const SIDEBAR = { default: layout.sidebarWidth, min: layout.sidebarMin, max: layout.sidebarMax } as const;
/** Item panel width in px, info mode (design-spec 2.5: 정보 320, 260–480; the tutor mode gets its own in T1). */
export const INSPECTOR = { default: layout.inspectorWidth, min: layout.inspectorMin, max: layout.inspectorMax } as const;
/**
 * The content column never gets narrower than this: below it the item panel folds away by itself, then the sidebar
 * (design-spec 2.1 "항목 패널 → 사이드바 순으로 자동 접힌다", 8.3 200 % zoom without sideways scrolling). The M4
 * table's default columns at their default widths need 664 (200 + 180 + 64 + 88 + 132, the column catalogue): in a
 * column between 520 and that the table scrolls sideways inside its own scroll view (.library-table), never the window.
 */
export const CONTENT_MIN = 520;

export interface PaneState {
  width: number;
  /** The user hid it (its toggle, its shortcut, or dragged shut). Persisted. */
  collapsed: boolean;
  /** The user showed it while the window is too narrow for it. Session only. */
  forceShown: boolean;
}
/** The sidebar's state: the shape both panes share. */
export type SidebarState = PaneState;
/** Both panes, as layout.panes stores them: one record, so no writer can drop the other pane's keys (P-10). */
export interface PanesState {
  sidebar: PaneState;
  inspector: PaneState;
}

export const clampSidebar = (w: number): number => Math.min(SIDEBAR.max, Math.max(SIDEBAR.min, Math.round(w)));
export const clampInspector = (w: number): number => Math.min(INSPECTOR.max, Math.max(INSPECTOR.min, Math.round(w)));
export const autoCollapses = (viewportWidth: number, sidebarWidth: number): boolean => viewportWidth < sidebarWidth + CONTENT_MIN;
export const sidebarHidden = (s: SidebarState, viewportWidth: number): boolean => s.collapsed || (autoCollapses(viewportWidth, s.width) && !s.forceShown);

/** What the content column and the item panel share: the window less a shown sidebar (the toolbar's width too). */
const mainColumnWidth = (p: PanesState, viewportWidth: number): number => viewportWidth - (sidebarHidden(p.sidebar, viewportWidth) ? 0 : p.sidebar.width);
/** The item panel does not fit beside the content column's minimum. */
export const inspectorAutoCollapses = (p: PanesState, viewportWidth: number): boolean => mainColumnWidth(p, viewportWidth) < p.inspector.width + CONTENT_MIN;

/**
 * Which panes are out of sight at this width. The sidebar keeps its own rule (it folds below its width + 520), and the
 * item panel folds whenever it does not fit beside the content column: so it always goes first. `inspectorPresent`:
 * the view has an item panel (the library with its table; spec §5.1).
 */
export function hiddenPanes(p: PanesState, viewportWidth: number, inspectorPresent: boolean): { sidebar: boolean; inspector: boolean } {
  const inspector = !inspectorPresent || p.inspector.collapsed || (inspectorAutoCollapses(p, viewportWidth) && !p.inspector.forceShown);
  return { sidebar: sidebarHidden(p.sidebar, viewportWidth), inspector };
}

export function toggledSidebar(s: SidebarState, viewportWidth: number): SidebarState {
  if (sidebarHidden(s, viewportWidth)) return { ...s, collapsed: false, forceShown: autoCollapses(viewportWidth, s.width) };
  // Shown on demand in a narrow window: folding it again hands it back to the automatic fold, not a stored collapse (M-5).
  if (s.forceShown) return { ...s, forceShown: false };
  return { ...s, collapsed: true, forceShown: false };
}

/** ⌥⌘I and the toolbar toggle, with the sidebar's rules: on demand in a narrow window, a stored choice otherwise. */
export function toggledInspector(p: PanesState, viewportWidth: number): PaneState {
  const i = p.inspector;
  if (hiddenPanes(p, viewportWidth, true).inspector) return { ...i, collapsed: false, forceShown: inspectorAutoCollapses(p, viewportWidth) };
  if (i.forceShown) return { ...i, forceShown: false };
  return { ...i, collapsed: true, forceShown: false };
}

export function afterViewportChange(s: SidebarState, viewportWidth: number): SidebarState {
  return s.forceShown && !autoCollapses(viewportWidth, s.width) ? { ...s, forceShown: false } : s;
}

export function inspectorAfterViewportChange(p: PanesState, viewportWidth: number): PaneState {
  return p.inspector.forceShown && !inspectorAutoCollapses(p, viewportWidth) ? { ...p.inspector, forceShown: false } : p.inspector;
}

/**
 * The width a drag of the item panel's boundary ends at: within 260–480 and no wider than leaves the content column its
 * 520 — wider would fold the panel the moment it is let go. A panel shown on demand is already past that rule.
 */
export function draggedInspectorWidth(p: PanesState, viewportWidth: number, px: number): number {
  return clampInspector(p.inspector.forceShown ? px : Math.min(px, mainColumnWidth(p, viewportWidth) - CONTENT_MIN));
}

/** layout.panes → both panes; a key that is missing or not a number gives that pane's default (an M3 record has the sidebar only). */
export function parsePanes(raw: unknown): PanesState {
  const r = (raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const num = (k: string): number | null => (typeof r[k] === 'number' ? (r[k] as number) : null);
  const sidebarWidth = num('sidebar');
  const inspectorWidth = num('inspector.info');
  return {
    sidebar: { width: sidebarWidth === null ? SIDEBAR.default : clampSidebar(sidebarWidth), collapsed: r['sidebarCollapsed'] === 1, forceShown: false },
    inspector: { width: inspectorWidth === null ? INSPECTOR.default : clampInspector(inspectorWidth), collapsed: r['inspectorCollapsed'] === 1, forceShown: false },
  };
}

/** The whole layout.panes record (settings.set replaces it whole). The tutor mode's width joins it in T1. */
export const serializePanes = (p: PanesState): Record<string, number> => ({
  sidebar: p.sidebar.width,
  sidebarCollapsed: p.sidebar.collapsed ? 1 : 0,
  'inspector.info': p.inspector.width,
  inspectorCollapsed: p.inspector.collapsed ? 1 : 0,
});
```

```ts
/** Just the context fields (what main needs for the menu bar: availability, and the pane states for its labels). */
export function contextOf(env: CommandEnv): CommandContextState {
  return {
    view: env.view,
    blocked: env.blocked,
    textSize: env.textSize,
    libraryCount: env.libraryCount,
    selectionCount: env.selectionCount,
    selectionAvailable: env.selectionAvailable,
    selectionRelinkable: env.selectionRelinkable,
    ...(env.sidebar ? { sidebar: env.sidebar } : {}),
    ...(env.inspector ? { inspector: env.inspector } : {}),
  };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { formatDate } from '../format';
import { hasInfo, infoRows, partialDate } from './infoRows';

const times = { createdAt: '2026-10-20T11:40:00.000Z', updatedAt: '2026-10-21T00:30:00.000Z' };
const now = new Date(2026, 9, 23, 12, 0);

describe('정보 rows (spec §5.3)', () => {
  it('reads a year as a year and a month or a day as a date (design-spec 9 dates)', () => {
    expect(partialDate('2024')).toEqual({ label: '연도', value: '2024' });
    expect(partialDate('2024-03')).toEqual({ label: '날짜', value: '2024. 3.' });
    expect(partialDate('2024-03-15')).toEqual({ label: '날짜', value: '2024. 3. 15.' });
  });
  it('lists only the fields that have a value, in the spec order, then 추가일 · 수정일 always', () => {
    const rows = infoRows(
      {
        creators: [{ name: '한서진', role: 'author' }, { name: '윤재하', role: 'editor' }],
        date: '2024-03', publisher: '학습출판', language: '', url: 'https://example.org/a', abstract: '요약입니다.', extra: '6장 전체',
      },
      times,
      now,
    );
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.field)).toEqual(['creators', 'date', 'publisher', 'url', 'abstract', 'extra', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt']);
    expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({ label: '저자', value: '한서진, 윤재하 (편집자)' });
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.field === 'url')).toMatchObject({ kind: 'link', value: 'https://example.org/a' });
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.field === 'abstract')?.kind).toBe('long');
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.field === 'extra')?.kind).toBe('note');
    expect(rows.at(-2)).toMatchObject({ label: '추가일', value: formatDate(times.createdAt, now) });
    expect(rows.at(-1)?.title).toContain('2026');
  });
  it('knows an item with no info at all (whitespace counts as nothing)', () => {
    expect(hasInfo({ creators: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(hasInfo({ creators: [], publisher: '   ' })).toBe(false);
    expect(hasInfo({ creators: [], language: 'ko' })).toBe(true);
    expect(hasInfo({ creators: [{ name: '김하린', role: 'other' }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(infoRows({ creators: [] }, times, now).map((r) => r.field)).toEqual(['createdAt', 'updatedAt']);
  });
});
```

구현 — `R/format.ts` 끝에:
```ts
/** A duration as a player shows it (design-spec 9 "18:20"): m:ss under an hour, h:mm:ss from one; whole seconds, rounded down. */
export function formatDuration(ms: number): string {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
  const h = Math.floor(total / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
  const ss = String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0');
  return h > 0 ? `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${ss}` : `${m}:${ss}`;
}
```

`R/inspector/summary.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { formatSize } from '../format';
import { t } from '../strings';

/** One unbreakable value ("1.9 GB"): the line breaks at its middots, never inside a value (design-spec 4). */
const bound = (s: string): string => s.replace(/ /g, ' ');

function tally(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): { pdf: number; video: number; bytes: number } {
  let pdf = 0;
  let bytes = 0;
  for (const i of items) {
    if (i.type === 'pdf') pdf++;
    bytes += i.size;
  }
  return { pdf, video: items.length - pdf, bytes };
}

/** Nothing selected: "내 라이브러리 · 자료 48개(PDF 35 · 동영상 13) · 1.9 GB"; a kind without items is left out. */
export function libraryStats(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): string {
  const k = tally(items);
  const kinds = [k.pdf ? t.inspector.kindCount(t.library.type.pdf, k.pdf) : '', k.video ? t.inspector.kindCount(t.library.type.video, k.video) : ''].filter(Boolean);
  return t.inspector.stats(t.shell.myLibrary, items.length, kinds.join(' · '), bound(formatSize(k.bytes)));
}

/** Several selected: "PDF 2개 · 동영상 1개 · 합계 9.8 MB". */
export function multiSummary(items: readonly LibraryItem[]): string {
  const k = tally(items);
  return [
    k.pdf ? t.inspector.kindItems(t.library.type.pdf, k.pdf) : '',
    k.video ? t.inspector.kindItems(t.library.type.video, k.video) : '',
    t.inspector.total(bound(formatSize(k.bytes))),
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' · ');
}
```

```ts
export interface InfoRow {

  label: string;
  value: string;
  /** text: one value; link: an http(s) URL; long: the abstract (4 lines, then 더 보기); note: the memo as typed; time: a date with its full form as the tooltip. */
  kind: 'text' | 'link' | 'long' | 'note' | 'time';
  title?: string;
}

/** "2024" / "2024. 3." / "2024. 3. 15." from YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; a year alone is labelled 연도 (spec §5.3). */
export function partialDate(date: string): { label: string; value: string } {
  const m = /^(\d{4})(?:-(\d{2})(?:-(\d{2}))?)?$/.exec(date);
  if (!m) return { label: t.inspector.fields.date, value: date };
  const [, y, mo, d] = m;
  if (mo === undefined) return { label: t.inspector.fields.year, value: y! };
  return { label: t.inspector.fields.date, value: d === undefined ? t.inspector.monthDate(Number(y), Number(mo)) : t.inspector.dayDate(Number(y), Number(mo), Number(d)) };
}

const filled = (v: string | undefined): v is string => v !== undefined && v.trim() !== '';

/** Anything to show beyond the dates (else the panel says what writing it gives). */
export const hasInfo = (meta: ItemMetadata): boolean =>
  meta.creators.length > 0 || [meta.date, meta.publisher, meta.language, meta.url, meta.abstract, meta.extra].some(filled);

const fullTime = (iso: string): string => {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '' : d.toLocaleString('ko-KR', { dateStyle: 'long', timeStyle: 'short' });
};

/** The 정보 rows with a value, in the spec's order (§5.3), then 추가일 · 수정일, which are always there. */
export function infoRows(meta: ItemMetadata, item: Pick<LibraryItem, 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>, now: Date): InfoRow[] {
  const f = t.inspector.fields;
  const rows: InfoRow[] = [];
  if (meta.creators.length > 0) {
    const names = meta.creators.map((c) => (c.role === 'author' ? c.name : t.inspector.creatorWithRole(c.name, t.inspector.roles[c.role])));
    rows.push({ field: 'creators', label: f.creators, value: names.join(', '), kind: 'text' });
  }
  if (filled(meta.date)) rows.push({ field: 'date', ...partialDate(meta.date), kind: 'text' });
  if (filled(meta.publisher)) rows.push({ field: 'publisher', label: f.publisher, value: meta.publisher, kind: 'text' });
  if (filled(meta.language)) rows.push({ field: 'language', label: f.language, value: meta.language, kind: 'text' });
  if (filled(meta.url)) rows.push({ field: 'url', label: f.url, value: meta.url, kind: 'link' });
  if (filled(meta.abstract)) rows.push({ field: 'abstract', label: f.abstract, value: meta.abstract, kind: 'long' });
  if (filled(meta.extra)) rows.push({ field: 'extra', label: f.extra, value: meta.extra, kind: 'note' });
  rows.push({ field: 'createdAt', label: f.createdAt, value: formatDate(item.createdAt, now), kind: 'time', title: fullTime(item.createdAt) });
  rows.push({ field: 'updatedAt', label: f.updatedAt, value: formatDate(item.updatedAt, now), kind: 'time', title: fullTime(item.updatedAt) });
  return rows;
}
```

```ts
import { isAllowedAppUrl } from './url-policy';

/**
 * What our own pages may use, by Electron's permission names: full screen for the video viewer, clipboard writes for
 * the item panel's copy button (navigator.clipboard.writeText, P-6). Reading the clipboard and everything else stay denied.
 */
export const APP_PERMISSIONS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['fullscreen', 'clipboard-sanitized-write']);

export const appMayUse = (permission: string, requestingUrl: string, devOrigin: string | null): boolean =>
  APP_PERMISSIONS.has(permission) && isAllowedAppUrl(requestingUrl, devOrigin);
```

```ts
  session.defaultSession.setPermissionCheckHandler((_wc, permission, requestingOrigin, details) =>
    appMayUse(permission, details.requestingUrl ?? requestingOrigin, devOrigin),
  );
```

`R/shell/useSidebar.ts`의 `usePanePersistence` 전체를:
```ts
/** Saves both panes' widths and the user's collapse choices — one layout.panes record (P-10) — 300 ms after the last change. */
export function usePanePersistence(): void {
  const sidebarWidth = useShell((s) => s.sidebar.width);
  const sidebarCollapsed = useShell((s) => s.sidebar.collapsed);
  const inspectorWidth = useShell((s) => s.inspector.width);
  const inspectorCollapsed = useShell((s) => s.inspector.collapsed);
  const value = serializePanes({
    sidebar: { width: sidebarWidth, collapsed: sidebarCollapsed, forceShown: false },
    inspector: { width: inspectorWidth, collapsed: inspectorCollapsed, forceShown: false },
  });
  const json = JSON.stringify(value);
  // The boot value came from the setting itself; only a record that differs from the last one written is saved
  // (also when a change is undone within 300 ms, and under StrictMode's double effects).
  const saved = useRef<string | null>(null);
  saved.current ??= json;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (json === saved.current) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      saved.current = json;
      // A lost save only forgets this layout; log the code only.
      api().settings.set({ key: 'layout.panes', value }).then(
        (r) => {
          if (!r.ok) console.warn(`[layout] saving layout.panes failed: ${r.code}`);
        },
        () => console.warn('[layout] saving layout.panes failed: INTERNAL'),
      );
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    // `value` is the record `json` spells.
  }, [json]);
}
```
(파일의 `import { serializePanes, sidebarHidden, toggledSidebar } from './layout';`는 그대로 맞는다.)

`R/shell/useInspector.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { useCallback, useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { useShell } from '../state/shell-store';
import { lastInput } from '../ui/inputModality';
import { quietUntilInput } from '../ui/tooltipGate';
import { hiddenPanes, toggledInspector } from './layout';
import { useViewportWidth } from './useViewportWidth';

/** DOM id and test id of the toolbar toggle (inspector/InspectorToggle.tsx): where a fold hands a keyboard focus. */
export const INSPECTOR_TOGGLE_ID = 'inspector-toggle';

/** The item panel is out of sight: the view has none (`present` false), the user hid it, or the window is too narrow. */
export function useInspectorHidden(present: boolean): boolean {
  const sidebar = useShell((s) => s.sidebar);
  const inspector = useShell((s) => s.inspector);
  return hiddenPanes({ sidebar, inspector }, useViewportWidth(), present).inspector;
}

/** ⌥⌘I and the toolbar toggle (the registry handler), by the sidebar's rules (layout.ts toggledInspector). */
export function useToggleInspector(): () => void {
  return useCallback(() => {
    const { sidebar, inspector, setInspector } = useShell.getState();
    setInspector(toggledInspector({ sidebar, inspector }, innerWidth));
  }, []);
}

/**
 * Whatever folds the item panel — ⌥⌘I, its toggle, a drag or a key on its boundary, the window or the zoom — a focus
 * inside it does not fall to <body>: a keyboard user's goes to the toolbar toggle in the next frame (its ring and no
 * tooltip, as the sidebar's rescue does), a pointer user's is let go (Task 8 critique m1).
 */
export function useKeepFocusOnInspectorFold(hidden: boolean): void {
  const last = useRef(hidden);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (last.current === hidden) return;
    last.current = hidden;
    if (!hidden) return;
    const active = document.activeElement;
    if (!(active instanceof HTMLElement) || active.closest('#inspector, #inspector-separator') === null) return;
    if (lastInput() !== 'keyboard') {
      active.blur();
      return;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const now = document.activeElement;
      // The user moved on within the frame (F6 right after the fold): the focus they placed stays.
      if (now instanceof HTMLElement && now !== document.body && now !== active && now.closest('[inert]') === null) return;
      const toggle = document.getElementById(INSPECTOR_TOGGLE_ID);
      if (!toggle) return;
      flushSync(() => quietUntilInput());
      toggle.focus();
    });
  }, [hidden]);
}
```

`R/shell/Shell.tsx` 전체를:
```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { Group, Panel, Separator, usePanelRef, type Layout, type LayoutChangedMeta, type PanelImperativeHandle } from 'react-resizable-panels';
import { useShell } from '../state/shell-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { INSPECTOR, SIDEBAR, afterViewportChange, clampSidebar, draggedInspectorWidth, hiddenPanes, inspectorAfterViewportChange, sidebarHidden } from './layout';
import { SidebarToggle } from './SidebarToggle';
import { useKeepFocusOnInspectorFold } from './useInspector';
import { keepFocusAcross, useKeepFocusAcrossFold } from './useSidebar';
import { useViewportWidth } from './useViewportWidth';

/** The content and item panels' boxes clip: what scrolls is inside them (the table body, the panel body). */
const CLIP = { overflow: 'hidden' } as const;

/**
 * Layout B (design-spec 2.3): a full-height sidebar whose top 88 px (traffic lights + toggle, ⌘K launcher, 8 gap)
 * is identical in every view, a 1 px boundary with a ±4 px resize handle, and the main column: the 52 px toolbar over
 * the content and, in the library, the item panel (design-spec 2.5) — a nested group whose boundary works as the
 * sidebar's does, so the toolbar spans both.
 */
export function Shell(props: { sidebar: ReactNode; launcher?: ReactNode; toolbar: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; inspector?: ReactNode; overlays?: ReactNode }) {
  const panelRef = usePanelRef();
  const groupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inspectorRef = usePanelRef();
  const mainGroupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const sidebar = useShell((s) => s.sidebar);
  const setSidebar = useShell((s) => s.setSidebar);
  const inspector = useShell((s) => s.inspector);
  const setInspector = useShell((s) => s.setInspector);
  const viewportWidth = useViewportWidth();
  const hidden = sidebarHidden(sidebar, viewportWidth);
  const present = props.inspector !== undefined;
  const inspectorHidden = hiddenPanes({ sidebar, inspector }, viewportWidth, present).inspector;
  useKeepFocusAcrossFold(hidden);
  useKeepFocusOnInspectorFold(inspectorHidden);
  // Mount-time size only: a changing defaultSize re-registers the panel; later changes go through the imperative effect.
  const [initialSize] = useState(() => (hidden ? 0 : sidebar.width));

  useEffect(() => {
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    if (!panel) return;
    if (hidden && !panel.isCollapsed()) panel.collapse();
    else if (!hidden && panel.isCollapsed()) panel.resize(sidebar.width);
  }, [hidden, sidebar.width, panelRef]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const s = useShell.getState();
    const next = afterViewportChange(s.sidebar, viewportWidth);
    if (next !== s.sidebar) setSidebar(next);
    const nextInspector = inspectorAfterViewportChange({ sidebar: next, inspector: s.inspector }, viewportWidth);
    if (nextInspector !== s.inspector) setInspector(nextInspector);
  }, [viewportWidth, setSidebar, setInspector]);

  /** Only drags and separator keys count as the user's choice (not window resizes or our own collapse()). */
  const onLayoutChanged = (layout: Layout, meta: LayoutChangedMeta) => {
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    const group = groupRef.current;
    if (!meta.isUserInteraction || !panel || !group) return;
    const current = useShell.getState().sidebar;
    if (panel.isCollapsed()) {
      if (sidebarHidden(current, innerWidth)) return;
      keepFocusAcross(true); // dragged or keyed shut from the separator, which disappears with the sidebar
      // Shown on demand in a narrow window: shutting it hands it back to the automatic fold (M-5), as ⌃⌘S does.
      setSidebar(current.forceShown ? { ...current, forceShown: false } : { ...current, collapsed: true });
    } else {
      // From the new layout (percent of the group): getSize().inPixels reads the DOM, which a keyboard step has not re-rendered yet.
      const percent = layout['sidebar'] ?? panel.getSize().asPercentage;
      setSidebar({ ...current, width: clampSidebar((percent / 100) * group.offsetWidth), collapsed: false });
    }
  };

  /** The item panel's boundary, by the same rules; its fold rescue is useKeepFocusOnInspectorFold. */
  const onMainLayoutChanged = (layout: Layout, meta: LayoutChangedMeta) => {
    const panel = inspectorRef.current;
    const group = mainGroupRef.current;
    if (!meta.isUserInteraction || !panel || !group) return;
    const s = useShell.getState();
    const panes = { sidebar: s.sidebar, inspector: s.inspector };
    if (panel.isCollapsed()) {
      if (hiddenPanes(panes, innerWidth, true).inspector) return;
      setInspector(s.inspector.forceShown ? { ...s.inspector, forceShown: false } : { ...s.inspector, collapsed: true });
      return;
    }
    const px = ((layout['inspector'] ?? panel.getSize().asPercentage) / 100) * group.offsetWidth;
    const width = draggedInspectorWidth(panes, innerWidth, px);
    setInspector({ ...s.inspector, width, collapsed: false });
    // Dragged wider than leaves the content column its 520: back to the widest that does, rather than folding on release.
    if (Math.abs(width - px) >= 1) panel.resize(width);
  };

  return (
    <div className="window" data-testid="shell" data-sidebar={hidden ? 'hidden' : 'shown'} data-inspector={present ? (inspectorHidden ? 'hidden' : 'shown') : undefined}>
      <Group
        orientation="horizontal"
        className="window-panes"
        elementRef={groupRef}
        onLayoutChanged={onLayoutChanged}
        resizeTargetMinimumSize={{ fine: 9, coarse: 20 }}
      >
        <Panel
          id="sidebar"
          panelRef={panelRef}
          className="sidebar"
          defaultSize={initialSize}
          minSize={SIDEBAR.min}
          maxSize={SIDEBAR.max}
          collapsible
          collapsedSize={0}
          groupResizeBehavior="preserve-pixel-size"
        >
          {/* inert while folded: nothing in a 0 px panel may take focus or be read out. */}
          <nav className="sidebar-inner" aria-label={t.shell.sidebar} inert={hidden}>
            <div className="sidebar-top" data-testid="sidebar-top">
              <SidebarToggle place="sidebar" />
            </div>
            <div className="launcher-wrap">{hidden ? null : props.launcher}</div>
            <div className="sidebar-scroll" data-pane="sidebar">
              {props.sidebar}
            </div>
          </nav>
        </Panel>
        {/* Window-splitter pattern: the focusable handle is named after the pane it resizes. */}
        <Separator className="pane-separator" id="pane-separator" aria-label={t.shell.sidebar} />
        <Panel id="main" className="main-column">
          {props.toolbar}
          <Group orientation="horizontal" className="main-panes" elementRef={mainGroupRef} onLayoutChanged={onMainLayoutChanged} resizeTargetMinimumSize={{ fine: 9, coarse: 20 }}>
            <Panel id="content-pane" className="content-pane" style={CLIP}>
              <main className="content" data-testid="content" data-pane="content">
                {props.children}
              </main>
            </Panel>
            {present && (
              <>
                <Separator className="inspector-separator" id="inspector-separator" aria-label={t.inspector.panel} />
                <InspectorPanel panelRef={inspectorRef} hidden={inspectorHidden} width={inspector.width}>
                  {props.inspector}
                </InspectorPanel>
              </>
            )}
          </Group>
        </Panel>
      </Group>
      {props.overlays}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The item panel's slot. It mounts when the library's table first shows, so its first size comes from the store then;
 * later changes go through the imperative effect, as the sidebar's. Folded, it stays mounted and inert (an open edit
 * survives a fold; nothing in it takes focus or is read out).
 */
function InspectorPanel(props: { panelRef: RefObject<PanelImperativeHandle | null>; hidden: boolean; width: number; children: ReactNode }) {
  const { panelRef, hidden, width } = props;
  const [initialSize] = useState(() => (hidden ? 0 : width));
  useEffect(() => {
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    if (!panel) return;
    if (hidden && !panel.isCollapsed()) panel.collapse();
    else if (!hidden && panel.isCollapsed()) panel.resize(width);
  }, [hidden, width, panelRef]);
  return (
    <Panel
      id="inspector"
      data-testid="inspector-panel"
      panelRef={panelRef}
      className="inspector-panel"
      style={CLIP}
      defaultSize={initialSize}
      minSize={INSPECTOR.min}
      maxSize={INSPECTOR.max}
      collapsible
      collapsedSize={0}
      groupResizeBehavior="preserve-pixel-size"
    >
      <aside className="inspector" aria-label={t.inspector.panel} data-pane="inspector" inert={hidden}>
        {props.children}
      </aside>
    </Panel>
  );
}
```
주의: RRP의 `Panel`은 바깥 `div[data-panel][id][data-testid]`와 `className`·`style`을 받는 안쪽 `div`(인라인 `overflow: auto`)를 그린다. `style={CLIP}`이 안쪽 상자의 `overflow`를 덮는다. 바깥 상자의 자동 `data-testid`(= id)는 `data-testid="inspector-panel"`로 바꿔 `Inspector` 루트의 `inspector`와 겹치지 않게 한다.

`R/shell/panes.ts`(Task 3이 `landsOn`을 더하고 Task 5가 `usablePane`·`landIn`·`focusPaneNamed`로 나눈 모양): 첫 줄 주석과 `PANES`를
```ts
// F6 order (design-spec 7.4, 8.3): sidebar → table → item panel. The toast region (ui/toasts.tsx, data-pane="toasts")
// exists only while a toast is visible; it is the last stop so F6 still reaches a toast once the keymap owns F6 (R-1).
const PANES = ['sidebar', 'content', 'inspector', 'toasts'] as const;
```
로, `focusPane`의 문서 주석(Task 5: `F6 / ⇧F6: next / previous pane; folded (inert) and absent panes are skipped.`)을 `/** F6 / ⇧F6: next / previous pane (sidebar → content → item panel → toasts); folded (inert) and absent panes are skipped. */`로. 착지 규칙(`FOCUSABLE`·`landsOn`·`landIn`)은 그대로다: 표(grid) 안에서는 커서 행에만 내려앉고(P-31), 항목 패널은 grid가 아니므로 머리의 첫 동작 단추(`inspector-open`, 원본 없는 연결 파일이면 `inspector-relink`)에 내려앉는다. 접힌 패널(`inert`, 폭 0)은 `usablePane`이 건너뛴다.

```ts
export const useItemDetail = (itemId: string) => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.detail(itemId), queryFn: () => unwrap(api().library.detail({ itemId })) });
```

`R/viewers/pdfjs.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import * as lib from 'pdfjs-dist';
import workerUrl from 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url';
import { assetUrl } from '@learn/domain';

let ready: Promise<typeof lib> | null = null;

/** pdf.js with its worker set, once, whichever needs it first: the reader or the item panel's page count (P-28). */
export function pdfjs(): Promise<typeof import('pdfjs-dist')> {
  ready ??= Promise.resolve().then(() => {
    lib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerUrl;
    return lib;
  });
  return ready;
}

/** pdf.js runtime data copied by scripts/copy-pdfjs-assets.mjs; same-origin in dev and production. */
const dataUrl = (dir: string) => new URL(`pdfjs/${dir}/`, document.baseURI).href;

/** getDocument's source for an asset, with the runtime data every caller needs. */
export const pdfSource = (assetId: string) => ({
  url: assetUrl(assetId),
  cMapUrl: dataUrl('cmaps'),
  cMapPacked: true,
  standardFontDataUrl: dataUrl('standard_fonts'),
  wasmUrl: dataUrl('wasm'),
  iccUrl: dataUrl('iccs'),
  enableXfa: false,
});
```
`R/viewers/PdfViewer.tsx`:
- import 세 줄 `import * as pdfjs from 'pdfjs-dist';`, `import workerUrl from 'pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url';`, 그리고 모듈 수준의 `pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerUrl;`와 `const dataUrl = …;` 두 문장(주석 포함)을 지운다. `import type { PDFDocumentProxy, RenderTask } from 'pdfjs-dist';`를 `import type { PDFDocumentLoadingTask, PDFDocumentProxy, RenderTask } from 'pdfjs-dist';`로, `import { assetUrl, type LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';`를 `import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';`로 바꾸고 `import { pdfSource, pdfjs } from './pdfjs';`를 더한다.
- 문서 여는 effect 전체를:

```tsx
    void pdfjs().then((lib) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      task = lib.getDocument(pdfSource(item.assetId));
      task.promise.then(
        (d) => { if (!cancelled) setDoc(d); },
        (e: unknown) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          logFailure(e);
          setOpenFailed(true);
        },
      );
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      void task?.destroy();
    };
  }, [item.assetId]);
```
(정적 import 그대로라 pdf.js는 지금처럼 App 청크에 있다. 바뀌는 것은 워커 설정의 자리뿐이다.)

`R/inspector/fileFacts.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import type { PDFDocumentLoadingTask } from 'pdfjs-dist';
import { assetUrl } from '@learn/domain';
import { pdfSource, pdfjs } from '../viewers/pdfjs';

/** What the panel's head can tell from the file itself (spec §5.3): a PDF's page count, a video's length. */
export interface FileFacts {
  pages?: number;
  durationMs?: number;
}
export interface Probe {
  done: Promise<FileFacts>;
  cancel(): void;
}

/** By revision: a revision's bytes never change, so a fact read once holds for the session (a failed read is {}). */
const known = new Map<string, FileFacts>();
export const knownFacts = (revisionId: string): FileFacts | undefined => known.get(revisionId);
export const rememberFacts = (revisionId: string, facts: FileFacts): void => void known.set(revisionId, facts);

/** numPages without the whole file: no streaming and no auto-fetch, so pdf.js asks the asset protocol for ranges only. */
export function probePdf(assetId: string): Probe {
  let task: PDFDocumentLoadingTask | null = null;
  let cancelled = false;
  const done = pdfjs()
    .then(async (lib): Promise<FileFacts> => {
      if (cancelled) return {};
      task = lib.getDocument({ ...pdfSource(assetId), disableAutoFetch: true, disableStream: true });
      try {
        return { pages: (await task.promise).numPages };
      } finally {
        void task.destroy();
      }
    })
    .catch((): FileFacts => ({}));
  return {
    done,
    cancel: () => {
      cancelled = true;
      void task?.destroy();
    },
  };
}

/** The duration from the metadata alone (preload="metadata"); a file the engine cannot read gives {}. */
export function probeVideo(assetId: string): Probe {
  const video = document.createElement('video');
  video.preload = 'metadata';
  video.muted = true;
  const release = () => {
    video.removeAttribute('src');
    video.load();
  };
  const done = new Promise<FileFacts>((resolve) => {
    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => resolve(Number.isFinite(video.duration) && video.duration > 0 ? { durationMs: Math.round(video.duration * 1000) } : {}), { once: true });
    video.addEventListener('error', () => resolve({}), { once: true });
  }).finally(release);
  video.src = assetUrl(assetId);
  return { done, cancel: release };
}
```

`R/inspector/useFileFacts.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { knownFacts, probePdf, probeVideo, rememberFacts, type FileFacts } from './fileFacts';

const NONE: FileFacts = {};

/**
 * Page count or length of the selected item, read by the renderer from the file (spec §5.3). Only the item on show is
 * read: moving on cancels the read. Known revisions answer at once; the head keeps its line meanwhile (the fact joins
 * the end of it, so nothing moves). A missing file is not read.
 */
export function useFileFacts(item: LibraryItem): FileFacts {
  const [facts, setFacts] = useState<FileFacts>(() => knownFacts(item.revisionId) ?? NONE);
  useEffect(() => {
    const hit = knownFacts(item.revisionId);
    setFacts(hit ?? NONE);
    if (hit || item.availability === 'missing') return;
    const probe = item.type === 'pdf' ? probePdf(item.assetId) : probeVideo(item.assetId);
    let live = true;
    void probe.done.then((found) => {
      if (!live) return;
      rememberFacts(item.revisionId, found);
      setFacts(found);
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
      probe.cancel();
    };
  }, [item.revisionId, item.assetId, item.type, item.availability]);
  return facts;
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button as AriaButton, Disclosure, DisclosurePanel, Heading } from 'react-aria-components';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { useSections, type SectionId } from './sections';

/** A panel section (library.html .section): a disclosure head with the section's name, and room at its end (`extra`). */
export function Section({ id, title, extra, testId, children }: { id: SectionId; title: string; extra?: ReactNode; testId: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  const open = useSections((s) => s.open[id]);
  const setOpen = useSections((s) => s.setOpen);
  return (
    <section className="section" data-testid={testId}>
      <Disclosure isExpanded={open} onExpandedChange={(next) => setOpen(id, next)}>
        <div className="section-head">
          <Heading level={3} className="section-title">
            <AriaButton slot="trigger" className="section-toggle">
              <Icon icon={ChevronDown} size="xs" />
              {title}
            </AriaButton>
          </Heading>
          {extra}
        </div>
        <DisclosurePanel className="section-body">{children}</DisclosurePanel>
      </Disclosure>
    </section>
  );
}
```

`R/inspector/useShownAfter.ts`:
```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

/** True once `active` has lasted `ms` (design-spec 6: a load under 300 ms shows nothing); false as soon as it ends. */
export function useShownAfter(active: boolean, ms: number): boolean {
  const [late, setLate] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) {
      setLate(false);
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setLate(true), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [active, ms]);
  return active && late;
}
```

```tsx
import { Clapperboard, FileText, FolderSearch } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById, commandLabel, type CommandId, type LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { formatDuration } from '../format';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { useFileFacts } from './useFileFacts';

/**
 * The panel's head (library.html inspectorItem): kind · pages or length, the title (title3, never above the content's
 * title; user text, so no text-wrap: pretty), "저자 · 연도" when known, and the item's actions through the registry.
 * A missing file (P-8): a linked one leads with 다시 연결… and keeps 열기 (it reaches the notice); a managed one leads
 * with 열기; Finder에서 보기 stays in place, disabled with the reason.
 */
export function InfoHead({ item }: { item: LibraryItem }) {
  const { env, run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  const facts = useFileFacts(item);
  const platform = currentPlatform();
  const target = { itemIds: [item.id] };
  const label = (id: CommandId) => commandLabel(commandById(id), platform);
  const relinkFirst = item.availability === 'missing' && item.storageMode === 'linked';
  const kind =
    item.type === 'pdf'
      ? [t.library.type.pdf, facts.pages === undefined ? '' : t.inspector.pages(facts.pages)]
      : [t.library.type.video, facts.durationMs === undefined ? '' : formatDuration(facts.durationMs)];
  const byline = [item.creators.join(', '), item.year === null ? '' : String(item.year)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return (
    <header className="item-head" data-testid="inspector-head">
      <div className="kind" data-testid="inspector-kind">
        <Icon icon={item.type === 'video' ? Clapperboard : FileText} size="sm" />
        <span className="num">{kind.filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</span>
      </div>
      <h2>{item.title}</h2>
      {byline && <div className="authors">{byline}</div>}
      <div className="actions">
        {relinkFirst && (
          <Button variant="primary" testId="inspector-relink" onPress={() => run('item.relink', target)} isDisabled={!isEnabled('item.relink', target)} disabledReason={t.common.busy}>
            {label('item.relink')}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button variant={relinkFirst ? 'secondary' : 'primary'} testId="inspector-open" onPress={() => run('item.open', target)} isDisabled={!isEnabled('item.open', target)} disabledReason={t.common.busy}>
          {label('item.open')}
        </Button>
        <Button
          icon={FolderSearch}
          testId="inspector-reveal"
          onPress={() => run('item.showInFolder', target)}
          isDisabled={!isEnabled('item.showInFolder', target)}
          disabledReason={env.blocked ? t.common.busy : t.reader.needsFile}
        >
          {label('item.showInFolder')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
```
