```tsx
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { ItemDetail, LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { cx } from '../ui/cx';
import { useNow } from '../useNow';
import { hasInfo, infoRows, type InfoRow } from './infoRows';
import { Section } from './Section';

/** 정보 (spec §5.3): the rows that have a value, then 추가일 · 수정일; with no info yet, what writing it gives. */
export function InfoSection({ item, detail }: { item: LibraryItem; detail: ItemDetail }) {
  const now = useNow();
  return (
    <Section id="info" title={t.inspector.sections.info} testId="info-section">
      {!hasInfo(detail.metadata) && (
        <p className="info-hint" data-testid="info-empty">
          {t.inspector.noInfo}
        </p>
      )}
      <dl className="kv">
        {infoRows(detail.metadata, item, now).map((row) => (
          <div key={row.field} className="kv-row" data-testid="info-row" data-field={row.field}>
            <dt>{row.label}</dt>
            <dd>
              <RowValue row={row} />
            </dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
    </Section>
  );
}

function RowValue({ row }: { row: InfoRow }) {
  // target=_blank: the window-open handler hands http(s) to shell.openExternal in main (security.ts); never a navigation here.
  if (row.kind === 'link')
    return (
      <a className="link" href={row.value} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
        {row.value}
      </a>
    );
  if (row.kind === 'long') return <LongText text={row.value} />;
  return (
    <span className={cx(row.kind === 'note' && 'note', row.kind === 'time' && 'num')} title={row.title}>
      {row.value}
    </span>
  );
}

/** The abstract: four lines, then 더 보기 / 접기 while it is longer than that (spec §5.3). */
function LongText({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [overflows, setOverflows] = useState(false);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const measure = () => setOverflows(el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 1);
    measure();
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(measure); // the panel's width changes the line count
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [text, open]);
  return (
    <>
      <span ref={ref} className={cx('long', !open && 'clamp')}>
        {text}
      </span>
      {(overflows || open) && (
        <div className="more-row">
          <Button variant="plain-accent" size="small" testId="info-more" onPress={() => setOpen(!open)}>
            {open ? t.inspector.showLess : t.inspector.showMore}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

`R/inspector/FileSection.tsx`:
```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import type { ItemDetail } from '@learn/domain';
import { useAppInfo } from '../data/queries';
import { formatSize, homeRelative } from '../format';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { IconButton } from '../ui/Button';
import { cx } from '../ui/cx';
import { showToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { Section } from './Section';

/** How long the copy button says 복사했습니다 (spec §5.3). */
export const COPIED_MS = 1500;

interface FileRow {
  field: 'storage' | 'size' | 'originalName' | 'location';
  label: string;
  value: string;
  title?: string;
  mono?: boolean;
}

/** 파일 (spec §5.3): where the technical values live (design-spec 9), paths and the hash in mono, end-ellipsised with the whole value as tooltip. */
export function FileSection({ detail }: { detail: ItemDetail }) {
  const home = useAppInfo().data?.homeDir;
  const f = detail.file;
  const rows: FileRow[] = [
    { field: 'storage', label: t.inspector.file.storage, value: t.inspector.storage[f.storageMode] },
    { field: 'size', label: t.inspector.file.size, value: formatSize(f.size) },
    { field: 'originalName', label: t.inspector.file.originalName, value: f.originalName, title: f.originalName },
    ...(f.storageMode === 'linked' && f.externalPath
      ? [{ field: 'location' as const, label: t.inspector.file.location, value: homeRelative(f.externalPath, home), title: f.externalPath, mono: true }]
      : []),
  ];
  return (
    <Section id="file" title={t.inspector.sections.file} testId="file-section">
      <dl className="kv">
        {rows.map((row) => (
          <div key={row.field} className="kv-row" data-testid="file-row" data-field={row.field}>
            <dt>{row.label}</dt>
            <dd className={cx('ellipsis', row.mono && 'mono c-secondary', row.field === 'size' && 'num')} title={row.title}>
              {row.value}
            </dd>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className="kv-row" data-testid="file-row" data-field="sha256">
          <dt>{t.inspector.fileSha}</dt>
          <dd className="sha">
            <span className="mono c-secondary" data-testid="sha-value" title={f.sha256}>{`${f.sha256.slice(0, 8)}…`}</span>
            <CopyButton value={f.sha256} />
          </dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
    </Section>
  );
}

/** 전체 SHA-256 복사: the clipboard gets the whole value; the tooltip confirms for 1.5 s, and no toast (spec §5.3). */
function CopyButton({ value }: { value: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!copied) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), COPIED_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [copied]);
  const copy = () =>
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(value).then(
      () => setCopied(true),
      (e: unknown) => {
        console.warn(`[inspector] copy failed: ${(e as Error)?.name ?? 'Error'}`);
        showToast({ kind: 'error', title: t.inspector.copyFailedTitle, body: t.inspector.copyFailedBody, testId: 'copy-failed' });
      },
    );
  return (
    <>
      <IconButton icon={Copy} size="small" label={copied ? t.inspector.copied : t.inspector.copySha} tooltipOpen={copied} onPress={() => void copy()} testId="copy-sha" />
      {/* A tooltip is not read out: the confirmation is said in a polite live region too. */}
      <span className="visually-hidden" role="status">
        {copied ? t.inspector.copied : ''}
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Clapperboard, FileText, Files, MousePointer2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { useItemDetail, useItems } from '../data/queries';
import { sortItems } from '../library/sort';
import { useLibrarySettings } from '../library/useLibrarySettings';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { PaneEmpty } from '../ui/PaneEmpty';
import { Spinner } from '../ui/Spinner';
import { FileSection } from './FileSection';
import { InfoHead } from './InfoHead';
import { InfoSection } from './InfoSection';
import { libraryStats, multiSummary } from './summary';
import { useShownAfter } from './useShownAfter';

const NO_ITEMS: readonly LibraryItem[] = [];
/** Titles a multiple selection lists before "외 N개" (spec §5.4). */
const MULTI_TITLES = 8;
/** A load shorter than this shows nothing (design-spec 6). */
const LOADING_DELAY_MS = 300;

/** Info mode (spec §5.3–5.4), from the table's selection: nothing selected, several, or one item. */
export function InfoPane() {
  const items = useItems().data ?? NO_ITEMS;
  const selected = useLibrary((s) => s.selected);
  // The selected items in list order (the store's set is in the order they were picked): equal values keep the list's
  // order in sortItems (Q-46), so MultiSelection's titles come in the table's relative order.
  const chosen = useMemo(() => (selected.size === 0 ? NO_ITEMS : items.filter((i) => selected.has(i.id))), [selected, items]);
  if (chosen.length === 0) return <NoSelection items={items} />;
  if (chosen.length > 1) return <MultiSelection items={chosen} />;
  return <ItemInfo key={chosen[0]!.id} item={chosen[0]!} />;
}

/**
 * library.html?state=none: the empty-state format (design-spec 6; Task 5's PaneEmpty on Task 3's .pane-empty) and the
 * library's numbers in tertiary, last, in the slot after the text (no button there).
 */
function NoSelection({ items }: { items: readonly LibraryItem[] }) {
  const stats = useMemo(() => libraryStats(items), [items]);
  return (
    <PaneEmpty
      icon={MousePointer2}
      title={t.inspector.noneTitle}
      testId="inspector-none"
      action={
        <div className="pe-text pe-stats" data-testid="inspector-stats">
          {stats}
        </div>
      }
    >
      {t.inspector.noneBody}
    </PaneEmpty>
  );
}

/** library.html?state=multi without its M5/M7 parts (no action buttons, no common sections): the kinds, the count, the titles. */
function MultiSelection({ items }: { items: readonly LibraryItem[] }) {
  const { sort } = useLibrarySettings();
  // The table's own sort over the selected rows, which come in list order (ties keep it, Q-46): the table's relative order.
  const shown = useMemo(() => sortItems(items, sort).slice(0, MULTI_TITLES), [items, sort]);
  const summary = useMemo(() => multiSummary(items), [items]);
  return (
    <div className="inspector-scroll" data-testid="inspector-multi">
      <header className="item-head">
        <div className="kind" data-testid="inspector-kind">
          <Icon icon={Files} size="sm" />
          <span className="num">{summary}</span>
        </div>
        <h2>{t.inspector.multiTitle(items.length)}</h2>
        <ul className="multi-list">
          {shown.map((i) => (
            <li key={i.id} className="multi-row" data-testid="multi-row">
              <Icon icon={i.type === 'video' ? Clapperboard : FileText} size="sm" />
              <span className="ellipsis" title={i.title}>
                {i.title}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
          {items.length > MULTI_TITLES && <li className="multi-more">{t.inspector.more(items.length - MULTI_TITLES)}</li>}
        </ul>
      </header>
    </div>
  );
}

/** One item: the head at once from the list row, the sections when the item's detail has come (300 ms rule meanwhile). */
export function ItemInfo({ item }: { item: LibraryItem }) {
  const detail = useItemDetail(item.id);
  const loading = useShownAfter(detail.isPending, LOADING_DELAY_MS);
  return (
    <div className="inspector-scroll" data-testid="inspector-item" data-item-id={item.id}>
      <InfoHead item={item} />
      {detail.data ? (
        <>
          <InfoSection item={item} detail={detail.data} />
          <FileSection detail={detail.data} />
        </>
      ) : detail.isError ? (
        <div className="pane-empty top" data-testid="inspector-failed">
          <div className="pe-title">{t.inspector.detailFailed}</div>
          <div className="pe-text">{detail.error.message}</div>
          <Button size="small" isPending={detail.isFetching} onPress={() => void detail.refetch()}>
            {t.common.retry}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : loading ? (
        <div className="pane-empty top" data-testid="inspector-loading">
          <div className="loading">
            <Spinner />
            {t.inspector.loading}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { PanelRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById, commandLabel } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { INSPECTOR_TOGGLE_ID } from '../shell/useInspector';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { IconButton } from '../ui/Button';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';

/**
 * The toolbar's last control (design-spec 2.4, library.html libraryHeader): on = --fill-pressed. Named by what a press
 * does now, as the 보기 menu says it (항목 패널 가리기 / 항목 패널 보기); disabled with the reason while work holds the window.
 */
export function InspectorToggle() {
  const { env, run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  const shown = env.inspector === 'shown';
  const command = commandById('view.toggleInspector');
  return (
    <IconButton
      id={INSPECTOR_TOGGLE_ID}
      icon={PanelRight}
      label={commandLabel(command, currentPlatform(), { inspector: shown ? 'shown' : 'hidden' })}
      accelerator={command.accelerator}
      isOn={shown}
      onPress={() => run('view.toggleInspector')}
      isDisabled={!isEnabled('view.toggleInspector')}
      disabledReason={t.common.busy}
      aria-expanded={shown}
      aria-controls="inspector"
      testId={INSPECTOR_TOGGLE_ID}
    />
  );
}
```

`R/styles/screens/inspector.css`(새 파일, `R/styles/index.ts`에서 `import './screens/library.css';` 다음 줄에 `import './screens/inspector.css';`):
```css
@layer screens {
  /* The main column (design-spec 2.3): toolbar, then content | item panel. The panel library gives the group an inline
     height of 100 %; a zero basis lets it take what the toolbar leaves. */
  .main-panes {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .content-pane {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  /* The item panel (design-spec 2.5; library.html .inspector): --bg-content, its 1 px boundary on the left edge. */
  .inspector-panel {
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    background: var(--bg-content);
    box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 var(--separator);
  }
  .inspector {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    padding-left: 1px; /* local: the boundary line's column */
  }
  /* A pane F6 lands on as a whole (nothing to focus in it): the ring inside the clipped panel. */
  .inspector:focus-visible {
    outline-offset: calc(var(--focus-ring-width) * -1);
  }
  /* Its resize handle, as the sidebar's: zero width on the boundary, ±4 px hit area, the line is the panel's own. */
  .inspector-separator {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 3;
    flex: 0 0 0px;
    outline: none;
  }
  .inspector-separator::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0 -4px;
  }
  .inspector-separator:focus-visible::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0 -2px 0 -1px; /* local: 3 px over the panel's line, which lies right of the handle */
    background: var(--focus);
  }
  :root[data-window-inactive] .inspector-separator:focus-visible::before {
    content: none;
  }
  .window[data-inspector='hidden'] .inspector-separator {
    display: none;
  }
  .inspector-body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .inspector-scroll {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  /* Head (library.html .item-head). */
  .inspector .item-head {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-8);
    padding: var(--space-16) var(--space-16) var(--space-12);
  }
  .inspector .item-head .kind {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-6);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
  }
  /* title3: the side panel never out-ranks the content's title; user text, so no text-wrap: pretty (design-spec 4). */
  .inspector .item-head h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font: var(--type-title3);
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .inspector .item-head .authors {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .inspector .item-head .actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--space-8);
    margin-top: var(--space-4);
  }

  /* Sections (library.html .section, .section-head). */
  .inspector .section {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--separator);
    padding: 0 var(--space-16) var(--space-12);
  }
  .inspector .section-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 36px; /* local: section header row */
    margin-left: -8px; /* local: the chevron on x 12, as the mockup's */
  }
  .inspector .section-title {
    margin: 0;
    font: var(--type-headline);
  }
  .inspector .section-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-4);
    height: var(--control-height-small);
    padding: 0 var(--space-4);
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: none;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font: inherit;
    cursor: default;
    outline: none;
  }
  .inspector .section-toggle .icon {
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    transition: rotate var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard);
  }
  .inspector .section-toggle[aria-expanded='false'] .icon {
    rotate: -90deg;
  }
  .inspector .section-toggle[data-focus-visible] {
    outline: var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--focus);
    outline-offset: calc(var(--focus-ring-width) * -1);
  }
  .inspector .section-head > :is(.icon-btn, .soft-disabled) {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: -6px; /* local: the glyph on the section's right inset, as the mockup's */
  }

  /* Label–value rows (library.html .kv). */
  .inspector .kv {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr); /* local: the label column */
    column-gap: var(--space-12);
    row-gap: var(--space-6);
    align-items: baseline;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .inspector .kv-row {
    display: contents;
  }
  .inspector .kv dt {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
    text-align: right;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .inspector .kv dd {
    margin: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .inspector .kv dd.ellipsis {
    overflow-wrap: normal;
  }
  .inspector .kv :is(.note, .long) {
    white-space: pre-wrap;
  }
  .inspector .kv .clamp {
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .inspector .kv .link {
    color: var(--accent-text);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .inspector .kv .link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
  .inspector .kv .more-row {
    margin-left: calc(var(--space-8) * -1); /* the plain button's label on the value column */
  }
  .inspector .kv dd.sha {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-6);
  }
  .inspector .info-hint {
    margin: 0 0 var(--space-8);
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
  }

  /* Several selected (library.html .multi-list). */
  .inspector .multi-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    margin: var(--space-4) 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .inspector .multi-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-6);
    height: 24px; /* local: library.html .collection-path */
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .inspector .multi-row .icon {
    flex: none;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .inspector .multi-more {
    padding-left: var(--space-20); /* on the titles' column: 14 icon + 6 gap */
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
    font: var(--type-footnote);
  }

  /* Empty and loading states (design-spec 6; library.html .pane-empty): the shape is Task 3's components/pane-empty.css
     (.pane-empty, .pane-empty.top, .pe-title, .pe-text, .loading) and Task 5's PaneEmpty. The panel adds balanced lines
     in its narrow column and the library's numbers under 선택한 자료 없음. */
  .inspector .pane-empty :is(.pe-title, .pe-text) {
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  .inspector .pane-empty .pe-stats {
    margin-top: var(--space-12);
    color: var(--text-tertiary);
  }
}
```

`E/helpers.ts`의 `importFiles` 아래에(B.8):
```ts
/** The system clipboard's text, read in main: the page may write the clipboard but never read it (P-6). */
export const readClipboard = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<string> => app.evaluate(({ clipboard }) => clipboard.readText());
```

`E/inspector.spec.ts`(새 파일, 전문):
```ts
// The item panel (spec §5, design-spec 2.5): its slot under the toolbar, folding before the sidebar, ⌥⌘I, F6, and the
// info mode's head, sections and states. ⌥⌘I goes through its menu item (CDP keys never reach native accelerators on
// Linux); the macOS evidence lane presses it for real.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { FIXTURES, expectDisabledReason, importPaths, launch, mainWindow, menuSnapshot, readClipboard, runMenuCommand, seedMetadata, selectRows, type MenuNode } from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const MP4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-h264-aac.mp4');
const REVEAL = process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기';

const dirs = (testInfo: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata')] as const;
const zoom = async (app: ElectronApplication, f: number) => (await mainWindow(app)).evaluate((w, f) => w.webContents.setZoomFactor(f), f);
const contentWidth = async (app: ElectronApplication, width: number) =>
  (await mainWindow(app)).evaluate((w, width) => w.setContentSize(width, w.getContentSize()[1]!), width);
const panelState = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('shell').getAttribute('data-inspector');
const panelWidth = async (page: Page) => Math.round((await page.getByTestId('inspector-panel').boundingBox())?.width ?? 0);
const inPane = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.closest('[data-pane]')?.getAttribute('data-pane') ?? null);
const focusedTestId = (page: Page) => page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.closest('[data-testid]')?.getAttribute('data-testid') ?? null);
const flatten = (nodes: readonly MenuNode[]): MenuNode[] => nodes.flatMap((n) => [n, ...flatten(n.submenu ?? [])]);
const menuItem = async (app: ElectronApplication, id: string) => flatten(await menuSnapshot(app)).find((n) => n.id === id);
/** Titles in the table's order: rows are placed by data-index, and a virtualized body's DOM order need not be the visual one. */
const tableOrder = (page: Page) =>
  page.getByTestId('item-row').evaluateAll((rows) =>
    rows.sort((a, b) => Number(a.getAttribute('data-index')) - Number(b.getAttribute('data-index'))).map((r) => r.getAttribute('data-title') ?? ''),
  );
/** Text with U+00A0 read as a space (the copy binds values with it, design-spec 4). */
const plain = (s: string | null) => (s ?? '').replace(/ /g, ' ');
const detailOf = (page: Page, itemId: string) =>
  page.evaluate(async (id) => {
    const r = await window.learn.library.detail({ itemId: id });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.detail failed: ${r.code}`);
    return r.data;
  }, itemId);
/** The stored layout.panes setting (null while nothing was ever saved), read after the 300 ms save debounce. */
const savedPanes = async (page: Page): Promise<unknown> => {
  await page.waitForTimeout(600);
  return page.evaluate(async () => {
    const r = await window.learn.settings.get({ key: 'layout.panes' });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`settings.get failed: ${r.code}`);
    return r.data;
  });
};
/** Room for 240 + 520 + 320: a 1440 px window. The 1024 px macOS runner may keep it narrower: there the panel folds. */
async function roomForPanel(app: ElectronApplication, page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await contentWidth(app, 1440);
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => innerWidth)).toBeGreaterThan(1000);
  const width = await page.evaluate(() => innerWidth);
  test.skip(width < 1080, `a ${width} px window folds the item panel by design; Linux CI and the macOS evidence lane cover this`);
}

test('one item: the head, the info rows that have a value and the file section; nothing selected shows the library; several show a summary in table order', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(page, [PDF, KO_PDF, MP4]);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('item-row')).toHaveCount(3);
    // Nothing is selected: the import came from the page, so no focus entered the table (only that picks a first row, Q-48).
    const none = page.getByTestId('inspector-none');
    await expect(none).toContainText('선택한 자료 없음');
    await expect(none).toContainText('표에서 자료를 고르면 정보가 여기에 보입니다.');
    expect(plain(await page.getByTestId('inspector-stats').textContent())).toMatch(/^내 라이브러리 · 자료 3개\(PDF 2 · 동영상 1\) · [\d.]+ MB$/);

    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    const head = page.getByTestId('inspector-head');
    await expect(head.locator('h2')).toHaveText('sample');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-kind')).toHaveText('PDF · 3쪽'); // pdf.js numPages of the 3-page fixture
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-open')).toHaveText('열기');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-open')).toHaveClass(/btn-primary/);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-reveal')).toHaveText(REVEAL);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-relink')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-empty')).toHaveText('저자와 연도를 적어 두면 표에서 정렬하고 찾을 수 있습니다.');
    expect(await page.getByTestId('info-row').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-field')))).toEqual(['createdAt', 'updatedAt']);
    const file = (field: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="file-row"][data-field="${field}"] dd`);
    await expect(file('storage')).toHaveText('사본 · 라이브러리 안');
    await expect(file('originalName')).toHaveText('sample.pdf');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="file-row"][data-field="location"]')).toHaveCount(0); // a library copy has no outside location
    const sha = (await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).file.sha256;
    await expect(page.getByTestId('sha-value')).toHaveText(`${sha.slice(0, 8)}…`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('sha-value')).toHaveAttribute('title', sha);

    // Info written meanwhile arrives with libraryChanged: rows in the spec's order, and the byline in the head.
    await seedMetadata(page, pdf!.id, {
      creators: [{ name: '한서진', role: 'author' }, { name: '윤재하', role: 'editor' }],
      date: '2024-03', publisher: '학습출판', language: '한국어', url: 'https://example.org/signal', abstract: '세포 신호 전달의 개요.', extra: '6장 전체',
    });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-empty')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect
      .poll(() => page.getByTestId('info-row').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-field'))))
      .toEqual(['creators', 'date', 'publisher', 'language', 'url', 'abstract', 'extra', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt']);
    const info = (field: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="info-row"][data-field="${field}"]`);
    await expect(info('creators').locator('dd')).toHaveText('한서진, 윤재하 (편집자)');
    await expect(info('date').locator('dt')).toHaveText('날짜');
    await expect(info('date').locator('dd')).toHaveText('2024. 3.');
    await expect(head.locator('.authors')).toHaveText('한서진, 윤재하 · 2024');

    await selectRows(page, ['sample', '한글 경로 (테스트) #1', 'sample-h264-aac'], { modifier: 'Meta' });
    const multi = page.getByTestId('inspector-multi');
    await expect(multi.locator('h2')).toHaveText('자료 3개 선택');
    expect(plain(await multi.getByTestId('inspector-kind').textContent())).toMatch(/^PDF 2개 · 동영상 1개 · 합계 [\d.]+ MB$/);
    await expect(multi.getByTestId('multi-row')).toHaveText(await tableOrder(page));
    await expect(multi.locator('button')).toHaveCount(0); // its actions arrive with tabs (M7) and collections (M5)
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('a missing original (P-8): a linked file leads with 다시 연결…, a managed one with 열기; Finder에서 보기 says why it is off; 열기 reaches the notice', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const { app, page } = await launch(lib, testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    await importPaths(page, [KO_PDF]);
    const gone = testInfo.outputPath('gone.pdf');
    fs.copyFileSync(PDF, gone);
    const linked = await page.evaluate((p) => window.learn.library.import({ paths: [p], mode: 'linked' }), gone);
    expect(linked).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    fs.rmSync(gone);
    const assets = path.join(lib, 'assets'); // the managed copy goes too (readers.spec does the same)
    for (const d of fs.readdirSync(assets)) fs.rmSync(path.join(assets, d), { recursive: true, force: true });
    await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const list = await window.learn.library.list();
      if (list.ok) for (const i of list.data) await window.learn.library.get({ itemId: i.id });
    });

    await selectRows(page, ['gone']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-relink')).toHaveText('다시 연결…');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-relink')).toHaveClass(/btn-primary/);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-open')).toHaveClass(/btn-secondary/);
    await expectDisabledReason(page.getByTestId('inspector-reveal'), '원본 파일이 있어야 쓸 수 있습니다');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-kind')).toHaveText('PDF'); // a missing file is not read
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="file-row"][data-field="location"] dd')).toHaveAttribute('title', gone);
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="file-row"][data-field="storage"] dd')).toHaveText('외부 연결');

    await selectRows(page, ['한글 경로 (테스트) #1']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-relink')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-open')).toHaveClass(/btn-primary/);
    await expectDisabledReason(page.getByTestId('inspector-reveal'), '원본 파일이 있어야 쓸 수 있습니다');
    await page.getByTestId('inspector-open').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('missing-notice')).toContainText('라이브러리 안의 사본을 찾을 수 없습니다');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('⌥⌘I and the toolbar toggle hide and show the panel, named by what they do; its width and the user\'s choice survive a restart', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const [lib, ud] = dirs(testInfo);
  let { app, page } = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    // The empty library has no panel and no toggle; the menu item is off under its neutral name (design-spec 2.4, 7.4).
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-toggle')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-panel')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect(await menuItem(app, 'view.toggleInspector')).toMatchObject({ label: '항목 패널 보기/가리기', enabled: false, accelerator: 'Alt+CmdOrCtrl+I' });

    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('shown');
    expect(await panelWidth(page)).toBe(320);
    const toggle = page.getByTestId('inspector-toggle');
    await expect(toggle).toHaveAccessibleName('항목 패널 가리기');
    await expect(toggle).toHaveAttribute('data-on', '');
    await expect(toggle).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await menuItem(app, 'view.toggleInspector'))?.label).toBe('항목 패널 가리기');
    expect((await menuItem(app, 'view.toggleInspector'))?.enabled).toBe(true);

    await toggle.click();
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('hidden');
    expect(await panelWidth(page)).toBe(0);
    await expect(toggle).toHaveAccessibleName('항목 패널 보기');
    await expect(toggle).not.toHaveAttribute('data-on');
    await expect.poll(async () => (await menuItem(app, 'view.toggleInspector'))?.label).toBe('항목 패널 보기');
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('shown');

    // The boundary resizes within 260–480 and is stored on release, with the sidebar's keys (one record, P-10).
    const x = (await page.locator('#inspector-separator').boundingBox())!.x;
    const drag = async (from: number, to: number) => {
      await page.mouse.move(from, 400);
      await page.mouse.down();
      await page.mouse.move(to, 400, { steps: 10 });
      await page.mouse.up();
    };
    await drag(x, x - 80);
    await expect.poll(() => panelWidth(page)).toBe(400);
    await drag(x - 80, x - 400);
    await expect.poll(() => panelWidth(page)).toBe(480);
    await drag(x - 160, x - 80);
    await expect.poll(() => panelWidth(page)).toBe(400);
    expect(await savedPanes(page)).toEqual({ sidebar: 240, sidebarCollapsed: 0, 'inspector.info': 400, inspectorCollapsed: 0 });
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('hidden');
    expect(await savedPanes(page)).toEqual({ sidebar: 240, sidebarCollapsed: 0, 'inspector.info': 400, inspectorCollapsed: 1 });
    await app.close();

    ({ app, page } = await launch(lib, ud));
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('hidden');
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    await expect.poll(() => panelWidth(page)).toBe(400); // the width is remembered while hidden
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the item panel folds before the sidebar as the window narrows; shown on demand it is not a user choice; 200 % zoom has no sideways scroll', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('shown');
    await contentWidth(app, 1100); // 240 + 520 + 320 = 1080 fits
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => innerWidth)).toBe(1100);
    expect(await panelState(page)).toBe('shown');
    await contentWidth(app, 1000); // the panel folds first; the sidebar stays (it folds below 760)
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('hidden');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('shell')).toHaveAttribute('data-sidebar', 'shown');
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleInspector'); // shown on demand in the narrow window
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('shown');
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleInspector'); // folded again: back to the automatic fold
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('hidden');
    await contentWidth(app, 1440);
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('shown');
    await zoom(app, 2);
    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => innerWidth)).toBeLessThan(760);
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('hidden');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('shell')).toHaveAttribute('data-sidebar', 'hidden');
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth)).toBe(true);
    await zoom(app, 1);
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('shown');
    expect(await savedPanes(page)).toBeNull(); // automatic folds and on-demand showing are never stored (M-5)
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('layout B: the toolbar spans the content and the item panel, which starts under it; the sidebar top 88 px does not change', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  const top88 = async () => {
    await page.mouse.move(900, 700);
    return page.screenshot({ clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 240, height: 88 }, animations: 'disabled', caret: 'hide' });
  };
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    const empty = await top88();
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('shown');
    const vw = await page.evaluate(() => innerWidth);
    const box = async (testId: string) => (await page.getByTestId(testId).boundingBox())!;
    const [toolbar, panel, content] = [await box('toolbar'), await box('inspector-panel'), await box('content')];
    expect(Math.round(toolbar.x + toolbar.width)).toBe(vw);
    expect(Math.round(toolbar.y + toolbar.height)).toBe(52);
    expect(Math.round(panel.y)).toBe(52);
    expect(Math.round(panel.x + panel.width)).toBe(vw);
    expect(Math.round(panel.width)).toBe(320);
    expect(Math.round(content.x + content.width)).toBe(Math.round(panel.x));
    // 가져오기 → 검색 → 토글 at the toolbar's end (design-spec 2.4).
    const order = await page
      .getByTestId('toolbar')
      .locator('[data-testid="import-menu"], [data-testid="search-field"], [data-testid="inspector-toggle"]')
      .evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-testid')));
    expect(order).toEqual(['import-menu', 'search-field', 'inspector-toggle']);
    expect((await top88()).equals(empty), 'with the panel').toBe(true);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('hidden');
    expect((await top88()).equals(empty), 'panel hidden').toBe(true);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    await expect(page.getByRole('separator', { name: '항목 패널' })).toHaveCount(1); // the handle is named after its pane
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('F6 visits sidebar → table → item panel; a folded panel is skipped, and a fold under the keyboard focus hands it to the toggle', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await selectRows(page, ['sample']); // its row is the table's cursor: F6 lands there (P-31, roving tabindex)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-open')).toBeVisible();
    await page.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null)?.blur());
    for (const pane of ['sidebar', 'content', 'inspector', 'sidebar']) {
      await page.keyboard.press('F6');
      expect(await inPane(page)).toBe(pane);
    }
    await page.keyboard.press('Shift+F6');
    expect(await inPane(page)).toBe('inspector');
    expect(await focusedTestId(page)).toBe('inspector-open'); // the head's first action
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    await expect.poll(() => panelState(page)).toBe('hidden');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-toggle')).toBeFocused(); // not <body>
    for (const pane of ['sidebar', 'content', 'sidebar']) {
      await page.keyboard.press('F6');
      expect(await inPane(page)).toBe(pane);
    }
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('전체 SHA-256 복사 puts the whole value on the clipboard and says 복사했습니다 for 1.5 s, no toast; the page still cannot read the clipboard (P-6)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const sha = (await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).file.sha256;
    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    const copy = page.getByTestId('copy-sha');
    await expect(copy).toHaveAccessibleName('전체 SHA-256 복사');
    await (await mainWindow(app)).evaluate((w) => w.focus()); // the clipboard takes writes from a focused document
    await copy.click();
    await expect.poll(() => readClipboard(app)).toBe(sha);
    await page.mouse.move(5, 600); // away: what stays open is the confirmation, not a hover tooltip
    await expect(page.locator('.tooltip')).toHaveText('복사했습니다');
    await expect(copy).toHaveAccessibleName('복사했습니다');
    await expect(page.locator('.toast')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('.tooltip')).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 3_000 });
    await expect(copy).toHaveAccessibleName('전체 SHA-256 복사');
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => navigator.clipboard.readText().then(() => 'read', (e: Error) => e.name))).toBe('NotAllowedError');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('page count and length come from the file and are kept per revision; a long abstract folds to four lines; a URL opens through main', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(page, [PDF, MP4]);
    await selectRows(page, ['sample-h264-aac']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-kind')).toHaveText('동영상 · 0:10'); // the 10 s fixture, from its metadata
    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-kind')).toHaveText('PDF · 3쪽');
    await selectRows(page, ['sample-h264-aac']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-kind')).toHaveText('동영상 · 0:10', { timeout: 200 }); // known for this revision: at once

    await seedMetadata(page, pdf!.id, { url: 'https://example.org/signal', abstract: Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => `${i + 1}번째 줄의 초록 문장입니다.`).join('\n') });
    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    const abstract = page.locator('[data-testid="info-row"][data-field="abstract"] .long');
    await expect(abstract).toHaveClass(/clamp/);
    const clamped = await abstract.evaluate((e) => e.clientHeight);
    await page.getByTestId('info-more').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-more')).toHaveText('접기');
    expect(await abstract.evaluate((e) => e.clientHeight)).toBeGreaterThan(clamped);

    await app.evaluate(({ shell }) => {
      const g = globalThis as { __learnExternal?: string[] };
      g.__learnExternal = [];
      shell.openExternal = async (url: string) => {
        g.__learnExternal!.push(url);
      };
    });
    await page.locator('[data-testid="info-row"][data-field="url"] a').click();
    await expect.poll(() => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnExternal?: string[] }).__learnExternal ?? [])).toEqual(['https://example.org/signal']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('library-table')).toBeVisible(); // the page did not navigate
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

Run: `pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/inspector.spec.ts`
Expected: 8 passed(Linux). 실패하는 단언을 먼저 하나 확인한다: `InfoHead`의 `variant={relinkFirst ? 'secondary' : 'primary'}`를 잠시 `'primary'`로 두면 두 번째 테스트가 `btn-secondary`에서 실패해야 한다 — 되돌린다. 1024px macOS 러너에서 창을 1440으로 넓히지 못하면 `roomForPanel`이 8개를 건너뛴다(그 화면의 패널은 Step 18의 증거 테스트를 Step 20에서 macOS로 돌려 본다).

- [ ] **Step 16: 깨지는 기존 테스트 고치기**

| 파일 | 지금 | 바꾼 뒤 |
|---|---|---|
| `E/platform.spec.ts` `VIEW_START` | `[null, '사이드바 가리기'], ['-', ''],` | `[null, '사이드바 가리기'], [null, '항목 패널 보기/가리기'], ['-', ''],` — 빈 라이브러리라 보고된 상태가 없어 중립 이름(판정 3) |
| `E/platform.spec.ts` `menu: an unpackaged run without LEARN_E2E=1 does show 개발자 도구` | 모양만 비교 | 끝에 `expect(flatten(view).find((n) => roleOf(n) === 'toggledevtools')?.accelerator).toBe('Alt+CmdOrCtrl+J'); // ⌥⌘I is the item panel's (P-1)` |
| `E/shell.spec.ts` `arrow keys on the separator …` | `toEqual({ sidebar: 180, sidebarCollapsed: 1 })` | `toEqual({ sidebar: 180, sidebarCollapsed: 1, 'inspector.info': 320, inspectorCollapsed: 0 }) // one record for both panes (P-10)` |
| `E/commands-coverage.spec.ts` `effects` | `view.toggleSidebar`만 두 상태 | 아래 항목을 더한다 |
| `E/visual/tour.spec.ts` `palette: …`의 `ㄱ` 행 수 | M3 `toHaveCount(6)`, Task 5의 `빠른 검색`(검)으로 7 | `toHaveCount(8)` — 늘어난 행은 `항목 패널 가리기`(가; 선택이 없어 `item` 명령은 없다). Task 5가 7이 아닌 수를 남겼다면 그 수 + 1. 주석도 "항목 패널 가리기" 포함으로 고친다 |

`commands-coverage.spec.ts`의 `sidebar` 함수 아래에 `const inspector = () => page.getByTestId('shell').getAttribute('data-inspector');`, `effects`에(1024px macOS 러너에서는 이 창에서 패널이 처음부터 자동으로 접혀 있어 첫 실행이 "필요할 때 보이기"가 된다 — 그래서 첫 기대값을 창 폭에서 정한다):
```ts

    'view.toggleInspector': async () => {
```

`E/sheets.spec.ts` — Task 4의 `the ⌘/ sheet lays its groups out in two columns, …` 테스트는 고칠 단언이 없다(⌥⌘I는 왼쪽 열의 라이브러리 묶음에 들어가 열 나누기가 그대로다). 그 안의 높이 주석(Task 4·5가 남긴 `// Short enough for every 1440 × 900 room (estimate …): no scrolling.`)만 지금 값으로 고친다:
```ts
    // Short enough for every 1440 × 900 room (≈ 620 px with 자료, ⌘F and ⌥⌘I; Linux room 824, Mac 774): no scrolling.
```
`a ⌘/ sheet whose list scrolls …`(Task 4가 끝 절반을 `fitsNoStop`으로 바꾼 것)과 `⌘/ lists every registry shortcut in a sheet …`(명령마다 `commandLabel(c, process.platform)` 한 줄 — ⌥⌘I는 중립 이름으로 한 줄)도 그대로 통과해야 한다.

Run: `pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/platform.spec.ts tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts tests/e2e/sheets.spec.ts tests/e2e/commands-coverage.spec.ts tests/e2e/inspector.spec.ts` (백그라운드, 끝날 때까지 폴링)
Expected: 모두 통과. `sheets.spec`의 두 열 테스트가 왼쪽 `['앱', '라이브러리']`·오른쪽 `['자료', '리더', '팔레트·대화상자']`를 보고, 콘솔의 `[measure] ⌘/ sheet natural height`가 ≈620px(Linux는 "사이드바 보기/가리기"가 `Ctrl Shift S` 옆에서 두 줄이 되어 ≈628), 경계 700 안이다. 그 값을 커밋 본문에 적는다(추정과 20px 넘게 다르면 Task 4 Step 3의 추정 줄과 이 주석을 함께 고친다).

- [ ] **Step 17: 시각 투어**

`E/visual/tour.spec.ts`에 import `seedMetadata`, `selectRows`(`../helpers`)와 `type Page`(`@playwright/test`)를 더하고, `library` 도우미(`const library = (dir: string) => […]`) 다음에 항목 패널의 공용 마스크와 대기를 둔다:
```ts
/** What changes between runs in the item panel: its dates, a fixture's SHA-256 (pdf-lib writes the date), an outside file's path. */
const panelMasks = (page: Page) => [
  page.locator('[data-testid="info-row"]:is([data-field="createdAt"], [data-field="updatedAt"]) dd'),
  page.getByTestId('sha-value'),
  page.locator('[data-testid="file-row"][data-field="location"] dd'),
];
/** One item in the panel as it stays: its kind line (the page count or length is read from the file, later) and its sections. */
async function panelSettled(page: Page, kind: string | RegExp): Promise<void> {
  await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-kind')).toHaveText(kind);
  await expect(page.getByTestId('info-section')).toBeVisible();
}
```
그리고 `keyboard focus: …` 테스트 다음에:
```ts
test('item panel: nothing selected, one item, several, a missing original, folded, loading', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  // The table's dates in its rows only (Q-40: the header keeps its sort arrow), and what moves in the panel (panelMasks).
  const masks = () => [s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]'), ...panelMasks(s.page)];
  try {
    const LIBRARY = library(testInfo.outputPath('videos'));
    const [sample] = await importPaths(s.page, LIBRARY);
    await seedMetadata(s.page, sample!.id, {
      creators: [{ name: '한서진', role: 'author' }, { name: '윤재하', role: 'author' }, { name: '배유나', role: 'editor' }],
      date: '2024-03-15', publisher: '학습출판', language: '한국어', url: 'https://example.org/molbio/6',
      abstract: ['세포가 바깥 신호를 받아들이는 과정을 수용체, G 단백질, 2차 전령의 순서로 정리한다.', '각 단계에서 신호가 어떻게 증폭되는지 그림 6-4와 함께 설명한다.', '신호를 끄는 장치와 그 속도가 반응의 크기를 정한다는 점을 다룬다.', '마지막 절은 수용체 타이로신 인산화효소를 소개한다.', '연습 문제는 66쪽에 있다.'].join('\n'),
      extra: '시험 범위: 6장 전체',
    });
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('inspector-none')).toBeVisible(); // imported from the page: no focus entered the table (Q-48)
      await shoot(s.page, `inspector-none-${theme}`, { mask: masks() });
    }
    await selectRows(s.page, ['sample']);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('inspector-kind')).toHaveText('PDF · 3쪽');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('info-row')).toHaveCount(9);
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `inspector-item-${theme}`, { mask: masks() });
    }
    await selectRows(s.page, ['sample', '한글 경로 (테스트) #1', 'sample-h264-aac'], { modifier: 'Meta' });
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('multi-row')).toHaveCount(3);
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await shoot(s.page, `inspector-multi-${theme}`, { mask: masks() });
    }
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    // A linked original that went missing: 다시 연결… leads (P-8).
    const gone = testInfo.outputPath('gone.pdf');
    fs.copyFileSync(LIBRARY[0]!, gone);
    await s.page.evaluate((p) => window.learn.library.import({ paths: [p], mode: 'linked', allowDuplicate: true }), gone);
    fs.rmSync(gone);
    await s.page.evaluate(async () => {
      const list = await window.learn.library.list();
      if (list.ok) for (const i of list.data) await window.learn.library.get({ itemId: i.id });
    });
    await selectRows(s.page, ['gone']);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('inspector-relink')).toBeVisible();
    await panelSettled(s.page, 'PDF'); // a missing file is not read; its outside path is masked
    await shoot(s.page, 'inspector-missing-light', { mask: masks() });
    // Folded by the user: the toolbar toggle off.
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('shell')).toHaveAttribute('data-inspector', 'hidden');
    await shoot(s.page, 'inspector-hidden-light', { mask: masks() });
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    // Loading past 300 ms (design-spec 6): the item's detail never answers. Last: the handler stays replaced.
    await s.app.evaluate(({ ipcMain }) => {
      ipcMain.removeHandler('library:detail');
      ipcMain.handle('library:detail', () => new Promise(() => {}));
    });
    await selectRows(s.page, ['sample-mpeg4part2']);
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('inspector-loading')).toBeVisible();
    await shoot(s.page, 'inspector-loading-light', { mask: masks() });
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```
(`library(dir)`의 네 파일 제목은 `sample`, `한글 경로 (테스트) #1`, `sample-h264-aac`, `sample-mpeg4part2`. `sample-mpeg4part2`는 아직 아무도 고르지 않아 detail 캐시가 없다.)

라이브러리 보기의 모든 기준 PNG에 이제 항목 패널과 도구 막대 토글이 있다. 패널의 내용은 그 장면의 선택을 따른다:
- 선택이 없는 장면 — `focus-sidebar-light`, `palette-{empty,}-{light,dark}`, `palette-multi-light`, `palette-none-{light,dark}`, `palette-inactive-light`, `density-compact-light`, `font-15-light`(모두 페이지에서 가져온 뒤 표에 포커스가 들어오지 않았다) — 은 선택 없음(`inspector-none`): 고칠 것이 없다.
- 여러 개 — Task 3의 `table-multi-{light,dark}` — 는 `inspector-multi`(날짜 없음): 고칠 것이 없다.
- 한 자료 — Task 3의 `library:` 테스트가 `rowAt(s.page, 0).click()`으로 첫 행(가장 새 행 = 원본 없는 연결 파일 `gone`)을 고른 뒤의 `library-{light,dark}`·`library-collapsed-{light,dark}`·`toast-failure-light`·`toast-failure-multi-dark`, `keyboard focus:`의 두 번째 F6가 커서 없는 표에 들어오며 첫 행을 고른 `focus-row-light`(Q-48), Task 3 `table:` 테스트의 `table-sorted-light`(`rowAt(s.page, 0).click()`)·`table-inactive-light`(↓), Task 4의 `palette-selection-light`(`sample`) — 은 그 자료의 머리·절이 보이고 날짜·SHA-256·바깥 경로가 실행마다 달라진다. 그 테스트들의 마스크에 `...panelMasks(s.page)`를 더하고(`dates()`를 두는 `library:`·`table:` 테스트는 그 배열 안에, `keyboard focus:`의 `focus-row-light`와 `palette-selection-light`는 그 `mask` 배열에), 그런 첫 장면 앞에서 패널이 다 그려지기를 기다린다: `library:`는 Task 3의 `await expect(rowAt(s.page, 0)).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');` 다음에 `await panelSettled(s.page, 'PDF');`(원본이 없어 쪽수를 읽지 않는다), `keyboard focus:`는 두 번째 `F6` 다음에 `await panelSettled(s.page, / · /);`, `table:`은 `table-sorted-light`와 `table-inactive-light`의 `shoot` 앞에 각각 `await panelSettled(s.page, 'PDF · 3쪽');`(시드한 행은 `sample.pdf`의 리비전을 함께 쓴다), `palette-selection-light`는 `rowByTitle(s.page, 'sample').click()` 다음에 `await panelSettled(s.page, 'PDF · 3쪽');`.
- 패널이 없는 장면 — `table-loading-{light,dark}`(첫 목록 전, Q-19), `empty-*`, `reader-*` — 은 그대로다.

`sheet-shortcuts-{light,dark}`(⌘/ 시트 페이지)에는 왼쪽 열의 라이브러리 묶음에 "항목 패널 보기/가리기 ⌥⌘I"(Linux `Ctrl Alt I`) 줄이 "빠른 검색" 다음에 하나 늘어 시트가 ≈29px 길어진다 — 이 두 장을 다시 찍고, 두 열의 나누기(왼쪽 앱·라이브러리)와 아래 줄이 그대로인지 눈으로 본다. 새 기준 9장: `inspector-none-{light,dark}`, `inspector-item-{light,dark}`, `inspector-multi-{light,dark}`, `inspector-missing-light`, `inspector-hidden-light`, `inspector-loading-light`(+ 위의 다시 찍는 기존 것).

Run: `pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts --update-snapshots=all` → `git status --short tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts-snapshots`로 바뀐 PNG를 하나씩 눈으로 본다(README "시각 투어 기준 PNG": 잡음만 바뀐 `fatal-light`·`focus-sidebar-light`·`settings-focus-light`는 `git checkout --`) → `pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts`(갱신 없이, 결정성).
Expected: 두 번째 실행이 통과.

- [ ] **Step 18: 증거 하네스** `V/library.evidence.ts`

Task 3이 이 파일을 `shell.evidence.ts`의 틀로 만들었다: `TAG = { tag: '@library' }`, 직렬 공유 세션 `s`(48개 자료), `results`, `checks`, `check(name, ok, value)`, `guard(name, run)`, `save()`(→ `m4-library.json`), 모듈의 `setTheme(page, theme)`·`PDF`·`fs`·`os`·`path`, 끝의 판정 테스트. 그 판정 테스트 **앞에**(Task 4·5의 테스트 다음) 아래를 둔다. import에 `seedMetadata`, `selectRows`(`../e2e/helpers`)와 `menuItemNames`(`./capture`)를 더한다 — `importPaths`·`nativeKeystroke`·`NativeInputNotPermitted`·`rowAt`·`IS_MAC`·`allShots`는 Task 3이, `runMenuCommand`·`captureOpenMenu`는 Task 4가 이미 가져온다(빠진 것이 있으면 함께 더한다):
```ts
test('M4 library: the item panel — its fold at this width, ⌥⌘I from a real keystroke, one item, none, several; the 보기 menu', TAG, async () => {
  const page = s.page;
  const state = () => page.getByTestId('shell').getAttribute('data-inspector');
  const inspector: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  results['inspector'] = inspector;
  // Its own PDF (unique bytes after %%EOF, as perf.evidence does): the session may hold sample.pdf already.
  const src = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `learn-m4-inspector-${process.pid}.pdf`);
  fs.writeFileSync(src, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(PDF), Buffer.from('\n% inspector evidence\n')]));
  const [item] = await importPaths(page, [src]);
  await seedMetadata(page, item!.id, { creators: [{ name: '한서진', role: 'author' }], date: '2024', publisher: '학습출판' });
  const width = await page.evaluate(() => innerWidth);
  const fits = width >= 240 + 520 + 320;
  await expect.poll(state).toBe(fits ? 'shown' : 'hidden');
  inspector['innerWidth'] = width;
  inspector['defaultState'] = await state();
  check('inspector: shown exactly when 240 + 520 + 320 fit (it folds before the sidebar)', (await state()) === (fits ? 'shown' : 'hidden'), { width, state: await state() });

  await guard('inspector: ⌥⌘I reaches the 보기 item and toggles the panel', async () => {
    const before = await state();
    let native = true;
    if (IS_MAC) {
      try {
        await nativeKeystroke(s.app, 'i', ['option', 'command']);
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted)) throw e;
        native = false;
        await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector');
      }
    } else {
      native = false;
      await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector');
    }
    await expect.poll(state).not.toBe(before);
    inspector['keystroke'] = { native, before, after: await state() };
    check('inspector: ⌥⌘I reaches the 보기 item and toggles the panel', true, inspector['keystroke']);
  });
  if ((await state()) !== 'shown') await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector'); // on demand at 1024 px
  await expect.poll(state).toBe('shown');

  // The new item is the newest row (index 0): the table (its own scroll view) back at the top, where the virtualizer draws it.
  await page.getByTestId('library-table').evaluate((grid) => grid.scrollTo(0, 0));
  await selectRows(page, [path.parse(src).name]);
  await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-kind')).toHaveText('PDF · 3쪽');
  const vw = await page.evaluate(() => innerWidth);
  const panel = (await page.getByTestId('inspector-panel').boundingBox())!;
  const toolbar = (await page.getByTestId('toolbar').boundingBox())!;
  inspector['geometry'] = { panel, toolbarRight: toolbar.x + toolbar.width, vw };
  check('inspector: under the 52 px toolbar, flush with the right edge, the toolbar over both', Math.round(panel.y) === 52 && Math.round(panel.x + panel.width) === vw && Math.round(toolbar.x + toolbar.width) === vw, inspector['geometry']);
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(page, theme);
    await allShots(s.app, page, `m4-inspector-item-${theme}`, `item panel, one PDF with info (${theme})`);
  }
  await setTheme(page, 'light');
  // esc on the table clears the selection, the cursor stays (Q-43): the key goes to the cursor row (the roving stop).
  const cursorRow = page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][tabindex="0"]');
  await cursorRow.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-none')).toBeVisible();
  await allShots(s.app, page, 'm4-inspector-none-light', 'item panel, nothing selected (light)');
  // The first three rows in the table's order (data-index; the DOM order of a virtualized body is not the visual one).
  const titles = (await Promise.all([0, 1, 2].map((i) => rowAt(page, i).getAttribute('data-title')))).filter((x): x is string => x !== null);
  await selectRows(page, titles, { modifier: 'Meta' });
  await expect(page.getByTestId('multi-row')).toHaveCount(titles.length);
  await allShots(s.app, page, 'm4-inspector-multi-light', `item panel, ${titles.length} selected (light)`);

  if (IS_MAC) {
    await guard('inspector: 보기 lists 항목 패널 가리기 with ⌥⌘I, and no 개발자 도구', async () => {
      const pid = s.app.process().pid!;
      inspector['menuView'] = { ...(await captureOpenMenu(s.app, pid, 5, 'm4-inspector-menu-view', '보기 open: 항목 패널 가리기 ⌥⌘I after 사이드바 가리기')), names: await menuItemNames(pid, 5) };
      const names = (inspector['menuView'] as { names: string[] | null }).names ?? [];
      check('inspector: 보기 lists 항목 패널 가리기 with ⌥⌘I, and no 개발자 도구', names.includes('항목 패널 가리기') && !names.includes('개발자 도구'), names);
    });
  }
  // Leave the session as it was for the tests after this one: default panel state, nothing selected (esc on the table, Q-43).
  await cursorRow.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"][aria-selected="true"]')).toHaveCount(0);
  if ((await state()) !== inspector['defaultState']) await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector');
  fs.rmSync(src, { force: true });
  save();
});
```
(`os`, `fs`, `path`, `PDF`, `setTheme`은 Task 3 파일에 이미 있다. 표의 esc가 선택을 비우는 것은 Task 3의 `gridKeys.ts`(`{ kind: 'clear' }` → `reduceSelection`)이다(Q-43) — 키는 표에 포커스가 있을 때만 닿으므로, 캡처·메뉴 열기 사이에 포커스가 옮겨 갔어도 되도록 두 번 모두 커서 행(roving `tabindex="0"`, Q-48)에 먼저 포커스를 준다. 행 고르기는 `selectRows`(행 누르기)이고, 프로그램의 `click()`은 쓰지 않는다.)

Run: `xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1440x900x24" pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.evidence.config.ts --grep "@library"` (백그라운드)
Expected: 통과, `evidence-results/m4-library.json`에 `inspector`(`innerWidth`, `defaultState: 'shown'`, `keystroke`, `geometry`)와 위 판정 3개가 `ok: true`(Linux에서는 메뉴 캡처 판정이 없다).

### Task 7: 정보 편집 — 제자리 폼, 검증 문구, 떠날 때의 규칙, `item.editInfo`

명세 §5.3의 편집 부분을 구현한다: 연필(정보 절 머리) 또는 팔레트의 "정보 편집"으로 정보 절이 같은 자리에서 폼이 된다. 필드는 제목(필수)·저자(이름 + 역할 저자/편집자/강연자/기타, 줄 추가·삭제·순서)·날짜(YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD)·출판사·언어·URL(http/https)·초록·메모, 아래에 "취소"(esc)·"저장"(기본, ⌘↩, 한 줄 필드에서는 ↩도). 검증은 domain의 `titleSchema`·`itemMetadataSchema`를 그대로 쓰고, 잘못된 필드는 빨간 테두리 + 필드 아래 footnote(원인 + 다음 행동). 저장 실패(IPC)는 폼을 연 채 오류 토스트. 편집 중에 다른 행을 고르거나 리더로 가거나 창을 닫으면 Zotero처럼: 바뀐 것이 없으면 끝내고 넘어가고, 모두 올바르면 저장한 뒤 넘어가고(실패하면 넘어가지 않는다), 올바르지 않으면 넘어가지 않고 표 선택을 편집 중인 자료로 되돌리며 폼 위에 "저장하지 못한 변경이 있습니다…" 줄과 "버리기"를 보인다(시트 없음). 창 닫기(⌘W·닫기 단추)와 앱 종료(⌘Q·Dock·`app.quit()`)는 main이 먼저 페이지에 묻는다(`M/edit-flush.ts`, 컨트롤러 판정 5): 저장했거나 바뀐 것이 없으면 원래 동작을 다시 하고(⌘Q는 macOS에서도 정말 종료), 표시한 필드가 있으면 창이 남고 종료가 취소된다. 저장하면 `library.updateMetadata` → `libraryChanged` → 표와 인스펙터가 다시 받는다. 디자인 명세 6(필드·버튼·오류 문구), 9(문체), 7.4(IME 규칙)를 따른다. **범위 밖**: 메타데이터 자동 보강(R3), 태그·컬렉션 편집(M5), 제목이 바뀐 뒤의 이름 붙은 사본(I1 규칙 그대로, main이 이미 한다), 사본 내보내기(Task 8).

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { ItemMetadata } from '@learn/domain';
import { draftOf, sameInfo, validateInfo, type InfoDraft } from './editInfo';

let n = 0;
const key = () => `k${++n}`;
const META: ItemMetadata = { creators: [{ name: '한서진', role: 'author' }, { name: '윤재하', role: 'editor' }], date: '2024-03', publisher: '학습출판' };
const base = (): InfoDraft => draftOf('세포 신호 전달', META, key);

describe('정보 편집: the draft, its checks, and what counts as a change (spec §5.3)', () => {
  it('starts from the stored values, an empty field as empty text', () => {
    const d = base();
    expect(d).toMatchObject({ title: '세포 신호 전달', date: '2024-03', publisher: '학습출판', language: '', url: '', abstract: '', extra: '' });
    expect(d.creators.map((c) => [c.name, c.role])).toEqual([['한서진', 'author'], ['윤재하', 'editor']]);
    expect(new Set(d.creators.map((c) => c.key)).size).toBe(2);
  });
  it('saves trimmed values, leaves empty fields out, drops rows without a name, keeps the row order', () => {
    const d = base();
    const edited: InfoDraft = { ...d, title: '  고친 제목 ', language: ' 한국어 ', publisher: '', creators: [d.creators[1]!, d.creators[0]!, { key: 'x', name: '  ', role: 'other' }] };
    expect(validateInfo(edited)).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      value: { title: '고친 제목', metadata: { creators: [{ name: '윤재하', role: 'editor' }, { name: '한서진', role: 'author' }], date: '2024-03', language: '한국어' } },
    });
  });
  it('marks each wrong field with its own footnote: the cause, then what to write', () => {
    const r = validateInfo({ ...base(), date: '2024-13', url: 'example.org', title: '   ' });
    if (r.ok) throw new Error('expected marked fields');
    expect(r.errors).toEqual({
      title: '제목은 비워 둘 수 없습니다. 자료를 알아볼 이름을 적으세요.',
      date: '날짜는 2024, 2024-03, 2024-03-15처럼 적어 주세요.',
      url: 'http:// 또는 https://로 시작하는 주소를 적어 주세요.',
    });
  });
  it('tells a value that is too long from one of the wrong form, and marks a creator row by its key', () => {
    const long = (k: number) => 'ㄱ'.repeat(k);
    const d = base();
    const r = validateInfo({ ...d, title: long(501), language: long(36), url: `https://example.org/${long(2048)}`, creators: [{ ...d.creators[0]!, name: long(201) }] });
    if (r.ok) throw new Error('expected marked fields');
    expect(r.errors).toEqual({
      title: '제목은 500자까지 쓸 수 있습니다. 줄여서 다시 적으세요.',
      language: '언어는 35자까지 쓸 수 있습니다. 한국어나 ko처럼 짧게 적으세요.',
      url: 'URL은 2048자까지 쓸 수 있습니다. 줄여서 다시 적으세요.',
      [`creator:${d.creators[0]!.key}`]: '이름은 200자까지 쓸 수 있습니다. 줄여서 다시 적으세요.',
    });
  });
  it('counts as unchanged what saving would not change: spaces around a value, an empty row', () => {
    const d = base();
    expect(sameInfo(d, base())).toBe(true);
    expect(sameInfo({ ...d, publisher: ' 학습출판  ' }, d)).toBe(true);
    expect(sameInfo({ ...d, creators: [...d.creators, { key: 'e', name: '', role: 'author' }] }, d)).toBe(true);
    expect(sameInfo({ ...d, title: '고친 제목' }, d)).toBe(false);
    expect(sameInfo({ ...d, creators: [d.creators[1]!, d.creators[0]!] }, d)).toBe(false);
    expect(sameInfo({ ...d, creators: [{ ...d.creators[0]!, role: 'other' }, d.creators[1]!] }, d)).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

`R/inspector/editInfo.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { itemMetadataSchema, titleSchema, type ItemMetadata } from '@learn/domain';
import { t } from '../strings';

export type CreatorRole = ItemMetadata['creators'][number]['role'];
/** In the order the role menu lists them (spec §5.3: 저자/편집자/강연자/기타). */
export const CREATOR_ROLES: readonly CreatorRole[] = ['author', 'editor', 'lecturer', 'other'];
export interface CreatorDraft {
  /** The row's identity while it is edited (its React key and its error's key): rows move and go. */
  key: string;
  name: string;
  role: CreatorRole;
}
/** The form's values as typed. */
export interface InfoDraft {
  title: string;
  creators: CreatorDraft[];
  date: string;
  publisher: string;
  language: string;
  url: string;
  abstract: string;
  extra: string;
}
export type InfoTextField = 'title' | 'date' | 'publisher' | 'language' | 'url' | 'abstract' | 'extra';
/** A field the form can mark: a text field, or a creator row by its key. */
export type FieldKey = InfoTextField | `creator:${string}`;
export type FieldErrors = Partial<Record<FieldKey, string>>;
export interface CleanInfo {
  title: string;
  metadata: ItemMetadata;
}

const OPTIONAL = ['date', 'publisher', 'language', 'url', 'abstract', 'extra'] as const;
type OptionalField = (typeof OPTIONAL)[number];
/** The form's order, where the focus looks for the first marked field (creator rows sit after the title). */
export const FIELD_ORDER: readonly InfoTextField[] = ['title', ...OPTIONAL];

export function draftOf(title: string, meta: ItemMetadata, newKey: () => string): InfoDraft {
  return {
    title,
    creators: meta.creators.map((c) => ({ key: newKey(), name: c.name, role: c.role })),
    date: meta.date ?? '',
    publisher: meta.publisher ?? '',
    language: meta.language ?? '',
    url: meta.url ?? '',
    abstract: meta.abstract ?? '',
    extra: meta.extra ?? '',
  };
}

/** The draft as it would be saved: trimmed, empty fields left out, rows without a name dropped (and the rows that stay). */
function asSaved(d: InfoDraft): { title: string; rows: CreatorDraft[]; metadata: Record<string, unknown> } {
  const rows = d.creators.filter((c) => c.name.trim() !== '');
  const metadata: Record<string, unknown> = { creators: rows.map((c) => ({ name: c.name.trim(), role: c.role })) };
  for (const field of OPTIONAL) {
    const value = d[field].trim();
    if (value !== '') metadata[field] = value;
  }
  return { title: d.title.trim(), rows, metadata };
}

/** A marked field's footnote, by field and by what the schema found (too long, or not the form it wants). */
function messageFor(field: OptionalField, code: string): string {
  const m = t.inspector.editor.errors;
  switch (field) {
    case 'date':
      return m.date;
    case 'url':
      return code === 'too_big' ? m.urlLong : m.url;
    case 'publisher':
      return m.publisherLong;
    case 'language':
      return m.languageLong;
    case 'abstract':
      return m.abstractLong;
    case 'extra':
      return m.extraLong;
  }
}

/** domain's own schemas (titleSchema, itemMetadataSchema: what main checks again), each problem on its field. */
export function validateInfo(d: InfoDraft): { ok: true; value: CleanInfo } | { ok: false; errors: FieldErrors } {
  const { rows, metadata } = asSaved(d);
  const m = t.inspector.editor.errors;
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};
  const title = titleSchema.safeParse(d.title);
  if (!title.success) errors.title = title.error.issues.some((i) => i.code === 'too_big') ? m.titleLong : m.titleEmpty;
  const meta = itemMetadataSchema.safeParse(metadata);
  if (!meta.success) {
    for (const issue of meta.error.issues) {
      const [field, index] = issue.path;
      if (field === 'creators' && typeof index === 'number') {
        const row = rows[index];
        if (row) errors[`creator:${row.key}`] ??= m.nameLong;
      } else if (typeof field === 'string' && (OPTIONAL as readonly string[]).includes(field)) {
        errors[field as OptionalField] ??= messageFor(field as OptionalField, issue.code);
      }
    }
  }
  if (title.success && meta.success) return { ok: true, value: { title: title.data, metadata: meta.data } };
  return { ok: false, errors };
}

/** Changes are what saving would change: spaces around a value or an empty row are none. */
export function sameInfo(a: InfoDraft, b: InfoDraft): boolean {
  const x = asSaved(a);
  const y = asSaved(b);
  return x.title === y.title && JSON.stringify(x.metadata) === JSON.stringify(y.metadata);
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { afterEditing, editSession, flushEdits, leaveEditing, openEditSession, type EditSession } from './editGuard';

const closers: Array<() => void> = [];
const open = (over: Partial<EditSession> = {}): EditSession => {
  const s: EditSession = { itemId: 'a', dirty: () => true, leave: vi.fn(async () => true), ...over };
  closers.push(openEditSession(s));
  return s;
};
/** Where main's executeJavaScript finds the flush (M/edit-flush.ts FLUSH_SCRIPT): the page's global. */
const host = globalThis as { __learnFlushEdits?: () => Promise<string> };
afterEach(() => {
  while (closers.length > 0) closers.pop()!();
});

describe('leaving an open edit (spec §5.3)', () => {
  it('lets anything go on at once while nothing is being edited', async () => {
    const run = vi.fn();
    afterEditing(run);
    expect(run).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(await leaveEditing()).toBe(true);
  });
  it('goes on only once the editor let go (nothing changed, or saved); never while it stays', async () => {
    const s = open();

    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(run).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(s.leave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    closers.pop()!();
    open({ leave: vi.fn(async () => false) });
    const stays = vi.fn();
    afterEditing(stays);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
    expect(stays).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

    let release!: (ok: boolean) => void;
    const s = open({ leave: vi.fn(() => new Promise<boolean>((r) => (release = r))) });
    const a = leaveEditing();
    const b = leaveEditing();
    expect(s.leave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    release(true);
    expect(await a).toBe(true);
    expect(await b).toBe(true);
    void leaveEditing();
    expect(s.leave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2); // a later attempt asks again
  });
  it('a closer closes only its own session', () => {
    const first = openEditSession({ itemId: 'a', dirty: () => false, leave: async () => true });
    const second = open({ itemId: 'b' });
    first();
    expect(editSession()).toBe(second);
  });
  it('answers main before a close or a quit — clean, saved or invalid — through a hook that exists only while an editor is open', async () => {
    expect(host.__learnFlushEdits).toBeUndefined();
    expect(await flushEdits()).toBe('clean');
```

`R/inspector/editGuard.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
/**
 * The open 정보 편집, as the rest of the window sees it (spec §5.3): whatever leaves the item — another row, the reader —
 * asks it first and goes on only if it let go. Closing the window and quitting ask too, from main (M/edit-flush.ts):
 * main runs the page's `__learnFlushEdits` before either. One editor at a time (InfoEditor registers).
 */
export interface EditSession {
  itemId: string;
  /** Changes that saving would write. */
  dirty(): boolean;
  /** No change: ends. Valid changes: saves, then ends. Invalid ones, or a failed save: stays. True when the caller may go on. */
  leave(): Promise<boolean>;
}

/** What main's flush gets back (the same three words as M/edit-flush.ts FlushResult). */
export type FlushResult = 'saved' | 'clean' | 'invalid';
/** The page's global main reaches with executeJavaScript (no IPC channel): present only while an editor is open. */
const host = globalThis as { __learnFlushEdits?: () => Promise<FlushResult> };

let session: EditSession | null = null;
let leaving: Promise<boolean> | null = null;

/** The editor's registration; the returned function ends it (a stale one never ends a newer session). */
export function openEditSession(s: EditSession): () => void {
  session = s;
  host.__learnFlushEdits = flushEdits;
  return () => {
    if (session !== s) return;
    session = null;
    delete host.__learnFlushEdits;
  };
}

export const editSession = (): EditSession | null => session;

/** Asks the open editor to let go; callers that come while it decides share one answer. */
export function leaveEditing(): Promise<boolean> {
  const s = session;
  if (!s) return Promise.resolve(true);
  leaving ??= s.leave().finally(() => {
    leaving = null;
  });
  return leaving;
}

/** Runs `run` now with no editor open, else once the editor let go (never if it stayed). */
export function afterEditing(run: () => void): void {
  if (!session) {
    run();
    return;
  }
  void leaveEditing().then((ok) => {
    if (ok) run();
  });
}

/** The window is about to close or the app to quit (main asks): the edit lets go if it can, and says how. */
export function flushEdits(): Promise<FlushResult> {
  const s = session;
  if (!s) return Promise.resolve('clean');
  const changed = s.dirty();
  return leaveEditing().then((ok): FlushResult => (!ok ? 'invalid' : changed ? 'saved' : 'clean'));
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5b: 창 닫기와 종료 앞의 flush(main) — 테스트 먼저**

창 닫기(⌘W·닫기 단추·`win.close()`)와 앱 종료(⌘Q·Dock·`app.quit()`, 다시 시작 포함)가 열린 편집을 잃지 않게 main이 먼저 묻는다: 그 시도를 `preventDefault()`로 멈추고, 메인 창 페이지에서 `executeJavaScript(FLUSH_SCRIPT, true)`로 `window.__learnFlushEdits()`를 부른다(새 IPC 채널 없음). 답이 `'saved'`·`'clean'`이면 원래 동작을 다시 하고(⌘Q는 정말 종료한다 — macOS에서도 창만 닫히지 않는다), `'invalid'`면 멈춘다(창이 남고 종료가 취소되며, 폼이 저장하지 못한 변경 줄로 까닭을 보인다). 3초 안에 답이 없거나 실패하면 `'clean'`으로 보고 진행해 멈춘 렌더러가 종료를 막지 않는다. 시도마다 한 번만 묻는다(되풀이한 동작과, 종료 안에서 일어나는 창 닫기는 그대로 통과).

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { FLUSH_SCRIPT, createFlushGate, type FlushGate, type FlushWindow } from './edit-flush';

interface Ev {
  prevented: boolean;
  preventDefault(): void;
}
const ev = (): Ev => ({
  prevented: false,
  preventDefault() {
    this.prevented = true;
  },
});

/** A main window and an app the way Electron drives the gate: close() emits 'close', quit() emits 'before-quit', then closes. */
function rig(answers: Array<() => Promise<unknown>>) {
  const calls = { scripts: 0, exited: false, records: [] as Array<{ action: string; result: string }> };
  let gate!: FlushGate;
  const win: FlushWindow & { destroyed: boolean } = {
    destroyed: false,
    isDestroyed: () => win.destroyed,
    close: () => {
      const e = ev();
      gate.onClose(win, e);
      if (!e.prevented) win.destroyed = true;
    },
    webContents: {
      executeJavaScript: (code: string) => {
        expect(code).toBe(FLUSH_SCRIPT);
        calls.scripts++;
        return (answers.shift() ?? (() => Promise.resolve('clean')))();
      },
    },
  };
  const quit = () => {
    const e = ev();
    gate.onBeforeQuit(e);
    if (e.prevented) return;
    if (!win.destroyed) win.close();
    calls.exited = win.destroyed;
  };
  gate = createFlushGate({ mainWindow: () => (win.destroyed ? null : win), quit, timeoutMs: 50, record: (r) => calls.records.push(r) });
  return { win, quit, calls };
}
const tick = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));

describe('closing or quitting over an open 정보 편집 (spec §5.3; M/edit-flush.ts)', () => {
  it('saved: the close is held while the page saves, then goes on; the repeat is not asked again', async () => {
    const r = rig([() => Promise.resolve('saved')]);
    r.win.close();
    expect(r.win.destroyed).toBe(false);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(r.win.destroyed).toBe(true));
    expect(r.calls.scripts).toBe(1);
    expect(r.calls.records).toEqual([{ action: 'close', result: 'saved' }]);
  });
  it('clean: a quit goes on and really quits (the window closes inside it unasked)', async () => {
    const r = rig([() => Promise.resolve('clean')]);
    r.quit();
    expect(r.calls.exited).toBe(false);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(r.calls.exited).toBe(true));
    expect(r.calls.scripts).toBe(1);
  });
  it('invalid: the window stays and the quit is off; a later attempt asks again', async () => {
    const r = rig([() => Promise.resolve('invalid'), () => Promise.resolve('invalid')]);
    r.win.close();
    await tick();
    expect(r.win.destroyed).toBe(false);
    r.quit();
    await tick();
    expect(r.calls.exited).toBe(false);
    expect(r.calls.scripts).toBe(2);
    expect(r.calls.records).toEqual([{ action: 'close', result: 'invalid' }, { action: 'quit', result: 'invalid' }]);
  });
  it('a page that does not answer in time, throws or says something else holds nothing (counts as clean)', async () => {
    const hung = rig([() => new Promise(() => {})]);
    hung.quit();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(hung.calls.exited).toBe(true));
    const thrown = rig([() => Promise.reject(new Error('render process gone'))]);
    thrown.win.close();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(thrown.win.destroyed).toBe(true));
    const odd = rig([() => Promise.resolve(42)]);
    odd.win.close();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(odd.win.destroyed).toBe(true));
  });
  it('no re-entry: a second close while the page decides asks nothing more; ⌘Q meanwhile turns it into a quit', async () => {
    let release!: (v: unknown) => void;
    const r = rig([() => new Promise((res) => (release = res))]);
    r.win.close();
    r.win.close();
    r.quit();
    expect(r.calls.scripts).toBe(1);
    release('saved');
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(r.calls.exited).toBe(true));
    expect(r.calls.scripts).toBe(1);
    expect(r.calls.records).toEqual([{ action: 'quit', result: 'saved' }]);
  });
  it('without a main window a quit is not held (Linux after the window closed, macOS with only settings left)', () => {
    const r = rig([]);
    r.win.destroyed = true;
    r.quit();
    expect(r.calls.exited).toBe(true);
    expect(r.calls.scripts).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

`M/edit-flush.ts`(새 파일, electron import 없음 — `index.ts`가 창과 `app.quit`을 넘기고, 단위 테스트는 가짜를 넘긴다):
```ts
// Closing the main window or quitting while 정보 편집 is open (spec §5.3): main asks the page first. Valid changes are
// saved and the close or quit goes on; nothing changed lets it go; marked fields keep the window and call the quit off,
// the form saying why. A page that cannot answer in time never holds either.

/** The page's answer (renderer inspector/editGuard.ts flushEdits). */
export type FlushResult = 'saved' | 'clean' | 'invalid';
/** Run in the page's main world, where the renderer installs the hook while an editor is open (no IPC channel). */
export const FLUSH_SCRIPT = 'window.__learnFlushEdits ? window.__learnFlushEdits() : "clean"';
/** Longer than a save takes; a hung, crashed or still-loading page past it counts as having nothing to save. */
export const FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS = 3000;

/** The main window as far as the gate needs it (a BrowserWindow fits). */
export interface FlushWindow {
  isDestroyed(): boolean;
  close(): void;
  webContents: { executeJavaScript(code: string, userGesture?: boolean): Promise<unknown> };
}
export interface PreventableEvent {
  preventDefault(): void;
}
type Action = 'close' | 'quit';

export interface FlushGateDeps {
  /** The main window now, or null (not open yet, or closed). */
  mainWindow(): FlushWindow | null;
  /** app.quit(): the quit again, once the page let go. */
  quit(): void;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  /** Every decision, for the E2E log (index.ts). */
  record?(entry: { action: Action; result: FlushResult }): void;
}

/** The page's answer; 'clean' when none comes in time, the call fails, or it answers anything else. */
export function askToFlush(win: FlushWindow, timeoutMs = FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS): Promise<FlushResult> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (result: FlushResult) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve(result);
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish('clean'), timeoutMs);
    win.webContents.executeJavaScript(FLUSH_SCRIPT, true).then(
      (answer) => finish(answer === 'saved' || answer === 'invalid' ? answer : 'clean'),
      () => finish('clean'),
    );
  });
}

export interface FlushGate {
  /** The main window's 'close' (⌘W, its close button, win.close(), and each window a quit closes). */
  onClose(win: FlushWindow, event: PreventableEvent): void;
  /** The app's 'before-quit' (⌘Q, the Dock, app.quit(), a relaunch). */
  onBeforeQuit(event: PreventableEvent): void;
}

export function createFlushGate(deps: FlushGateDeps): FlushGate {
  /** The attempt the page answered for: its repeat passes, and for a quit the window's close inside it too. */
  let passing: Action | null = null;
  /** An answer is awaited, for this action ('quit' wins: ⌘Q while a ⌘W waits quits). */
  let asking: Action | null = null;

  const ask = (win: FlushWindow, action: Action) => {
    if (asking !== null) {
      if (action === 'quit') asking = 'quit';
      return;
    }
    asking = action;
    void askToFlush(win, deps.timeoutMs).then((result) => {
      const wanted = asking ?? action;
      asking = null;
      deps.record?.({ action: wanted, result });
      if (result === 'invalid') return; // the window stays, the quit is off: the form shows why
      passing = wanted;
      if (wanted === 'quit') deps.quit();
      else if (!win.isDestroyed()) win.close();
      else passing = null;
    });
  };

  return {
    onClose(win, event) {
      if (passing !== null) {
        passing = null; // the attempt that was asked for
        return;
      }
      if (win.isDestroyed()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      ask(win, 'close');
    },
    onBeforeQuit(event) {
      if (passing === 'quit') return; // our own repeat
      const win = deps.mainWindow();
      if (!win || win.isDestroyed()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      ask(win, 'quit');
    },
  };
}
```
