```ts
import { revealInspector } from '../shell/useInspector';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { afterEditing, editSession } from './editGuard';
import { useSections } from './sections';

let focusFor: string | null = null;

/** InfoEditor asks when it mounts: true once after 정보 편집 asked for this item (its title field then takes the focus). */
export function takeFocusRequest(itemId: string): boolean {
  const asked = focusFor === itemId;
  focusFor = null;
  return asked;
}

/** 정보 편집 (item.editInfo, the pencil): the panel shows if it is out of sight, 정보 opens, its form takes the focus. */
export function startEditing(itemId: string): void {
  const begin = () => {
    revealInspector();
    useSections.getState().setOpen('info', true);
    if (useLibrary.getState().editingId === itemId) {
      // Already open (the palette again): only the focus moves.
      document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="editor-field"][data-field="title"] input')?.focus();
      return;
    }
    focusFor = itemId;
    useLibrary.getState().setEditing(itemId);
  };
  const open = editSession();
  if (open && open.itemId !== itemId) afterEditing(begin);
  else begin();
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CircleAlert, Minus, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { FieldError, Input, Label, TextArea, TextField } from 'react-aria-components';
import type { ItemDetail, LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { keys } from '../data/queries';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';
import { revealInspector } from '../shell/useInspector';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Button, IconButton } from '../ui/Button';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { showToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { leaveEditing, openEditSession } from './editGuard';
import { CREATOR_ROLES, FIELD_ORDER, draftOf, sameInfo, validateInfo, type CleanInfo, type CreatorDraft, type FieldErrors, type InfoDraft, type InfoTextField } from './editInfo';
import { takeFocusRequest } from './startEditing';

let rowSeq = 0;
const newRowKey = () => `row-${++rowSeq}`;
/** A key that only finishes a Korean composition (design-spec 7.4): it neither saves nor cancels. */
const composing = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229;
const fieldInput = (root: HTMLElement | null, field: InfoTextField) =>
  root?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-testid="editor-field"][data-field="${field}"] :is(input, textarea)`) ?? null;

/**
 * 정보 편집 (spec §5.3): the 정보 section as a form, in its place. It saves through library.updateMetadata, the whole
 * metadata object (the repository replaces it). While it is open it is the edit session (editGuard.ts): another row,
 * the reader, and — through main's flush (M/edit-flush.ts) — closing the window or quitting ask it first. No change
 * ends it, valid changes are saved first, invalid ones keep the item (the table selection comes back to it) with the
 * unsaved line and 버리기. No sheet.
 */
export function InfoEditor({ item, detail }: { item: LibraryItem; detail: ItemDetail }) {
  const e = t.inspector.editor;
  // What the edit started from: a refresh meanwhile (libraryChanged) does not move the base under the user's typing.
  const [initial] = useState(() => draftOf(item.title, detail.metadata, newRowKey));
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(initial);
  const [showErrors, setShowErrors] = useState(false);
  const [blocked, setBlocked] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [focusRow, setFocusRow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const draftRef = useRef(draft);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    draftRef.current = draft;
  });
  const check = useMemo(() => validateInfo(draft), [draft]);
  const errors: FieldErrors = showErrors && !check.ok ? check.errors : {};
  useEffect(() => {
    if (check.ok) setBlocked(false); // the line goes once nothing is marked
  }, [check.ok]);

  const set = (patch: Partial<InfoDraft>) => setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, ...patch }));
  const setCreator = (i: number, patch: Partial<CreatorDraft>) => setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, creators: d.creators.map((c, j) => (j === i ? { ...c, ...patch } : c)) }));
  const addCreator = () => {
    const row: CreatorDraft = { key: newRowKey(), name: '', role: 'author' };
    setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, creators: [...d.creators, row] }));
    setFocusRow(row.key);
  };
  const removeCreator = (i: number) => {
    const next = draft.creators[i + 1] ?? draft.creators[i - 1];
    setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, creators: d.creators.filter((_, j) => j !== i) }));
    setFocusRow(next?.key ?? 'add');
  };
  const moveCreator = (i: number, by: -1 | 1) => {
    const key = draft.creators[i]!.key;
    setDraft((d) => {
      const creators = [...d.creators];
      const [row] = creators.splice(i, 1);
      creators.splice(i + by, 0, row!);
      return { ...d, creators };
    });
    setFocusRow(key); // its arrow may now be the disabled end one: the focus stays on the row
  };
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (focusRow === null) return;
    const root = rootRef.current;
    const target = focusRow === 'add' ? root?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="creator-add"]') : root?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-row="${focusRow}"] input`);
    target?.focus();
    setFocusRow(null);
  }, [focusRow]);

  /** Ends the edit; the pencil takes the focus back if the form had it. */
  const end = (returnFocus: boolean) => {
    const hadFocus = rootRef.current?.contains(document.activeElement) ?? false;
    useLibrary.getState().setEditing(null);
    if (returnFocus && hadFocus) requestAnimationFrame(() => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="info-edit"]')?.focus());
  };
  /** True once the library has it; a failure is a toast and the form stays (spec §5.3). */
  const save = async (value: CleanInfo): Promise<boolean> => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const saved = await unwrap(api().library.updateMetadata({ itemId: item.id, title: value.title, metadata: value.metadata }));
      // What the panel and the row show next, before libraryChanged's reads come back (no frame of the old values).
      queryClient.setQueryData<ItemDetail>(keys.detail(item.id), (d) => (d ? { ...d, item: saved, metadata: value.metadata } : d));
      queryClient.setQueryData<LibraryItem[]>(keys.items, (list) => list?.map((i) => (i.id === saved.id ? saved : i)));
      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      showToast({ kind: 'error', title: e.saveFailed, body: (err as Error).message, testId: 'save-failed' });
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };
  const focusFirstError = (errs: FieldErrors) => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    if (errs.title) return void fieldInput(root, 'title')?.focus();
    const row = draftRef.current.creators.find((c) => errs[`creator:${c.key}`] !== undefined);
    if (row) return void root?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-row="${row.key}"] input`)?.focus();
    const field = FIELD_ORDER.find((f) => errs[f] !== undefined);
    if (field) fieldInput(root, field)?.focus();
  };
  /** 저장, ⌘↩ and ↩ in a one-line field. Nothing changed: the edit just ends (no write, 수정일 stays). */
  const submit = async () => {
    const v = validateInfo(draftRef.current);
    if (!v.ok) {
      setShowErrors(true);
      focusFirstError(v.errors);
      return;
    }
    if (sameInfo(draftRef.current, initial)) return end(true);
    if (await save(v.value)) end(true);
  };
  /** The session's answer when something leaves the item (spec §5.3). */
  const leave = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    const d = draftRef.current;
    if (sameInfo(d, initial)) {
      end(false);
      return true;
    }
    const v = validateInfo(d);
    if (v.ok && (await save(v.value))) {
      end(false);
      return true;
    }
    if (!v.ok) {
      setShowErrors(true);
      setBlocked(true);
      revealInspector(); // a folded panel would hide why nothing moved (or why the window did not close)
    }
    // Back to the edited item (and after a failed save, whose toast says why): it is the anchor and the keyboard cursor
    // again too (Q-47), so the arrows go on from it.
    useLibrary.getState().setSelected([item.id]);
    return false;
  };
  const leaveRef = useRef(leave);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    leaveRef.current = leave;
  });

  useEffect(() => openEditSession({ itemId: item.id, dirty: () => !sameInfo(draftRef.current, initial), leave: () => leaveRef.current() }), [item.id, initial]);
  // Another row: whatever the table did — a press, an arrow, ⌘A, esc emptying it (Q-43), the first press of a
  // double-click — the edit is asked first (a selection of exactly this item is no change; nor is our own setSelected).
  useEffect(
    () =>
      useLibrary.subscribe((s, prev) => {
        if (s.selected === prev.selected || (s.selected.size === 1 && s.selected.has(item.id))) return;
        void leaveEditing();
      }),
    [item.id],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    if (takeFocusRequest(item.id)) fieldInput(rootRef.current, 'title')?.focus();
  }, [item.id]);

  const onKeyDown = (ev: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (composing(ev) || ev.key === 'Process') return;
    const command = currentPlatform() === 'darwin' ? ev.metaKey : ev.ctrlKey;
    const plain = !ev.metaKey && !ev.ctrlKey && !ev.altKey && !ev.shiftKey;
    if (ev.key === 'Enter' && (command || (plain && ev.target instanceof HTMLInputElement))) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      void submit();
    } else if (ev.key === 'Escape' && plain) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      ev.stopPropagation();
      end(true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className="editor" role="form" aria-label={e.form} data-testid="info-editor" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
      {blocked && (
        <div className="ed-unsaved" role="alert" data-testid="editor-unsaved">
          <Icon icon={CircleAlert} size="sm" />
          <span className="ed-unsaved-text">{e.unsaved}</span>
          <Button variant="plain-danger" size="small" testId="editor-discard" onPress={() => end(true)}>
            {e.discard}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      <EditorText field="title" label={e.title} value={draft.title} onChange={(title) => set({ title })} error={errors.title} />
      <div className="ed-field ed-creators" role="group" aria-label={e.creators}>
        <span className="ed-label" aria-hidden="true">
          {e.creators}
        </span>
        {draft.creators.map((c, i) => {
          const error = errors[`creator:${c.key}`];
          return (
            <div key={c.key} className="ed-creator" data-testid="creator-row" data-index={i} data-row={c.key}>
              <TextField className="ed-name" aria-label={e.creatorName(i + 1)} value={c.name} onChange={(name) => setCreator(i, { name })} isInvalid={error !== undefined} validationBehavior="aria">
                <Input className="field ed-input" />
                <FieldError className="ed-error">{error}</FieldError>
              </TextField>
              <select
                className="field ed-select"
                aria-label={e.creatorRole(i + 1)}
                value={c.role}
                onChange={(ev) => setCreator(i, { role: ev.target.value as CreatorDraft['role'] })}
                data-testid="creator-role"
              >
                {CREATOR_ROLES.map((r) => (
                  <option key={r} value={r}>
                    {t.inspector.roles[r]}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <IconButton icon={ChevronUp} size="small" label={e.creatorUp(i + 1)} isDisabled={i === 0} onPress={() => moveCreator(i, -1)} testId="creator-up" />
              <IconButton icon={ChevronDown} size="small" label={e.creatorDown(i + 1)} isDisabled={i === draft.creators.length - 1} onPress={() => moveCreator(i, 1)} testId="creator-down" />
              <IconButton icon={Minus} size="small" label={e.creatorRemove(i + 1)} onPress={() => removeCreator(i)} testId="creator-remove" />
            </div>
          );
        })}
        <div className="ed-add">
          <Button variant="plain" size="small" icon={Plus} leading testId="creator-add" onPress={addCreator}>
            {e.addCreator}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <EditorText field="date" label={e.date} value={draft.date} onChange={(date) => set({ date })} error={errors.date} placeholder={e.datePlaceholder} />
      <EditorText field="publisher" label={e.publisher} value={draft.publisher} onChange={(publisher) => set({ publisher })} error={errors.publisher} />
      <EditorText field="language" label={e.language} value={draft.language} onChange={(language) => set({ language })} error={errors.language} placeholder={e.languagePlaceholder} />
      <EditorText field="url" label={e.url} value={draft.url} onChange={(url) => set({ url })} error={errors.url} placeholder={e.urlPlaceholder} />
      <EditorText field="abstract" label={e.abstract} value={draft.abstract} onChange={(abstract) => set({ abstract })} error={errors.abstract} multiline />
      <EditorText field="extra" label={e.extra} value={draft.extra} onChange={(extra) => set({ extra })} error={errors.extra} multiline />
      <div className="ed-actions">
        <Button testId="editor-cancel" onPress={() => end(true)}>
          {t.common.cancel}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="primary" testId="editor-save" isPending={saving} onPress={() => void submit()}>
          {e.save}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** One labelled field: the label above (the panel is 288 wide), the footnote under it while it is marked. */
function EditorText(props: { field: InfoTextField; label: string; value: string; onChange(value: string): void; error: string | undefined; placeholder?: string; multiline?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <TextField className="ed-field" data-testid="editor-field" data-field={props.field} value={props.value} onChange={props.onChange} isInvalid={props.error !== undefined} validationBehavior="aria">
      <Label className="ed-label">{props.label}</Label>
      {props.multiline ? <TextArea className="field ed-input ed-text" rows={4} /> : <Input className="field ed-input" placeholder={props.placeholder} />}
      <FieldError className="ed-error">{props.error}</FieldError>
    </TextField>
  );
}
```

`R/inspector/InfoSection.tsx`: `import { Button } from '../ui/Button';`을 `import { Button, IconButton } from '../ui/Button';`로 바꾸고 import에
```ts
import { Pencil } from 'lucide-react';
import { commandById, commandLabel } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { InfoEditor } from './InfoEditor';
```
를 더한 뒤, `InfoSection` 함수 전체를:
```tsx
/**
 * 정보 (spec §5.3): the rows that have a value, then 추가일 · 수정일; with no info yet, what writing it gives. The pencil
 * (정보 편집, the registry command) turns the section into the form in place; while it is open the pencil is not drawn.
 */
export function InfoSection({ item, detail }: { item: LibraryItem; detail: ItemDetail }) {
  const now = useNow();
  const editing = useLibrary((s) => s.editingId === item.id);
  const { run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  const target = { itemIds: [item.id] };
  const pencil = editing ? undefined : (
    <IconButton
      icon={Pencil}
      size="small"
      label={commandLabel(commandById('item.editInfo'), currentPlatform())}
      onPress={() => run('item.editInfo', target)}
      isDisabled={!isEnabled('item.editInfo', target)}
      disabledReason={t.common.busy}
      testId="info-edit"
    />
  );
  return (
    <Section id="info" title={t.inspector.sections.info} testId="info-section" extra={pencil}>
      {editing ? (
        <InfoEditor item={item} detail={detail} />
      ) : (
        <>
          {!hasInfo(detail.metadata) && (
            <p className="info-hint" data-testid="info-empty">
              {t.inspector.noInfo}
            </p>
          )}
          <dl className="kv">
            {infoRows(detail.metadata, item, now).map((row) => (
              <div key={row.field} className="kv-row" data-testid="info-row" data-field={row.field}>
                <dt>{row.label}</dt>
                <dd>
                  <RowValue row={row} />
                </dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        </>
      )}
    </Section>
  );
}
```

`R/inspector/InfoPane.tsx`: import에 `useEffect`를 더하고 `InfoPane` 전체를:
```tsx
/** Info mode (spec §5.3–5.4), from the table's selection; an open edit keeps its item on show until it lets go. */
export function InfoPane() {
  const items = useItems().data ?? NO_ITEMS;
  const selected = useLibrary((s) => s.selected);
  const editingId = useLibrary((s) => s.editingId);
  const byId = useMemo(() => new Map(items.map((i) => [i.id, i])), [items]);
  // In list order, as Task 6 has it (MultiSelection's titles keep the table's relative order, Q-46).
  const chosen = useMemo(() => (selected.size === 0 ? NO_ITEMS : items.filter((i) => selected.has(i.id))), [selected, items]);
  const editing = editingId === null ? undefined : byId.get(editingId);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editingId !== null && !byId.has(editingId)) useLibrary.getState().setEditing(null); // the item left the library
  }, [editingId, byId]);
  if (editing) return <ItemInfo key={editing.id} item={editing} />;
  if (chosen.length === 0) return <NoSelection items={items} />;
  if (chosen.length > 1) return <MultiSelection items={chosen} />;
  return <ItemInfo key={chosen[0]!.id} item={chosen[0]!} />;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: E2E** `E/inspector-edit.spec.ts`(새 파일, 전문)

```ts
// 정보 편집 (spec §5.3): the form in place, its checks, what happens when something leaves it — another row, the reader,
// closing the window, quitting (main's flush, M/edit-flush.ts) — and item.editInfo from the palette. ⌘↩ is a key of the
// form (no menu accelerator), so it is pressed in the page.
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { FIXTURES, importPaths, launch, mainWindow, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, selectRows } from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const KO_PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1.pdf');
const SAVE_KEY = process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'Meta+Enter' : 'Control+Enter';

const dirs = (testInfo: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata')] as const;
const contentWidth = async (app: ElectronApplication, width: number) =>
  (await mainWindow(app)).evaluate((w, width) => w.setContentSize(width, w.getContentSize()[1]!), width);
/** As inspector.spec.ts: the panel needs a 1080 px window; the 1024 px macOS runner may not give one. */
async function roomForPanel(app: ElectronApplication, page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await contentWidth(app, 1440);
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => innerWidth)).toBeGreaterThan(1000);
  const width = await page.evaluate(() => innerWidth);
  test.skip(width < 1080, `a ${width} px window folds the item panel by design; Linux CI and the macOS evidence lane cover this`);
}
const field = (page: Page, name: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="editor-field"][data-field="${name}"] :is(input, textarea)`);
const fieldBox = (page: Page, name: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="editor-field"][data-field="${name}"]`);
const infoValue = (page: Page, name: string) => page.locator(`[data-testid="info-row"][data-field="${name}"] dd`);
const panelState = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('shell').getAttribute('data-inspector');
const detailOf = (page: Page, itemId: string) =>
  page.evaluate(async (id) => {
    const r = await window.learn.library.detail({ itemId: id });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.detail failed: ${r.code}`);
    return r.data;
  }, itemId);
const windowCount = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().filter((w) => !w.isDestroyed()).length);
/** What main's flush was answered for each close or quit (M/index.ts, E2E only). */
const flushLog = (app: ElectronApplication) =>
  app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnEditFlushLog?: Array<{ action: string; result: string }> }).__learnEditFlushLog ?? []);

test('the pencil turns 정보 into a form in place; 저장, ⌘↩ and ↩ in a one-line field save; 취소 and esc write nothing', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    const pencil = page.getByTestId('info-edit');
    await expect(pencil).toHaveAccessibleName('정보 편집');
    await pencil.click();
    const editor = page.getByTestId('info-editor');
    await expect(editor).toBeVisible();
    await expect(field(page, 'title')).toBeFocused();
    await expect(field(page, 'title')).toHaveValue('sample');
    await expect(pencil).toHaveCount(0); // the form's own buttons take over
    await field(page, 'title').fill('세포 신호 전달');
    await page.getByTestId('creator-add').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('creator-row').nth(0).locator('input')).toBeFocused();
    await page.keyboard.type('한서진');
    await field(page, 'date').fill('2024-03');
    await field(page, 'publisher').fill('학습출판');
    await page.getByTestId('editor-save').click();
    await expect(editor).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('inspector-head').locator('h2')).toHaveText('세포 신호 전달');
    await expect(infoValue(page, 'date')).toHaveText('2024. 3.');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, '세포 신호 전달')).toBeVisible(); // the table took the new title (libraryChanged)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-edit')).toBeFocused(); // back where the edit began
    const saved = await detailOf(page, pdf!.id);
    expect(saved.item.title).toBe('세포 신호 전달');
    expect(saved.metadata).toEqual({ creators: [{ name: '한서진', role: 'author' }], date: '2024-03', publisher: '학습출판' });

    // ⌘↩ (Ctrl+Enter off macOS) saves from anywhere; ↩ in a multi-line field is a new line.
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await field(page, 'extra').click();
    await page.keyboard.type('첫 줄');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await page.keyboard.type('둘째 줄');
    await page.keyboard.press(SAVE_KEY);
    await expect(editor).toHaveCount(0);
    expect((await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).metadata.extra).toBe('첫 줄\n둘째 줄');
    // ↩ in a one-line field saves.
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await field(page, 'language').fill('한국어');
    await field(page, 'language').press('Enter');
    await expect(editor).toHaveCount(0);
    expect((await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).metadata.language).toBe('한국어');

    // 취소 and esc keep the stored values; nothing is written (수정일 stays).
    const before = (await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).item.updatedAt;
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await field(page, 'publisher').fill('바뀐 출판사');
    await page.getByTestId('editor-cancel').click();
    await expect(infoValue(page, 'publisher')).toHaveText('학습출판');
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await field(page, 'publisher').fill('바뀐 출판사');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(editor).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(infoValue(page, 'publisher')).toHaveText('학습출판');
    // 저장 with nothing changed only ends the edit.
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await page.getByTestId('editor-save').click();
    await expect(editor).toHaveCount(0);
    expect((await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).item.updatedAt).toBe(before);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('leaving the edit: another row after valid changes saves first; invalid ones bring the selection back with the unsaved line and 버리기; no change just ends it', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(page, [PDF, KO_PDF]);
    const head = page.getByTestId('inspector-head').locator('h2');
    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await selectRows(page, ['한글 경로 (테스트) #1']); // no change: the other row simply shows
    await expect(head).toHaveText('한글 경로 (테스트) #1');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-editor')).toHaveCount(0);

    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await field(page, 'publisher').fill('학습출판');
    await selectRows(page, ['한글 경로 (테스트) #1']); // valid: saved, then the other row
    await expect(head).toHaveText('한글 경로 (테스트) #1');
    expect((await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).metadata.publisher).toBe('학습출판');

    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await field(page, 'date').fill('어제');
    await selectRows(page, ['한글 경로 (테스트) #1']); // invalid: nothing moves
    await expect(page.getByTestId('editor-unsaved')).toContainText('저장하지 못한 변경이 있습니다. 표시한 칸을 고치거나 변경을 버리세요.');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, 'sample')).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(rowByTitle(page, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1')).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    await expect(head).toHaveText('sample');
    await expect(field(page, 'date')).toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    // The reader is a way out too: refused the same way. The double-click's first press selects that row (the edit is
    // asked and the selection comes back), then its item.open goes through env.open's afterEditing: asked again, refused.
    await rowByTitle(page, '한글 경로 (테스트) #1').dblclick();
    await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('library-table')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('pdf-canvas')).toHaveCount(0);
    // 버리기 ends the edit without a write.
    await page.getByTestId('editor-discard').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-editor')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect((await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).metadata.date).toBeUndefined();

    // Valid changes and 열기: saved, then the reader (the press selects the edited row itself: no change, nothing asked).
    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    await field(page, 'language').fill('영어');
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').dblclick();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('pdf-canvas')).toHaveAttribute('data-rendered', /^[1-9]\d*$/);
    expect((await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).metadata.language).toBe('영어');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('creator rows: added, reordered, given a role and removed; saved in that order, an empty row left out', async ({}, testInfo) => {

    }

    await expect(rows.nth(0).getByTestId('creator-up')).toBeDisabled();

    await rows.nth(1).getByTestId('creator-role').selectOption('editor'); // 윤재하

    await app.close();
  }
});

test('closing the window over invalid changes keeps it, the form saying why; valid ones are saved, then it closes', async ({}, testInfo) => {

test('quitting (⌘Q, app.quit) over invalid changes is called off; valid ones are saved and the app really quits', async ({}, testInfo) => {

    await field(page, 'date').fill('2024-13');

    await expect(page.getByTestId('editor-unsaved')).toBeVisible();
    await expect.poll(() => flushLog(app)).toEqual([{ action: 'quit', result: 'invalid' }]);
    expect(await windowCount(app)).toBe(1); // nothing closed: the quit is off

    expect((await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).metadata.date).toBe('2024-03');
  } finally {
    await app.close().catch(() => {});
  }
});

test('IME: ↩ and esc that belong to a composition neither save nor cancel; keyCode 229 too; after the commit ↩ saves', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await roomForPanel(app, page);
    const [pdf] = await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await selectRows(page, ['sample']);
    await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
    const title = field(page, 'title');
    await title.fill('');
    const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
    await cdp.send('Input.imeSetComposition', { text: '세포', selectionStart: 2, selectionEnd: 2 });
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-editor')).toBeVisible();
    await cdp.send('Input.insertText', { text: '세포' }); // commits the composition
    await expect(title).toHaveValue('세포');
    for (const type of ['keyDown', 'keyUp'] as const) {
      await cdp.send('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', { type, key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', windowsVirtualKeyCode: 229, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 229 }); // macOS IME confirm
    }
    await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-editor')).toBeVisible();
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-editor')).toHaveCount(0);
    expect((await detailOf(page, pdf!.id)).item.title).toBe('세포');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

```ts
    await s.page.locator('[data-testid="editor-field"][data-field="date"] input').fill('2024-13');
```

새 기준 4장: `inspector-edit-{light,dark}`, `inspector-edit-end-light`, `inspector-edit-invalid-light`. 패널에 한 자료가 보이는 기존 장면은 연필이 더해져 바뀐다(정보 절 머리 오른쪽): Task 6의 `inspector-item-*`·`inspector-missing-light`, 그리고 Task 6 Step 17이 꼽은 한 자료 장면(`library-*`, `library-collapsed-*`, `toast-failure-light`, `toast-failure-multi-dark`, `focus-row-light`, `table-sorted-light`, `table-inactive-light`, `palette-selection-light`).

Run: `pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts --update-snapshots=all` → 바뀐 PNG를 눈으로 확인(위 장면들의 연필, 새 4장) → `pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts`(갱신 없이).

- [ ] **Step 11: 증거 하네스** — `V/library.evidence.ts`의 Task 6 테스트 다음(판정 테스트 앞)에(import에 `mainWindow`, `nativeKeyCode`, `KEY_CODE`(`../e2e/helpers`)를 더한다; `rowAt`·`selectRows`·`runMenuCommand`·`importPaths`·`nativeKeystroke`·`NativeInputNotPermitted`·`IS_MAC`·`allShots`와 모듈의 `setTheme`·`PDF`는 Task 3·4·6이 이미 둔다):
```ts
test('M4 library: 정보 편집 — the form in place, ⌘↩ from a real keystroke, a marked field; ⌘W and ⌘Q refused over it', TAG, async () => {
  const page = s.page;
  const state = () => page.getByTestId('shell').getAttribute('data-inspector');
  const edit: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  results['inspectorEdit'] = edit;
  const src = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `learn-m4-edit-${process.pid}.pdf`);
  fs.writeFileSync(src, Buffer.concat([fs.readFileSync(PDF), Buffer.from('\n% edit evidence\n')]));
  const [item] = await importPaths(page, [src]);
  const title = path.parse(src).name;
  const publisher = async () =>
    page.evaluate(async (id) => {
      const r = await window.learn.library.detail({ itemId: id });
      return r.ok ? (r.data.metadata.publisher ?? null) : null;
    }, item!.id);
  // The new item is the newest row (index 0): the table (its own scroll view) at the top, where the virtualizer draws it.
  await page.getByTestId('library-table').evaluate((grid) => grid.scrollTo(0, 0));
  await selectRows(page, [title]);
  const shownBefore = (await state()) === 'shown';
  if (!shownBefore) await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector'); // the 1024 px runner folds it
  await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
  await page.locator('[data-testid="editor-field"][data-field="publisher"] input').fill('학습출판');
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    await setTheme(page, theme);
    await allShots(s.app, page, `m4-inspector-edit-${theme}`, `정보 편집, the form in place (${theme})`);
  }
  await setTheme(page, 'light');

  await guard('edit: ⌘↩ saves', async () => {
    let native = false;
    if (IS_MAC) {
      try {
        await nativeKeyCode(s.app, KEY_CODE.return, ['command']);
        native = true;
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted)) throw e;
        await page.keyboard.press('Meta+Enter');
      }
    } else {
      await page.keyboard.press('Control+Enter');
    }
    await expect(page.getByTestId('info-editor')).toHaveCount(0);
    edit['saveKey'] = { native, publisher: await publisher() };
    check('edit: ⌘↩ saves', (await publisher()) === '학습출판', edit['saveKey']);
  });

  await page.getByTestId('info-edit').click();
  await page.locator('[data-testid="editor-field"][data-field="date"] input').fill('2024-13');
  // Another row: the one beside the edited item in the table's order (data-index, not the DOM order); its press asks
  // the edit, which refuses and brings the selection back.
  const besideMine = (await rowAt(page, 0).getAttribute('data-title')) === title ? 1 : 0;
  await rowAt(page, besideMine).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('editor-unsaved')).toBeVisible();
  await allShots(s.app, page, 'm4-inspector-edit-invalid-light', '정보 편집, a marked date and the unsaved line (light)');

  await guard('edit: closing the window over a marked field keeps it open', async () => {
    let native = false;
    if (IS_MAC) {
      try {
        await nativeKeystroke(s.app, 'w', ['command']); // 윈도우 닫기 ⌘W
        native = true;
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted)) throw e;
        await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.close());
      }
    } else {
      await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.close());
    }
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    const open = await s.app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().some((w) => !w.isDestroyed() && w.webContents.getURL().includes('window=main')));
    edit['closeGuard'] = { native, open };
    check('edit: closing the window over a marked field keeps it open', open, edit['closeGuard']);
  });
  // ⌘Q over the marked field: main's flush calls the quit off (edit-flush.ts). Were it to quit, this session ends here —
  // the failed check then explains the tests that fail after it.
  await guard('edit: quitting over a marked field is called off (the app stays)', async () => {
    let native = false;
    if (IS_MAC) {
      try {
        await nativeKeystroke(s.app, 'q', ['command']); // Learn 종료 ⌘Q
        native = true;
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted)) throw e;
        await s.app.evaluate(({ app: electronApp }) => electronApp.quit());
      }
    } else {
      await s.app.evaluate(({ app: electronApp }) => electronApp.quit());
    }
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    const alive = await s.app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().some((w) => !w.isDestroyed() && w.webContents.getURL().includes('window=main')));
    edit['quitGuard'] = { native, alive, flushLog: await s.app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnEditFlushLog?: unknown[] }).__learnEditFlushLog ?? []) };
    check('edit: quitting over a marked field is called off (the app stays)', alive, edit['quitGuard']);
  });
  await page.getByTestId('editor-discard').click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('info-editor')).toHaveCount(0);
  if (!shownBefore) await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector');
  fs.rmSync(src, { force: true });
  save();
});
```
Run: `xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1440x900x24" pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.evidence.config.ts --grep "@library"`(백그라운드) → 통과, `m4-library.json`의 `inspectorEdit.saveKey.publisher: '학습출판'`, `closeGuard.open: true`, `quitGuard.alive: true`(`flushLog`에 `{ action: 'close', result: 'invalid' }`, `{ action: 'quit', result: 'invalid' }`), 세 판정 `ok: true`.

### Task 8: 사본 내보내기·오래 걸리는 첫 복사의 바쁨 표시

#### 계약과 다른 점 (판정 기록)

아래 1–6은 컨트롤러가 권고대로 판정했다(Q-10…Q-15). 7은 Task 5의 판정(Q-26)을 따른다. 단계는 판정대로 쓰였다.

1. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-10으로 해소.** **P-12의 300ms를 사본 내보내기에서는 저장 패널이 닫힌 뒤부터 센다.** `library.exportCopy`는 저장 패널과 복사를 한 번의
   IPC로 한다(B.3). P-12 문구대로 "IPC가 300ms 넘게 끝나지 않으면"을 세면 사용자가 패널에서 이름을 고르는 동안 "내보내는 중…"
   토스트가 패널 밑에 뜬다. 권고: `runFileAction(kind, title, call, opts?)`에 선택 인자 `{ countFrom?: Promise<void> }`를 두고,
   내보내기는 창이 이미 받는 `windowState` push(`sheetOpen` true → false, `windows.asSheet`가 보냄)로 패널이 닫힌 때를 알아
   그때부터 센다. 새 main 이벤트는 없다(P-12의 "no main event" 유지). 패널이 떠 있는 동안 창은 다시 연결…의 열기 패널처럼
   잡힌다(`blocked`): 메뉴 막대·팔레트·드롭이 두 번째 패널을 열지 못한다. 복사 중에는 잡지 않는다.
2. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-11로 해소.** **바쁨 토스트 제목은 동작마다.** 명세 8절은 세 동작 모두 "여는 중…"이라 쓰지만 사본 내보내기는 아무것도 열지 않는다.
   권고: 기본 앱으로 열기·Finder에서 보기 = "여는 중…", 사본 내보내기 = "내보내는 중…". 둘째 줄은 자료 제목(한 줄, 말줄임).
3. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-12로 해소.** **"라이브러리에서 ‘…’ 검색" 행은 자료가 있는 라이브러리에서만.** P-20은 "결과 없음 테스트는 이제 검색 행만 기대한다"고
   하지만, 빈 라이브러리에는 빠른 검색 필드가 없다(명세 3.5, 디자인 명세 2.4) — 그 행은 질의를 넣을 곳이 없는 가짜 컨트롤이
   된다(`library.find`도 `libraryCount > 0`일 때만 켜진다, B.2). 권고: 행은 질의가 있고 `libraryCount > 0`이고 창이 잡혀 있지
   않을 때만 나온다. 빈 라이브러리에서 도는 M3 결과 없음 테스트(palette.spec "keywords, no results…", ARIA 테스트)는 지금처럼
   `palette-empty`만 기대하고, 자료가 있는 라이브러리의 결과 없음(keyboard.spec 여정, 투어 `palette-none-*`, 새 테스트)이
   검색 행을 기대한다.
4. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-13으로 해소.** **발 줄의 ↩ 이름은 커서 행을 따른다.** 명세 4.4는 "↑ ↓ 이동 · ↩ 열기"인데, 목업 `?state=none`(커서가 검색 행)은 "↩ 실행 ·
   esc 닫기"다. 권고: 커서가 자료 행이면 "열기", 명령 행·검색 행이면 "실행". 결과 없음 상태(검색 행 하나)는 목업대로
   "↩ 실행 · esc 닫기"만(↑↓·초성 힌트 없음 — 초성 예는 안내 본문에 있다).
5. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-14로 해소.** **`palette.recent`는 팔레트에서 고른 명령만 기록한다.** 명세 4.4 "최근 실행한 명령"은 어디서 실행했는지 말하지 않는다.
   권고: 팔레트에서 골라 실제로 실행된 명령만(VS Code·Raycast의 "최근 사용"과 같다). 메뉴 막대·단축키·도구 막대로 실행한
   것까지 넣으면 ⌃⌘S 한 번이 팔레트 첫 줄을 바꾼다. 자료 행·검색 행은 명령이 아니라 기록하지 않는다.
6. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-15로 해소.** **내보내기의 "마지막으로 고른 폴더"는 main 프로세스 메모리에만.** 명세 7절의 설정 키 목록에 해당 키가 없다. 권고: 이번
   실행 동안만 기억하고(다시 시작하면 다운로드), 저장에 성공한 폴더만 기억한다(쓰지 못한 폴더를 다시 권하지 않는다).
7. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-26으로 해소.** **팔레트 결과 없음 제목의 와/과.** 처음 초안은 `R/strings/palette.ts`에 지역 도우미 `wa`를 두었다.
   판정: Task 5의 `R/strings/josa.ts` `waGwa(word)`(한글 받침·숫자 읽기)를 그대로 쓴다(Task 9 Step 5).

**이웃 초안과 맞춘 이름(2026-10-24, TanStack Task 3 재작성 뒤 — 충돌 아님):** Task 3의 도우미 `rowByTitle(page, title)`(클릭·오른쪽 클릭),
`openItem(page, title)`(더블클릭 — 한 번 클릭은 고르기만), `rowAt(page, index)`(`data-index`), 투어 날짜 마스크
`[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]`(Q-40), `V/library.evidence.ts`의 모듈 이름(`TAG`, `results`, `checks`, `check`, `guard`,
`save`, `setTheme`, 직렬 공유 세션 `s`)과 이미 있는 가져오기; Task 4의 팔레트 자료 명령(`itemTarget`·`itemCommands`·`targetOf(id)`, 라이브러리
보기에서 `env.selection()`)과 `commands-coverage.spec.ts`의 누적 shell 기대값; Task 5의 `searchIndexFor`·`search`·`useSearchTexts`·
`focusQuickSearch`·`setQuery`·`waGwa`·`search-field`; Task 2의 `state = { sidebar: env.sidebar, inspector: env.inspector }`; Task 6의
`env.inspector`; Task 7이 `COMMANDS`에서 `item.openExternally` 바로 뒤에 둔 `item.editInfo`(그래서 `item.exportCopy`는 그 뒤). 투어 기준
이름은 Task 13이 찾는 `palette-items-{light,dark}`(자료 결과)를 쓴다. E2E 도우미 `saveDialogCalls(app)`는 `openDialogCalls`처럼 **수**를
돌려주고(Task 13이 그렇게 쓴다), 패널이 받은 값은 `saveDialogLog(app)`가 돌려준다.

6절 표의 `item.exportCopy` 줄, 디자인 명세 7.3 자료 컨텍스트 메뉴 "사본 내보내기…"). main이 메인 창에 시트로 붙는 저장 패널을
띄우고(기본 이름은 기본 앱으로 열기의 이름 규칙 — `L/openable.ts`의 `safeBaseName` + 확장자, 기본 폴더는 이번 실행에서
마지막으로 저장한 폴더, 없으면 다운로드), 고른 폴더 안의 임시 이름 `.<이름>.learn-export-<uuid>.part`로 `COPYFILE_FICLONE`
복사한 뒤 rename한다 — 고른 경로에는 다 쓴 파일만 나타난다. 실패하면 임시 파일을 지우고 원인 + 다음 행동을 토스트로 알린다.
저장했으면 "사본을 저장했습니다" 토스트 + "Finder에서 보기"(밖에서는 "폴더에서 보기") 동작 단추가 `library.revealExport()`로
그 파일을 보인다(렌더러는 경로를 보지 않는다). 토스트는 동작(`action`)과 바쁨 종류(`busy`: 스피너, 자동 닫힘 없음, 닫기 단추
없음, `closeToast(key)`로 닫힘)를 얻는다(P-29). 렌더러의 `runFileAction`(P-12)은 기본 앱으로 열기·Finder에서 보기·사본
내보내기의 IPC가 300ms를 넘게 걸리면 바쁨 토스트("여는 중…"/"내보내는 중…" + 자료 제목)를 띄우고 끝나면 거둔다(명세 8절
"오래 걸리는 첫 복사"). 내보내기는 판정 Q-10대로 패널이 닫힌 뒤부터 센다. E2E 도우미 `stubSaveDialog`·`saveDialogCalls`·`saveDialogLog`와,
spec마다 따로 있던 `stubShell`·`shellCalls`를 `E/helpers.ts`로 옮긴다(B.8, P-21).

고친 사본 다시 가져오기(M6), 내보낸 파일의 정리(내보낸 파일은 사용자 것이다 — 지우지 않는다), `shell.evidence.ts`의 Finder

- [ ] **Step 4: 구현** `L/openable.ts`

`namedCopyPath`를 다음 두 함수로 바꾼다(동작은 그대로, 이름 규칙만 꺼낸다):
```ts
/**
 * The file name the OS sees for an asset under this title: the named copy's (namedCopyPath) and the default in
 * 사본 내보내기's save panel — the title made safe (the original name's base when the title is empty) with the type's
 * extension. null: a type with no known extension.
 */
export function openableName(asset: Pick<OpenableAsset, 'mime' | 'originalName'>, title: string): string | null {
  const ext = openExtension(asset.mime, asset.originalName);
  if (!ext) return null;
  return `${safeBaseName(title, safeBaseName(path.parse(asset.originalName).name))}.${ext}`;
}

/** Where the named copy of an asset lives (null: a type with no known extension, nothing to name). */
export function namedCopyPath(layout: LibraryLayout, asset: OpenableAsset, title: string): string | null {
  const name = openableName(asset, title);
  return name === null ? null : path.join(layout.derivedDir, 'open', asset.id, name);
}
```
파일 끝(`openableFile` 다음)에 추가:
```ts
/** A file name may take 255 bytes on every file system we write to; an export's temporary name stays within it. */
export const EXPORT_TEMP_BYTES = 255;

/**
 * `.<name>.learn-export-<uuid>.part`: hidden (leading dot) and in the chosen folder, so the rename that finishes the
 * export stays on one volume and is atomic. A long chosen name is cut at a character to keep within EXPORT_TEMP_BYTES.
 */
export function exportTempName(fileName: string, id: string = randomUUID()): string {
  const tail = `.learn-export-${id}.part`;
  const room = EXPORT_TEMP_BYTES - 1 - Buffer.byteLength(tail, 'utf8');
  const chars = Array.from(fileName.normalize('NFC'));
  while (Buffer.byteLength(chars.join(''), 'utf8') > room) chars.pop();
  return `.${chars.join('')}${tail}`;
}

/**
 * 사본 내보내기 (spec §7): copies `src` to `dst` through a temporary name beside it (copy-on-write where the volume has
 * it), then renames it over `dst`. The chosen path only ever holds the whole file, and a file already there (the save
 * panel asked before replacing it) is replaced in one step. Any failure removes the temporary file and is rethrown.
 * The copy keeps the source's mode: the user's file, not a locked named copy.
 */
export async function exportFile(src: string, dst: string): Promise<void> {
  const tmp = path.join(path.dirname(dst), exportTempName(path.basename(dst)));
  try {
    await fs.copyFile(src, tmp, fsConstants.COPYFILE_FICLONE);
    await fs.rename(tmp, dst);
  } catch (e) {
    await fs.rm(tmp, { force: true }).catch(() => {});
    throw e;
  }
}
```
파일 머리 주석의 마지막 문장 "Importing an edited copy again is M4/M6; removing these files belongs with trash (M6)."는 그대로 둔다(내보낸 파일은
사용자의 파일이라 정리 대상이 아니다).

- [ ] **Step 5: main의 내보내기 — 실패하는 테스트** `M/ipc/export.test.ts`(새 파일)

`@learn/library`는 모의하지 않는다: 이름·임시 파일·rename을 실제 임시 폴더에서 확인한다. 등록은 한 번이고 "마지막으로 저장한
폴더"는 그 등록의 상태라, 테스트는 적힌 순서대로 돈다.

```ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { SaveDialogOptions } from 'electron';
import { afterAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { LearnError, type Availability, type Result } from '@learn/domain';
import { libraryLayout } from '@learn/library';
import { mainStrings } from '../strings';
import { stubDeps } from './test-deps';

type Listener = (event: unknown, raw: unknown) => Promise<Result<unknown>>;
const handlers = new Map<string, Listener>();
const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'learn-export-'));
afterAll(() => fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }));
const DOWNLOADS = path.join(tmp, 'Downloads');
const MAIN = { id: 1, name: 'main window' };
/** What the save panel answers next (null: cancelled) and every call it got. */
const panel: { answer: string | null; calls: Array<{ parent: unknown; options: SaveDialogOptions }> } = { answer: null, calls: [] };
const reveals: string[] = [];

vi.mock('electron', () => ({
  app: { getPath: (name: string) => (name === 'downloads' ? DOWNLOADS : path.join(tmp, name)) },
  ipcMain: { handle: (channel: string, fn: Listener) => handlers.set(channel, fn) },
  BrowserWindow: { fromWebContents: () => MAIN, getAllWindows: () => [] },
  dialog: {
    showSaveDialog: async (parent: unknown, options: SaveDialogOptions) => {
      panel.calls.push({ parent, options });
      return panel.answer === null ? { canceled: true, filePath: '' } : { canceled: false, filePath: panel.answer };
    },
  },
  shell: { showItemInFolder: (p: string) => void reveals.push(p) },
}));

const { createHandle } = await import('./register');
const { registerLibraryIpc, exportError } = await import('./library');

const layout = libraryLayout(path.join(tmp, 'library'));
const ITEM = '7d3f3c3e-8a51-4f7e-9d7c-2b1f0f6f8f10';
const ASSET = '1b6f5a52-2c1e-4d55-9a3e-0d2c6f7e8a90';
const SHA = 'ab'.repeat(32);
const assetFile = path.join(layout.assetsDir, 'ab', SHA);
const BYTES = '%PDF-1.7\nexport\n';
const stored: { availability: Availability } = { availability: 'available' };
const repo = {
  getItem: (id: string) => (id === ITEM ? { id: ITEM, assetId: ASSET, title: '세포 신호: 개요', type: 'pdf', storageMode: 'managed', availability: stored.availability } : undefined),
  getAsset: (id: string) =>
    id === ASSET
      ? { id: ASSET, sha256: SHA, storageMode: 'managed', relativePath: `assets/ab/${SHA}`, externalPath: null, originalName: 'Lecture 3.pdf', mime: 'application/pdf', size: BYTES.length, availability: stored.availability, createdAt: '', checkedAt: null }
      : undefined,
  setAvailability: (_id: string, a: Availability) => void (stored.availability = a),
  itemIdsForAsset: () => [ITEM],
};
/** Follow-up D: the panel runs inside windows.asSheet(owner, …), like every dialog with a parent window. */
const sheets: string[] = [];
registerLibraryIpc(
  createHandle(null),
  stubDeps({
    getContext: () => ({ layout, repo }) as never,
    windows: {
      openSettings: () => {},
      asSheet: async (_owner, show) => {
        sheets.push('shown');
        try {
          return await show();
        } finally {
          sheets.push('closed');
        }
      },
    },
  }),
);
const invoke = (channel: string, raw?: unknown) => handlers.get(channel)!({ sender: { id: 10 }, senderFrame: { url: 'learn://app/index.html?window=main' } }, raw);
const chosen = path.join(tmp, 'chosen');

beforeEach(() => {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(assetFile), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(assetFile, BYTES);
  stored.availability = 'available';
  panel.answer = null;
  panel.calls.length = 0;
  reveals.length = 0;
  sheets.length = 0;
});

describe('사본 내보내기 (spec §7) — in order: the run remembers the last folder', () => {
  it('revealExport before anything was exported: NOT_FOUND with the next step, nothing revealed', async () => {
    expect(await invoke('library:revealExport')).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: mainStrings.exportCopy.gone });
    expect(reveals).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('asks in a save panel on the asking window: the title-named default in Downloads, the type filter, overwrite asked', async () => {
    expect(await invoke('library:exportCopy', { itemId: ITEM })).toEqual({ ok: true, data: { saved: false } });
    expect(sheets).toEqual(['shown', 'closed']);
    expect(panel.calls).toHaveLength(1);
    const { parent, options } = panel.calls[0]!;
    expect(parent).toBe(MAIN);
    expect(options).toMatchObject({
      title: '사본 내보내기',
      defaultPath: path.join(DOWNLOADS, '세포 신호 개요.pdf'),
      filters: [{ name: 'PDF', extensions: ['pdf'] }],
    });
    expect(options.properties).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['createDirectory', 'showOverwriteConfirmation']));
    expect(fs.existsSync(DOWNLOADS)).toBe(false); // cancelled: nothing written anywhere
  });

  it('saves the bytes at the chosen path with no temporary file left; the next panel opens there; revealExport shows it', async () => {
    fs.mkdirSync(chosen, { recursive: true });
    panel.answer = path.join(chosen, '내 사본.pdf');
    expect(await invoke('library:exportCopy', { itemId: ITEM })).toEqual({ ok: true, data: { saved: true } });
    expect(fs.readFileSync(panel.answer, 'utf8')).toBe(BYTES);
    expect(fs.readdirSync(chosen)).toEqual(['내 사본.pdf']);
    expect(await invoke('library:revealExport')).toEqual({ ok: true, data: undefined });
    expect(reveals).toEqual([path.join(chosen, '내 사본.pdf')]);
    panel.answer = null;
    await invoke('library:exportCopy', { itemId: ITEM });
    expect(panel.calls.at(-1)!.options.defaultPath).toBe(path.join(chosen, '세포 신호 개요.pdf'));
  });

  it('a copy the user has moved or deleted since is not revealed', async () => {
    fs.rmSync(path.join(chosen, '내 사본.pdf'));
    expect(await invoke('library:revealExport')).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: mainStrings.exportCopy.gone });
    expect(reveals).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('a file that is gone is reported before any panel opens, in the words Finder에서 보기 uses', async () => {
    fs.rmSync(assetFile);
    expect(await invoke('library:exportCopy', { itemId: ITEM })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: mainStrings.itemFile.managedMissing });
    expect(panel.calls).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.skipIf(process.getuid?.() === 0)('a folder that refuses the copy: PERMISSION_DENIED with the cause and the next step, nothing left in it', async () => {
    const ro = path.join(tmp, 'read-only');
    fs.mkdirSync(ro, { recursive: true });
    fs.chmodSync(ro, 0o555);
    try {
      panel.answer = path.join(ro, 'x.pdf');
      expect(await invoke('library:exportCopy', { itemId: ITEM })).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED', message: mainStrings.exportCopy.notWritable });
    } finally {
      fs.chmodSync(ro, 0o755);
    }
    expect(fs.readdirSync(ro)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('names a full disk and a refused folder in the user\'s words; any other error keeps its own', () => {
    const errno = (code: string) => Object.assign(new Error(code), { code });
    expect(exportError(errno('ENOSPC'))).toMatchObject({ code: 'DISK_FULL', message: mainStrings.exportCopy.diskFull });
    expect(exportError(errno('EDQUOT'))).toMatchObject({ code: 'DISK_FULL', message: mainStrings.exportCopy.diskFull });
    for (const c of ['EACCES', 'EPERM', 'EROFS']) expect(exportError(errno(c))).toMatchObject({ code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED', message: mainStrings.exportCopy.notWritable });
    const other = errno('EIO');
    expect(exportError(other)).toBe(other);
    expect(exportError(errno('ENOSPC'))).toBeInstanceOf(LearnError);
  });
});
```

```ts
  type ImportOutcome,
```

- `announceImported` 다음, `registerLibraryIpc` 앞에:
```ts
/** A copy that could not be written, in the user's words (cause + next step); any other error keeps its own (failureFrom). */
export function exportError(e: unknown): unknown {
  const code = (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException | null)?.code;
  if (code === 'EACCES' || code === 'EPERM' || code === 'EROFS') return new LearnError('PERMISSION_DENIED', mainStrings.exportCopy.notWritable, { cause: e });
  if (code === 'ENOSPC' || code === 'EDQUOT') return new LearnError('DISK_FULL', mainStrings.exportCopy.diskFull, { cause: e, retryable: true });
  return e;
}
```
- `existingFile`(주석 포함)를 다음으로 바꾸고, 그 아래 `showInFolder`·`openExternally` 처리기는 그대로 둔 채 그 뒤에 두 처리기를 더한다:
```ts
  /**
   * The item's file, re-checked first (a missing file is reported, never used): the item, its asset and where its bytes
   * are on disk. The renderer never sees a path.
   */
  async function availableAsset(itemId: string) {
    const ctx = deps.getContext();
    const item = await refreshItemAvailability(ctx, itemId);
    const copy = mainStrings.itemFile;
    if (item.availability === 'missing') throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', item.storageMode === 'managed' ? copy.managedMissing : copy.linkedMissing);
    const asset = ctx.repo.getAsset(item.assetId);
    if (!asset) throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', copy.noItem);
    return { ctx, item, asset, src: resolveAssetPath(ctx.layout, asset) };
  }

  /**
   * The file to hand the OS for an item: a name the OS can open by its extension (openableFile: the named copy under
   * derived/open/ for a managed asset, or for a linked file whose extension misleads; final review I1).
   */
  async function existingFile(itemId: string): Promise<string> {
    const { ctx, item, asset, src } = await availableAsset(itemId);
    return openableFile(ctx.layout, asset, item.title, src);
  }
```
```ts
  /** The copy 사본 내보내기 saved last in this run: its folder is where the next panel opens, and revealExport shows it. */
  let lastExport: string | null = null;

  // 사본 내보내기… (spec §7): the save panel as a sheet on the asking window, then the copy through a temporary name in the
  // chosen folder (L/openable.ts exportFile). The panel asks before replacing a file (showOverwriteConfirmation on Linux;
  // macOS and Windows always ask). The default name is the one 기본 앱으로 열기 gives its copy.
  handle(Channels.library.exportCopy, itemIdInput, async ({ itemId }, event) => {
    const { item, asset, src } = await availableAsset(itemId);
    const ext = openExtension(asset.mime, asset.originalName);
    const options: SaveDialogOptions = {
      title: commandMention(commandById('item.exportCopy'), process.platform),
      defaultPath: path.join(lastExport ? path.dirname(lastExport) : app.getPath('downloads'), openableName(asset, item.title) ?? safeBaseName(asset.originalName)),
      properties: ['createDirectory', 'showOverwriteConfirmation'],
      ...(ext ? { filters: [{ name: mainStrings.exportCopy.filterName[item.type], extensions: [ext] }] } : {}),
    };
    const win = BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender);
    const res = win ? await deps.windows.asSheet(win, () => dialog.showSaveDialog(win, options)) : await dialog.showSaveDialog(options);
    if (res.canceled || !res.filePath) return { saved: false };
    try {
      // The file itself, never a link to it (a clone of a symlink is the symlink on macOS, as for the named copy).
      await exportFile(await fs.realpath(src), res.filePath);
    } catch (e) {
      throw exportError(e);
    }
    lastExport = res.filePath;
    return { saved: true };
  });

  handle(Channels.library.revealExport, emptyInput, () => {
    if (lastExport === null || !existsSync(lastExport)) throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', mainStrings.exportCopy.gone);
    shell.showItemInFolder(lastExport);
  });
```

규칙을 순수 함수로 떼어(타이머·토스트를 주입) node 환경에서 확인한다(`busyReducer`, `startAutoClose`와 같은 관례).

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { Result } from '@learn/domain';
import { ApiError } from '../api';
import type { ToastData } from '../ui/toasts';
import { FILE_BUSY_DELAY_MS, busyToast, fileActionRunner, whenPanelCloses, type BusyToastDeps } from './fileActions';

/** Fake timers and toasts: `tick(ms)` runs what has come due, then lets promise callbacks run. */
function harness() {
  let now = 0;
  let nextId = 1;
  const timers: Array<{ at: number; fn: () => void; id: number }> = [];
  const shown: Array<{ key: string; data: ToastData }> = [];
  const closed: string[] = [];
  const deps: BusyToastDeps = {
    show: (data) => {
      const key = `t${shown.length + 1}`;
      shown.push({ key, data });
      return key;
    },
    close: (key) => void closed.push(key),
    setTimer: (fn, ms) => {
      const id = nextId++;
      timers.push({ at: now + ms, fn, id });
      return id;
    },
    clearTimer: (id) => {
      const i = timers.findIndex((t) => t.id === id);
      if (i >= 0) timers.splice(i, 1);
    },
  };
  const tick = async (ms: number) => {
    now += ms;
    for (const t of timers.filter((x) => x.at <= now)) {
      timers.splice(timers.indexOf(t), 1);
      t.fn();
    }
    await flush();
  };
  return { run: fileActionRunner(deps), shown, closed, tick };
}
const flush = () => new Promise<void>((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
/** A call main has not answered yet. */
function pending<T>() {
  let answer: (r: Result<T>) => void = () => {};
  const promise = new Promise<Result<T>>((r) => (answer = r));
  return { promise, answer: (r: Result<T>) => answer(r) };
}

describe('a slow first copy says so (P-12, design-spec 6: nothing under 300 ms)', () => {
  it('a call that answers within 300 ms shows nothing', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    const call = pending<void>();
    const done = h.run('open', '세포 신호', () => call.promise);
    await h.tick(FILE_BUSY_DELAY_MS - 1);
    call.answer({ ok: true, data: undefined });
    await done;
    await h.tick(1000);
    expect(h.shown).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('past 300 ms: 여는 중… with the item title, taken down when main answers; the data comes back', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    const call = pending<number>();
    const done = h.run('reveal', '세포 신호', () => call.promise);
    await h.tick(FILE_BUSY_DELAY_MS);
    expect(h.shown.map((s) => s.data)).toEqual([{ kind: 'busy', title: '여는 중…', lines: ['세포 신호'], testId: 'file-busy' }]);
    call.answer({ ok: true, data: 7 });
    expect(await done).toBe(7);
    expect(h.closed).toEqual(['t1']);
  });

  it('a refusal comes back as an ApiError and takes the busy toast down too', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    const call = pending<{ saved: boolean }>();
    const done = h.run('export', '세포 신호', () => call.promise);
    await h.tick(400);
    expect(h.shown[0]!.data.title).toBe('내보내는 중…');
    call.answer({ ok: false, code: 'DISK_FULL', message: '디스크 공간이 부족합니다.', retryable: true });
    await expect(done).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ApiError);
    expect(h.closed).toEqual(['t1']);
  });

  it('countFrom: the time before it (the user in the save panel) is not work and is not counted', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    const call = pending<{ saved: boolean }>();
    let panelClosed: () => void = () => {};
    const countFrom = new Promise<void>((r) => (panelClosed = r));
    const done = h.run('export', '세포 신호', () => call.promise, { countFrom });
    await h.tick(2000);
    expect(h.shown).toEqual([]);
    panelClosed();
    await flush();
    await h.tick(FILE_BUSY_DELAY_MS - 1);
    expect(h.shown).toEqual([]);
    await h.tick(1);
    expect(h.shown).toHaveLength(1);
    call.answer({ ok: true, data: { saved: true } });
    await done;
    expect(h.closed).toEqual(['t1']);
  });

  it('a call that ends while its panel is still counted as up (a cancel) never shows anything', async () => {
    const h = harness();
    const call = pending<{ saved: boolean }>();
    const done = h.run('export', '세포 신호', () => call.promise, { countFrom: new Promise<void>(() => {}) });
    call.answer({ ok: true, data: { saved: false } });
    expect(await done).toEqual({ saved: false });
    await h.tick(5000);
    expect(h.shown).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('no title known: the busy toast has its title line only', () => {
    expect(busyToast('open', '')).toEqual({ kind: 'busy', title: '여는 중…', testId: 'file-busy' });
  });
});

describe('the save panel closing, from the windowState push', () => {
  function pushes() {
    const subs = new Set<(s: { sheetOpen: boolean }) => void>();
    return {
      subscribe: (cb: (s: { sheetOpen: boolean }) => void) => {
        subs.add(cb);
        return () => void subs.delete(cb);
      },
      push: (sheetOpen: boolean) => [...subs].forEach((cb) => cb({ sheetOpen })),
      count: () => subs.size,
    };
  }

  it('resolves when the sheet that came has gone (not on a closed state before it came) and stops listening', async () => {
    const p = pushes();
    const w = whenPanelCloses(p.subscribe);
    let closed = false;
    void w.closed.then(() => (closed = true));
    p.push(false);
    await flush();
    expect(closed).toBe(false);
    p.push(true);
    await flush();
    expect(closed).toBe(false);
    p.push(false);
    await flush();
    expect(closed).toBe(true);
    expect(p.count()).toBe(0);
  });

  it('stop unsubscribes when no panel came (the item was missing, or main refused first)', () => {
    const p = pushes();
    whenPanelCloses(p.subscribe).stop();
    expect(p.count()).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { Result, WindowState } from '@learn/domain';
import { unwrap } from '../api';
import { t } from '../strings';
import type { ToastData } from '../ui/toasts';

/** The file actions whose first run can make a long copy in main (P-12, spec §8). */
export type FileActionKind = 'open' | 'reveal' | 'export';
/** design-spec 6: under 300 ms nothing shows; past it, the work says so. */
export const FILE_BUSY_DELAY_MS = 300;

export interface BusyToastDeps {
  show(data: ToastData): string;
  close(key: string): void;
  setTimer(fn: () => void, ms: number): unknown;
  clearTimer(timer: unknown): void;
}

/** "여는 중…" / "내보내는 중…", then the item's title on one line; kind busy: no close button, no time-out. */
export const busyToast = (kind: FileActionKind, title: string): ToastData => ({
  kind: 'busy',
  title: t.toast.busy[kind],
  ...(title ? { lines: [title] } : {}),
  testId: 'file-busy',
});

export type RunFileAction = <T>(kind: FileActionKind, title: string, call: () => Promise<Result<T>>, opts?: { countFrom?: Promise<void> }) => Promise<T>;

/**
 * Runs a file call and resolves with its data (an ApiError when main refused). While the call is still pending
 * FILE_BUSY_DELAY_MS after `countFrom` (default: at once), a busy toast says what is being made; it goes when the call
 * settles. `countFrom` is for a call that first waits on the user (사본 내보내기's save panel): that time is not work.
 */
export function fileActionRunner(deps: BusyToastDeps): RunFileAction {
  return async function runFileAction<T>(kind: FileActionKind, title: string, call: () => Promise<Result<T>>, opts: { countFrom?: Promise<void> } = {}): Promise<T> {
    let settled = false;
    let timer: unknown = null;
    let key: string | null = null;
    const arm = () => {
      if (settled) return;
      timer = deps.setTimer(() => {
        timer = null;
        if (!settled) key = deps.show(busyToast(kind, title));
      }, FILE_BUSY_DELAY_MS);
    };
    if (opts.countFrom) void opts.countFrom.then(arm);
    else arm();
    try {
      return await unwrap(call());
    } finally {
      settled = true;
      if (timer !== null) deps.clearTimer(timer);
      if (key !== null) deps.close(key);
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Resolves `closed` when the window's sheet goes after it came (windowState: sheetOpen true, then false) — how the
 * renderer learns that main's save panel has closed (main's windows.asSheet marks it). `stop` unsubscribes.
 */
export function whenPanelCloses(subscribe: (cb: (state: Pick<WindowState, 'sheetOpen'>) => void) => () => void): { closed: Promise<void>; stop(): void } {
  let seen = false;
  let resolve: () => void = () => {};
  const closed = new Promise<void>((r) => (resolve = r));
  const stop = subscribe((state) => {
    if (state.sheetOpen) seen = true;
    else if (seen) {
      resolve();
      stop();
    }
  });
  return { closed, stop };
}
```

`R/library/runFileAction.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { closeToast, showToast } from '../ui/toasts';
import { fileActionRunner } from './fileActions';

/** 기본 앱으로 열기, Finder에서 보기, 사본 내보내기 (P-12): this window's toasts and timers. */
export const runFileAction = fileActionRunner({
  show: showToast,
  close: closeToast,
  setTimer: (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms),
  clearTimer: (timer) => clearTimeout(timer as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>),
});
```

```tsx
/** 16 px icon in the 20 px icon column, centred on the title line (design-spec 6 토스트); a busy toast spins there. Shared with the board. */
export function ToastIcon({ kind }: { kind: ToastKind }) {
  if (kind === 'busy') {
    return (
      <span className="t-icon">
        <Spinner />
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span className={`t-icon ${TOAST_TONE[kind]}`}>
      <Icon icon={TOAST_ICON[kind]} size="md" />
    </span>
  );
}

/** The action on the title line, a small link button (mockup .t-actions); `onDone` closes the toast first. Shared with the board. */
export function ToastActionButton({ action, onDone }: { action: ToastAction; onDone?: () => void }) {
  return (
    <span className="t-actions">
      <Button
        variant="plain-accent"
        size="small"
        testId={action.testId}
        onPress={() => {
          onDone?.();
          action.onAction();
        }}
      >
        {action.label}
      </Button>
    </span>
  );
}
```

`E/helpers.ts`의 `openDialogCalls` 다음에(P-21: spec마다 있던 shell stub을 옮기고, 저장 패널·복사 붙잡기를 더한다):
```ts
/** What main handed the OS since the last stubShell, in order: Finder에서 보기 = reveal, 기본 앱으로 열기 = open. */
export type ShellCall = ['reveal' | 'open', string];

/** Record shell calls in main instead of opening Finder or another app; `openFails` makes openPath report an error. */
export async function stubShell(app: ElectronApplication, opts: { openFails?: boolean } = {}): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ shell }, openFails) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __learnShell?: Array<['reveal' | 'open', string]> };
    g.__learnShell = [];
    shell.showItemInFolder = (p: string) => void g.__learnShell!.push(['reveal', p]);
    shell.openPath = async (p: string) => {
      g.__learnShell!.push(['open', p]);
      return openFails ? 'No application knows how to open this file' : '';
    };
  }, opts.openFails === true);
}
export const shellCalls = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<ShellCall[]> => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnShell?: ShellCall[] }).__learnShell ?? []);

/** One call of the stubbed save panel: whether it hung on a window (a sheet), and what it was asked to show. */
export interface SaveDialogCall {
  parent: boolean;
  title: string | null;
  defaultPath: string | null;
  properties: string[];
  extensions: string[];
}

/**
 * Replace the native save panel in main for the rest of the session: it answers `filePath` (null: cancelled) and records
 * every call, from none (saveDialogCalls counts them, saveDialogLog says what each was asked to show).
 */
export async function stubSaveDialog(app: ElectronApplication, filePath: string | null): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(({ dialog }, answer) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __learnSaveDialogCalls?: SaveDialogCall[] };
    g.__learnSaveDialogCalls = [];
    dialog.showSaveDialog = (async (...args: unknown[]) => {
      const o = (args.length > 1 ? args[1] : args[0]) as { title?: string; defaultPath?: string; properties?: string[]; filters?: Array<{ extensions: string[] }> };
      g.__learnSaveDialogCalls!.push({
        parent: args.length > 1,
        title: o.title ?? null,
        defaultPath: o.defaultPath ?? null,
        properties: o.properties ?? [],
        extensions: (o.filters ?? []).flatMap((f) => f.extensions),
      });
      return answer === null ? { canceled: true, filePath: '' } : { canceled: false, filePath: answer };
    }) as typeof dialog.showSaveDialog;
  }, filePath);
}
/** How many times the stubbed (or held) save panel was shown since the last stubSaveDialog / holdSaveDialog, as openDialogCalls counts. */
export const saveDialogCalls = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<number> =>
  app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnSaveDialogCalls?: SaveDialogCall[] }).__learnSaveDialogCalls?.length ?? 0);
/** What each of those panels was asked to show, oldest first. */
export const saveDialogLog = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<SaveDialogCall[]> =>
  app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnSaveDialogCalls?: SaveDialogCall[] }).__learnSaveDialogCalls ?? []);

/** A save panel that stays up (the user still choosing) until releaseSaveDialog, then answers `filePath`; calls are recorded from none. */
export const holdSaveDialog = (app: ElectronApplication, filePath: string) =>
  app.evaluate(({ dialog }, answer) => {
    const g = globalThis as { __learnReleaseSave?: () => void; __learnSaveDialogCalls?: SaveDialogCall[] };
    delete g.__learnReleaseSave;
    g.__learnSaveDialogCalls = [];
    dialog.showSaveDialog = ((...args: unknown[]) => {
      const o = (args.length > 1 ? args[1] : args[0]) as { title?: string; defaultPath?: string; properties?: string[]; filters?: Array<{ extensions: string[] }> };
      g.__learnSaveDialogCalls!.push({
        parent: args.length > 1,
        title: o.title ?? null,
        defaultPath: o.defaultPath ?? null,
        properties: o.properties ?? [],
        extensions: (o.filters ?? []).flatMap((f) => f.extensions),
      });
      return new Promise((resolve) => (g.__learnReleaseSave = () => resolve({ canceled: false, filePath: answer })));
    }) as typeof dialog.showSaveDialog;
  }, filePath);
/** Answers the held save panel; waits until main has shown it (the menu click returns before the IPC arrives). */
export async function releaseSaveDialog(app: ElectronApplication): Promise<void> {
  await expect.poll(() => app.evaluate(() => typeof (globalThis as { __learnReleaseSave?: () => void }).__learnReleaseSave)).toBe('function');
  await app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnReleaseSave?: () => void }).__learnReleaseSave!());
}

/**
 * Every copy main makes from now (node:fs/promises copyFile: imports, named copies, exports) waits until releaseCopies.
 * The real copyFile is kept the first time, so holding again does not stack waits.
 */
export async function holdCopies(app: ElectronApplication): Promise<void> {
  await app.evaluate(() => {
    const fsp = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs/promises');
    const g = globalThis as { __learnRealCopyFile?: typeof fsp.copyFile; __learnReleaseCopy?: () => void };
    const real = (g.__learnRealCopyFile ??= fsp.copyFile);
    const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (g.__learnReleaseCopy = resolve));
    fsp.copyFile = (async (...args: Parameters<typeof real>) => {
      await held;
      return real(...args);
    }) as typeof real;
  });
}
export const releaseCopies = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnReleaseCopy?: () => void }).__learnReleaseCopy?.());
```
