```ts
// 사본 내보내기… (spec §7) and the busy toast of a slow first copy (spec §8, P-12). The save panel is stubbed in main
// (no native panel on CI); main's copies are held (helpers holdCopies) to make them slow.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { expect, test, type ElectronApplication } from '@playwright/test';
import {
  FIXTURES, holdCopies, holdSaveDialog, importPaths, launch, menuItemEnabled, openItem, releaseCopies, releaseSaveDialog, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, saveDialogCalls,
  saveDialogLog, shellCalls, stubContextMenu, stubSaveDialog, stubShell,
} from './helpers';

const PDF = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf');
const MPEG4 = path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample-mpeg4part2.mp4');
const REVEAL = process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'Finder에서 보기' : '폴더에서 보기';
const dirs = (i: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }) => [i.outputPath('library'), i.outputPath('userdata')] as const;
/** A folder's entries, hidden ones (a temporary .part) included. */
const names = (dir: string) => (fs.existsSync(dir) ? fs.readdirSync(dir).sort() : []);
/** A folder for the copies, made empty. */
const folder = (i: { outputPath(...p: string[]): string }, name: string) => {
  const dir = i.outputPath(name);
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  return dir;
};

test.beforeAll(() => {
  for (const f of [PDF, MPEG4]) if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`fixture missing: ${f} — run \`pnpm fixtures\``);
});

test('사본 내보내기… from the 파일 menu, the item menu and the palette: the title-named default, a whole copy, 사본을 저장했습니다 with 폴더에서 보기', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const [item] = await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    await page.evaluate((itemId) => window.learn.library.updateMetadata({ itemId, title: '세포 신호: 개요' }), item!.id);
    const row = rowByTitle(page, '세포 신호: 개요');
    await expect(row).toBeVisible();
    const out = folder(testInfo, 'exports');
    const chosen = path.join(out, '내 사본.pdf');
    await stubSaveDialog(app, chosen);
    await stubShell(app);

    // The 파일 menu runs it on the selection (P-2): one row, its file there.
    await row.click();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.exportCopy');
    const done = page.getByTestId('export-done');
    await expect(done).toContainText('사본을 저장했습니다');
    const downloads = await app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.getPath('downloads'));
    expect(await saveDialogLog(app)).toEqual([
      {
        parent: true, // a sheet on the main window
        title: '사본 내보내기',
        defaultPath: path.join(downloads, '세포 신호 개요.pdf'), // 기본 앱으로 열기's name for its copy (L/openable.ts)
        properties: expect.arrayContaining(['createDirectory', 'showOverwriteConfirmation']),
        extensions: ['pdf'],
      },
    ]);
    expect(fs.readFileSync(chosen)).toEqual(fs.readFileSync(PDF));
    expect(names(out)).toEqual(['내 사본.pdf']); // no temporary file beside it
    await expect(page.getByTestId('file-busy')).toHaveCount(0); // a quick copy says nothing

    // 폴더에서 보기 on the toast: main shows the copy it remembered (the page never sees the path); the toast goes.
    const reveal = done.getByTestId('export-reveal');
    await expect(reveal).toHaveText(REVEAL);
    await reveal.click();
    await expect.poll(() => shellCalls(app)).toEqual([['reveal', chosen]]);
    await expect(done).toHaveCount(0);

    // The item menu, next to 폴더에서 보기: the panel opens in the folder chosen last.
    await stubContextMenu(app, '사본 내보내기…');
    await row.click({ button: 'right' });
    await expect.poll(() => saveDialogCalls(app)).toBe(2);
    expect((await saveDialogLog(app))[1]!.defaultPath).toBe(path.join(out, '세포 신호 개요.pdf'));
    await expect(page.getByTestId('export-done')).toBeVisible();

    // The palette lists it for the one selected item (P-15).
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    await page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill('내보내기');
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-command-id="item.exportCopy"]')).toBeVisible();
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');

    // A cancelled panel writes nothing and says nothing.
    await stubSaveDialog(app, null);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.exportCopy');
    await expect.poll(() => saveDialogCalls(app)).toBe(1);
    await page.waitForTimeout(300);
    expect(names(out)).toEqual(['내 사본.pdf']);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('export-failed')).toHaveCount(0);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the save panel holds the window and never shows a busy toast; a copy still running 300 ms after it closed says 내보내는 중…', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const out = folder(testInfo, 'exports');
    const chosen = path.join(out, 'sample.pdf');
    await holdSaveDialog(app, chosen);
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.exportCopy');
    // The panel is a sheet: the window is held as under 다시 연결…'s panel (no second panel from the menu bar) …
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'item.exportCopy')).toBe(false);
    expect(await menuItemEnabled(app, 'file.importManaged')).toBe(false);
    // … and the time the user spends choosing is not work: no busy toast under it.
    await page.waitForTimeout(800);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('file-busy')).toHaveCount(0);

    await holdCopies(app);
    await releaseSaveDialog(app);
    const busy = page.getByTestId('file-busy');
    await expect(busy).toHaveAttribute('data-kind', 'busy');
    await expect(busy).toContainText('내보내는 중…');
    await expect(busy).toContainText('sample');
    await expect(busy.getByRole('button')).toHaveCount(0); // it goes with the work, not by a ×
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(app, 'file.importManaged')).toBe(true); // the copy holds nothing
    expect(fs.existsSync(chosen)).toBe(false);
    await releaseCopies(app);
    await expect(busy).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('export-done')).toBeVisible();
    expect(names(out)).toEqual(['sample.pdf']);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

/** Renames onto `target` wait until releaseRename: the export's last step, after its copy is whole. */
const holdRename = (app: ElectronApplication, target: string) =>
  app.evaluate((_electron, to) => {
    const fsp = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs/promises');
    const g = globalThis as { __learnReleaseRename?: () => void };
    const real = fsp.rename;
    const held = new Promise<void>((resolve) => (g.__learnReleaseRename = resolve));
    fsp.rename = (async (from: Parameters<typeof real>[0], dest: Parameters<typeof real>[1]) => {
      if (String(dest) === to) await held;
      return real(from, dest);
    }) as typeof real;
  }, target);
const releaseRename = (app: ElectronApplication) => app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __learnReleaseRename?: () => void }).__learnReleaseRename?.());

test('the chosen path never holds part of a file: a hidden temporary copy, then a rename; a copy that fails leaves nothing and says why', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [PDF]);
    const out = folder(testInfo, 'exports');
    const chosen = path.join(out, 'sample.pdf');
    await stubSaveDialog(app, chosen);
    await holdRename(app, chosen);
    await rowByTitle(page, 'sample').click();
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.exportCopy');
    // The copy is whole under its hidden temporary name beside the target; the chosen name is still free.
    await expect.poll(() => names(out)).toEqual([expect.stringMatching(/^\.sample\.pdf\.learn-export-[0-9a-f-]{36}\.part$/)]);
    expect(fs.statSync(path.join(out, names(out)[0]!)).size).toBe(fs.statSync(PDF).size);
    expect(fs.existsSync(chosen)).toBe(false);
    await releaseRename(app);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('export-done')).toBeVisible();
    expect(names(out)).toEqual(['sample.pdf']);

    // A disk that fills up during the copy: the half-written temporary file goes and the toast says why and what next.
    await app.evaluate(() => {
      const fsp = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs/promises');
      const real = fsp.copyFile;
      fsp.copyFile = (async (from: Parameters<typeof real>[0], to: Parameters<typeof real>[1], mode?: number) => {
        await real(from, to, mode);
        if (!String(to).includes('.learn-export-')) return;
        await fsp.truncate(to, 10);
        throw Object.assign(new Error('no space left on device'), { code: 'ENOSPC' });
      }) as typeof real;
    });
    const full = folder(testInfo, 'full-disk');
    await stubSaveDialog(app, path.join(full, 'sample.pdf'));
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'item.exportCopy');
    const failed = page.getByTestId('export-failed');
    await expect(failed).toContainText('사본을 저장하지 못했습니다');
    await expect(failed).toContainText('디스크 공간이 부족합니다. 공간을 확보하거나 다른 폴더를 고르세요.');
    expect(names(full)).toEqual([]);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('a first named copy past 300 ms says 여는 중… for 기본 앱으로 열기 without holding the window; the copy reused next time says nothing', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    await importPaths(page, [MPEG4]);
    await stubShell(app);
    await openItem(page, 'sample-mpeg4part2'); // unplayable: the notice has 폴더에서 보기 and 기본 앱으로 열기 (design-spec 10.7)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('codec-open')).toBeVisible();
    await holdCopies(app);
    await page.getByTestId('codec-open').click();
    const busy = page.getByTestId('file-busy');
    await expect(busy).toContainText('여는 중…');
    await expect(busy).toContainText('sample-mpeg4part2');
    expect(await menuItemEnabled(app, 'nav.back')).toBe(true); // work in main, not a sheet: the window is not held
    await releaseCopies(app);
    await expect(busy).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect.poll(() => shellCalls(app)).toEqual([['open', expect.stringMatching(/[\\/]derived[\\/]open[\\/][0-9a-f-]{36}[\\/]sample-mpeg4part2\.mp4$/)]]);
    // The named copy is there now: 폴더에서 보기 reuses it at once, so nothing says busy.
    await page.getByTestId('codec-reveal').click();
    await expect.poll(async () => (await shellCalls(app)).length).toBe(2);
    await page.waitForTimeout(400);
    await expect(busy).toHaveCount(0);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

```ts
// 사본 내보내기 (spec §7) and the busy toast (P-12), in a session of its own: the save panel is held, then the copy.
test('M4 library: 사본 내보내기… — the default name, nothing partial at the chosen path, no busy toast under the panel, 내보내는 중… after it', TAG, async ({}, testInfo) => {

  const shared = await mainWindow(s.app);
  await shared.evaluate((w) => w.hide());
  const x = await launch(path.join(dir, 'library'), path.join(dir, 'userdata'), { colorScheme: null });
  const value: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  results['export'] = value;
  try {
    await setTheme(x.page, 'light'); // the captures below are named light
    const [item] = await importPaths(x.page, [path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf')]);
    await x.page.evaluate((itemId) => window.learn.library.updateMetadata({ itemId, title: '세포 신호: 개요' }), item!.id);
    const out = path.join(dir, 'exports');
    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
    const chosen = path.join(out, '세포 신호 개요.pdf');
    await stubShell(x.app);
    await holdSaveDialog(x.app, chosen);
    await rowByTitle(x.page, '세포 신호: 개요').click();
    await runMenuCommand(x.app, 'item.exportCopy');
    await guard('export: the save panel opens as a sheet on the title-named default in Downloads', async () => {
      await expect.poll(() => saveDialogCalls(x.app)).toBe(1);
      const [call] = await saveDialogLog(x.app);
      const downloads = await x.app.evaluate(({ app }) => app.getPath('downloads'));
      const v = { name: call?.defaultPath ? path.basename(call.defaultPath) : null, inDownloads: call?.defaultPath ? path.dirname(call.defaultPath) === downloads : false, sheet: call?.parent ?? false };
      value['panel'] = v;
      check('export: the save panel opens as a sheet on the title-named default in Downloads', v.name === '세포 신호 개요.pdf' && v.inDownloads && v.sheet, v);
    });

      check('export: no busy toast while the save panel is up', shown === 0, { shown });
    });
    await holdCopies(x.app);
    const released = Date.now();
    await releaseSaveDialog(x.app);
    await guard('export: 내보내는 중… from 300 ms after the panel closed, while the copy runs', async () => {
      await expect(x.page.getByTestId('file-busy')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5_000 });
      const ms = Date.now() - released;
      value['busyShownMs'] = ms;
      check('export: 내보내는 중… from 300 ms after the panel closed, while the copy runs', ms >= 280 && ms <= 2_000, { ms });
    });
    await allShots(x.app, x.page, 'm4-08-export-busy', '사본 내보내기: 내보내는 중… while the copy runs (light)');
    await guard('export: nothing at the chosen path before the copy is whole', async () => {
      const there = fs.existsSync(chosen);
      value['partialAtChosenPath'] = there;
      check('export: nothing at the chosen path before the copy is whole', !there, { there });
    });
    await releaseCopies(x.app);
    await guard('export: 사본을 저장했습니다, and its Finder에서 보기 reveals the saved copy', async () => {
      const done = x.page.getByTestId('export-done');
      await expect(done).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10_000 });
      await allShots(x.app, x.page, 'm4-08-export-done', '사본 내보내기: 사본을 저장했습니다 with Finder에서 보기 (light)');
      const label = await done.getByTestId('export-reveal').textContent();
      await done.getByTestId('export-reveal').click();
      await expect.poll(async () => (await shellCalls(x.app)).length).toBe(1);
      const [reveal] = await shellCalls(x.app);
      const v = { left: fs.readdirSync(out), label, revealedTheCopy: reveal?.[0] === 'reveal' && reveal[1] === chosen };
      value['saved'] = v;
      check('export: 사본을 저장했습니다, and its Finder에서 보기 reveals the saved copy', v.left.length === 1 && v.left[0] === '세포 신호 개요.pdf' && v.revealedTheCopy, v);
    });
  } finally {
    save();
    await x.app.close();
    await shared.evaluate((w) => w.show()); // the shared session goes on for the tests after this one
  }
});
```
(검사 이름 5개가 `m4-library.json`의 `checks`에, 측정값이 `results.export`에 남는다. Linux에서는 `allShots`의 창·전체 화면 캡처가
`skipped`로 기록된다. `setTheme`·`check`·`guard`·`save`·`results`·`TAG`·`s`는 Task 3의 모듈 이름이다.)

### Task 9: 팔레트 자료 결과·라이브러리에서 검색·최근 실행·"검색 및 명령"

⌘K 팔레트가 자료를 찾는다(명세 4.4, 디자인 명세 10.5 "팔레트 자료 결과", 목업 `palette.html`·`?state=none`). 질의가 있으면 명령 묶음
위에 "자료" 묶음 — 빠른 검색과 같은 일치 규칙과 같은 색인(Task 5의 `R/library/search.ts` `searchIndexFor`·`search`, 같은
`useSearchTexts` 읽기)으로 최대 5개,
순위는 제목 일치(제목 앞쪽일수록 위) → 다른 필드 일치 → 마지막으로 연 시각(그다음 추가일, id로 안정). 행은 종류 아이콘, 제목(일치
강조), 오른쪽 보조 정보 "저자 · 연도"(없으면 종류), 커서 행에만 ↩ 키캡; ↩ = 열기(`item.open`, 레지스트리). 명령 묶음 끝에
"라이브러리에서 ‘<질의>’ 검색 ⌘F" 행: 팔레트를 닫고, 리더면 라이브러리로 돌아간 뒤(`nav.back`), 빠른 검색에 질의를 넣고 그 필드에
포커스를 둔다(Task 5의 `setQuery`·`focusQuickSearch` — ⌘F처럼 값이 선택된다; Q-12: 자료가 있는 라이브러리에서만). 결과가 없어도 그
행은 남고 위에 "‘<질의>’와 일치하는 자료·명령이 없습니다"(와/과는 Task 5의 `waGwa`, Q-26). 최근 실행: 팔레트에서 고른 명령을 라이브러리
설정 키 `palette.recent`(명령 id 최대 20개, `COMMAND_IDS` enum)에 남기고(Q-14), 빈 질의에서는 최근 5개를 위에, 질의가 있으면 같은 점수 안에서 최근 것을 앞에 둔다. 실행기·입력 문구는
"검색 및 명령"으로 돌아가고, 키 힌트 줄의 초성 예는 라이브러리 제목에서 고른다("ㅅㅎ → 신호"; 없으면 "ㅅㅈ → 설정"). 발 줄의 ↩ 이름은
커서 행을 따른다(Q-13). 팔레트의 `item` 명령은 Task 4의 규칙 그대로 표의 선택(라이브러리 보기에서 `env.selection()`)으로
판정·실행한다. 테스트 id는 P-20: 자료 행 `palette-result`(`data-item-id`), 검색 행 `palette-search-library`, 명령 행은
그대로 `palette-item`.
범위 밖: 컬렉션 결과(M5), ⌘↩ 새 탭에서 열기(M7, 발 줄에도 없다), 목업의 "분자생물학 · 42쪽" 보조 정보(명세 4.4가 "저자 · 연도"로
정했다), 데모 장 구성(Task 13 — 이 작업은 10장의 기대값이 그대로 맞는지만 지킨다), 데모 오버레이의 ↩ 알약 문구(`demoPill`은 "실행"
그대로). 알려진 한계: "마지막으로 연 시각"은 목록의 `openedAt`이다 — `reader.open`은 알림을 보내지 않으므로(M3 인계 M-3, M7) 이번

`rank.ts` 전체:
```ts
import { commandLabel, type CommandContextState, type CommandId, type CommandSpec } from '@learn/domain';
import { MATCH_RANK, matchKorean, type Match } from './hangul';

export interface RankedCommand {
  command: CommandSpec;
  /** Where the query matched the label (for <mark>); null for keyword-only matches and the empty query. */
  match: Match | null;
}

/** Spec §4.4: with an empty query, the five commands run most recently from the palette head the list. */
export const RECENT_SHOWN = 5;

/**
 * Label matches by kind then position, then keyword-only matches; a tie goes to the command run more recently from the
 * palette (`recent`, newest first), then registry order. An empty query lists the RECENT_SHOWN most recent of
 * `commands` first, then the rest in registry order. The label is the one the palette shows: the state label for the
 * reported state (사이드바 가리기 / 사이드바 보기), as the menu and tooltip.
 */
export function rankCommands(
  commands: readonly CommandSpec[],
  query: string,
  platform: string,
  state: Pick<CommandContextState, 'sidebar' | 'inspector'> = {},
  recent: readonly CommandId[] = [],
): RankedCommand[] {
  if (query.trim() === '') {
    const top = recent.flatMap((id) => commands.filter((c) => c.id === id)).slice(0, RECENT_SHOWN);
    return [...top, ...commands.filter((c) => !top.includes(c))].map((command) => ({ command, match: null }));
  }
  const recency = (id: CommandId) => {
    const i = recent.indexOf(id);
    return i < 0 ? recent.length : i;
  };
  return commands
    .flatMap((command, index): Array<RankedCommand & { score: number; index: number }> => {
      const onLabel = matchKorean(query, commandLabel(command, platform, state));
      if (onLabel) return [{ command, match: onLabel, score: MATCH_RANK[onLabel.kind] * 100 + onLabel.start, index }];
      const kinds = (command.keywords ?? []).flatMap((k) => {
        const m = matchKorean(query, k);
        return m ? [MATCH_RANK[m.kind]] : [];
      });
      return kinds.length ? [{ command, match: null, score: 1000 + Math.min(...kinds), index }] : [];
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score || recency(a.command.id) - recency(b.command.id) || a.index - b.index)
    .map(({ command, match }) => ({ command, match }));
}
```

```ts
describe('palette.recent (spec §4.4)', () => {
```

```ts
import type { LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import type { SearchResult } from '../library/search';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { initialOf, type Match } from './hangul';

/** Spec §4.4: the 자료 group lists five at most. */
export const ITEM_RESULTS_MAX = 5;

export interface RankedItem {
  item: LibraryItem;
  /** Where the query matched the title (for <mark>); null when only another field matched. */
  match: Match | null;
}

const openedAt = (i: LibraryItem): number => (i.openedAt === null ? -Infinity : Date.parse(i.openedAt));
/** -1 when `a` comes first (the larger value), 1 when `b` does, 0 when equal. */
const larger = (a: number | string, b: number | string): number => (a === b ? 0 : a > b ? -1 : 1);

/**
 * The 자료 group: the quick search's matches (search.ts, the same rules), title matches first — the earlier in the title
 * the higher — then matches in other fields; a tie goes to the last opened, then the newest added, then the id (stable).
 */
export function rankItems(items: readonly LibraryItem[], result: SearchResult, max = ITEM_RESULTS_MAX): RankedItem[] {
  return items
    .filter((item) => result.ids.has(item.id))
    .map((item) => ({ item, match: result.titleMatches.get(item.id) ?? null }))
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        Number(a.match === null) - Number(b.match === null) ||
        (a.match && b.match ? a.match.start - b.match.start : 0) ||
        larger(openedAt(a.item), openedAt(b.item)) ||
        larger(a.item.createdAt, b.item.createdAt) ||
        -larger(a.item.id, b.item.id),
    )
    .slice(0, max);
}

/** Right of the title (spec §4.4): 저자 · 연도, whichever there are; the kind when there is neither. */
export function itemMeta(item: Pick<LibraryItem, 'creators' | 'year' | 'type'>): string {
  const parts = [item.creators.join(', '), item.year === null ? '' : String(item.year)].filter((p) => p !== '');
  return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(' · ') : t.library.type[item.type];
}

const HANGUL_WORD = /^[가-힣]{2,4}$/;

/**
 * The 초성 example of the key hints (spec §4.4, palette.html "ㅅㅎ → 신호"): from the first title, in list order (newest
 * first), that has a word of two to four Hangul syllables. null: none has one (the hint then says ㅅㅈ → 설정).
 */
export function initialsExample(items: Iterable<Pick<LibraryItem, 'title'>>): { initials: string; word: string } | null {
  for (const { title } of items) {
    for (const word of title.normalize('NFC').split(/[^가-힣]+/)) {
      if (HANGUL_WORD.test(word)) return { initials: [...word].map(initialOf).join(''), word };
    }
  }
  return null;
}
```
(색인은 따로 두지 않는다: 팔레트는 Task 5의 `searchIndexFor(items, texts)`를 부른다 — 도구 막대의 빠른 검색이 이미 만든(창이 한가할 때 미리
만든) 그 목록 배열의 색인을 그대로 쓴다.)

`R/palette/recent.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { COMMAND_IDS, type CommandId } from '@learn/domain';
import { ApiError, api, unwrap } from '../api';
import { queryClient } from '../data/query-client';

/** The library setting (ADR-0007 (b)) and its cache entry. */
export const RECENT_KEY = ['settings', 'palette.recent'] as const;
/** As many as palette.recent keeps (domain settings.ts). */
export const RECENT_MAX = 20;
const KNOWN: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(COMMAND_IDS);
const NONE: readonly CommandId[] = [];

/** Known command ids only, once each, at most RECENT_MAX; anything else reads as no history. */
export function parseRecent(raw: unknown): CommandId[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  const out: CommandId[] = [];
  for (const v of raw) if (typeof v === 'string' && KNOWN.has(v) && !out.includes(v as CommandId)) out.push(v as CommandId);
  return out.slice(0, RECENT_MAX);
}

/** `id` first, once; the RECENT_MAX newest kept. */
export const withRecent = (recent: readonly CommandId[], id: CommandId): CommandId[] => [id, ...recent.filter((x) => x !== id)].slice(0, RECENT_MAX);

/** A command run from the palette goes to the head of the history at once (the cache), then to the library (logged by code only when that fails). */
export function rememberRecent(id: CommandId): void {
  const next = withRecent(queryClient.getQueryData<CommandId[]>(RECENT_KEY) ?? NONE, id);
  queryClient.setQueryData(RECENT_KEY, next);
  void unwrap(api().settings.set({ key: 'palette.recent', value: next })).catch((e: unknown) => {
    console.warn(`[palette] saving palette.recent failed: ${e instanceof ApiError ? e.code : 'INTERNAL'}`);
  });
}

/** The palette's history; read once, at start-up (an unreadable one is none). */
export function usePaletteRecent(): { ids: readonly CommandId[]; remember(id: CommandId): void } {
  const q = useQuery({ queryKey: RECENT_KEY, queryFn: async () => parseRecent(await unwrap(api().settings.get({ key: 'palette.recent' }))) });
  return { ids: q.data ?? NONE, remember: rememberRecent };
}
```

`R/palette/searchRow.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import type { CommandContextState, CommandId } from '@learn/domain';
import { focusQuickSearch } from '../library/LibrarySearch';
import { useLibrary } from '../state/library-store';

/**
 * 라이브러리에서 ‘…’ 검색 (spec §4.4): back to the library when the reader shows (nav.back, through the registry), the
 * query into the quick search — the table filters as if it had been typed there — and the focus in its field with the
 * query selected, as ⌘F leaves it (Task 5's focusQuickSearch). Synchronous, so the field is mounted (the library view's
 * toolbar) before it takes the focus.
 */
export function searchLibrary(query: string, run: (id: CommandId) => boolean, view: CommandContextState['view']): void {
  flushSync(() => {
    if (view === 'viewer') run('nav.back');
    useLibrary.getState().setQuery(query);
  });
  focusQuickSearch();
}
```

```ts
import { waGwa } from './josa';

/** ⌘K palette: 자료 (with a query) above 명령 (design-spec 10.5, palette.html, spec §4.4). */
export const palette = {
  dialogLabel: '명령 팔레트',
  /** It finds items and commands (M4); the launcher says the same (shell.launcher). */
  inputLabel: '검색 및 명령',
  placeholder: '검색 및 명령',
  /** The listbox; its groups are named by their headers. */
  listLabel: '검색 결과',
  groups: { items: '자료', commands: '명령' },
  /** 와/과 by the query's last syllable, as the quick search's no-results title (josa.ts, K-7 / Q-26). */
  emptyTitle: (query: string) => `‘${query}’${waGwa(query)} 일치하는 자료·명령이 없습니다`,
  /** `example`: 초성 → word from the library's titles, or ㅅㅈ → 설정 (palette/items.ts initialsExample). */
  emptyBody: (example: string) => `초성으로도 찾을 수 있습니다. 예: ${example}`,
  example: (initials: string, word: string) => `${initials} → ${word}`,
  /** The last row of 명령 while there is a query: the quick search takes the query over (⌘F). */
  searchLibrary: (query: string) => `라이브러리에서 ‘${query}’ 검색`,
  /** While an import or a sheet holds the window (critic T9-n5): what is unavailable, then why and what next. */
  busyTitle: '지금은 명령을 실행할 수 없습니다',
  busyBody: '진행 중인 작업이 있습니다. 작업이 끝나면 다시 쓸 수 있습니다.',
  /**
   * The same hold while a command that still runs (설정…) is listed under it: the header says why the rest is missing
   * and when it comes back, not that nothing runs.
   */
  busyHeaderTitle: '진행 중인 작업이 있습니다',
  busyHeaderBody: '작업이 끝나면 다른 명령도 쓸 수 있습니다.',
  /** Read out (polite) with that header: the hold, then how many commands are listed. */
  busyStatus: (n: number) => `진행 중인 작업이 있습니다. 실행할 수 있는 명령 ${n}개`,
  /** Read out (polite) when the results change. */
  resultCount: (items: number, commands: number) => (items > 0 ? `자료 ${items}개, 명령 ${commands}개` : `명령 ${commands}개`),
  footMove: '이동',
  /** ↩ on a command row (and the demo overlay's pill). */
  footRun: '실행',
  /** ↩ on an item row. */
  footOpen: '열기',
  footClose: '닫기',
  footHint: (example: string) => `초성 검색 지원 · ${example}`,
} as const;
```

Task 2의 `state` 줄(`{ sidebar: env.sidebar, inspector: env.inspector }` — Task 6의 `env.inspector`가 여기로 온다)과 Task 4 Step 8의 자료 명령
대상(P-15: `itemTarget`, `itemCommands`, `targetOf(id)`, `run(id, targetOf(id))`)을 그 모양 그대로 담는다. 그 밖의 변경이 있으면 같은 자리에
옮기고 커밋 본문에 적는다. `openPalette`·`closePalette`·`stopWhileComposing`은 지금 그대로다. 파일 전체:

```tsx
import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { Clapperboard, FileText, ListFilter, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { Dialog, Modal, ModalOverlay } from 'react-aria-components';
import { COMMANDS, commandById, commandLabel, commandMention, inPalette, type CommandId, type LibraryItem } from '@learn/domain';
import { useCommands } from '../commands/CommandProvider';
import { COMMAND_ICONS } from '../commands/icons';
import { useItems, useSearchTexts } from '../data/queries';
import { search, searchIndexFor } from '../library/search';
import { useShell } from '../state/shell-store';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { Icon } from '../ui/Icon';
import { Kbd } from '../ui/Kbd';
import { currentPlatform } from '../ui/platform';
import { setTooltipBlock } from '../ui/tooltipGate';
import { highlight } from './highlight';
import { initialsExample, itemMeta, rankItems, type RankedItem } from './items';
import { rankCommands, type RankedCommand } from './rank';
import { usePaletteRecent } from './recent';
import { searchLibrary } from './searchRow';

const NO_ITEMS: readonly LibraryItem[] = [];

/** ⌘K (`app.palette`): opens the palette (remembering what had the focus), or selects its field when it is already open. */
export function openPalette(): void {
  const shell = useShell.getState();
  if (shell.paletteOpen) {
    const input = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-testid="palette-input"]');
    input?.focus();
    input?.select();
    return;
  }
  shell.setPaletteOpen(true, document.activeElement);
}

/**
 * Closes the palette, gives the focus back to its opener at once, then runs `then` (a command picked in the palette,
 * or from the menu bar while it is open). The command thus acts from where the user was, as if the palette had never
 * been up: when it hides the opener (사이드바 가리기 from the sidebar launcher), the sidebar's own focus rescue sees
 * that and moves the focus on (useSidebar keepFocusAcross) — it never falls to <body> with the unmounted opener.
 * RAC's FocusScope would restore the opener only a frame after the palette unmounts, i.e. after the command.
 */
export function closePalette(then?: () => void): void {
  const opener = useShell.getState().paletteOpener;
  // Synchronously: the overlay is gone, so its focus containment no longer pulls the focus back. Closing forgets the
  // opener in the store.
  flushSync(() => useShell.getState().setPaletteOpen(false));
  const active = document.activeElement;
  if ((active === null || active === document.body) && opener instanceof HTMLElement && opener.isConnected) opener.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  then?.();
}

/**
 * A key that belongs to a Korean composition (isComposing, or keyCode 229) must not act: the cursor does not move, no
 * command runs and the palette does not close (ADR-0005 §3). Stopped in the capture phase, so neither the field's own
 * keys nor RAC's esc on the modal see it — including the keyCode 229 keys macOS IMEs send without isComposing (the
 * confirming ↩).
 */
export function stopWhileComposing(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) e.stopPropagation();
}

/** ⌘K palette (palette.html, design-spec 10.5): items and the commands that can run now, 초성 search, ↩ runs once. */
export function Palette() {
  const open = useShell((s) => s.paletteOpen);
  // Read with the window, not on the first ⌘K: the recent commands are in place the first time the palette opens.
  const recent = usePaletteRecent();
  // Opening closes any tooltip and none opens while the palette is up (ui/tooltipGate.ts).
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    setTooltipBlock('modal', true);
    return () => setTooltipBlock('modal', false);
  }, [open]);
  // Mounted only while open, so it leaves at once when closed (there is no exit animation): a ⌘K right after ↩ gets a
  // fresh palette with an empty query and the focus in its field, not the old one cancelling its exit.
  if (!open) return null;
  return (
    // esc and a click on the scrim (RAC) close it like a picked command, minus the command.
    <ModalOverlay className="palette-scrim" isOpen onOpenChange={(next) => !next && closePalette()} isDismissable>
      <Modal className="palette-modal">
        <PaletteDialog recent={recent.ids} remember={recent.remember} />
      </Modal>
    </ModalOverlay>
  );
}

/** A row under the one cursor: an item (↩ opens it), a command (↩ runs it), or the hand-off to the quick search. */
type Row =
  | { kind: 'item'; key: string; ranked: RankedItem }
  | { kind: 'command'; key: string; ranked: RankedCommand }
  | { kind: 'search'; key: 'search' };

/**
 * The dialog itself, mounted with each opening (the query starts empty). The field is an ARIA combobox over a listbox
 * with one cursor row, kept here (the Raycast / VS Code model): whenever the list has rows the cursor is on one — the
 * first after opening and after every edit (typing, Backspace, paste, undo), the one ↑ ↓ or the pointer moved it to
 * otherwise, as long as that row is listed. ↩ runs it. (RAC's Autocomplete cleared its cursor on delete, paste and undo
 * and set none on open, so ↩ did nothing under a footer that says 실행 — critic T9-M1.)
 */
function PaletteDialog({ recent, remember }: { recent: readonly CommandId[]; remember(id: CommandId): void }) {
  const { env, run, isEnabled } = useCommands();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  /** The row the user moved the cursor to; null puts it on the first row. */
  const [cursorKey, setCursorKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const ids = useId();
  const platform = currentPlatform();
  const q = query.trim();
  /** 설정 as the hints name it: ㅅㅈ → 설정 (critic T14-n2), when no title gives an example. */
  const settingsName = commandMention(commandById('app.settings'), platform);
  // The pane states the toggles' names follow (사이드바 가리기 / 사이드바 보기), as the menu bar has them (Task 2).
  const state = { sidebar: env.sidebar, inspector: env.inspector };
  // Item commands (Finder에서 보기, 기본 앱으로 열기, 사본 내보내기… and 정보 편집) are judged and run on the table
  // selection, which only the library view shows (Task 4, P-15). Judged once per env rather than on every keystroke: a
  // selection can hold every row (⌘A).
  const itemTarget = useMemo(() => ({ itemIds: env.view === 'library' ? env.selection() : [] }), [env]);
  const itemCommands = useMemo(
    () => new Set(COMMANDS.filter((c) => c.contexts.includes('item') && inPalette(c) && isEnabled(c.id, itemTarget)).map((c) => c.id)),
    [isEnabled, itemTarget],
  );
  const targetOf = (id: CommandId) => (commandById(id).contexts.includes('item') ? itemTarget : {});
  // Only what can run now (no fake commands), exactly as the registry says, re-read on every render: the list follows
  // availability while open. While an import or a sheet holds the window that is the main-owned 설정… alone, under the
  // notice that says why the rest is missing (review minor 1).
  const commands = rankCommands(
    COMMANDS.filter((c) => inPalette(c) && (c.contexts.includes('item') ? itemCommands.has(c.id) : isEnabled(c.id))),
    query,
    platform,
    state,
    recent,
  );

  const list = useItems().data ?? NO_ITEMS;
  // The quick search's long fields (P-7), read once a query is typed: the same query as the toolbar's (keys.searchTexts).
  const texts = useSearchTexts(q !== '').data;
  // The toolbar's own index of this list (Task 5 searchIndexFor: one per list array and long-field read). search, not
  // searchCached: that keeps one answer per index, the toolbar's, which the palette's query must not push out.
  const found = useMemo(() => {
    if (q === '') return [];
    const result = search(searchIndexFor(list, texts), q);
    return result ? rankItems(list, result) : [];
  }, [q, list, texts]);
  // An item row runs 열기 on that item: listed only while it can run (never while the window is held).
  const items = found.filter((r) => isEnabled('item.open', { itemIds: [r.item.id] }));
  // 라이브러리에서 ‘…’ 검색: only where the quick search is (a library with items) and nothing holds the window.
  const searchRow = q !== '' && !env.blocked && env.libraryCount > 0;
  const rows: Row[] = [
    ...items.map((ranked): Row => ({ kind: 'item', key: `item:${ranked.item.id}`, ranked })),
    ...commands.map((ranked): Row => ({ kind: 'command', key: `command:${ranked.command.id}`, ranked })),
    ...(searchRow ? [{ kind: 'search', key: 'search' } as const] : []),
  ];
  /** Nothing matched (the search row may still be there: palette.html ?state=none). */
  const none = items.length === 0 && commands.length === 0;
  const cursor = rows.length === 0 ? -1 : Math.max(0, rows.findIndex((r) => r.key === cursorKey));
  const listId = `${ids}-list`;
  const optionId = (index: number) => `${ids}-option-${index}`;
  /** The 초성 example of the hints: a word from the library's titles (spec §4.4), else ㅅㅈ → 설정. */
  const example = useMemo(() => {
    const e = initialsExample(list);
    return e ? t.palette.example(e.initials, e.word) : t.palette.example('ㅅㅈ', settingsName);
  }, [list, settingsName]);

  // Read out politely when the result changes (the counts, or the notice that replaces the list); a cursor move or an
  // edit that leaves the same counts changes nothing here, so nothing is re-announced.
  const status = env.blocked
    ? commands.length > 0
      ? t.palette.busyStatus(commands.length)
      : t.palette.busyTitle
    : none
      ? t.palette.emptyTitle(q)
      : t.palette.resultCount(items.length, commands.length + (searchRow ? 1 : 0));
  // An import or a sheet holds the window (not "no match"). Alone when nothing is listed: nothing can run until it ends.
  // Above the commands that still run (설정…): a header — not an option, never under the cursor — that says the others
  // come back when the work ends. Defensive: nothing holds the window under an open palette in the app's own flows
  // (⌘K and the launcher are refused while it is held, every command closes the palette before it runs, a file drag
  // closes it before its drop starts an import).
  const busy = env.blocked && (
    <div className="p-empty" data-testid="palette-busy">
      <div className="pe-title">{commands.length > 0 ? t.palette.busyHeaderTitle : t.palette.busyTitle}</div>
      <div className="pe-text">{commands.length > 0 ? t.palette.busyHeaderBody : t.palette.busyBody}</div>
    </div>
  );
  const empty = !env.blocked && none && (
    <div className="p-empty" data-testid="palette-empty">
      <div className="pe-title">{t.palette.emptyTitle(q)}</div>
      <div className="pe-text">{t.palette.emptyBody(example)}</div>
    </div>
  );
  const cursorElementId = cursor >= 0 ? optionId(cursor) : null;
  // Keep the cursor row in view when ↑ ↓ move it past the list's edge.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (cursorElementId) document.getElementById(cursorElementId)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }, [cursorElementId]);

  const execute = (row: Row) => {
    if (row.kind === 'item') closePalette(() => run('item.open', { itemIds: [row.ranked.item.id] }));
    else if (row.kind === 'search') closePalette(() => searchLibrary(q, run, env.view));
    else {
      const { command } = row.ranked;
      closePalette(() => {
        // Q-14: palette.recent keeps what was picked here and ran.
        if (run(command.id, targetOf(command.id))) remember(command.id);
      });
    }
  };
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault(); // not the caret's start/end
      if (cursor < 0) return;
      const next = Math.min(rows.length - 1, Math.max(0, cursor + (e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : -1)));
      setCursorKey(rows[next]!.key);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && !(e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || e.shiftKey) && cursor >= 0) {
      e.preventDefault(); // no keypress for the opener, which has the focus again by then
      execute(rows[cursor]!);
    }
  };

  /** One option: the cursor follows the pointer (only when it moves), the field keeps the focus, a click runs the row. */
  const option = (row: Row, index: number, testIds: Record<string, string>, children: ReactNode) => (
    <div
      key={row.key}
      id={optionId(index)}
      role="option"
      aria-selected={index === cursor}
      className="p-item"
      data-focused={index === cursor ? 'true' : undefined}
      {...testIds}
      onPointerMove={() => index !== cursor && setCursorKey(row.key)}
      onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      onClick={() => execute(row)}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
  const renderRow = (row: Row, index: number) => {
    if (row.kind === 'item') {
      const { item, match } = row.ranked;
      return option(row, index, { 'data-testid': 'palette-result', 'data-item-id': item.id }, (
        <>
          <Icon icon={item.type === 'video' ? Clapperboard : FileText} />
          <span className="p-title ellipsis">{highlight(item.title, match)}</span>
          <span className="p-meta">
            <span className="p-sub ellipsis">{itemMeta(item)}</span>
            {/* palette.html: ↩ on the row under the cursor only. */}
            {index === cursor && <Kbd accelerator="Enter" />}
          </span>
        </>
      ));
    }
    if (row.kind === 'search') {
      return option(row, index, { 'data-testid': 'palette-search-library' }, (
        <>
          <Icon icon={ListFilter} />
          <span className="p-title ellipsis">{t.palette.searchLibrary(q)}</span>
          <span className="p-meta">
            <Kbd accelerator={commandById('library.find').accelerator} />
          </span>
        </>
      ));
    }
    const { command, match } = row.ranked;
    return option(row, index, { 'data-testid': 'palette-item', 'data-command-id': command.id }, (
      <>
        <Icon icon={COMMAND_ICONS[command.id]} />
        <span className="p-title ellipsis">{highlight(commandLabel(command, platform, state), match)}</span>
        {command.accelerator && (
          <span className="p-meta">
            <Kbd accelerator={command.accelerator} />
          </span>
        )}
      </>
    ));
  };

  return (
    <Dialog className="palette" aria-label={t.palette.dialogLabel} data-testid="palette">
      <div className="p-body" onKeyDownCapture={stopWhileComposing}>
        <div className="p-input">
          <Icon icon={Search} />
          <input
            className="p-field"
            role="combobox"
            aria-label={t.palette.inputLabel}
            aria-autocomplete="list"
            aria-expanded={rows.length > 0}
            aria-controls={rows.length > 0 ? listId : undefined}
            aria-activedescendant={cursor >= 0 ? optionId(cursor) : undefined}
            placeholder={t.palette.placeholder}
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setQuery(e.target.value);
              setCursorKey(null); // every edit puts the cursor back on the first row
            }}
            onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
            autoFocus
            autoComplete="off"
            autoCorrect="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            enterKeyHint="go"
            data-testid="palette-input"
          />
          {/* palette.html p-scope: the esc keycap at the end of the input row (C-7). */}
          <span className="p-scope" data-testid="palette-esc">
            <Kbd accelerator="Escape" />
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="p-list">
          {rows.length > 0 && (busy || empty)}
          {rows.length > 0 ? (
            <div role="listbox" id={listId} aria-label={t.palette.listLabel}>
              {/* A listbox holds options and groups only: a heading names its group and is no element of its own (role
                  presentation, as RAC's ListBoxSection draws it; axe aria-required-children). */}
              {items.length > 0 && (
                <section role="group" aria-labelledby={`${ids}-items`}>
                  <header className="p-group" id={`${ids}-items`} role="presentation">
                    {t.palette.groups.items}
                  </header>
                  {rows.slice(0, items.length).map((row, i) => renderRow(row, i))}
                </section>
              )}
              {rows.length > items.length && (
                <section role="group" aria-labelledby={`${ids}-commands`}>
                  <header className="p-group" id={`${ids}-commands`} role="presentation">
                    {t.palette.groups.commands}
                  </header>
                  {rows.slice(items.length).map((row, i) => renderRow(row, items.length + i))}
                </section>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            busy || empty
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div role="status" className="visually-hidden" data-testid="palette-status">
        {status}
      </div>
      {/* Key hints for what the keys do now: ↩ names what the cursor row does; with no match (only the search row, or
          nothing) there is nothing to move to (palette.html ?state=none). */}
      <div className="p-foot">
        {rows.length > 0 && !none && (
          <span className="row">
            <Kbd keys={['↑', '↓']} alternatives />
            {t.palette.footMove}
          </span>
        )}
        {cursor >= 0 && (
          <span className="row">
            <Kbd accelerator="Enter" />
            {rows[cursor]!.kind === 'item' ? t.palette.footOpen : t.palette.footRun}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="row">
          <Kbd accelerator="Escape" />
          {t.palette.footClose}
        </span>
        {rows.length > 0 && !none && (
          <>
            <span className="spacer" />
            <span className="row">{t.palette.footHint(example)}</span>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

`R/styles/screens/palette.css`의 `.palette .p-item mark` 규칙 앞에:
```css
  /* An item row's 저자 · 연도 gives way (ellipsis) before the title does. */
  .palette .p-item .p-sub {
    min-width: 0;
    max-width: 240px; /* local: the title keeps at least half of the 624 px row */
  }
```
`.palette .p-empty .pe-text` 규칙 다음에:
```css
  /* palette.html ?state=none: the notice above the 명령 group with its search row, 24 from the notice to the group header. */
  .palette .p-list > .p-empty + [role='listbox'] {
    margin-top: var(--space-8);
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 8: E2E — 기존 팔레트 테스트 갱신과 새 테스트**

`E/palette.spec.ts` 기존 테스트(모두 빈 라이브러리에서 돈다: 자료 행도 검색 행도 없다 — Q-12):
- `the launcher opens the palette; …`: 주석 `// M3 finds commands only, …`를 `// It finds items and commands (M4), and the launcher says so, like the palette's own field (design-spec 10.5).`로,
  `'명령 검색'` 세 곳(`toContainText`, `toHaveAccessibleName`, `placeholder`)을 `'검색 및 명령'`으로. 나머지는 그대로다(빈 라이브러리에서
  `library.find`·`view.toggleInspector`는 `libraryCount > 0`이 아니라 꺼져 있고, `item` 명령은 선택이 없어 꺼져 있다 — 일곱 줄이 같다).
- `ARIA: …`: `page.getByRole('listbox', { name: '명령' })` 두 곳을 `{ name: '검색 결과' }`로, `ids.length` 확인 다음에
  `await expect(listbox.getByRole('group')).toHaveText([/^명령/]); // one group with an empty query, named by its header`를 더하고,
  `'‘효소 억제제’에 맞는 명령이 없습니다'`를 `'‘효소 억제제’와 일치하는 자료·명령이 없습니다'`로.
- `keywords, no results, esc, …`: 같은 문구 교체, 그리고 `await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-item')).toHaveCount(0);` 다음에
  `await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-search-library')).toHaveCount(0); // an empty library has no quick search to hand the query to`.
- `the cursor is on a row …`(최근 기록이 생겨도 기대가 그대로인 까닭을 주석으로): 첫 `await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');` 위에
  `// Runs picked here go to palette.recent; every expectation below already starts with the one run first (파일 가져오기…).`

파일 끝에 새 테스트 셋:
```ts
test('item results: 자료 above the commands, five at most; title matches by position, then other fields, then the last opened; ↩ opens one', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const dir = testInfo.outputPath('src');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const real = path.join(dir, '신호 증폭.pdf'); // the one opened at the end: a real PDF
    fs.copyFileSync(PDF, real);
    const fake = (title: string) => {
      const p = path.join(dir, `${title}.pdf`);
      fs.writeFileSync(p, `%PDF-1.4\n% ${title}\n%%EOF\n`);
      return p;
    };
    // One import each, a few ms apart: the order they were added breaks the last tie (createdAt).
    const ids: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const p of [fake('세포 신호 전달'), real, fake('단백질 접힘'), fake('전달 신호 모음'), fake('강의 · 신호'), fake('효소 반응'), fake('열역학')]) {
      const [item] = await importPaths(page, [p]);
      ids[item!.title] = item!.id;
      await page.waitForTimeout(5);
    }
    // Opened (openedAt) before the metadata writes: their libraryChanged brings the list with it (reader.open sends none).
    await page.evaluate((itemId) => window.learn.reader.open({ itemId }), ids['전달 신호 모음']!);
    await page.evaluate(async (i) => {
      await window.learn.library.updateMetadata({ itemId: i.a, metadata: { creators: [{ name: '김하늘', role: 'author' }], date: '2024-03' } });
      await window.learn.library.updateMetadata({ itemId: i.b, metadata: { creators: [], publisher: '신호 출판' } });
      await window.learn.library.updateMetadata({ itemId: i.c, metadata: { creators: [], extra: '신호 경로를 그린 메모' } });
    }, { a: ids['신호 증폭']!, b: ids['단백질 접힘']!, c: ids['효소 반응']! });
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    await page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill('신호');
    const results = page.getByTestId('palette-result');
    // Title matches by position (0, 3, 3, 5; the tie at 3 to the one opened), then other fields: the memo (long field,
    // read once the query is there) on the newer item before the publisher; the sixth match is left out.
    await expect
      .poll(() => results.evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-item-id'))))
      .toEqual([ids['신호 증폭'], ids['전달 신호 모음'], ids['세포 신호 전달'], ids['강의 · 신호'], ids['효소 반응']]);
    await expect(page.locator('.palette .p-group')).toHaveText(['자료', '명령']);
    await expect(results.first()).toHaveAttribute('data-focused', 'true');
    await expect(results.first().locator('mark')).toHaveText('신호');
    await expect(results.first().locator('.p-sub')).toHaveText('김하늘 · 2024');
    await expect(results.nth(3).locator('.p-sub')).toHaveText('PDF'); // no author, no year: the kind
    await expect(results.nth(4).locator('mark')).toHaveCount(0); // matched outside the title
    await expect(results.first().locator('.p-meta .kbd-group')).toHaveCount(1); // ↩ on the cursor row only
    await expect(results.nth(1).locator('.p-meta .kbd-group')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-search-library')).toHaveText(/라이브러리에서 ‘신호’ 검색/);
    await expect(page.locator('.p-foot .row').nth(1)).toHaveText(/열기/); // ↩ opens the item under the cursor
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-status')).toHaveText('자료 5개, 명령 1개');
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    await expect(results.nth(1)).toHaveAttribute('data-focused', 'true');
    await page.keyboard.press('ArrowUp');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');

    await expect(page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toHaveText('신호 증폭');

});

test('recent: commands run from the palette come first with an empty query (five at most), win ties, and survive a restart', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  let session = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  const cursor = (page: Page) => page.locator('[data-testid="palette-item"][data-focused]');
  const listed = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('palette-item').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => e.getAttribute('data-command-id')));
  /** Runs `id` from the palette by typing `query`; its row must be the cursor row. */
  const pick = async (s: { app: ElectronApplication; page: Page }, query: string, id: string) => {
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.palette');
    await s.page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill(query);
    await expect(cursor(s.page)).toHaveAttribute('data-command-id', id);
    await s.page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(s.page.getByTestId('palette')).toBeHidden();
  };
  try {
    await stubOpenDialog(session.app, []);
    await pick(session, '파일 가져오기', 'file.importManaged');
    await pick(session, '외부 파일', 'file.importLinked');
    const sheet = await expectWindow(session.app, 'sheet', () => pick(session, '단축키', 'app.shortcuts'));
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape');
    await expect.poll(() => menuItemEnabled(session.app, 'app.palette')).toBe(true);
    await pick(session, '글자 크게', 'view.textBigger');
    await pick(session, '글자 작게', 'view.textSmaller');
    await pick(session, 'ㅅㅇㄷㅂ', 'view.toggleSidebar');
    // The five newest first, then the rest in registry order (설정… never ran; 파일 가져오기… is the sixth newest).
    const expected = ['view.toggleSidebar', 'view.textSmaller', 'view.textBigger', 'app.shortcuts', 'file.importLinked', 'file.importManaged', 'app.settings'];
    await runMenuCommand(session.app, 'app.palette');
    expect(await listed(session.page)).toEqual(expected);
    // 글자 크게 and 글자 작게 both match ㄱㅈ at 0: the one run last comes first.
    await session.page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill('ㄱㅈ');
    expect((await listed(session.page)).slice(0, 2)).toEqual(['view.textSmaller', 'view.textBigger']);
    await session.page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    // A library setting (ADR-0007 (b)): written whole, newest first.
    await expect
      .poll(() => session.page.evaluate(async () => {
        const r = await window.learn.settings.get({ key: 'palette.recent' });
        return r.ok ? r.data : null;
      }))
      .toEqual(['view.toggleSidebar', 'view.textSmaller', 'view.textBigger', 'app.shortcuts', 'file.importLinked', 'file.importManaged']);
    await session.app.close();
    session = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
    await runMenuCommand(session.app, 'app.palette');
    await expect.poll(() => listed(session.page)).toEqual(expected);
  } finally {
    await session.app.close();
  }
});
```
import 줄: `fs`(`import fs from 'node:fs';`)를 더한다(`path`·`ElectronApplication`·`Page`·`closeSheet`·`expectWindow`·`importPaths`·`menuItemEnabled`·
`openItem`·`runMenuCommand`·`stubOpenDialog`는 이미 있다).

`E/keyboard.spec.ts`의 여정에서 `await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-empty')).toBeVisible();` 다음에:

```ts
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette-search-library')).toHaveAttribute('data-focused', 'true');
```

(여정의 나머지는 그대로 맞다: `ㅅㅇㄷㅂ`·`설정`과 일치하는 제목이 없어 커서가 명령 행에 있다 — `sample`, `sample-h264-aac`.)

`E/ime.spec.ts`: import에 `fs`, `path`, `FIXTURES`, `importPaths`를 더하고 파일 끝에:
```ts
test('palette: the 자료 group follows the composition; ↩ while composing opens nothing, after commit it opens the item', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(testInfo.outputPath('library'), testInfo.outputPath('userdata'));
  try {
    const dir = testInfo.outputPath('src');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const pdf = path.join(dir, '세포 신호.pdf');
    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf'), pdf);
    const [item] = await importPaths(page, [pdf]);
    await runMenuCommand(app, 'app.palette');
    const input = page.getByTestId('palette-input');
    await expect(input).toBeFocused();
    const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
    await cdp.send('Input.imeSetComposition', { text: 'ㅅㅎ', selectionStart: 2, selectionEnd: 2 });
    const result = page.locator(`[data-testid="palette-result"][data-item-id="${item!.id}"]`);
    await expect(result).toHaveAttribute('data-focused', 'true'); // filtered while still composing (spec §4.1)
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('palette')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toHaveCount(0);
    await cdp.send('Input.insertText', { text: 'ㅅㅎ' }); // commits the composition
    await expect(input).toHaveValue('ㅅㅎ');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('viewer-title')).toHaveText('세포 신호');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```
기존 두 IME 테스트는 그대로 맞다: 빈 라이브러리라 자료 행·검색 행이 없고, `cursor()`는 명령 행(`palette-item`)만 읽는다(P-20).

- [ ] **Step 10: 시각 투어 — 팔레트 상태와 실행기 문구**

`E/visual/tour.spec.ts`의 `palette: empty query, 초성 results, …` 테스트 전체를 아래 둘(도우미 + 테스트)로 바꾼다(Task 5·6이 이 테스트의 `ㄱ` 행
수를 고쳤어도 `ㄱ` 장면 — `palette-multi-light` — 은 아래에서 없어진다). 투어 라이브러리는 목업
`palette.html`의 자료(제목에 "신호"가 든 넷, 그중 동영상 하나, 둘은 저자·연도가 있다)이고, 목록의 첫 자료가 "신호 증폭의 정량 모델"이라
키 힌트의 초성 예가 목업과 같은 "ㅅㅎ → 신호"다. 인물은 가상이다(디자인 명세 부록 B).
```ts
/** palette.html's items: 신호 in four titles, one of them a video; author and year on two (spec §4.4: 저자 · 연도, else the kind). */
async function paletteLibrary(s: Session, dir: string): Promise<void> {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const pdf = (name: string) => {
    const p = path.join(dir, `${name}.pdf`);
    fs.writeFileSync(p, `%PDF-1.4\n% ${name}\n%%EOF\n`);
    return p;
  };
  const video = path.join(dir, 'c.mp4');
  fs.renameSync(h264(dir), video);
  // One import each, a few ms apart: the list (newest first) is d, c, b, a, and b and c, which match 신호 at the same
  // place, keep that order in the palette too (the newer first) — the shot is the same on every run.
  const imported: string[] = [];
  for (const p of [pdf('a'), pdf('b'), video, pdf('d')]) {
    imported.push(...(await importPaths(s.page, [p])).map((i) => i.id));
    await s.page.waitForTimeout(5);
  }
  await s.page.evaluate(async (ids) => {
    const set = (itemId: string, title: string, names: string[], date: string | null, role: 'author' | 'lecturer') =>
      window.learn.library.updateMetadata({ itemId, title, metadata: { creators: names.map((name) => ({ name, role })), ...(date ? { date } : {}) } });
    await set(ids[0]!, '세포 신호 그림 모음', [], null, 'author');
    await set(ids[1]!, '분자생물학 6장 · 신호 전달', ['김하늘'], '2024', 'author');
    await set(ids[2]!, '강의 04 · 세포 신호', ['박서준'], '2025', 'lecturer');
    await set(ids[3]!, '신호 증폭의 정량 모델', ['이도윤', '최민서'], '2023', 'author');
  }, imported);
  await expect(rowByTitle(s.page, '신호 증폭의 정량 모델')).toBeVisible();
}

test('palette: empty query, 자료 results (palette.html), commands only, no results, and the cursor row when the window is not key', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const s = await launchTour(testInfo.outputPath());
  // The table's dates in its rows only (Q-40), and whatever moves in the item panel behind the scrim (Task 6).
  const dates = () => [s.page.locator('[data-testid="item-row"] [data-col="createdAt"]'), ...panelMasks(s.page)];
  const input = s.page.getByTestId('palette-input');
  const cursor = s.page.locator('.palette [role="option"][data-focused]');
  try {
    await paletteLibrary(s, testInfo.outputPath('media'));
    for (const theme of THEMES) {
      await setTheme(s.page, theme);
      await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.palette');
      // Every available command, the cursor on the first (critic T9-M1, T9-n4); nothing ran from it yet.
      await expect(cursor).toHaveAttribute('data-command-id', 'file.importManaged');
      await shoot(s.page, `palette-empty-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
      // palette.html: 자료 above 명령, the matched 신호 in each title, 저자 · 연도 on the right, 라이브러리에서 ‘신호’ 검색 last.
      await input.fill('신호');
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('palette-result')).toHaveCount(4);
      await expect(cursor).toHaveAttribute('data-testid', 'palette-result');
      await expect(s.page.locator('.p-foot')).toContainText('ㅅㅎ → 신호');
      await shoot(s.page, `palette-items-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
      // Commands only, the search row under them (ㄱㅈㅇ: 파일 가져오기… alone, in no title) — M3's palette-{light,dark} state.
      await input.fill('ㄱㅈㅇ');
      await expect(cursor).toHaveAttribute('data-command-id', 'file.importManaged');
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('palette-search-library')).toBeVisible();
      await shoot(s.page, `palette-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
      // palette.html ?state=none: the notice, then the search row under the cursor; the foot says ↩ 실행 · esc 닫기.
      await input.fill('효소 억제제');
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('palette-empty')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(cursor).toHaveAttribute('data-testid', 'palette-search-library');
      await shoot(s.page, `palette-none-${theme}`, { mask: dates() });
      await s.page.keyboard.press('Escape');
      await expect(s.page.getByTestId('palette')).toBeHidden();
    }
    // Another window takes the key: the palette stays, its cursor row (an item) is the neutral selection (design-spec 3.1).
    await setTheme(s.page, 'light');
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.palette');
    await input.fill('신호');
    await expect(cursor).toHaveAttribute('data-testid', 'palette-result');
    await s.app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => {
      const w = new BrowserWindow({ width: 300, height: 200, show: true });
      void w.loadURL('about:blank');
      w.focus();
      (globalThis as { __probeWindow?: unknown }).__probeWindow = w;
    });
    await expect(s.page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
    await shoot(s.page, 'palette-inactive-light', { mask: dates() });
    await s.app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __probeWindow?: { close(): void } }).__probeWindow?.close());
    await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.focus());
    await expect(s.page.locator('html')).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```
`../helpers` import의 `rowByTitle`(Task 4), `type Session`(M3), Task 6의 `panelMasks`는 이미 있다. 자료 결과 장면의 이름은 Task 13이 찾는
`palette-items-{light,dark}`다. `palette-multi-light`의 목적(커서가 아닌 행의 `<mark>`)은 이제 `palette-items-*`의 자료 행 넷이 맡는다:
`git rm tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts-snapshots/palette-multi-light-linux.png`.

실행기 문구("검색 및 명령")가 사이드바와 접힌 도구 막대에 있으므로 라이브러리 화면의 모든 기준 PNG가 바뀐다.
Run: `pnpm e2e:xvfb tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts --update-snapshots=all`, `git status --short tests/e2e/visual/tour.spec.ts-snapshots`의 PNG를 모두

`font-15-light`, `drop-*`는 실행기 줄만, 그리고 앞 작업이 더한 메인 창 상태 — Task 3의 `table-*`, Task 4의 `palette-selection-light`, Task 5의
`search-*`·`search-none-*`, Task 6·7의 항목 패널 상태(`inspector-*`, `library-none-*`·`library-multi-*` 등 그 작업이 정한 이름) — 도 실행기 줄만),

```ts
// ⌘K finds items (spec §4.4, design-spec 10.5), in a session of its own: three PDFs with 신호 in the title (the shared
// session's seeded titles hold 신호 too, so its results and its 초성 example would not be these).
test('M4 library: ⌘K finds items — 자료 above 명령, 라이브러리에서 검색 last, the launcher says 검색 및 명령', TAG, async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const dir = testInfo.outputPath('palette');
  // A second profile beside the shared session: its window is hidden meanwhile, as in Task 8's test (shell.evidence.ts R-5).
  const shared = await mainWindow(s.app);
  await shared.evaluate((w) => w.hide());
  const x = await launch(path.join(dir, 'library'), path.join(dir, 'userdata'), { colorScheme: null });
  const value: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  results['paletteItems'] = value;
  const palette = x.page.getByTestId('palette');
  try {
    await setTheme(x.page, 'light');
    const media = path.join(dir, 'media');
    fs.mkdirSync(media, { recursive: true });
    // The last one imported heads the list, so the hint's 초성 example is ㅅㅎ → 신호 (palette/items.ts initialsExample).
    const files = ['분자생물학 6장 · 신호 전달', '세포 신호 그림 모음', '신호 증폭의 정량 모델'].map((title) => {
      const p = path.join(media, `${title}.pdf`);
      fs.writeFileSync(p, `%PDF-1.4\n% ${title}\n%%EOF\n`);

    await importPaths(x.page, files);
    await guard('palette: the launcher says 검색 및 명령', async () => {
      const text = (await x.page.getByTestId('launcher').textContent()) ?? '';
      value['launcher'] = text;
      check('palette: the launcher says 검색 및 명령', text.includes('검색 및 명령'), { text });
    });
    let via = 'menu';
    if (IS_MAC) {
      await bringAppToFront(x.app).catch(() => {});
      try {
        await nativeKeystroke(x.app, 'k', ['command']);
        via = 'keystroke';
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof NativeInputNotPermitted)) throw e;
        await runMenuCommand(x.app, 'app.palette');
      }
    } else await runMenuCommand(x.app, 'app.palette');
    await expect(palette).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5_000 });
    await x.page.keyboard.insertText('신호');
    await guard('palette: 자료 above 명령, the cursor on the first item, 라이브러리에서 ‘신호’ 검색 last', async () => {
      await expect(x.page.getByTestId('palette-result')).toHaveCount(3, { timeout: 5_000 });
      const v = {
        via,
        groups: await x.page.locator('.palette .p-group').allTextContents(),
        cursorOnItem: (await x.page.locator('.palette [role="option"][data-focused]').getAttribute('data-testid')) === 'palette-result',
        lastIsSearch: (await x.page.locator('.palette [role="option"]').last().getAttribute('data-testid')) === 'palette-search-library',
        hint: (await x.page.locator('.p-foot').textContent()) ?? '',
      };
      value['results'] = v;
      check('palette: 자료 above 명령, the cursor on the first item, 라이브러리에서 ‘신호’ 검색 last', v.groups.join('|') === '자료|명령' && v.cursorOnItem && v.lastIsSearch, v);
      check('palette: the 초성 hint comes from the library (ㅅㅎ → 신호)', v.hint.includes('ㅅㅎ → 신호'), { hint: v.hint });
    });
    await allShots(x.app, x.page, 'm4-09-palette-items', '⌘K 신호: 자료 above 명령 (light)');
    if (IS_MAC) {
      await setTheme(x.page, 'dark');
      await nativeWindowShot(x.app, 'm4-09-palette-items-dark', '⌘K 신호: 자료 above 명령 (dark)');
      await setTheme(x.page, 'light');
    }
    await x.page.getByTestId('palette-input').fill('효소 억제제');
    await guard('palette: with no match the notice and the search row stay', async () => {
      await expect(x.page.getByTestId('palette-empty')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5_000 });
      const v = { searchRow: await x.page.getByTestId('palette-search-library').count(), foot: await x.page.locator('.p-foot .row').allTextContents() };
      value['none'] = v;
      check('palette: with no match the notice and the search row stay', v.searchRow === 1 && v.foot.length === 2, v);
    });
    await allShots(x.app, x.page, 'm4-09-palette-none', '⌘K 효소 억제제: the notice above 라이브러리에서 검색 (light)');
    await x.page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  } finally {
    save();
    await x.app.close();
    await shared.evaluate((w) => w.show()); // the shared session goes on for the tests after this one
  }
});
```

### Task 10: 성능 — 1만 항목 `@perf`(`library-perf.json`, CI 2배 실패선), 드롭 뒤 렌더러 멈춤 프로파일과 수정

#### 계약과 다른 점 (판정 기록)

1. **P-4 "메인 창이 닫히면 없앤다"의 대상.** 계약은 미리 띄운 설정 창을 "메인 창이 닫힐 때와 `before-quit`에 없앤다"고 하고, M3의
   R-22(macOS: 설정 창만 남아도 앱이 살아 있고 Dock 클릭이 새 메인 창을 연다, `settings.spec.ts:321`)는 **보이는** 설정 창을 남긴다.
   권고 판정: 없애는 것은 **한 번도 보이지 않은(준비된) 창**뿐이다(`discardPrepared()`). 사용자가 연 설정 창은 지금처럼 macOS에서는
   남고, Linux/Windows에서는 메인 창과 함께 닫힌다. Task 12가 이대로 쓴다. — **컨트롤러 판정 Q-6으로 해소**(권고대로).
2. **`launch()`가 준비된 설정 창을 기다린다.** 계약은 "E2E 도우미(`expectWindow`, `openTimer`, 창 개수)가 재사용되는 숨은 설정 창을
   받아들인다"까지만 말한다. 준비가 끝나는 시점은 각 테스트의 첫 동작과 겹치는 경주가 된다(`browser-window-created`를 거는
   `sheets.spec.ts:236`, `settings.spec.ts:141`, `open-latency.ts`, 창 수를 세는 곳 다섯 군데). 권고 판정: `launch()`가
   `app-ready` 다음에 "설정 창이 준비됨"(숨은 창이 있고 그 페이지에 `data-sized`)까지 기다려, 모든 세션이 같은 상태(메인 + 준비된
   설정 창)에서 시작한다. 비용은 실행마다 약 0.3–0.6초(Linux CI E2E 단계 약 +1–1.5분). Task 12가 이대로 쓴다. — **컨트롤러 판정
   Q-7으로 해소**(권고대로, 실행마다 +0.3–0.6초를 받아들인다).
3. **유휴 알림 채널 `ui:reportIdle`(B에 없음).** 명세 8절 1행은 "`requestIdleCallback` 뒤 main에 알림"을 요구하는데 계약 B에
   채널 이름이 없다. 권고 판정: `ui.reportIdle(): Promise<Result<void>>`(`'ui:reportIdle'`, 입력 없음, 메인 창만 —
   `CHANNEL_KINDS`의 `['main']`). Task 12가 더한다. — **컨트롤러 판정 Q-8으로 해소**: 계약 B.3에 들어간다. Task 11보다 뒤에 오므로
   Task 12가 `CHANNEL_KINDS`(`Record<Channel, …>`: 빠지면 typecheck 실패)와 `P/main.ts`의 `requests.ui`(빠지면
   `P/surfaces.test.ts` 실패)에 함께 더한다(Task 11의 "새 채널" 규칙).
4. **테마를 "지금 바꿔라"는 신호.** 새 이벤트를 두지 않고, 이미 두 페이지가 듣는 `prefsChanged` 방송을 쓴다(Task 12 Step 8). —
   **컨트롤러 판정 Q-9으로 해소**(Task 11의 설정 창 preload 허용 목록에 `prefsChanged`가 있다; 시트 preload는 `sheet.*`뿐이고
   시트 높이 캐시는 main이 prefs에서 키를 만들므로 시트에 `prefs:get`이 필요 없다 — Q-5 그대로).
5. **준비 창을 버리는 `before-quit`의 순서.** Task 7의 편집 저장 문(`createFlushGate`)이 `before-quit`에서 종료를 멈출 수 있다. 처음
   안의 `will-quit`는 늦다(`app.quit()`이 숨은 창을 이미 닫았다). 판정: 저장 문 **다음에** 등록하고 `event.defaultPrevented`이면
   건너뛴다(Task 12 Step 5; 확인은 Step 7에서 고치는 Task 7의 종료 E2E). — **컨트롤러 판정 Q-30으로 해소**.
6. **시딩(Task 10).** 계약 B.8의 `seedLibrary(app, { count, from })` 대신, 행은 테스트 쪽에서 Task 3의 `seedRows`로 만들고 main 훅
   `__learnTest.seedItems`에 `{ fromItemId, rows }`를 넘긴다. 검색 입력(`searchSteps`)도 그 행에서 고른다(Task 10 Step 6). —
   **컨트롤러 판정 Q-45로 해소**.
7. **검색 시간을 재는 자리(Task 10).** 계약 B.4는 `useLibraryRows`가 `buildSearchIndex`·`search`를 부른다고 적었다. Task 5는 그것을
   두 곳(도구 막대의 "N개 / M개", 표의 행)이 함께 쓰는 `useSearch(items)`와 `search.ts`의 캐시(`searchIndexFor`가
   `buildSearchIndex`를, `searchCached`가 `search`를 한 번씩)로 옮겼고, 색인은 창이 한가할 때 미리 만든다. 그래서 `timed()`는
   `search.ts`의 그 두 호출을 감싼다(Task 10 Step 2). — **컨트롤러 판정 Q-27(·Q-29)로 해소**.

- [ ] **Step 2: 성능 표시 구현** — `R/ui/perfMarks.ts` 전체를 아래로 바꾼다(기존 `perfMark`·`clearImportMarks`의 동작은 그대로다).

```ts
/**
 * User Timing marks the evidence reads (tests/evidence/perf.evidence.ts, `learn:` marks), so a Mac run can show where
 * a drop's time goes (Mac run 3, critique n6: the screen held 0.55 s after a drop). For one drop, in order:
 * - `learn:drop`: the drop event reached the window;
 * - `learn:drop:clear`: the first painted frame without the overlay;
 * - `learn:import:start` / `learn:import:sent`: the import began / its request went to main;
 * - `learn:import:answered`: main answered; `learn:import:listed`: the list has what it brought;
 * - `learn:import:busy-text`: the first painted frame of "자료 N개를 가져오는 중…", only when it showed;
 * - `learn:toast:import-done`: the success toast's first painted frame; `learn:import:end`: the import let go.
 * A new drop or import clears the previous set, so the timeline holds the last one only.
 * The table and the item panel (spec 9 budgets; perfMarkLatest, one each):
 * - `learn:table:render`: the library view began a render; `learn:inspector:render`: the item panel did;
 * - `learn:table:painted`: the frame that paints rows that changed has begun (usePaintMark);
 * - `learn:table:first-paint`: the same, once per window — the first rows after the list arrived.
 */
export type PerfMark =
  | 'drop'
  | 'drop:clear'
  | 'import:start'
  | 'import:sent'
  | 'import:answered'
  | 'import:listed'
  | 'import:busy-text'
  | 'import:end'
  | 'table:render'
  | 'table:painted'
  | 'table:first-paint'
  | 'inspector:render'
  | `toast:${string}`;

/** Timed calls (performance.measure): one quick search over the library, and building its index (spec 9). */
export type PerfMeasure = 'search' | 'search:index';

const IMPORT_MARKS: readonly PerfMark[] = ['import:start', 'import:sent', 'import:answered', 'import:listed', 'import:busy-text', 'import:end', 'toast:import-done'];

export function perfMark(name: PerfMark): void {
  try {
    performance.mark(`learn:${name}`);
  } catch {
    // No timeline: nothing to record.
  }
}

/** A mark that recurs with every search, sort or list change: only the newest is kept, so a long session holds one. */
export function perfMarkLatest(name: PerfMark): void {
  try {
    performance.clearMarks(`learn:${name}`);
    performance.mark(`learn:${name}`);
  } catch {
    // No timeline.
  }
}

/** Runs `run` and records how long it took as the measure `learn:<name>` (the newest only); its result or throw passes through. */
export function timed<T>(name: PerfMeasure, run: () => T): T {
  const start = performance.now();
  try {
    return run();
  } finally {
    try {
      performance.clearMeasures(`learn:${name}`);
      performance.measure(`learn:${name}`, { start, end: performance.now() });
    } catch {
      // No timeline.
    }
  }
}

/** Forgets the marks of an earlier import; `drop` also those of an earlier drop. */
export function clearImportMarks(drop = false): void {
  try {
    for (const name of drop ? ['drop', 'drop:clear', ...IMPORT_MARKS] : IMPORT_MARKS) performance.clearMarks(`learn:${name}`);
  } catch {
    // No timeline.
  }
}
```

`R/library/usePaintMark.ts`(새 파일):
```ts
import { useLayoutEffect } from 'react';
import { perfMark, perfMarkLatest, type PerfMark } from '../ui/perfMarks';

/** Names already marked once in this window (the first rows after the list arrived). */
const firstMarked = new Set<PerfMark>();

/**
 * `learn:<name>` at the start of the frame that paints a commit in which `key` changed: the first animation frame after
 * the commit, whose paint follows its callbacks (spec 9: input → paint, sort → paint, list → first rows end there).
 * Keyed on identity: `key` must change only with what is drawn (useLibraryRows' memoised rows). `first` is also marked,
 * once per window. `null`: nothing is drawn yet (the table waits for its stored columns and sort), nothing is marked.
 * A window that draws no frames records nothing; it only measures.
 */
export function usePaintMark(name: PerfMark, key: unknown, first?: PerfMark): void {
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (key === null) return;
    const id = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      perfMarkLatest(name);
      if (first && !firstMarked.has(first)) {
        firstMarked.add(first);
        perfMark(first);
      }
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(id);
  }, [name, key, first]);
}
```

```ts
/** Nearest-rank percentile `p` (0–100) of `xs`: a value that was measured, never an interpolation. */
export function percentile(xs: readonly number[], p: number): number {
  if (xs.length === 0) throw new Error('percentile: no values');
  const sorted = [...xs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  return sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.ceil((p / 100) * sorted.length) - 1))]!;
}

/** The upper middle value (perf.json's median since M3: sorted[⌊n/2⌋]). */
export function median(xs: readonly number[]): number {
  if (xs.length === 0) throw new Error('median: no values');
  return [...xs].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(xs.length / 2)]!;
}
```
`tests/evidence/search-steps.ts`:
```ts
// The quick-search inputs the 10,000-item @perf test times: taken from the rows it seeds (tests/e2e/helpers.ts seedRows),
// so they hit real titles.
import { initialOf } from '../../apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/palette/hangul';

export interface SearchStep {
  group: 'ko' | 'initials' | 'en' | 'creator';
  /** Typed one by one, then erased one by one (each a timed input). */
  chars: string[];
}

const KO_RUN = /[가-힣]{2,}/u;
const LATIN_WORD = /[A-Za-z]{4,}/g;

/**
 * Two Korean title runs (up to 3 syllables each, from titles that start them differently), the 초성 of the first, two
 * Latin words (4 letters), one creator (2 characters): about 22 inputs typed and as many erased. Missing kinds are
 * left out; the test asks for enough inputs.
 */
export function searchSteps(items: ReadonlyArray<{ title: string; creators: readonly string[] }>): SearchStep[] {
  const ko: string[][] = [];
  const en: string[][] = [];
  for (const { title } of items) {
    const run = KO_RUN.exec(title)?.[0];
    if (run && ko.length < 2 && !ko.some((r) => r[0] === run[0])) ko.push([...run].slice(0, 3));
    for (const word of title.match(LATIN_WORD) ?? []) {
      if (en.length < 2 && !en.some((w) => w.join('') === word.slice(0, 4))) en.push([...word.slice(0, 4)]);
    }
    if (ko.length === 2 && en.length === 2) break;
  }
  const creator = items.flatMap((i) => i.creators).find((c) => [...c.replace(/\s/gu, '')].length >= 2);
  return [
    ...(ko[0] ? [{ group: 'ko' as const, chars: ko[0] }, { group: 'initials' as const, chars: ko[0].slice(0, 2).map(initialOf) }] : []),
    ...(ko[1] ? [{ group: 'ko' as const, chars: ko[1] }] : []),
    ...en.map((chars) => ({ group: 'en' as const, chars })),
    ...(creator ? [{ group: 'creator' as const, chars: [...creator.replace(/\s/gu, '')].slice(0, 2) }] : []),
  ];
}
```

드롭 뒤 멈춤은 Linux에서 재현되지 않았다(next-session "드롭 뒤 멈춤": Linux main 4–9ms, 프레임 간격 17ms; Mac 4차 317ms). 그래서
원인은 Mac 실행이 가져온 값으로 판정한다. 페이지의 `PerformanceObserver({ type: 'long-animation-frame' })`(LoAF, 50ms 이상 프레임:
스크립트별 시간·강제 레이아웃, 렌더 단계 시작, 스타일·레이아웃 단계 시작)와 앱의 `learn:` 표시를 묶어, 컨트롤러가 기계적으로
읽을 수 있는 원인 하나(`stall.cause`)를 `drop-import.json`에 남긴다. CDP 추적은 쓰지 않는다: 프로덕션 번들은 함수 이름이 줄어
있어 추적의 함수 표가 원인을 말하지 못하고, 수십 MB 산출물만 남는다.

```ts
  startTime: 1100, duration, forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration: forced,
});

    const marks = [at('drop', 1000), at('table:render', 1120), at('table:painted', 1255), at('toast:import-done', 1400)];
    const [s] = summarizeLongFrames([frame({ scripts: [script(30, 0, 'b'), script(120, 20, 'c'), script(10)] })], marks, 1000);

    expect(s.map((f) => f.durationMs)).toEqual([90, 60]);

describe("Step 9's rule: which fix a drop's longest frame calls for", () => {
  const marks = (inspectorAt: number) => [at('table:render', 1110), at('inspector:render', inspectorAt), at('table:painted', 1250)];
  const summary = (over: Partial<LongFrame>, m = marks(1150)) => summarizeLongFrames([frame(over)], m, 1000);
```
