`tests/evidence/long-frames.ts`:
```ts
// Long animation frames around a drop (spec 8, the drop stall): what the page's LoAF observer saw, summarised next to
// the app's learn: marks, and the cause Task 10 Step 9 picks a fix by.

/** One entry of the page's PerformanceObserver({ type: 'long-animation-frame' }) (frames of 50 ms or more). */
export interface LongFrame {
  startTime: number;
  duration: number;
  /** 0 when the frame had no rendering phase. */
  renderStart: number;
  /** 0 when the frame had no style-and-layout phase. */
  styleAndLayoutStart: number;
  blockingDuration: number;
  scripts: ReadonlyArray<{
    invoker: string;
    invokerType: string;
    sourceFunctionName: string;
    sourceURL: string;
    sourceCharPosition: number;
    startTime: number;
    duration: number;
    forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration: number;
  }>;
}
/** A User Timing mark on the page's clock (performance.now()). */
export interface Mark {
  name: string;
  at: number;
}

export interface LongFrameSummary {
  /** From the drop. */
  atMs: number;
  durationMs: number;
  scriptMs: number;
  forcedLayoutMs: number;
  /** From the frame's rendering phase (animation frames, observers, style, layout, paint) to its end. */
  renderMs: number;
  /** From its style-and-layout phase to its end. */
  styleLayoutMs: number;
  /** The learn: marks inside it, without the prefix, in time order. */
  marks: string[];
  /** Its three longest scripts (bundle file and character position: the production bundle has short names). */
  scripts: Array<{ invoker: string; type: string; fn: string; at: string; ms: number; forcedLayoutMs: number }>;
}

/** spec 8: a drop's longest frame gap on the Mac (page, drop-import.json) at most this. */
export const STALL_LIMIT_MS = 100;

const ms = (x: number) => Math.round(x);

export function summarizeLongFrames(frames: readonly LongFrame[], marks: readonly Mark[], origin: number): LongFrameSummary[] {
  return frames
    .filter((f) => f.startTime + f.duration >= origin)
    .map((f) => {
      const end = f.startTime + f.duration;
      return {
        atMs: ms(f.startTime - origin),
        durationMs: ms(f.duration),
        scriptMs: ms(f.scripts.reduce((n, s) => n + s.duration, 0)),
        forcedLayoutMs: ms(f.scripts.reduce((n, s) => n + s.forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration, 0)),
        renderMs: f.renderStart > 0 ? ms(end - f.renderStart) : 0,
        styleLayoutMs: f.styleAndLayoutStart > 0 ? ms(end - f.styleAndLayoutStart) : 0,
        marks: marks
          .filter((m) => m.at >= f.startTime && m.at <= end)
          .sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at)
          .map((m) => m.name.replace(/^learn:/, '')),
        scripts: [...f.scripts]
          .sort((a, b) => b.duration - a.duration)
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map((s) => ({
            invoker: s.invoker,
            type: s.invokerType,
            fn: s.sourceFunctionName,
            at: `${s.sourceURL.split('/').pop() ?? ''}:${s.sourceCharPosition}`,
            ms: ms(s.duration),
            forcedLayoutMs: ms(s.forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration),
          })),
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.durationMs - a.durationMs);
}

export type StallCause = 'none' | 'unmeasured' | 'styleLayout' | 'inspector' | 'script';
export interface Stall {
  cause: StallCause;
  /** The item panel's part of the longest frame's render, 2 decimals; null without the table and panel marks in it. */
  inspectorShare: number | null;
}

/**
 * Task 10 Step 9's rule, from the longest frame (`frames[0]`): 'styleLayout' when style, layout and forced layout take
 * half of it or more (first-use faces and glyph runs, Intl data); else 'inspector' when scripts take half or more and
 * the item panel's part of the render — learn:inspector:render to learn:table:painted (or the frame's end), against
 * learn:table:render to the same — is 0.4 or more; else 'script'.
 */
export function stallCause(gapMs: number, frames: readonly LongFrameSummary[], marks: readonly Mark[], origin: number): Stall {
  if (gapMs <= STALL_LIMIT_MS) return { cause: 'none', inspectorShare: null };
  const longest = frames[0];
  if (!longest) return { cause: 'unmeasured', inspectorShare: null };
  const start = longest.atMs;
  const end = longest.atMs + longest.durationMs;
  const rel = marks.map((m) => ({ name: m.name.replace(/^learn:/, ''), at: m.at - origin }));
  const inFrame = (name: string, from: number) => rel.filter((m) => m.name === name && m.at >= from && m.at <= end).map((m) => m.at);
  const tableAt = inFrame('table:render', start).at(-1);
  const inspectorAt = tableAt === undefined ? undefined : inFrame('inspector:render', tableAt)[0];
  const paintedAt = inspectorAt === undefined ? end : (inFrame('table:painted', inspectorAt)[0] ?? end);
  const inspectorShare = tableAt !== undefined && inspectorAt !== undefined && paintedAt > tableAt ? Math.round(((paintedAt - inspectorAt) / (paintedAt - tableAt)) * 100) / 100 : null;
  if ((longest.styleLayoutMs + longest.forcedLayoutMs) / longest.durationMs >= 0.5) return { cause: 'styleLayout', inspectorShare };
  if (longest.scriptMs / longest.durationMs >= 0.5 && inspectorShare !== null && inspectorShare >= 0.4) return { cause: 'inspector', inspectorShare };
  return { cause: 'script', inspectorShare };
}
```

```ts
              duration: x.duration,
              forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration: x.forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration,
            })),
          });
        }
      }).observe({ type: 'long-animation-frame' });
    });
```

- [ ] **Step 6: 1만 항목 `@perf` 테스트** — `tests/evidence/perf.evidence.ts` 끝에 더한다.

측정 방법(명세 9절 표의 각 줄):
- 시딩: 1만 행은 테스트가 `seedRows`로 만들어 main 훅에 `{ fromItemId, rows }`로 넘긴다(Q-45). 검색 입력도 그 행에서 고른다.
- 따뜻한 세션은 새 목록의 검색 색인이 다 만들어진 뒤(`useSearch`가 창이 한가할 때 만든다 — `learn:search:index` measure가 생긴 뒤)
  재기 시작한다: 1만 항목 색인의 긴 작업(≈150–240ms)이 어느 측정에도 끼지 않는다.
- 목록 IPC: 페이지에서 `window.learn.library.list()`를 5번 부른 왕복(렌더러가 부르는 그 경로).
- 첫 표 그리기: 같은 라이브러리로 5번 새로 띄워, 목록이 처음 그려진 렌더(`app-ready`의 `data-at`, R-18)에서
  `learn:table:first-paint`까지.
- 검색 입력 → 그리기: 검색 필드의 `input` 이벤트 `timeStamp`에서 그 뒤 첫 `learn:table:painted`까지, 한 글자씩(다음 글자는 앞
  글자가 그려진 뒤 — `useDeferredValue`가 버린 렌더를 앞 입력에 붙이지 않는다). 첫 질의는 초록·메모를 읽어 오므로(P-7) 재지 않는다.
- 메타데이터 검색: 그동안의 `learn:search` measure(`timed`, `searchCached`가 실제로 질의한 것) 전부.
- 스크롤: 표의 스크롤 뷰(grid 자신 `.library-table`, Task 3)를 rAF마다 40px씩 150프레임 내리며 잰 프레임 간격(처음 2개 제외).
- 정렬: 열 머리의 정렬 단추(`[data-testid="column-header"][data-col] .th-sort`)의 `click()`(단추의 `onClick`이 정렬한다 — 행과 달리
  단추의 프로그램 `click()`은 동작한다)에서 그 뒤 첫 `learn:table:painted`까지, 열 다섯 개.
- 인스펙터: 행에 보낸 `mousedown`(왼쪽 단추 — Task 3의 몸통 위임 처리기가 고른다. 행의 프로그램 `click()`은 아무것도 고르지 않는다)에서
  `inspector-head`의 `h2`가 그 행의 제목이고 `info-section`이 있는 첫 프레임까지, 5번. 패널이 보일 때만 뜻이 있다: Mac 러너의 창은
  1024px라(스파이크 Mac JSON 1024×684) 패널이 자동으로 접혀 있으므로, `shell[data-inspector]`가 `'shown'`이 아니면 먼저
  `view.toggleInspector`(`runMenuCommand` — 좁은 창에서 "필요할 때 보이기", forceShown)를 실행하고 보일 때까지 기다린 뒤 잰다.
  `inspectorToPaintMs.forcedShown`(그렇게 보였는지)과 `panel`을 함께 남기고, 그 뒤 `panel === 'shown'`을 `expect.soft`로 확인한다.

```ts
/** spec 9, ms. Linux CI fails beyond twice each; every other run reports. */
const LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS = { listIpc: 150, firstPaint: 500, inputToPaintP95: 50, searchP95: 300, scrollFrameP95: 16.7, sortToPaint: 100, inspectorToPaint: 100 } as const;
const LIBRARY_ITEMS = 10_000;
/** Each single-shot timing five times (spec 9: five or more). */
const LIBRARY_RUNS = 5;
/** The columns shown by default (spec 3.1), each sorted once. */
const SORT_COLUMNS = ['title', 'creators', 'year', 'type', 'createdAt'] as const;
/** What the page records while the warm session runs (PerformanceObserver and the search field's input events). */
interface PerfLog {
  marks: Array<{ name: string; at: number }>;
  measures: Array<{ name: string; ms: number }>;
  inputs: number[];
}
const tenth = (x: number) => Math.round(x * 10) / 10;

test('10,000 items: list, first rows, quick search, scroll, sort and the item panel against spec 9 (library-perf.json)', { tag: '@perf' }, async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const linuxCi = process.platform === 'linux' && Boolean(process.env['CI']);
  // P-23: on Linux CI the whole test, the seeding and five launches included, ends within a minute.
  test.setTimeout(linuxCi ? 60_000 : 180_000);
  const lib = testInfo.outputPath('library');
  const ud = testInfo.outputPath('userdata');
  const shownTotal = async (page: Page) => Number(/^(\d+)개$/.exec((await page.getByTestId('toolbar-count').textContent()) ?? '')?.[1] ?? 0);

  // 1. One real PDF, then 10,000 items that share its asset: one transaction, one libraryChanged (P-22). The rows are
  //    made here (Task 3's seedRows, Q-45: main keeps no sample data), and the search inputs below come from them.
  const libraryRows = seedRows(LIBRARY_ITEMS);
  const seeded = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    const [from] = await importPaths(seeded.page, [path.join(FIXTURES, 'sample.pdf')]);
    const added = await seeded.app.evaluate(
      (_electron, input) => (globalThis as unknown as { __learnTest: { seedItems(i: typeof input): number } }).__learnTest.seedItems(input),
      { fromItemId: from!.id, rows: libraryRows },
    );
    expect(added, 'main added every seeded row, in one transaction (P-22)').toBe(LIBRARY_ITEMS);
    await expect.poll(() => shownTotal(seeded.page), { timeout: 30_000 }).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(LIBRARY_ITEMS);
  } finally {
    await seeded.app.close();
  }

  // 2. Cold: five launches of that library. The list is there at app-ready's data-at (the first render with it, R-18);
  //    the first rows' frame is learn:table:first-paint. Both epoch ms.
  const firstPaintMs: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < LIBRARY_RUNS; i++) {
    const c = await launch(lib, ud);
    try {
      const listAt = Number(await c.page.getByTestId('app-ready').getAttribute('data-at'));
      await expect.poll(() => c.page.evaluate(() => performance.getEntriesByName('learn:table:first-paint').length)).toBe(1);
      const paintedAt = await c.page.evaluate(() => performance.timeOrigin + performance.getEntriesByName('learn:table:first-paint')[0]!.startTime);
      firstPaintMs.push(Math.round(paintedAt - listAt));
    } finally {
      await c.app.close();
    }
  }

  // 3. A warm session for the rest.
  const s = await launch(lib, ud);
  try {
    const page = s.page;
    // The list's search index is built at the window's first idle moment (useSearch, Task 5; timed() records it): wait
    // for it, so that long task lands in none of the measurements below.
    await expect
      .poll(() => page.evaluate(() => performance.getEntriesByName('learn:search:index', 'measure').length), { timeout: 15_000, message: 'the search index was built at an idle moment' })
      .toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const listed = await page.evaluate(async (runs) => {
      const out: number[] = [];
      let count = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < runs; i++) {
        const t0 = performance.now();
        const r = await window.learn.library.list();
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`library.list failed: ${r.code}`);
        out.push(Math.round(performance.now() - t0));
        count = r.data.length;
      }
      return { out, count };
    }, LIBRARY_RUNS);
    const listIpcMs = listed.out;
    await page.evaluate(() => {
      const log: PerfLog = { marks: [], measures: [], inputs: [] };
      (window as unknown as { __learnPerfLog: PerfLog }).__learnPerfLog = log;
      new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
        for (const e of list.getEntries()) {
          if (!e.name.startsWith('learn:')) continue;
          if (e.entryType === 'mark') log.marks.push({ name: e.name, at: e.startTime });
          else log.measures.push({ name: e.name, ms: e.duration });
        }
      }).observe({ entryTypes: ['mark', 'measure'] });
      document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        if ((e.target as Element | null)?.closest('[data-testid="search-field"]')) log.inputs.push(e.timeStamp);
      }, true);
    });
    const inputCount = () => page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __learnPerfLog: PerfLog }).__learnPerfLog.inputs.length);
    /** The first learn:table:painted after `t0` (the page's clock), or null after 3 s. */
    const paintedAfter = (t0: number) =>
      page.evaluate(async (t0) => {
        const log = (window as unknown as { __learnPerfLog: PerfLog }).__learnPerfLog;
        const until = performance.now() + 3000;
        while (performance.now() < until) {
          const m = log.marks.find((x) => x.name === 'learn:table:painted' && x.at > t0);
          if (m) return m.at;
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));
        }
        return null;
      }, t0);

    // Quick search, one character at a time, typed then erased.
    await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'library.find');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('search-field').locator('input')).toBeFocused();
    // The first query also brings the abstracts and memos (P-7), which re-draws the rows once more: not timed.
    await page.keyboard.insertText('a');
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
    await page.keyboard.press('Backspace');
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    const inputToPaintMs: number[] = [];
    let unpainted = 0;
    const timeInput = async (act: () => Promise<void>) => {
      const before = await inputCount();
      await act();
      await expect.poll(inputCount).toBe(before + 1);
      const t0 = await page.evaluate((i) => (window as unknown as { __learnPerfLog: PerfLog }).__learnPerfLog.inputs[i]!, before);
      const painted = await paintedAfter(t0);
      if (painted === null) unpainted++;
      else inputToPaintMs.push(Math.round(painted - t0));
    };
    const steps = searchSteps(libraryRows);
    for (const step of steps) {
      for (const ch of step.chars) await timeInput(() => page.keyboard.insertText(ch));
      for (let i = 0; i < step.chars.length; i++) await timeInput(() => page.keyboard.press('Backspace'));
    }
    expect(unpainted, 'every search input re-drew the rows (usePaintMark on the rows useLibraryRows memoises)').toBe(0);
    expect(inputToPaintMs.length, `enough inputs for a p95 (search-steps.ts found ${JSON.stringify(steps.map((x) => x.group))}; Task 3's seedRows gives Korean and Latin titles and creators)`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(20);
    const searchMs = (await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __learnPerfLog: PerfLog }).__learnPerfLog.measures))
      .filter((m) => m.name === 'learn:search')
      .map((m) => tenth(m.ms));
    expect(searchMs.length, "quick search is timed (timed() in search.ts' searchCached)").toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Scroll: the grid is the table's own scroll view (Task 3: .library-table, a sticky header, the rows placed by the
    // virtualizer), 40 px every frame for 150 frames.
    const scroll = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const target = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="library-table"]')!;
      if (target.scrollHeight <= target.clientHeight + 1) throw new Error('the table does not scroll');
      const deltas: number[] = [];
      await new Promise<void>((done) => {
        let last = 0;
        let n = 0;
        const step = (t: number) => {
          if (last) deltas.push(t - last);
          last = t;
          target.scrollTop += 40;
          if (++n < 150) requestAnimationFrame(step);
          else done();
        };
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      });
      return { deltas: deltas.slice(2), scrolledTo: Math.round(target.scrollTop) };
    });
    expect(scroll.scrolledTo, 'the table scrolled').toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const frameMs = scroll.deltas.map(tenth);

    // Sort: a press on a column header's sort button → the first frame with the re-sorted rows. The button's onClick sorts
    // (Task 3: button.th-sort; a button's click() runs it, unlike a row's), the settings write is optimistic.
    const sortToPaintMs: number[] = [];
    for (const col of SORT_COLUMNS) {
      const t0 = await page.evaluate((col) => {
        const t0 = performance.now();
        document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-testid="column-header"][data-col="${col}"] .th-sort`)!.click();
        return t0;
      }, col);
      const painted = await paintedAfter(t0);
      expect(painted, `sorting by ${col} re-drew the rows`).not.toBeNull();
      sortToPaintMs.push(Math.round(painted! - t0));
    }

    // The item panel: a press on a row → the first frame whose head names that row and has its info section. The table
    // selects on mousedown (Task 3: one delegated handler on its body); a programmatic click() selects nothing. A folded
    // panel would draw nothing, and the Mac runner's 1024 px window folds it (Task 6: 240 + 520 + 320 = 1080): there it is
    // shown on demand as a user would, with ⌥⌘I (view.toggleInspector, forceShown), before it is timed. Whether it is
    // shown is kept with the values and checked below.
    const forcedShown = (await page.getByTestId('shell').getAttribute('data-inspector')) !== 'shown';
    if (forcedShown) {
      await runMenuCommand(s.app, 'view.toggleInspector');
      await expect(page.getByTestId('shell'), 'the folded item panel shown on demand (view.toggleInspector)').toHaveAttribute('data-inspector', 'shown');
    }
    const panel = await page.getByTestId('shell').getAttribute('data-inspector');
    const inspectorToPaintMs: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < LIBRARY_RUNS; i++) {
      const ms = await page.evaluate(async (index) => {
        const head = () => document.querySelector('[data-testid="inspector-head"] h2')?.textContent ?? '';
        const candidates = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-testid="item-row"]')].filter((r) => r.dataset['title'] && r.dataset['title'] !== head());
        const row = candidates[index % candidates.length]!;
        const title = row.dataset['title']!;
        const t0 = performance.now();
        row.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 }));
        return new Promise<number>((resolve, reject) => {
          const check = (t: number) => {
            if (head() === title && document.querySelector('[data-testid="inspector"] [data-testid="info-section"]')) resolve(Math.max(0, t - t0));
            else if (performance.now() - t0 > 3000) reject(new Error(`the item panel never showed ${title}`));
            else requestAnimationFrame(check);
          };
          requestAnimationFrame(check);
        });
      }, i);
      inspectorToPaintMs.push(Math.round(ms));
    }

    const result = {
      items: listed.count,
      runs: LIBRARY_RUNS,
      budgetMs: LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS,
      linuxCiLimitMs: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS).map(([k, v]) => [k, 2 * v])),
      listIpcMs: { runs: listIpcMs, median: median(listIpcMs) },
      firstPaintMs: { runs: firstPaintMs, median: median(firstPaintMs) },
      inputToPaintMs: { inputs: inputToPaintMs.length, groups: steps.map((x) => x.group), runs: inputToPaintMs, median: median(inputToPaintMs), p95: percentile(inputToPaintMs, 95) },
      searchMs: { runs: searchMs, p95: percentile(searchMs, 95) },
      scrollFrameMs: { frames: frameMs.length, p95: percentile(frameMs, 95), max: Math.max(...frameMs), scrolledPx: scroll.scrolledTo },
      sortToPaintMs: { columns: SORT_COLUMNS, runs: sortToPaintMs, median: median(sortToPaintMs), max: Math.max(...sortToPaintMs) },
      inspectorToPaintMs: { panel, forcedShown, runs: inspectorToPaintMs, median: median(inspectorToPaintMs), max: Math.max(...inspectorToPaintMs) },
      platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`,
      ci: process.env['CI'] ?? null,
    };
    writeJson('library-perf.json', result, 'M4 library of 10,000 items: list, first rows, quick search, scroll, sort, item panel (spec 9)');
    console.log(
      '[measure] library',
      JSON.stringify({
        list: result.listIpcMs.median, firstPaint: result.firstPaintMs.median, inputP95: result.inputToPaintMs.p95, searchP95: result.searchMs.p95,
        scrollP95: result.scrollFrameMs.p95, sort: result.sortToPaintMs.median, inspector: result.inspectorToPaintMs.median,
      }),
    );
    // The item panel's timing is the panel's only while it is on screen (written above either way, then checked).
    expect.soft(panel, 'the item panel was shown while it was timed (data-inspector on the shell, Task 6)').toBe('shown');
    // spec 1 cond. 2 and 9: Linux CI fails beyond twice each budget (all checked, then the test fails); Mac values are reported.
    if (linuxCi) {
      const gate = (value: number, budget: number, what: string) =>
        expect.soft(value, `${what}: ${value} ms against the Linux CI limit ${2 * budget} ms (spec 9 budget ${budget} ms)`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2 * budget);
      gate(result.listIpcMs.median, LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS.listIpc, 'library.list of 10,000 items, median');
      gate(result.firstPaintMs.median, LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS.firstPaint, 'list arrived → first rows painted, median');
      gate(result.inputToPaintMs.p95, LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS.inputToPaintP95, 'search input → rows painted, p95');
      gate(result.searchMs.p95, LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS.searchP95, 'metadata search, p95');
      gate(result.scrollFrameMs.p95, LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS.scrollFrameP95, 'scroll frame interval, p95');
      gate(result.sortToPaintMs.median, LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS.sortToPaint, 'sort column change → rows painted, median');
      gate(result.inspectorToPaintMs.median, LIBRARY_BUDGET_MS.inspectorToPaint, 'row selected → item panel painted, median');
    }
  } finally {
    await s.app.close();
  }
});
```

`R/app/warmUp.ts`:
```ts
import { LIBRARY_COLUMNS } from '@learn/domain';
import { formatDate, formatSize } from '../format';
import { t } from '../strings';
import { afterPaintOr, type Pending } from '../ui/afterPaint';

/** The type roles the table, the item panel and the import toast are drawn in (base.css .t-*). */
const ROLES = ['t-body', 't-caption', 't-footnote', 't-headline', 't-title3'] as const;

/**
 * Pays, at an idle moment, what a window otherwise pays inside the frame of its first rows (spec 8, the drop stall):
 * the Korean collation and time-format data the table's sort and date cells load on first use, and the faces and glyph
 * runs of its type roles in both weights — Hangul, Latin and tabular digits. The probe is laid out unseen (visibility
 * hidden, off screen, aria-hidden) and removed once a frame has been painted. Returns its cancel.
 */
export function warmUp(doc: Document): Pending {
  new Intl.Collator('ko', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }).compare('가', 'a');
  formatDate(new Date(0).toISOString());
  formatSize(1_234_567);
  const text = `${LIBRARY_COLUMNS.map((c) => c.label).join(' ')} ${t.shell.myLibrary} ${t.toast.imported(8)} 0123456789 AaGg`;
  const probe = doc.createElement('div');
  probe.className = 'font-warm';
  probe.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  for (const role of ROLES) {
    for (const strong of [false, true]) {
      const line = doc.createElement('span');
      line.className = strong ? `${role} strong` : role;
      line.textContent = text;
      probe.append(line);
    }
  }
  doc.body.append(probe);
  const stop = afterPaintOr(1000, () => probe.remove());
  return () => {
    stop();
    probe.remove();
  };
}
```
`R/app/useWarmUp.ts`:
```ts
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { warmUp } from './warmUp';

/** Once the list has settled (`ready`), at the window's first idle moment (or after 2 s): warmUp. */
export function useWarmUp(ready: boolean): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return;
    let cancel = () => {};
    const id = requestIdleCallback(() => (cancel = warmUp(document)), { timeout: 2000 });
    return () => {
      cancelIdleCallback(id);
      cancel();
    };
  }, [ready]);
}
```

`R/ui/usePaintedOnce.ts`:
```ts
import { useLayoutEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { afterPaintOr } from './afterPaint';

/** False until a frame with this component's first commit has been painted (or 100 ms where no frames come), then true. */
export function usePaintedOnce(): boolean {
  const [painted, setPainted] = useState(false);
  useLayoutEffect(() => afterPaintOr(100, () => setPainted(true)), []);
  return painted;
}
```

### Task 11: 창마다 다른 preload와 창 종류 검사, 시트 부모의 "메인" 판정(m5), main 인라인 문구 정리

명세 8절의 M3 잔여 세 줄을 닫는다. (1) **창마다 다른 preload**(P-5): preload가 `P/main.ts`·`P/settings.ts`·`P/sheet.ts` 셋으로 나뉘고(공통 코드는 `P/surface.ts`, 각 파일에 함께 묶인다), 각 창의 페이지는 자기 창이 실제로 부르는 채널과 듣는 이벤트만 본다. main은 창을 만들 때 그 `webContents.id`에 창 종류를 적어 두고(`M/window-kinds.ts`), `createHandle`이 채널마다 허용된 창 종류(`M/ipc/channel-kinds.ts`의 `CHANNEL_KINDS`)를 검사한다. 페이지 URL은 믿지 않는다. 빌드는 electron-vite 6의 `isolatedEntries`로 공유 조각 없는 CommonJS 파일 셋을 만든다(Step 1에서 먼저 확인). (2) **시트 부모 판정**(최종 리뷰 m5, P-13): 우리 시트나 네이티브 패널이 붙은 창은 "우리 창 중 다른 창(자기 자신도, 자기 시트도 아닌 창)이 키일 때"는 메인이 아니다. `WindowState`에 `main`을 더해 렌더러의 `data-window-not-main`이 그것을 따르고, 우리 창 어느 것에 포커스가 와도 모든 창의 상태를 다시 읽는다. `sheetOpen`의 뜻("시트가 이 창을 잡고 있다", MainWindow의 `blocked`)은 그대로다. (3) **main 인라인 문구**: dossier-main §8.2의 모든 한글 리터럴(열기 패널 제목, `'잘못된 요청입니다.'`, `item-availability.ts`·`prefs.ts`·`index.ts`의 문구, 메뉴 레이블, About 크레딧)을 `M/strings.ts`로 옮기고, main에 그 밖의 한글 리터럴이 없음을 `strings.test.ts`가 검사한다. 문구는 한 글자도 바꾸지 않는다(옮기기만). Task 2–10이 더한 채널 넷(`ui:showColumnMenu` Task 3, `library:searchTexts` Task 5, `library:exportCopy`·`library:revealExport` Task 8)은 메인 창 전용으로 표와 `P/main.ts`에 들어간다. Task 2–10은 새 이벤트를 더하지 않으므로 창별 이벤트 허용 목록은 M3의 일곱 이벤트에서 나눈다. 범위 밖: 설정 창 미리 띄우기·시트 측정 겹치기와 같은 프레임 테마 전환(Task 12 — 그 작업이 `ui:reportIdle`의 표 줄과 `P/main.ts`의 동사를 스스로 더한다, 판정 Q-8), next-session의 m5 줄 번호 고치기와 문서(Task 13), `packages/library`·`packages/db`·`packages/domain`의 한글 문구(명세 8절 목록 밖; 열 이름은 domain 카탈로그 `LIBRARY_COLUMNS`에 있다, Q-44), main이 이벤트를 창 종류로 거르는 일(아래 판정 Q-4).

#### 계약과 다른 점 (모두 컨트롤러 판정으로 해소)

아래 다섯은 모두 권고대로 판정되었다(1 → Q-1, 2 → Q-2, 3 → Q-3, 4 → Q-4, 5 → Q-5). 6은 Task 12의 채널(Q-8)이 이 작업의 표와 만나는 자리다.

1. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-1으로 해소.** **m5 규칙의 "포커스된 창이 그 부모의 시트일 때뿐"**(명세 8절, next-session m5): 그대로 읽으면 시트가 키를 가져가는 순간(부모의 `blur`와 시트의 `focus` 사이, Electron이 키 창을 `null`로 보고하는 틈)과 시트가 닫힌 뒤 부모가 다시 키가 되기 전(`releasing`)에 부모가 흐려진다. `shell.spec.ts`의 "the chrome never dims on the way"(MutationObserver)와 M3 polish(시트 앞뒤로 크롬이 깜박이지 않는다)가 깨진다. **권고**: 명세가 네이티브 패널에 쓴 규칙을 우리 시트에도 쓴다 — 시트가 붙은 창은 "우리 창 중 자기 자신도 자기 시트도 아닌 창이 키일 때"만 메인이 아니다. m5의 두 경우(시트가 뜬 메인 창 → 설정 창 클릭, 폴더 패널이 뜬 설정 창 → 메인 창 클릭)는 이 규칙으로 흐려진다. 다른 앱이 앞에 있을 때의 모양은 M3 그대로다(m5 밖). 아래 단계는 이 권고를 따른다.
2. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-2로 해소.** **`sheetOpen`을 바꾸지 않고 `WindowState.main`을 더한다**: 명세는 "`sheetOpen`을 메인으로 세는 것"을 고치라고 쓰지만, `R/app/MainWindow.tsx:88`이 `sheetOpen`으로 시트가 창을 잡고 있는지(`blocked`, `modal`)를 정한다. `sheetOpen`을 설정 창 클릭 때 `false`로 만들면 시트가 떠 있는 동안 메인 창의 명령과 메뉴가 켜진다. **권고**: `sheetOpen`은 그대로 두고 `main: boolean`(AppKit의 메인 창: 키이거나, 시트가 붙어 있고 우리 다른 창이 키가 아님)을 더한다. 렌더러는 `data-window-not-main = !main`.
3. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-3으로 해소.** **메인 창의 채널 범위**: 실제 호출자만 세면 `library.recoveryReport`·`trash`·`restore`·`listTrash`·`duplicateGroups`와 `collections.*`·`tags.*`는 어느 창도 부르지 않는다. **권고**: 이것들은 M5·M6·P1에서 메인 창이 쓸 메인 창의 API이므로 `main`에 둔다. 막아도 얻는 것이 없다(메인 페이지는 이미 `library.import`로 아무 절대 경로나 가져올 수 있다). 설정 창과 시트는 실제 호출자만 둔다. 그래서 설정 창은 `ui.openSettings`를 잃는다(`SettingsApp`은 부르지 않는다. ⌘,는 main이 직접 실행하는 메뉴 명령이다). `ui.test.ts`의 "settings 창에서도 연다" 기대값이 바뀐다.
4. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-4로 해소.** **이벤트 허용 목록은 preload가 지킨다**: P-5의 "Event allow-lists per kind"를 preload마다의 `on()` 허용 목록으로 구현한다. main의 `broadcast`는 지금처럼 모든 창에 보낸다(창 종류로 거르면 `broadcast.test.ts`·`reader.test.ts`·`window-state.test.ts`의 가짜 창을 모두 등록해야 하고, 페이지는 자기 preload가 허락하지 않은 이벤트를 어차피 들을 수 없다). 종류별 목록은 `P/surfaces.test.ts`가 고정한다.
5. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-5로 해소.** **시트는 `prefs.get`을 받지 않는다**: next-session 권고 5는 "시트는 `sheet.*`와 `prefs.get`"이라고 썼지만 `R/sheets/*`는 `sheet.payload`·`sheet.resolve`만 부르고 이벤트도 듣지 않는다. **권고**: 시트는 `sheet.*`만, `on`도 없다. 시트가 prefs를 읽게 되면(Task 12의 측정 캐시가 렌더러에서 글자 크기를 읽는다면) 그 작업이 `CHANNEL_KINDS['prefs:get']`과 `P/sheet.ts`에 `sheet`를 더한다. (Task 12 초안은 시트 높이 열쇠를 main에서 `prefs.get()`으로 만든다 — `sheetHeightKey({ platform, fontSize, density, digest })`의 `staticKey` — 그래서 시트에 `prefs:get`을 더하지 않는다.)
6. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-8으로 해소(Task 12가 더한다).** **`ui:reportIdle`**: 새 채널(입력 없음, 메인 창만, `IpcDeps.prepareSettings()`)은 Task 12가 `D/ipc-channels.ts`에 만든다. 이 작업이 끝날 때는 아직 `Channels`에 없으므로 `CHANNEL_KINDS`(`Record<Channel, …>`)에 미리 적으면 typecheck가 남는 키로 막는다. 그래서 Task 12가 자기 Step 1에서 `CHANNEL_KINDS`에 `'ui:reportIdle': MAIN`(`'ui:showColumnMenu'` 다음 줄)을, `P/main.ts`의 `ui` 목록 끝에 `'reportIdle'`을 더한다. 이 작업의 표 테스트(`channel-kinds.test.ts`의 메인 창 목록은 `ALL`에서 설정 창·시트 몫을 뺀 것, `surfaces.test.ts`와 `platform.spec.ts`는 `CHANNEL_KINDS`에서 목록을 만든다)는 고칠 줄이 없고, 설정 창·시트의 정확한 목록도 그대로다. 빠지면: `CHANNEL_KINDS` 줄은 typecheck가(`Record<Channel, …>`에 키가 빠짐), `P/main.ts`의 동사는 `surfaces.test.ts`의 첫 테스트가 막는다.

- [ ] **Step 1: 빌드 확인 — electron-vite 6이 공유 조각 없는 preload 셋을 만드는지(프로젝트 파일은 건드리지 않는다)**

electron-vite 6.0.0은 실험 옵션 `build.isolatedEntries`를 둔다(`node_modules/electron-vite/dist/index.d.ts`의 `IsolatedEntriesMixin`: "Build each entry point as an isolated bundle without code splitting … When using `isolatedEntries` in `preload` config, you should also disable `build.externalizeDeps` … required for Electron sandbox support"). 구현은 `dist/chunks/lib-*.js`의 `isolateEntriesPlugin`: 입력이 둘 이상이면 입력마다 따로 `build()`를 돌려 결과를 자산으로 내보낸다. 한 rollup 빌드에 입력을 여럿 주면 공통 모듈이 `chunks/`로 빠지고, 샌드박스 preload는 그 파일을 `require`할 수 없다. 둘을 임시 폴더에서 견준다.

```bash
cd /home/baejs/projects/tutor/.worktrees/m4
ROOT=$PWD
S=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$S/src"
cat > "$S/src/surface.ts" <<EOF
import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } from 'electron';
import { EventChannels } from '$ROOT/packages/domain/src/event-channels';
import { Channels } from '$ROOT/packages/domain/src/ipc-channels';
export function expose(namespaces: readonly (keyof typeof Channels)[]): void {
  const api: Record<string, unknown> = { events: Object.keys(EventChannels) };
  for (const ns of namespaces) api[ns] = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(Channels[ns]).map(([v, c]) => [v, (i?: unknown) => ipcRenderer.invoke(c, i)]));
  contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('learn', api);
}
EOF
printf "import { expose } from './surface';\nexpose(['app', 'library', 'ui']);\n" > "$S/src/main.ts"
printf "import { expose } from './surface';\nexpose(['app', 'prefs', 'ui']);\n" > "$S/src/settings.ts"
printf "import { expose } from './surface';\nexpose(['sheet']);\n" > "$S/src/sheet.ts"
for iso in true false; do
cat > "$S/ev-$iso.config.ts" <<EOF
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
const entry = (name: string) => fileURLToPath(new URL(\`src/\${name}.ts\`, import.meta.url));
export default {
  preload: {
    build: {
      isolatedEntries: $iso,
      externalizeDeps: false,
      rollupOptions: { input: { main: entry('main'), settings: entry('settings'), sheet: entry('sheet') }, output: { format: 'cjs', entryFileNames: '[name].cjs' } },
    },
  },
};
EOF
(cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec electron-vite build --config "$S/ev-$iso.config.ts" --outDir "$S/out-$iso")
done
find "$S/out-true" "$S/out-false" -type f | sort
grep -ho 'require("[^"]*")' "$S"/out-true/preload/*.cjs | sort | uniq -c
grep -ho 'require("[^"]*")' "$S"/out-false/preload/*.cjs | sort | uniq -c
```
Expected (초안 작성 때 electron-vite 6.0.0 + vite 8.3.4로 같은 확인을 돌린 결과와 같아야 한다): `out-true/preload/`에 `main.cjs`·`settings.cjs`·`sheet.cjs` 세 파일만(각 3.3–3.4 kB, `chunks/` 없음), 셋 모두 `require("electron")` 하나씩(`3 require("electron")`). `out-false/preload/`는 `chunks/surface-<hash>.cjs`가 따로 생기고 입력 파일들이 `require("./chunks/surface-<hash>.cjs")`를 한다(그래서 `isolatedEntries`가 필요하다). "config is missing"(main·renderer) 경고와 "outDir … is not inside project root" 경고는 정상이다. 확인이 끝나면 `rm -rf "$S"`.

**판정 규칙**: `out-true`가 위와 같으면 Step 7의 설정(`isolatedEntries: true`)을 쓴다. 다르면(`chunks/`가 생기거나 `electron` 밖의 `require`가 있으면) Step 7에서 아래 **대체 설정**을 쓰고, 그 결과(파일 목록과 `require` 목록)를 커밋 본문과 `.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-23-m4-library/progress.md`에 한 줄씩 남긴다.

대체 설정 — 계약의 "else separate build configs": electron-vite는 `main`만 만들고, 설정 창과 시트 preload는 따로 빌드한다.
- `apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts`의 `preload.build`는 `{ rollupOptions: { input: { main: preload('main') }, output: { format: 'cjs', entryFileNames: '[name].cjs' } } }`(Step 7의 `preload` 함수 그대로, `isolatedEntries`·`externalizeDeps` 없이).
- 새 파일 `apps/desktop/vite.preload.config.ts`:
  ```ts
  import { builtinModules } from 'node:module';
  import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
  import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

  // The settings and sheet preloads, one build each, next to the main window's preload that electron-vite writes:
  // electron-vite's isolatedEntries did not give standalone files, and a sandboxed preload must be one CommonJS file.
  const kind = process.env['LEARN_PRELOAD'];
  if (kind !== 'settings' && kind !== 'sheet') throw new Error('LEARN_PRELOAD must be settings or sheet');

  export default defineConfig({
    build: {
      outDir: fileURLToPath(new URL('out/preload', import.meta.url)),
      emptyOutDir: false,
      minify: false,
      target: 'node24.18', // Electron 44's Node, as electron-vite targets its preload
      lib: { entry: fileURLToPath(new URL(`src/preload/${kind}.ts`, import.meta.url)), formats: ['cjs'], fileName: () => `${kind}.cjs` },
      rollupOptions: { external: ['electron', /^electron\/.+/, ...builtinModules.flatMap((m) => [m, `node:${m}`])] },
    },
  });
  ```
- `apps/desktop/package.json`의 `build`: `"node scripts/copy-pdfjs-assets.mjs && electron-vite build && LEARN_PRELOAD=settings vite build -c vite.preload.config.ts && LEARN_PRELOAD=sheet vite build -c vite.preload.config.ts"`. `dev` 스크립트는 바꾸지 않는다: `electron-vite dev`가 `out/preload`를 비우므로 대체 설정에서는 `pnpm dev`의 설정 창·시트에 preload가 없다. CI는 `pnpm dev`를 쓰지 않으므로(next-session "수동, 미확인") 이 한계를 커밋 본문에 적는다.
- 대체 설정에서도 Step 8의 `platform.spec.ts` 빌드 검사(파일 셋, `require("electron")`만)가 그대로 통과해야 한다.

```ts
/** A webContents stand-in: its id, and the 'destroyed' event Electron emits when it goes. */

    expect(windowKindOf(undefined)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('forgets a webContents once it is destroyed', () => {
    const c = contents(201);
    registerWindowKind(c, 'settings');

    expect(windowKindOf(201)).toBeUndefined();

    registerWindowKind(c, 'main');
    expect(c.listenerCount('destroyed')).toBe(1);
    expect(() => registerWindowKind(c, 'sheet')).toThrow(/301/);
    expect(windowKindOf(301)).toBe('main');
  });
```

`M/window-kinds.ts`:
```ts
/**
 * The kind of every window main creates, by its webContents id. IPC trusts this, never the page's URL: a page can
 * change its own URL within learn://app (will-navigate allows any app URL, history.pushState needs no navigation), and
 * the main window also shows the gallery board (?window=gallery) with the main window's preload.
 */
export type WindowKind = 'main' | 'settings' | 'sheet';

/** The part of a WebContents the registry needs (unit-testable without Electron). */
export interface KindedContents {
  readonly id: number;
  once(event: 'destroyed', listener: () => void): unknown;
}

const kinds = new Map<number, WindowKind>();

/**
 * Records the kind of a window main has just created, before its page loads; the entry goes with its webContents.
 * A webContents keeps one kind for its whole life: a second, different kind is a bug.
 */
export function registerWindowKind(contents: KindedContents, kind: WindowKind): void {
  const known = kinds.get(contents.id);
  if (known === kind) return;
  if (known !== undefined) throw new Error(`webContents ${contents.id} is a ${known} window, not a ${kind} window`);
  kinds.set(contents.id, kind);
  contents.once('destroyed', () => kinds.delete(contents.id));
}

/** The kind main registered for this webContents id; undefined for any other (one main did not create, or one gone). */
export const windowKindOf = (id: number | undefined): WindowKind | undefined => (id === undefined ? undefined : kinds.get(id));
```

`M/ipc/channel-kinds.ts`:
```ts
import type { WindowKind } from '../window-kinds';
import type { Channel } from './register';

const MAIN: readonly WindowKind[] = ['main'];
const SETTINGS: readonly WindowKind[] = ['settings'];
const MAIN_AND_SETTINGS: readonly WindowKind[] = ['main', 'settings'];
const SHEET: readonly WindowKind[] = ['sheet'];

/**
 * The window kinds that may call each channel. createHandle refuses any other sender — by the kind main gave its
 * webContents when it created the window (window-kinds.ts) — the way it refuses a foreign page. Each window's preload
 * exposes exactly its kind's channels (preload/surfaces.test.ts holds the two together).
 *
 * - main: the library window — all but the settings window's library location and the sheets' own channels. Channels
 *   no page calls yet (collections, tags, trash, the recovery report) are the main window's (M5, M6).
 * - settings: what SettingsApp calls. Not ui.openSettings: its ⌘, is the menu's, which main runs itself.
 * - sheet: its payload and its answer.
 */
export const CHANNEL_KINDS: Readonly<Record<Channel, readonly WindowKind[]>> = {
  'app:info': MAIN_AND_SETTINGS,
  'app:showLibraryFolder': SETTINGS,
  'app:chooseLibraryFolder': SETTINGS,

  'library:pickAndImport': MAIN,
  'library:import': MAIN,
  'library:list': MAIN,
  'library:get': MAIN,
  'library:pickAndRelink': MAIN,
  'library:recoveryReport': MAIN,

  'library:trash': MAIN,
  'library:restore': MAIN,
  'library:listTrash': MAIN,
  'library:duplicateGroups': MAIN,
  'library:showInFolder': MAIN,
  'library:openExternally': MAIN,
  'library:searchTexts': MAIN,
  'library:exportCopy': MAIN,
  'library:revealExport': MAIN,

  'collections:list': MAIN,
  'collections:create': MAIN,
  'collections:rename': MAIN,
  'collections:move': MAIN,
  'collections:remove': MAIN,
  'collections:restore': MAIN,
  'collections:addItems': MAIN,
  'collections:removeItems': MAIN,

  'tags:list': MAIN,
  'tags:create': MAIN,
  'tags:rename': MAIN,
  'tags:setColor': MAIN,
  'tags:remove': MAIN,
  'tags:assign': MAIN,
  'tags:unassign': MAIN,
  'tags:togglePosition': MAIN,

  'settings:get': MAIN,
  'settings:set': MAIN,

  'prefs:get': MAIN_AND_SETTINGS,
  'prefs:set': MAIN_AND_SETTINGS,

  'reader:open': MAIN,
  'reader:getPosition': MAIN,
  'reader:savePosition': MAIN,
```

`M/ipc/test-deps.ts`에 가짜 보낸이를 더한다(파일 끝, `stubDeps`는 그대로; 첫 줄 import를 아래 두 줄로):
```ts

```
```ts
/**
 * A sender webContents for IPC unit tests, registered as a window of `kind`: createHandle answers only senders main
 * registered, and only for the kinds a channel allows.
 */
export function fakeSender(id: number, kind: WindowKind): KindedContents {
  const contents: KindedContents = { id, once: () => contents };
  registerWindowKind(contents, kind);
  return contents;
}
```

`M/ipc/register.test.ts` 전체를 바꾼다(기존 다섯 테스트는 보낸이만 등록된 메인 창으로 바뀌고, 행렬 테스트가 더해진다):
```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { Channels, LearnError, itemIdInput, type Result } from '@learn/domain';
import type { WindowKind } from '../window-kinds';
import { CHANNEL_KINDS } from './channel-kinds';
import type { Channel } from './register';
import { fakeSender } from './test-deps';

type Listener = (event: unknown, raw: unknown) => Promise<Result<unknown>>;
const handlers = new Map<string, Listener>();

vi.mock('electron', () => ({
  ipcMain: { handle: (channel: string, fn: Listener) => handlers.set(channel, fn) },
}));

const { createHandle } = await import('./register');

const APP_URL = 'learn://app/index.html';
const ITEM = '7d3f3c3e-8a51-4f7e-9d7c-2b1f0f6f8f10';
const KINDS = ['main', 'settings', 'sheet'] as const satisfies readonly WindowKind[];
/** One sender of each kind, registered as main registers the windows it creates. */
const FROM: Record<WindowKind, unknown> = { main: fakeSender(1, 'main'), settings: fakeSender(2, 'settings'), sheet: fakeSender(3, 'sheet') };
/** A webContents main never registered: a page it did not create. */
const STRANGER = { id: 99 };
const REFUSED = { ok: false, code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED', message: '허용되지 않은 호출자입니다.', retryable: true }; // LearnError: PERMISSION_DENIED is retryable by default
const call = (channel: string, raw: unknown, url = APP_URL, sender: unknown = FROM.main) => handlers.get(channel)!({ sender, senderFrame: { url } }, raw);

let logged: unknown[][];
beforeEach(() => {
  handlers.clear();
  logged = [];
  vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation((...args: unknown[]) => void logged.push(args));
});
afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());

describe('createHandle (the single IPC entry point)', () => {
  it('rejects a sender from a foreign URL (and asset documents) without running the handler, whatever its window', async () => {
    const fn = vi.fn(() => ({ version: 'x' }) as never);
    createHandle(null)(Channels.app.info, z.object({}).optional(), fn);
    for (const url of ['https://evil.example/', 'file:///tmp/x.html', 'learn://app/asset/abc', 'http://localhost:5173/']) {
      const r = await call(Channels.app.info, undefined, url);
      expect(r).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED' });
    }
    expect(fn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('accepts the dev server origin only when one was configured', async () => {
    createHandle('http://localhost:5173')(Channels.app.info, z.object({}).optional(), () => ({ version: 'dev' }) as never);
    expect(await call(Channels.app.info, undefined, 'http://localhost:5173/')).toEqual({ ok: true, data: { version: 'dev' } });
  });

  it('answers each channel only for the window kinds CHANNEL_KINDS lists; any other sender is refused like a foreign page, before its input is read (P-5)', async () => {
    const handle = createHandle(null);
    const ran: string[] = [];
    const channels = Object.keys(CHANNEL_KINDS) as Channel[];
    for (const channel of channels) {
      handle(channel, z.object({ n: z.number() }), () => {
        ran.push(channel);
        return null as never;
      });
    }
    for (const channel of channels) {
      const allowed = CHANNEL_KINDS[channel];
      for (const kind of KINDS) {
        const r = await call(channel, { n: 1 }, APP_URL, FROM[kind]);
        expect(r, `${channel} from a ${kind} window`).toEqual(allowed.includes(kind) ? { ok: true, data: null } : REFUSED);
        // Refused before validation: a window that may not call the channel learns nothing about its input.
        if (!allowed.includes(kind)) expect(await call(channel, { n: 'x' }, APP_URL, FROM[kind])).toEqual(REFUSED);
      }
      expect(await call(channel, { n: 1 }, APP_URL, STRANGER), `${channel} from a page main did not create`).toEqual(REFUSED);
    }
    expect(ran).toEqual(channels.flatMap((c) => CHANNEL_KINDS[c].map(() => c)));
    // The same path as a foreign page: the channel and the code only.
    expect(logged.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(logged.every(([line]) => /^\[ipc\] [a-z]+:[A-Za-z]+ failed: PERMISSION_DENIED$/.test(String(line)))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('answers VALIDATION_FAILED for invalid input without running the handler', async () => {
    const fn = vi.fn(() => null);
    createHandle(null)(Channels.reader.getPosition, itemIdInput, fn);
    for (const raw of [undefined, null, {}, { itemId: 'not-a-uuid' }, { itemId: 42 }]) {
      expect(await call(Channels.reader.getPosition, raw)).toEqual({
        ok: false, code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', message: '잘못된 요청입니다.', retryable: false,
      });
    }
    expect(fn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('turns a throwing handler into a failure Result and logs only the channel and the code', async () => {
    const handle = createHandle(null);
    handle(Channels.library.detail, itemIdInput, () => {
      throw new Error('/Users/someone/Secret Papers/paper.pdf could not be parsed');
    });
    handle(Channels.library.trash, z.object({ itemIds: z.array(z.string()) }), () => {
      throw new LearnError('NOT_FOUND', '자료를 찾을 수 없습니다: /Users/someone/Secret Papers');
    });

    const internal = await call(Channels.library.detail, { itemId: ITEM });
    expect(internal).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'INTERNAL', message: '알 수 없는 오류가 발생했습니다.', retryable: false });
    const known = await call(Channels.library.trash, { itemIds: [ITEM] });
    expect(known).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_FOUND' });

    expect(logged).toEqual([['[ipc] library:detail failed: INTERNAL'], ['[ipc] library:trash failed: NOT_FOUND']]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(logged)).not.toMatch(/Secret|Users|paper|찾을/);
  });

  it('wraps the handler result (sync or async) in an ok Result and passes the parsed input', async () => {
    const handle = createHandle(null);
    const seen: unknown[] = [];
    handle(Channels.reader.getPosition, itemIdInput, (input) => {
      seen.push(input);
      return null;
    });
    handle(Channels.library.trash, z.object({ itemIds: z.array(z.string()).min(1) }), async ({ itemIds }) => itemIds.length);
    expect(await call(Channels.reader.getPosition, { itemId: ITEM, extra: 1 })).toEqual({ ok: true, data: null });
    expect(seen).toEqual([{ itemId: ITEM }]); // zod output, unknown keys stripped
    expect(await call(Channels.library.trash, { itemIds: [ITEM, ITEM] })).toEqual({ ok: true, data: 2 });
    expect(logged).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

`M/ipc/register.ts` — import 두 줄을 더하고(`import { mainStrings } from '../strings';` 다음):
```ts
import { windowKindOf } from '../window-kinds';
import { CHANNEL_KINDS } from './channel-kinds';
```
`IpcDeps`의 두 주석을 바꾼다(창 종류는 `createHandle`이 이미 보았다. 이것들은 "지금의 그 창"인지를 본다):
```ts
  /**
   * Whether `sender` is the current main window's renderer. createHandle has checked its kind already; this is the
   * window itself (a main window being closed still has the kind, and its last report must not drive the menu).
   */
  isMainWindow(sender: WebContents): boolean;
  /** Whether `sender` is the current settings window's renderer (its kind is checked by createHandle already). */
  isSettingsWindow(sender: WebContents): boolean;
```
`createHandle`을 통째로 바꾼다:
```ts
/**
 * The single IPC entry point: sender URL check, window-kind check (CHANNEL_KINDS, by the sender's webContents), zod
 * validation, `Result` envelope, and error-code-only logging. A sender the channel does not allow is refused before
 * its input is read. The signature additionally ties each channel to the result type LearnApi declares for it.
 */
export function createHandle(devOrigin: string | null): Handle {
  return function handle<S extends z.ZodType, T>(channel: Channel, schema: S, fn: Handler<S, T>): void {
    const kinds = CHANNEL_KINDS[channel];
    ipcMain.handle(channel, async (event, raw: unknown): Promise<Result<T>> => {
      try {
        const kind = windowKindOf(event.sender?.id);
        if (!isAllowedAppUrl(event.senderFrame?.url ?? '', devOrigin) || kind === undefined || !kinds.includes(kind)) {
          throw new LearnError('PERMISSION_DENIED', mainStrings.callerRefused);
        }
        const parsed = schema.safeParse(raw ?? undefined);
        if (!parsed.success) throw new LearnError('VALIDATION_FAILED', '잘못된 요청입니다.');
        return ok(await fn(parsed.data, event));
      } catch (e) {
        const failure = failureFrom(e);
        console.error(`[ipc] ${channel} failed: ${failure.code}`);
        return failure;
      }
    });
  } as Handle;
}
```
(`'잘못된 요청입니다.'`는 Step 13에서 `mainStrings.badRequest`가 된다.)

```ts
  // (CHANNEL_KINDS): the settings window's own ⌘, is the menu's, which main runs itself.
  handle(Channels.ui.openSettings, emptyInput, (_input, event) => {
    if (!deps.isMainWindow(event.sender)) throw new LearnError('PERMISSION_DENIED', mainStrings.callerRefused);
    deps.windows.openSettings();
  });
```
나머지 처리기의 창 검사(`mainWindowOf`, `ui.themeShown`, `app.ts`의 `fromSettings`, `sheets.ts`의 `find`)는 그대로 둔다: 종류가 아니라 "지금의 그 창 / 열린 그 시트"를 본다.

`P/surfaces.test.ts`(vitest `include`의 `apps/desktop/src/**/*.test.ts`에 든다. electron을 흉내 내고 세 preload를 차례로 불러, 각자 `contextBridge`에 넘긴 객체를 본다):
```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { EventChannels, type LearnEventMap } from '@learn/domain';
import { CHANNEL_KINDS } from '../main/ipc/channel-kinds';
import type { WindowKind } from '../main/window-kinds';

type Api = Record<string, unknown>;
/** What each preload handed contextBridge, in import order. */
const exposed: Array<{ key: string; api: Api }> = [];
const invoked: unknown[][] = [];
const listeners: Array<{ channel: string; listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void }> = [];
const removed: unknown[][] = [];

vi.mock('electron', () => ({
  contextBridge: { exposeInMainWorld: (key: string, api: Api) => void exposed.push({ key, api }) },
  ipcRenderer: {
    invoke: async (...args: unknown[]) => void invoked.push(args),
    on: (channel: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => void listeners.push({ channel, listener }),
    removeListener: (...args: unknown[]) => void removed.push(args),
  },
  webUtils: { getPathForFile: () => '/dropped/file.pdf' },
}));

await import('./main');
await import('./settings');
await import('./sheet');
const surfaces: Record<WindowKind, Api> = { main: exposed[0]!.api, settings: exposed[1]!.api, sheet: exposed[2]!.api };

/** Every function of a window.learn: `ns.verb` for invokers, the name for on / pathForFile. */
const functions = (api: Api): string[] =>
  Object.entries(api)
    .flatMap(([key, value]) => (typeof value === 'function' ? [key] : Object.keys(value as Api).map((verb) => `${key}.${verb}`)))
    .sort();
/** The channels CHANNEL_KINDS lets a window kind call, as `ns.verb`. */
const allowedFor = (kind: WindowKind) =>
  Object.entries(CHANNEL_KINDS)
    .filter(([, kinds]) => kinds.includes(kind))
    .map(([channel]) => channel.replace(':', '.'));
/** The push events each window's page may subscribe to. */
const EVENTS: Record<WindowKind, ReadonlyArray<keyof LearnEventMap>> = {
  main: ['menuCommand', 'libraryChanged', 'windowState', 'settingsChanged', 'prefsChanged', 'nativeMenu', 'demoShortcut'],
  // Its own window state, menu-bar menus and prefs; menuCommand and demoShortcut for the demo overlay it can show.
  settings: ['windowState', 'nativeMenu', 'prefsChanged', 'menuCommand', 'demoShortcut'],
  sheet: [],
};
const onOf = (kind: WindowKind) => surfaces[kind]['on'] as (name: unknown, cb: unknown) => () => void;

describe('preloads per window kind (P-5)', () => {
  it('each window gets the invokers of exactly the channels CHANNEL_KINDS allows its kind, on() where it hears events, pathForFile in the main window', () => {
    expect(exposed.map((e) => e.key)).toEqual(['learn', 'learn', 'learn']);
    expect(functions(surfaces.main)).toEqual([...allowedFor('main'), 'on', 'pathForFile'].sort());
    expect(functions(surfaces.settings)).toEqual([...allowedFor('settings'), 'on'].sort());
    expect(functions(surfaces.sheet)).toEqual(allowedFor('sheet').sort());
  });

  it('every invoker sends its own channel with the input as given', async () => {
    for (const [kind, api] of Object.entries(surfaces)) {
      for (const name of functions(api).filter((n) => n.includes('.'))) {
        const [ns, verb] = name.split('.') as [string, string];
        invoked.length = 0;
        await (api[ns] as Record<string, (input?: unknown) => Promise<unknown>>)[verb]!({ probe: kind });
        expect(invoked, name).toEqual([[`${ns}:${verb}`, { probe: kind }]]);
      }
    }
  });

  it("on() takes exactly its window's events, refuses any other name or a callback that is not a function", () => {
    for (const kind of ['main', 'settings'] as const) {
      for (const name of Object.keys(EventChannels)) {
        let taken = true;
        try {
          onOf(kind)(name, () => {});
        } catch {
          taken = false;
        }
        expect(taken, `${kind}: ${name}`).toBe(EVENTS[kind].includes(name as keyof LearnEventMap));
      }
      for (const bad of ['notAllowed', 'toString', 'constructor', 42]) expect(() => onOf(kind)(bad, () => {})).toThrow(/unknown event/);
      expect(() => onOf(kind)('windowState', 'not a function')).toThrow(/callback/);
    }
    expect(surfaces.sheet['on']).toBeUndefined(); // a sheet hears nothing: no on() at all
  });

  it('hands the callback the payload only, and the returned function unsubscribes', () => {
    listeners.length = 0;
    const seen: unknown[][] = [];
    const off = onOf('settings')('prefsChanged', (...args: unknown[]) => void seen.push(args));
    const sub = listeners[0]!;
    expect(sub.channel).toBe(EventChannels.prefsChanged);
    sub.listener({ sender: 'the IpcRendererEvent', ports: [] }, { prefs: { theme: 'dark' } });
    expect(seen).toEqual([[{ prefs: { theme: 'dark' } }]]);
    off();
    expect(removed.at(-1)).toEqual([EventChannels.prefsChanged, sub.listener]);
  });

  it('resolves a dropped file through webUtils in the main window only', () => {
    expect((surfaces.main['pathForFile'] as (file: unknown) => string)({})).toBe('/dropped/file.pdf');
    expect(surfaces.settings['pathForFile']).toBeUndefined();
    expect(surfaces.sheet['pathForFile']).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 구현 — preload 셋, 빌드 설정, 창을 만들 때 종류 등록**

`P/surface.ts`(지금 `P/index.ts`의 검사·호출기·`on`을 창 종류마다 쓸 수 있게 옮긴다):
```ts
import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer, webUtils, type IpcRendererEvent } from 'electron';
import type { LearnApi, LearnEventMap } from '@learn/domain';
// Subpath imports: names only, no zod in the sandboxed preload bundles.
import { EventChannels } from '@learn/domain/event-channels';
import { Channels } from '@learn/domain/ipc-channels';

type Requests = Omit<LearnApi, 'on' | 'pathForFile'>;

// Compile-time guard: Channels and LearnApi declare exactly the same namespaces and verbs.
type Same<A, B> = [A] extends [B] ? ([B] extends [A] ? true : false) : false;
const sameShape: Same<{ [N in keyof Requests]: keyof Requests[N] }, { [N in keyof typeof Channels]: keyof (typeof Channels)[N] }> = true;
void sameShape;

/** The verbs of each namespace a window's page may call: a part of LearnApi. */
export type RequestPick = { readonly [N in keyof Requests]?: readonly (keyof Requests[N])[] };

/**
 * What one window kind's preload gives its page as window.learn. Main checks the same per channel
 * (CHANNEL_KINDS); preload/surfaces.test.ts keeps the two equal.
 */
export interface Surface {
  requests: RequestPick;
  /** The push events its page may subscribe to; on() throws for any other name. None: no on() at all. */
  events: readonly (keyof LearnEventMap)[];
  /** Drag and drop: resolves a dropped File to its path via webUtils (sandbox-safe). The main window only. */
  pathForFile?: true;
}

type Invoker = (input?: unknown) => Promise<unknown>;

/** One fixed invoker per allowed channel. No generic invoke/send is ever exposed. */
function invokers(requests: RequestPick): Record<string, Record<string, Invoker>> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(requests).map(([ns, verbs]) => {
      const channels: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = Channels[ns as keyof typeof Channels];
      return [ns, Object.fromEntries((verbs as readonly string[]).map((verb) => [verb, (input?: unknown) => ipcRenderer.invoke(channels[verb]!, input)]))];
    }),
  );
}

function subscriber(events: readonly (keyof LearnEventMap)[]): LearnApi['on'] {
  const allowed = new Set<string>(events);
  return (name, cb) => {
    if (typeof name !== 'string' || !allowed.has(name) || !Object.hasOwn(EventChannels, name)) throw new Error(`unknown event: ${String(name)}`);
    if (typeof cb !== 'function') throw new Error('callback must be a function');
    const channel = EventChannels[name];
    // The IpcRendererEvent (sender, ports) never reaches the page: only the payload does.
    const listener = (_event: IpcRendererEvent, payload: unknown) => cb(payload as Parameters<typeof cb>[0]);
    ipcRenderer.on(channel, listener);
    return () => {
      ipcRenderer.removeListener(channel, listener);
    };
  };
}

export function exposeSurface(surface: Surface): void {
  contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('learn', {
    ...invokers(surface.requests),
    ...(surface.events.length > 0 ? { on: subscriber(surface.events) } : {}),
    ...(surface.pathForFile ? { pathForFile: (file: File) => webUtils.getPathForFile(file) } : {}),
  });
}
```

`apps/desktop/electron.vite.config.ts` 전체(Step 1이 대체 설정을 골랐으면 그쪽):
```ts
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { defineConfig } from 'electron-vite';

/** One preload per window kind: each page sees only its window's part of the API. */
const preload = (kind: 'main' | 'settings' | 'sheet') => fileURLToPath(new URL(`src/preload/${kind}.ts`, import.meta.url));

export default defineConfig({
  main: {},
  preload: {
    build: {
      // A sandboxed preload must be one CommonJS file: it cannot require a sibling chunk, so each entry is bundled on
      // its own with everything it imports (isolatedEntries; electron-vite asks for externalizeDeps off with it).
      isolatedEntries: true,
      externalizeDeps: false,
      rollupOptions: {
        input: { main: preload('main'), settings: preload('settings'), sheet: preload('sheet') },
        output: { format: 'cjs', entryFileNames: '[name].cjs' },
      },
    },
  },
  renderer: {
    plugins: [react()],
  },
});
```
(설정 파일 안의 `import.meta.url`은 electron-vite가 설정을 묶을 때 원래 파일의 URL로 바꿔 넣는다 — `bundleConfigFile`의 `define`. `import.meta.dirname`은 바꾸지 않으므로 쓰지 않는다.)

`M/index.ts` — preload 경로 세 곳:
- `openMainWindow`의 `preload: path.join(here, '../preload/index.cjs'),` → `preload: path.join(here, '../preload/main.cjs'),`
- `createSettingsWindow({ preload: path.join(here, '../preload/index.cjs'), …` → `'../preload/settings.cjs'`
- `createSheetHost({ preload: path.join(here, '../preload/index.cjs'), …` → `'../preload/sheet.cjs'`

창을 만드는 세 곳에서 종류를 등록한다(각 파일 import에 `import { registerWindowKind } from './window-kinds';`):
- `M/window.ts`의 `createMainWindow`: `const win = new BrowserWindow({ … });` 바로 다음 줄에
  ```ts
  // IPC knows the window by its webContents, never by its page's URL.
  registerWindowKind(win.webContents, 'main');
  ```
- `M/sheets.ts`의 `show`: `const win = new BrowserWindow({ … });`와 `const id = win.webContents.id;` 사이에 `registerWindowKind(win.webContents, 'sheet');`
- `M/settings-window.ts`의 `open`: `const created = new BrowserWindow({ … });` 다음의 `win = created;` 바로 다음 줄에 `registerWindowKind(created.webContents, 'settings');`(Task 12가 이 창 만들기를 `create(show)`로 옮길 때 같은 자리 — `win = created;` 다음 — 에 그대로 둔다고 표시해 두었다)
- 이 셋 밖에서 `new BrowserWindow`를 만드는 곳은 테스트의 창뿐이다: 키를 가져가는 탐침 창(`drop.spec.ts`, `library.spec.ts`, `palette.spec.ts`, `shell.spec.ts`, `visual/tour.spec.ts`와 Task 3·8이 더한 투어 상태 — `app.evaluate` 안에서 `about:blank`)과 `demo.evidence.ts`의 숨은 인쇄 창(`loadFile`). 등록되지 않으므로 그 창이 IPC를 부르면 거절되지만, 부르지 않는다(preload도 없다). 그 창이 키를 가져가면 Step 10의 `resyncAllWindowStates`가 돌고, 시트 없는 메인 창은 M3처럼 키도 메인도 아니게 된다(`data-window-not-main`은 M3의 `!focused && !sheetOpen`과 같은 값).
- Task 7의 편집 flush(`M/edit-flush.ts`)와 이 등록부는 겹치지 않는다: flush는 채널이 아니라 `webContents.executeJavaScript`로 메인 창 페이지의 전역을 부르고(`createHandle`을 거치지 않는다), 메인 창의 `close`를 `preventDefault()`한 뒤 다시 `win.close()`해도 같은 `webContents`라 등록은 그대로다(`'destroyed'`에서만 지운다). 메인 창 preload가 `index.cjs`에서 `main.cjs`로 바뀌어도 flush 전역은 렌더러(`inspector/editGuard.ts`)가 두므로 영향이 없다.

`R/api.ts`의 전역 선언에 주석을 단다(타입은 그대로 `LearnApi`: 창마다 나누면 메인 창과 설정 창이 함께 쓰는 `data/queries.ts`·`shell/useWindowState.ts`가 갈라진다):
```ts
declare global {
  interface Window {
    /**
     * Each window's preload exposes its own part of LearnApi only (preload/main.ts, settings.ts, sheet.ts):
     * another window's namespace is undefined in this page, and main refuses its channels anyway.
     */
    learn: LearnApi;
  }
}
```

  ```ts

  import type { WindowKind } from '../../apps/desktop/src/main/window-kinds';
  ```

  ```ts
  /** A page's window.learn: every function by path, generic IPC names anywhere in it, and whether ipcRenderer leaked. */
  const scanSurface = (p: Page) =>
    p.evaluate(() => {
      const GENERIC = new Set([
        'invoke', 'send', 'sendSync', 'sendTo', 'sendToHost', 'postMessage', 'ipcRenderer', 'once', 'addListener', 'removeAllListeners',
      ]);
      const functions: string[] = [];
      const generic: string[] = [];
      const seen = new Set<unknown>();
      const walk = (value: unknown, at: string): void => {
        if (value === null || (typeof value !== 'object' && typeof value !== 'function') || seen.has(value)) return;
        seen.add(value);
        for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
          const child = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
          const where = at ? `${at}.${key}` : key;
          if (GENERIC.has(key)) generic.push(where);
          if (typeof child === 'function') {
            functions.push(where);
            if (GENERIC.has(child.name)) generic.push(`${where} (named ${child.name})`);
          }
          walk(child, where);
        }
      };
      walk(window.learn, '');
      return { functions: functions.sort(), generic, windowIpc: typeof (window as unknown as { ipcRenderer?: unknown }).ipcRenderer };
    });
  /** Whether window.learn.on(name, callback) throws in this page. */
  const onThrows = (p: Page, name: string, callback: 'function' | 'string' = 'function') =>
    p.evaluate(
      ([n, c]) => {
        try {
          (window.learn as unknown as { on(name: unknown, cb: unknown): unknown }).on(n, c === 'function' ? () => {} : 'not a function');
          return false;
        } catch {
          return true;
        }
      },
      [name, callback] as const,
    );

  test('preload: each window has only its own invokers and events (P-5), no generic IPC; on() rejects every other name', async ({}, testInfo) => {
    // The built preloads: one standalone CommonJS file per window kind (a sandboxed preload cannot require a chunk).
    const out = path.join(ROOT, 'apps/desktop/out/preload');
    expect(fs.readdirSync(out).sort()).toEqual(['main.cjs', 'settings.cjs', 'sheet.cjs']);
    for (const file of ['main.cjs', 'settings.cjs', 'sheet.cjs']) {
      const required = [...fs.readFileSync(path.join(out, file), 'utf8').matchAll(/require\(([^)]*)\)/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
      expect(required, file).toEqual(['"electron"']);
    }
    const { app, page } = await session(testInfo);
    try {
      const settings = await expectWindow(app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.settings'));
      const sheet = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.shortcuts'));
      const pages: Record<WindowKind, Page> = { main: page, settings, sheet };
      for (const kind of ['main', 'settings', 'sheet'] as const) {
        const channels = Object.entries(CHANNEL_KINDS)
          .filter(([, kinds]) => kinds.includes(kind))
          .map(([channel]) => channel.replace(':', '.'));
        const others = kind === 'main' ? ['on', 'pathForFile'] : kind === 'settings' ? ['on'] : [];
        const scan = await scanSurface(pages[kind]);
        expect(scan.functions, kind).toEqual([...channels, ...others].sort());
        expect(scan.generic, kind).toEqual([]);
        expect(scan.windowIpc, kind).toBe('undefined');
      }
      // The main window hears its events; another name, an Object.prototype key or a callback that is not one is refused.
      expect(await onThrows(page, 'libraryChanged')).toBe(false);
      expect(await onThrows(page, 'notAllowed')).toBe(true);
      expect(await onThrows(page, 'toString')).toBe(true);
      expect(await onThrows(page, 'libraryChanged', 'string')).toBe(true);
      // The settings window hears its own events, not the main window's.
      expect(await onThrows(settings, 'prefsChanged')).toBe(false);
      expect(await onThrows(settings, 'libraryChanged')).toBe(true);
      await closeSheet(sheet, 'Enter');
    } finally {
      await app.close();
    }
  });
  ```

다른 E2E·증거의 `window.learn` 호출은 모두 메인 페이지에서 메인 창의 채널(`library.*`, `prefs.*`, `settings.*`, `reader.*`, `app.info`, `ui.windowState`, `ui.reportContext`, `on('libraryChanged' | 'windowState' | 'nativeMenu')`)만 부른다. Task 2–10 초안이 더한 호출도 모두 메인 페이지의 메인 창 채널이다: `library.list`·`get`·`import`·`detail`·`updateMetadata`·`trash`·`restore`(Task 3·5·6·8·10의 spec·증거와 `seedMetadata`), `prefs.set`, `settings.get`, `reader.open`, `on('windowState')`(Task 8 Step 13의 진단). 설정 창·시트 페이지에서 `evaluate`하는 새 줄(Task 4의 두 열 시트, Task 12의 테마)은 DOM만 읽는다. `git grep -n "window\.learn\." tests`로 다시 확인하고, 메인 창에 없는 채널을 부르는 줄이 새로 보이면 그 줄을 그 채널의 창 페이지로 옮긴다.

- [ ] **Step 9: 시트 부모의 "메인" 판정(m5) — 실패하는 테스트**

P-13: 최종 리뷰 m5의 코드는 `windowStateOf`(`M/window-state.ts:32–36`, `sheetOpen: sheets.has(win)`)와 `R/shell/useWindowState.ts:13`(`!focused && !sheetOpen`)이다. 지금은 시트가 붙은 창이 어느 창이 키든 메인으로 남고, 창은 자기 이벤트에만 상태를 다시 보낸다. `M/window-state.test.ts` 전체를 바꾼다 — 기존 네 테스트는 기대값에 `main`이 더해지고(뜻은 그대로), m5 묶음이 더해진다. 가짜 창에는 `id`와 `getParentWindow`가, electron 흉내에는 `getFocusedWindow`가 생긴다:
```ts
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { BrowserWindow } from 'electron';
import { EventChannels } from '@learn/domain';

/** The window Electron reports key now (BrowserWindow.getFocusedWindow); tests move it as the focus moves. */
let keyWindow: { id: number; getParentWindow(): { id: number } | null } | null = null;
vi.mock('electron', () => ({ BrowserWindow: { getAllWindows: () => [], getFocusedWindow: () => keyWindow } }));
const { isSheetOpen, resyncAllWindowStates, sheetClosed, sheetShown, trackWindowState, windowStateOf } = await import('./window-state');

let nextId = 1;
/** A BrowserWindow stand-in: tests set focus and full screen, emit its events, and read the pushes it received. */
class FakeWindow extends EventEmitter {
  readonly id = nextId++;
  focused = false;
  fullscreen = false;
  destroyed = false;
  readonly webContents = { isDestroyed: () => this.destroyed, send: vi.fn() };
  isFocused = () => this.focused;
  isFullScreen = () => this.fullscreen;
  isDestroyed = () => this.destroyed;
  getParentWindow = (): FakeWindow | null => null;
  /** The windowState payloads pushed to this window's renderer, oldest first. */
  pushes = () => this.webContents.send.mock.calls.filter(([channel]) => channel === EventChannels.windowState).map(([, payload]) => payload);
}
const win = (w: FakeWindow) => w as unknown as BrowserWindow;
/** One of our sheet windows over `parent`: only its identity matters to the window state. */
const sheetOver = (parent: FakeWindow) => ({ id: nextId++, getParentWindow: () => parent });

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.useFakeTimers();
  keyWindow = null;
});
afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers());

describe('window state per window (main and settings each get their own)', () => {
  it('pushes a window its own state on a real change, and never another window\'s', () => {
    const main = new FakeWindow();
    const settings = new FakeWindow();
    trackWindowState(win(main));
    trackWindowState(win(settings));
    settings.focused = true;
    settings.emit('focus');
    expect(settings.pushes()).toEqual([{ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true }]);
    expect(main.pushes()).toEqual([]); // the main window was not told about the settings window's focus
    main.emit('blur'); // the main window's own event: its own state
    settings.emit('focus'); // unchanged: nothing sent
    expect(main.pushes()).toEqual([{ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: false, main: false }]);
    expect(settings.pushes()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('a native sheet on the settings window: it stays main under it, and is re-read once it is key again (38e3a9e for any owner)', () => {
    const main = new FakeWindow();
    const settings = new FakeWindow();
    trackWindowState(win(main));
    trackWindowState(win(settings));
    settings.focused = true;
    settings.emit('focus');
    sheetShown(win(settings)); // the folder dialog / restart confirmation attaches to the settings window
    expect(isSheetOpen(win(settings))).toBe(true);
    settings.focused = false;
    settings.emit('blur'); // the sheet is key now; the settings window is still main (sheetOpen)
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });
    sheetClosed(win(settings));
    expect(isSheetOpen(win(settings))).toBe(false);
    expect(windowStateOf(win(settings))).toMatchObject({ sheetOpen: true, main: true }); // still main until it is key again: no dimmed flash
    settings.focused = true; // AppKit makes it key again without a 'focus' event
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(250);
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true });
    expect(main.pushes()).toEqual([]); // the main window's state is untouched throughout
  });

  it('a native dialog on a window: not key under it although no blur comes (macOS), key again once it is gone (critique m2)', () => {
    const settings = new FakeWindow();
    trackWindowState(win(settings));
    settings.focused = true;
    settings.emit('focus');
    sheetShown(win(settings), { native: true });
    // Electron still says focused and sends no 'blur' on macOS: the push says not key, still main.
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });
    expect(windowStateOf(win(settings)).focused).toBe(false);
    sheetClosed(win(settings), { native: true }); // the dialog resolved; the window is key (isFocused) at once
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true });

    // Our own sheet window takes the key itself (its parent gets 'blur'): not marked, the parent's own focus counts.
    sheetShown(win(settings));
    expect(windowStateOf(win(settings))).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: true, main: true });
    sheetClosed(win(settings));
  });

  it('two native dialogs in flight on one window: it stays under a sheet, not key, until the last one closes (re-review m7)', () => {
    const main = new FakeWindow();
    trackWindowState(win(main));
    main.focused = true;
    main.emit('focus');
    sheetShown(win(main), { native: true });
    sheetShown(win(main), { native: true });
    sheetClosed(win(main), { native: true }); // the first resolves
    expect(isSheetOpen(win(main))).toBe(true);
    expect(windowStateOf(win(main))).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(500);
    expect(main.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true }); // nothing released meanwhile
    sheetClosed(win(main), { native: true }); // the last one: released at once (the window is key)
    expect(isSheetOpen(win(main))).toBe(false);
    expect(main.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true });
    // A close with nothing open changes nothing, and does not leave a debt for the next sheet.
    sheetClosed(win(main), { native: true });
    sheetShown(win(main), { native: true });
    expect(windowStateOf(win(main))).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });
    sheetClosed(win(main), { native: true });
    expect(windowStateOf(win(main))).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true });
  });
});

describe('a sheet keeps its window main only while no other window of ours has the key (final review m5)', () => {
  it('the main window under its sheet: the settings window taking the key makes it not main, its sheet taking it back makes it main again', () => {
    const main = new FakeWindow();
    const settings = new FakeWindow();
    trackWindowState(win(main));
    trackWindowState(win(settings));
    main.focused = true;
    keyWindow = main;
    main.emit('focus');
    sheetShown(win(main)); // the ⌘/ sheet is about to show over the main window
    const sheet = sheetOver(main);
    main.focused = false;
    keyWindow = sheet;
    main.emit('blur'); // the sheet has the key: the main window is not key, still main
    expect(main.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });

    // A click on the settings window: AppKit makes it key and main. The main window gets no event of its own for it.
    const before = main.pushes().length;
    keyWindow = settings;
    settings.focused = true;
    settings.emit('focus');
    expect(main.pushes()).toHaveLength(before);
    resyncAllWindowStates(); // main/index.ts runs this on app 'browser-window-focus'
    expect(main.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: false });
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true });
    expect(isSheetOpen(win(main))).toBe(true); // still held by its sheet: its commands stay refused

    // Back on the sheet: main again.
    keyWindow = sheet;
    settings.focused = false;
    settings.emit('blur');
    resyncAllWindowStates();
    expect(main.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });
    // No key window reported (between one window's blur and the next one's focus): no dimmed flash.
    keyWindow = null;
    const settled = main.pushes().length;
    resyncAllWindowStates();
    expect(main.pushes()).toHaveLength(settled);
  });

  it('the settings window under its native folder dialog: the main window taking the key makes it not main, its own key back makes it main again', () => {
    const main = new FakeWindow();
    const settings = new FakeWindow();
    trackWindowState(win(main));
    trackWindowState(win(settings));
    settings.focused = true;
    keyWindow = settings;
    settings.emit('focus');
    sheetShown(win(settings), { native: true }); // Electron keeps reporting the settings window key under its dialog
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });

    settings.focused = false;
    main.focused = true;
    keyWindow = main;
    main.emit('focus');
    resyncAllWindowStates();
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: false });
    expect(main.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true });

    main.focused = false;
    settings.focused = true;
    keyWindow = settings;
    main.emit('blur');
    settings.emit('focus');
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });
    sheetClosed(win(settings), { native: true });
    expect(settings.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true });
  });

  it('after its sheet closed a window stays main until it is key, unless another window of ours takes the key meanwhile', () => {
    const main = new FakeWindow();
    const settings = new FakeWindow();
    trackWindowState(win(main));
    trackWindowState(win(settings));
    sheetShown(win(main));
    keyWindow = sheetOver(main);
    main.emit('blur');
    sheetClosed(win(main)); // the sheet is gone; AppKit has not made the main window key yet
    keyWindow = null;
    expect(windowStateOf(win(main))).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: true });
    keyWindow = settings;
    settings.focused = true;
    settings.emit('focus');
    resyncAllWindowStates();
    expect(main.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: true, main: false });
    vi.advanceTimersByTime(250); // released without becoming key: no sheet, not main
    expect(main.pushes().at(-1)).toEqual({ fullscreen: false, focused: false, sheetOpen: false, main: false });
  });

  it('a closed window leaves the re-read list', () => {
    const w = new FakeWindow();
    trackWindowState(win(w));
    w.emit('closed');
    w.focused = true;
    resyncAllWindowStates();
    expect(w.pushes()).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```
