Run: `pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/window-state.test.ts`
Expected: FAIL — 여덟 테스트 모두(기존 넷은 `main`이 없는 push, m5 넷은 `TypeError: resyncAllWindowStates is not a function`). 초안 작성 때 지금의 `window-state.ts`에 대해 돌려 이렇게 실패하고, Step 10의 코드에 대해 여덟 모두 통과하는 것을 확인했다.

- [ ] **Step 10: 구현 — `WindowState.main`, 모든 창 다시 읽기, 렌더러의 "메인 아님"**

`D/events.ts`의 `WindowState`를 통째로 바꾼다(판정 Q-2: `sheetOpen`의 뜻은 그대로, 주석만 정확히):
```ts
/** The window's state as its renderer draws it: pushed on change (windowState event) and answered by `ui.windowState()`. */
export interface WindowState {
  fullscreen: boolean;
  /** The key window (macOS): rings, keyboard cursor and the accent selection only here. */
  focused: boolean;
  /**
   * One of our sheets (a sheet window or a native dialog) hangs on this window, from just before it shows until the
   * window is key again after it closed: the window is held (the main window's `blocked`).
   */
  sheetOpen: boolean;
  /**
   * AppKit's main window: key, or carrying one of our sheets while no other window of ours has the key. Only a window
   * that is not main dims its chrome (design-spec 2.1).
   */
  main: boolean;
}
```

`M/window-state.ts`:
- 첫 줄 `import type { BrowserWindow } from 'electron';` → `import { BrowserWindow } from 'electron';`
- 머리 주석의 둘째 문단 `… during which the parent still counts as main (windowState.sheetOpen) but the sheet is gone (isSheetOpen).` → `… during which the parent is still held and main (windowState.sheetOpen, .main) but the sheet is gone (isSheetOpen).`
- `const pushers = …;`부터 `windowStateOf` 끝까지를 바꾼다:
  ```ts
  const pushers = new WeakMap<BrowserWindow, () => void>();
  /** Every tracked window's push, for a focus change anywhere among our windows (resyncAllWindowStates). */
  const tracked = new Set<() => void>();

  /**
   * Whether a window of ours other than `win` and its own sheets has the key: AppKit then makes that
   * window the main one, so `win` is neither key nor main even with a sheet attached. No key window at all (Electron's
   * report between one window's blur and the next one's focus, or with another app in front) does not count, nor does
   * `win` itself (Electron keeps reporting the parent of a native dialog key on macOS).
   */
  function keyElsewhere(win: BrowserWindow): boolean {
    const key = BrowserWindow.getFocusedWindow();
    return key !== null && key.id !== win.id && key.getParentWindow()?.id !== win.id;
  }

  /** What the windowState push and the ui.windowState query report. */
  export const windowStateOf = (win: BrowserWindow): WindowState => {
    const focused = win.isFocused() && !nativeSheets.has(win);
    const sheetOpen = sheets.has(win);
    return { fullscreen: win.isFullScreen(), focused, sheetOpen, main: focused || (sheetOpen && !keyElsewhere(win)) };
  };
  ```
  (식의 순서가 뜻을 가진다: 키인 창과 시트 없는 창은 `getFocusedWindow`를 묻지 않는다. 그래서 `ui.test.ts`·`settings-window.test.ts`의 electron 흉내에는 `getFocusedWindow`가 없어도 된다.)
- `trackWindowState`의 주석 끝 문장 `Each window has its own; one window's focus never reaches another's renderer.` → `Each window has its own; another window's focus reaches it only through resyncAllWindowStates (final review m5).`
- 같은 함수에서 비교 줄과 끝:
  ```ts
      if (last && last.fullscreen === next.fullscreen && last.focused === next.focused && last.sheetOpen === next.sheetOpen && last.main === next.main) return;
  ```
  ```ts
    pushers.set(win, pushState);
    tracked.add(pushState);
    win.once('closed', () => tracked.delete(pushState));
  }
  ```
- `resyncWindowState` 바로 다음에:
  ```ts
  /**
   * Re-reads every tracked window's state and pushes the ones that changed. main/index.ts runs it whenever a window of
   * ours gains the focus (app 'browser-window-focus'): a window under a sheet stops being main when another window of
   * ours takes the key, and is main again when its sheet takes it back, with no event of its own.
   */
  export function resyncAllWindowStates(): void {
    for (const push of tracked) push();
  }
  ```

`M/index.ts`:
- `import { isSheetOpen, sheetClosed, sheetShown } from './window-state';` → `import { isSheetOpen, resyncAllWindowStates, sheetClosed, sheetShown } from './window-state';`
- `app.on('activate', () => activation.onActivate());` 다음에:
  ```ts
    // A window under a sheet is main only while no other window of ours has the key: every window is re-read whenever
    // one of ours (a sheet included) gains the focus.
    app.on('browser-window-focus', () => resyncAllWindowStates());
  ```

`R/shell/useWindowState.ts`의 `apply`를 바꾼다(`sheetOpen`은 여기서 더 읽지 않는다. `MainWindow`와 `DemoOverlay`는 그대로 `sheetOpen`을 읽는다):
```ts
const apply = ({ fullscreen, focused, main }: LearnEventMap['windowState']) => {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  root.toggleAttribute('data-fullscreen', fullscreen); // no traffic lights → no 84 px inset
  // Not key: no rings or keyboard cursor, neutral selection. Not main as well — no sheet of ours holds it, or another
  // window of ours has the key: the chrome dims (design-spec 2.1).
  root.toggleAttribute('data-window-inactive', !focused);
  root.toggleAttribute('data-window-not-main', !main);
  setTooltipBlock('inactive', !focused); // a sheet, another app or window: open tooltips close
};
```

깨지는 테스트(`WindowState`를 그대로 견주는 곳; 줄 번호는 M3 기준, 판정 Q-2 — `WindowState` 객체를 통째로 견주는 곳마다 `main`이 든다):
- `M/settings-window.test.ts` 178: `{ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false }` → `{ fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true }`
- `M/ipc/ui.test.ts` 107: `data: { fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false }` → `data: { fullscreen: false, focused: true, sheetOpen: false, main: true }`; 109: `data: { fullscreen: true, focused: false, sheetOpen: false }` → `data: { fullscreen: true, focused: false, sheetOpen: false, main: false }`
- `E/platform.spec.ts` 347 `mainSees`: `({ fullscreen: w.isFullScreen(), focused: w.isFocused(), sheetOpen: false })` → `({ fullscreen: w.isFullScreen(), focused: w.isFocused(), sheetOpen: false, main: w.isFocused() })`(시트가 없으니 메인 = 키)
- `E/library.spec.ts` 278·287(`toMatchObject`), `E/demo-overlay.spec.ts` 186(`.sheetOpen`)은 그대로 통과한다. Task 2–10 초안은 `WindowState`를 통째로 적는 테스트를 더하지 않는다(Task 8의 `fileActions.test.ts`는 `{ sheetOpen }`만 보내는 가짜 구독 — `whenPanelCloses`의 인자가 `Pick<WindowState, 'sheetOpen'>`이라 그대로 맞다). `git grep -n "sheetOpen: \(true\|false\) }" -- apps tests`로 남은 곳이 없는지 본다.

- [ ] **Step 11: m5 E2E와 Mac 증거 검사**

`E/settings.spec.ts` — helpers import에 `closeSheet`를 더하고, `under its own folder dialog the settings window is not key …` 테스트 다음에 둘을 더한다(명세 8절의 확인 "시트가 뜬 메인 창 → 설정 창 클릭 → 메인 크롬 흐림"과 그 반대):
```ts
test('a sheet keeps the main window main only while no other window of ours has the key: the settings window clicked dims it, its sheet clicked undims it (final review m5)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app, page } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  const html = page.locator('html');
  /** One of our windows takes the key, as a click on it would (Xvfb has no window manager to click through). */
  const focusWindow = (part: string) =>
    app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }, part) => BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().find((w) => !w.isDestroyed() && w.webContents.getURL().includes(part))?.focus(), part);
  try {
    const settings = await expectWindow(app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.settings'));
    const sheet = await expectWindow(app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.shortcuts'));
    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', ''); // under its own sheet: still main
    await focusWindow('window=settings');
    await expect.poll(() => inactive(settings)).toBe(false);
    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', ''); // the settings window is AppKit's main window now
    expect(await menuItemEnabled(app, 'app.shortcuts')).toBe(false); // the sheet still holds the main window
    await focusWindow('window=sheet');
    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', '');
    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
    await closeSheet(sheet, 'Enter');
    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', '');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});

test('the other way round (m5): under its own folder dialog the settings window dims once the main window has the key', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    const settings = await expectWindow(app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.settings'));
    const html = settings.locator('html');
    await holdOpenDialog(app, []);
    await settings.getByTestId('library-choose').click(); // the folder dialog hangs on the settings window (a sheet on macOS)
    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', '');
    await (await mainWindow(app)).evaluate((w) => w.focus());
    await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', '');
    await (await settingsWindow(app)).evaluate((w) => w.focus());
    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', '');
    await releaseOpenDialog(app); // cancelled
    await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '');
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```
첫 테스트의 `menuItemEnabled(app, 'app.shortcuts') === false`가 판정 Q-2를 지킨다: 설정 창이 키여도 `sheetOpen`은 그대로라 메인 창은 시트가 닫힐 때까지 잡혀 있다.

`V/shell.evidence.ts` — `test('M3 chrome: ⌘, settings window over the main window, light and dark', …)`에서 테마 `for` 반복이 끝난 바로 다음(그 `}` 뒤, `await setTheme(s.page, 'light');` 앞)에 Mac 실기(AppKit의 키·메인 창)로 m5를 보는 검사를 더한다. Linux CI의 증거 실행에서도 같은 검사가 돈다(캡처만 건너뛴다):
```ts
  // One of our sheets keeps its window main only while no other window of ours has the key.
  // With the ⌘/ sheet on the main window, the settings window taking the key dims the main chrome as AppKit greys its
  // lights; the sheet taking the key back undims it.
  await guard('m5: a sheet keeps the main window main only while no other window of ours has the key', async () => {
    if (IS_MAC) await bringAppToFront(s.app).catch(() => {});
    const html = s.page.locator('html');
    const settings = await expectWindow(s.app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.settings'));
    let sheet: Page | null = null;
    try {
      sheet = await expectWindow(s.app, 'sheet', () => runMenuCommand(s.app, 'app.shortcuts'));
      await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '', { timeout: 5_000 });
      await s.page.waitForTimeout(600); // the colours ease in
      const underSheet = await mainChrome();
      await (await settingsWindow()).evaluate((w) => w.focus());
      await expect(html).toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', '', { timeout: 5_000 }).catch(() => {});
      await s.page.waitForTimeout(600); // AppKit repaints the main window's lights; the colours ease in
      const elsewhere = await mainChrome();
      const shot = await fullScreenShot('m4-11-sheet-parent-not-main', 'the ⌘/ sheet on the main window while the settings window has the key: the main chrome dims with its lights (final review m5)');
      await s.app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().find((w) => !w.isDestroyed() && w.webContents.getURL().includes('window=sheet'))?.focus());
      await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-not-main', '', { timeout: 5_000 }).catch(() => {});
      await s.page.waitForTimeout(600);
      const back = await mainChrome();
      results['m5SheetParent'] = { underSheet, elsewhere, back, shot: shot.file };
      check(
        'm5: under its sheet the main window stays main; the settings window taking the key dims it; the sheet taking the key back undims it',
        underSheet.notKey && !underSheet.notMain && underSheet.title === underSheet.tokens.primary &&
          elsewhere.notMain && elsewhere.title === elsewhere.tokens.inactive &&
          !back.notMain && back.title === back.tokens.primary,
        results['m5SheetParent'],
      );
    } finally {
      if (sheet && !sheet.isClosed()) await closeSheet(sheet, 'Escape').catch(() => {});
      await settings.close();
      if (IS_MAC) await bringAppToFront(s.app).catch(() => {});
      else await (await mainWindow(s.app)).evaluate((w) => w.focus());
      await expect(html).not.toHaveAttribute('data-window-inactive', '', { timeout: 5_000 }).catch(() => {});
    }
  });
```
(시트가 메인 창을 잡고 있는 동안 사이드바 토글은 이유 있는 비활성이라 `chromeDimmed`의 `toggleOpacity === '0.3'`은 맞지 않는다. 그래서 글자색으로만 본다.)

`M/menu/edit-context-menu.ts` — import `import { mainStrings } from '../strings';`와 `editContextMenuTemplate` 본문:
```ts
export function editContextMenuTemplate(p: Params): MenuItemConstructorOptions[] | null {
  const copy = mainStrings.menu.edit;
  if (p.isEditable) {
    return [
      { role: 'cut', label: copy.cut, enabled: p.editFlags.canCut },
      { role: 'copy', label: copy.copy, enabled: p.editFlags.canCopy },
      { role: 'paste', label: copy.paste, enabled: p.editFlags.canPaste },
      { type: 'separator' },
      { role: 'selectAll', label: copy.selectAll, enabled: p.editFlags.canSelectAll },
    ];
  }
  if (p.selectionText) return [{ role: 'copy', label: copy.copy, enabled: p.editFlags.canCopy }];
  return null;
}
```

`M/menu/app-menu.ts` — import에 `import { mainStrings } from '../strings';`(이 파일은 Electron을 타입으로만 가져오는 순수 빌더로 남는다. `strings.ts`도 Electron을 가져오지 않는다). `FULL_SCREEN` 정의를 바꾼다:
```ts
const copy = mainStrings.menu;

/** The macOS 전체 화면 item: Apple Korean names it by what it will do; the neutral name is spec 7.4's. */
export const FULL_SCREEN = {
  id: 'menu.view.fullScreen',
  label: copy.fullScreen.label,
  stateLabels: { windowed: copy.fullScreen.windowed, fullscreen: copy.fullScreen.fullscreen },
} as const;
```
`buildAppMenu` 본문의 레이블 리터럴을 모두 바꾼다(구조·순서·역할·가속기는 그대로; 개발자 도구 항목의 `accelerator`는 Task 6이 단 그대로 — 아래는 P-1 뒤의 모양이다):
```ts
export function buildAppMenu(opts: AppMenuOptions): Item[] {
  const mac = opts.platform === 'darwin';
  const reg = (name: MenuName) => registryItems(name, opts);
  const appMenu: Item = {
    id: 'menu.app',
    label: copy.top.app,
    submenu: join(
      [{ role: 'about', label: copy.app.about }],
      reg('app'),
      [{ role: 'services', label: copy.app.services }],
      [{ role: 'hide', label: copy.app.hide }, { role: 'hideOthers', label: copy.app.hideOthers }, { role: 'unhide', label: copy.app.unhide }],
      [{ role: 'quit', label: copy.app.quit }],
    ),
  };
  const close: Item = { role: 'close', label: mac ? copy.close.mac : copy.close.other, accelerator: 'CmdOrCtrl+W' };
  const file: Item = { id: 'menu.file', label: copy.top.file, submenu: join(reg('file'), [close]) };
  const edit: Item = {
    id: 'menu.edit',
    label: copy.top.edit,
    submenu: join(
      [{ role: 'undo', label: copy.edit.undo }, { role: 'redo', label: copy.edit.redo }],
      [{ role: 'cut', label: copy.edit.cut }, { role: 'copy', label: copy.edit.copy }, { role: 'paste', label: copy.edit.paste }, { role: 'selectAll', label: copy.edit.selectAll }],
      reg('edit'),
    ),
  };
  const view: Item = {
    id: 'menu.view',
    label: copy.top.view,
    submenu: join(reg('view'), fullScreenItems(opts), opts.isDev ? [{ role: 'toggleDevTools', label: copy.devTools, accelerator: 'Alt+CmdOrCtrl+J' }] : []),
  };
  const go: Item = { id: 'menu.go', label: copy.top.go, submenu: reg('go') };
  const windowMenu: Item = {
    id: 'menu.window',
    label: copy.top.window,
    role: 'windowMenu',
    submenu: join(
      // Not 'close' off macOS: the file menu already has "창 닫기" with the same accelerator.
      [{ role: 'minimize', label: copy.window.minimize }, ...(mac ? [{ role: 'zoom', label: copy.window.zoom } satisfies Item] : [])],
      mac ? [{ role: 'front', label: copy.window.front }] : [],
      reg('window'),
    ),
  };
  const help: Item = { id: 'menu.help', label: copy.top.help, role: 'help', submenu: join(reg('help'), mac ? [] : [{ role: 'about', label: copy.aboutOther }]) };
  return [...(mac ? [appMenu] : []), file, edit, view, go, windowMenu, help].filter((m) => Array.isArray(m.submenu) && m.submenu.length > 0);
}
```
(옛 줄의 주석 세 개 — 앱 메뉴와 닫기 항목의 "Apple Korean …" 둘, 도움말의 "macOS keeps Learn에 관하여 …" — 는 `mainStrings.menu`의 주석으로 옮겼다. Task 2는 이 함수 본문을 바꾸지 않고(`AppMenuOptions.labels`의 형과 `applyMenuLabels`만), Task 4·5·8의 새 메뉴 항목은 `reg('file')`·`reg('edit')`로 레지스트리에서 들어오므로 본문은 Task 6 뒤의 이 모양 그대로다. Task 6이 개발자 도구 항목을 다른 모양으로 썼다면 그 줄은 `'개발자 도구'`를 `copy.devTools`로만 바꾼다.)

값이 그대로이므로 레이블을 글자로 견주는 테스트(`app-menu.test.ts`의 `FILE`·`EDIT`·`VIEW`·`GO`·`HELP` 고정값 — Task 4·5·6·8이 더한 줄 포함 — 과 M3 l.283 `'전체 화면 종료'`, `edit-context-menu.test.ts`, `about.test.ts`, `register.test.ts`의 `'잘못된 요청입니다.'`, `app.test.ts`의 폴더 문구, E2E `platform.spec.ts`의 메뉴 레이블)는 바꾸지 않는다 — 옮기다 한 글자라도 바뀌면 이 테스트들이 잡는다.

### Task 12: 설정 창 미리 띄우기·시트 측정 겹치기와 캐시(P-4), 두 페이지가 같은 프레임에 바뀌는 테마

명세 8절 1행(P-4로 바로잡힘)과 2행. (1) 메인 창 페이지가 첫 목록을 그리고 한가해지면(`requestIdleCallback` 뒤 `ui.reportIdle`)
main이 설정 창을 **숨긴 채** 만들어 읽고 재고 크기를 맞춰 둔다. 첫 ⌘,는 그 창을 메인 창의 지금 자리 위에 놓고 보이기만 한다. 한 번도
보이지 않은 준비 창은 메인 창이 닫힐 때와 `before-quit`에 닫히고, 그래서 `window-all-closed`를 막지 않는다. 사용자가 연 창은 지금
규칙 그대로다(닫으면 없어지고 다음 ⌘,는 새 창, macOS는 메인 창이 닫혀도 남음 — R-22). 시트는 미리 띄우지 않는다(부모·modal은
만들 때 정해진다). 대신 측정을 첫 페인트(`ready-to-show`) 뒤가 아니라 문서가 생긴 때(`dom-ready`)부터 시작해 페인트와 겹치고,
⌘/ 시트처럼 내용이 바뀌지 않는 시트는 잰 높이를 `(platform, fontSize, density, 명령 digest)`마다 기억해 다음 창을 그 높이로 만든다.
목표 "⌘/ 중앙값 ≤ 250ms, 설정 첫 열기 ≤ 300ms"는 보고 값이다(CI 실패선은 M3의 500ms 그대로). 명세 12절에 따라 준비된 설정 창의
메모리를 `@perf`에 남긴다. (2) 테마: 설정 창의 타일을 누르면 그 페이지는 바로 바꾸지 않고(타일 선택 고리는 바로 옮긴다, T13M-m6),
main이 pref를 저장한 뒤 **모든 창에 한 번에** 보내는 `prefsChanged`를 받은 그 메시지의 작업 안에서 두 페이지가 함께 바꾼다. 각
페이지는 바꾼 직후 보고하고, main은 보이는 페이지들의 보고가 다 오면 `nativeTheme`을 바꾼다(250ms 대체, "마지막 변경만 센다"
그대로). 숨은 준비 창은 같은 방송으로 바뀌지만 기다리지 않는다. 범위 밖: 창별 preload와 창 종류 검사(Task 11, 이 작업은 그 위에
채널 하나를 더한다), 문서·next-session(Task 13), 시각 변화(없음: 투어 기준 PNG는 그대로 맞아야 한다).

```ts
describe('the settings window prepared hidden once the main window is idle (spec 8, P-4)', () => {
  it('prepare makes it hidden — loaded, measured, sized — and neither shows, focuses nor places it; once', async () => {
    const settings = host();
    settings.prepare();
    const w = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    expect(w.options).toMatchObject({ width: 600, show: false, title: '설정' });
    await ready(w);
    expect(w.contentSize).toEqual([600, 412]);
    expect(w.shown).toBe(false);
    expect(w.focused).toBe(0);
    expect(w.position).toBeNull();
    expect(settings.current()).toBe(w as unknown as BrowserWindow);
    settings.prepare();
    expect(FakeWindow.all).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('⌘, then shows that same window over where the main window is now, and focuses it', async () => {
    let bounds = { x: 100, y: 40, width: 1440, height: 900 };
    const main = { isDestroyed: () => false, getBounds: () => bounds } as unknown as BrowserWindow;
    const settings = host(main);
    settings.prepare();
    const w = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    await ready(w);
    bounds = { x: 300, y: 200, width: 1200, height: 800 }; // moved since it was measured
    expect(settings.open()).toBe(w as unknown as BrowserWindow);
    expect(FakeWindow.all).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(w.shown).toBe(true);
    expect(w.focused).toBe(1);
    expect(w.position).toEqual([300 + (1200 - 600) / 2, 200 + 96]);
  });

  it('⌘, while it is still being measured shows it, sized and placed, once measured', async () => {
    const settings = host();
    settings.prepare();
    const w = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    expect(settings.open()).toBe(w as unknown as BrowserWindow);
    expect(w.shown).toBe(false);
    await ready(w);
    expect(w.shown).toBe(true);
    expect(w.contentSize).toEqual([600, 412]);
    expect(w.position).toEqual([100 + (1440 - 600) / 2, 40 + 96]);
  });

  it('discardPrepared closes a window never shown — also one being measured — and leaves one asked for or shown', async () => {
    const settings = host();
    settings.prepare();
    const measuring = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    settings.discardPrepared();
    expect(measuring.destroyed).toBe(true);
    expect(settings.current()).toBeNull();
    settings.prepare();
    const prepared = FakeWindow.all[1]!;
    await ready(prepared);
    settings.discardPrepared();
    expect(prepared.destroyed).toBe(true);
    const asked = settings.open() as unknown as FakeWindow; // a ⌘, while it is measured: the user wants it
    settings.discardPrepared();
    expect(asked.destroyed).toBe(false);
    await ready(asked);
    settings.discardPrepared();
    expect(asked.destroyed).toBe(false);
    expect(asked.shown).toBe(true);
  });

  it('follows its content height from the moment it is sized, hidden or shown', async () => {
    const settings = host();
    settings.prepare();
    const w = FakeWindow.all[0]!;
    await ready(w);

});
```

11개와 Task 11의 "is registered as the settings window")는 그대로 통과해야 한다(바꾸지 않는다). 가짜 창의 `webContents.id`·`once`는
Task 11이 더했다(`registerWindowKind`가 부른다).

`M/settings-window.ts`의 `SettingsWindow` 인터페이스와 `createSettingsWindow` 전체를 아래로 바꾼다(`SETTINGS_WIDTH`,
`BELOW_MAIN_TOP`, `Rect`, `settingsPosition`, import는 그대로 — Task 11의 `import { registerWindowKind } from './window-kinds';`
포함. Task 11이 `open()` 안의 `new BrowserWindow({ … })`와 `win = created;` 사이에 둔
`registerWindowKind(created.webContents, 'settings');`는 아래 `create()`의 같은 자리에 있다 — 준비된 창도 설정 창으로 등록된다):
```ts
export interface SettingsWindow {
  /** ⌘, : shows the settings window — the one prepared hidden, when there is one — or brings the open one to the front. */
  open(): BrowserWindow;
  /** The settings window, shown or prepared (theme changes, the window-kind registry and the IPC checks reach it). */
  current(): BrowserWindow | null;
  /**
   * Makes the settings window hidden — loaded, measured and sized — so the next ⌘, only places and shows it (spec 8,
   * P-4). Nothing when one exists. Main calls it when the main window's page reports it is idle (ui.reportIdle).
   */
  prepare(): void;
  /**
   * Closes a prepared window nobody asked for yet (the main window closed, the app quits): a hidden window must never
   * keep the app alive (window-all-closed). One that was asked for or shown stays (R-22 on macOS).
   */
  discardPrepared(): void;
}

/**
 * ⌘, (design-spec 6 설정 창): one standard window with the title "설정", 600 wide, as tall as its content (also when a
 * message appears in it), not resizable by hand. Changes apply at once; it has no 완료 or × button of its own (closed by
 * its traffic light or ⌘W). Prepared hidden once the main window is idle (P-4), so the first ⌘, does not wait for a
 * renderer to start; a window closed by the user is gone, and the next ⌘, makes a new one.
 */
export function createSettingsWindow(deps: { preload: string; url(): string; main(): BrowserWindow | null }): SettingsWindow {
  let win: BrowserWindow | null = null;
  /** measuring: loading and being measured; ready: sized and hidden; shown: on screen (or was). */
  let phase: 'measuring' | 'ready' | 'shown' = 'measuring';
  /** A ⌘, came while it was being measured: it shows itself once sized (final review m4: never shown unsized). */
  let wanted = false;
  const live = (): BrowserWindow | null => (win && !win.isDestroyed() ? win : null);

  /** Over the main window as it is now (it may have moved since it was measured), inside that display's work area. */
  function place(w: BrowserWindow): void {
    const main = deps.main();
    if (!main || main.isDestroyed()) return;
    const b = main.getBounds();
    const size = w.getBounds(); // the frame, title bar included
    // The display it would land on, then that display's work area.
    const { workArea } = screen.getDisplayMatching({ x: Math.round(b.x + (b.width - size.width) / 2), y: b.y + BELOW_MAIN_TOP, width: size.width, height: size.height });
    const at = settingsPosition(b, size, workArea);
    w.setPosition(at.x, at.y);
  }
  function reveal(w: BrowserWindow): void {
    place(w);
    phase = 'shown';
    w.show();
  }

  function create(show: boolean): BrowserWindow {
    phase = 'measuring';
    wanted = show;
    const created = new BrowserWindow({
      width: SETTINGS_WIDTH,
      height: 560, // measured at this height first, then fitted to the content
      useContentSize: true,
      show: false,
      title: mainStrings.settingsWindow.title,
      resizable: false,
      minimizable: false,
      maximizable: false,
      fullscreenable: false,
      autoHideMenuBar: true,
      backgroundColor: windowBackground[currentTheme()],
      webPreferences: {
        preload: deps.preload,
        sandbox: true,
        contextIsolation: true,
        nodeIntegration: false,
        webSecurity: true,
        spellcheck: false,
        backgroundThrottling: false,
      },
    });
    // IPC knows the window by its webContents (Task 11), the prepared one too: before its page loads.
    registerWindowKind(created.webContents, 'settings');
    win = created;
    // ⌘W or the close light: off the screen first, then torn down. Closing tears the page down before AppKit takes the
    // window away, which showed an empty body for 2 frames (Mac run 2, critique n2); hidden, that happens unseen.
    created.on('close', () => {
      if (!created.isDestroyed() && created.isVisible()) created.hide();
    });
    created.on('closed', () => {
      if (win === created) win = null;
    });
    // Not key: no rings, neutral selection; under its own sheet it stays main (design-spec 2.1, Task 8 window states).
    trackWindowState(created);
    created.once('ready-to-show', () => {
      void (async () => {
        // Rendered, then its font loaded (at most 300 ms more), then measured: never boxes with no text (T13-m6), and
        // the height is the one its own font gives.
        const rendered = await contentHeight(created.webContents, '[data-settings-root]', 480);
        await fontsReady(created.webContents, '[data-settings-root]');
        if (created.isDestroyed()) return;
        // Re-measured with its own font; briefly (the page has rendered), keeping the first height otherwise, so a page
        // that never renders still shows within the first measurement's 5 s.
        const height = await contentHeight(created.webContents, '[data-settings-root]', rendered, REMEASURE_MS);
        if (created.isDestroyed()) return;
        created.setContentSize(SETTINGS_WIDTH, height);
        await markSized(created.webContents);
        if (created.isDestroyed()) return;
        phase = 'ready';
        if (wanted) reveal(created);
        // A message that appears (a refused folder) or goes makes the window as tall as its content again; on macOS the
        // bottom edge slides as AppKit's own windows do (`animate` is ignored elsewhere).
        followContentHeight(created.webContents, '[data-settings-root]', height, (next) => {
          if (!created.isDestroyed()) created.setContentSize(SETTINGS_WIDTH, next, true);
        });
      })().catch(() => {
        // Only a window closed mid-measure gets here; otherwise it is shown unsized when asked rather than not at all.
        if (created.isDestroyed()) return;
        phase = 'ready';
        if (wanted) reveal(created);
      });
    });
    void created.loadURL(deps.url());
    return created;
  }

  return {
    current: live,
    open(): BrowserWindow {
      const w = live();
      if (!w) return create(true);
      if (phase === 'measuring') {
        wanted = true; // it shows itself, sized, in a moment (and takes the focus then)
        return w;
      }
      if (phase === 'ready') reveal(w);
      else w.show();
      w.focus();
      return w;
    },
    prepare(): void {
      if (!live()) create(false);
    },
    discardPrepared(): void {
      const w = live();
      if (w && phase !== 'shown' && !wanted) w.close();
    },
  };
}
```

`M/sheets.test.ts`를 고친다.
- `FakeWindow`에 `static fontsReady = true;`를 더하고(`static pageHeight = 200;` 다음), 생성자의 가짜 `executeJavaScript`를
  ```ts
      // contentHeight polls in the page; fontsReady waits for document.fonts; markSized sets a flag.
      contents.executeJavaScript = async (script: string) =>
        script.includes('getBoundingClientRect') ? FakeWindow.pageHeight : script.includes('document.fonts') ? FakeWindow.fontsReady : undefined;
  ```
  로 바꾼다. `beforeEach`에 `FakeWindow.fontsReady = true;`.
- 측정은 이제 문서가 생긴 때 시작한다: `ready(w)`의 첫 줄 `w.emit('ready-to-show');`를
  ```ts
  w.webContents.emit('dom-ready'); // the page's document exists: measuring starts here, alongside the first paint
  w.emit('ready-to-show');
  ```
  로, 가짜 타이머 테스트 세 곳 — "ends a sheet that stays unresponsive…"의 `w.emit('ready-to-show');`, "a sheet shown unsized after a
  failed measurement…"의 `w.emit('ready-to-show');`, "gives up on a sheet that is still not shown 10 s…"의 `shown.emit('ready-to-show');`
  — 앞에 각각 같은 창의 `webContents.emit('dom-ready');` 한 줄을 더한다.
- import 줄 `const { createSheetHost, SHEET_SHOW_TIMEOUT_MS, SHEET_TOP, UNRESPONSIVE_GRACE_MS } = await import('./sheets');`를
  `const { createSheetHost, SHEET_SHOW_TIMEOUT_MS, SHEET_TOP, UNRESPONSIVE_GRACE_MS, sheetHeightKey, shortcutsDigest } = await import('./sheets');`로,
  맨 위 import에 `import { COMMANDS } from '@learn/domain';`.
- 파일 끝에:
```ts
describe('the ⌘/ sheet keeps the height it measured (spec 8, P-4)', () => {
  const keyed = () =>
    createSheetHost({ preload: '/p.cjs', url: () => 'learn://app/index.html?window=sheet', platform: 'linux', staticKey: (p) => (p.kind === 'shortcuts' ? 'linux|13|regular|d' : null) });
  /** One sheet over `p`, measured and shown, then closed; the scripts its page was asked. */
  async function openOnce(h: ReturnType<typeof createSheetHost>, p = parent()) {
    void h.open(p, { kind: 'shortcuts' });
    await tick();
    const w = FakeWindow.all.at(-1)!;
    const asked: string[] = [];
    const answer = w.webContents.executeJavaScript;
    w.webContents.executeJavaScript = async (script: string) => {
      asked.push(script);
      return answer(script);
    };
    await ready(w);
    const shown = w.shown;
    w.close();
    await tick();
    return { w, asked, shown };
  }

  it('makes the next one at the height the last one measured, checking only that it has rendered', async () => {
    const h = keyed();
    const first = await openOnce(h);
    expect(first.w.options.height).toBe(900 - SHEET_TOP - 16); // measured at full height first
    expect(first.w.contentSize).toEqual([560, 200]);
    FakeWindow.pageHeight = 260; // what a re-measure would see: it must not be asked
    const second = await openOnce(h);
    expect(second.w.options.height).toBe(200);
    expect(second.w.contentSize).toEqual([560, 200]);
    expect(second.shown).toBe(true);
    expect(second.asked.some((s) => s.includes('> 5000'))).toBe(true); // rendered first: never an empty sheet
    expect(second.asked.filter((s) => s.includes('> 500)'))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('caps a remembered height to the room the parent leaves, as a measured one', async () => {
    const h = keyed();
    FakeWindow.pageHeight = 743;
    await openOnce(h, parent(1, 900));
    const short = await openOnce(h, parent(1, 500));
    expect(short.w.options.height).toBe(500 - SHEET_TOP - 16);
    expect(short.w.contentSize).toEqual([560, 500 - SHEET_TOP - 16]);
  });

  it('remembers no height measured before its fonts were ready, and none for a sheet without a key', async () => {
    const h = keyed();
    FakeWindow.fontsReady = false;
    await openOnce(h);
    FakeWindow.fontsReady = true;
    expect((await openOnce(h)).w.options.height).toBe(900 - SHEET_TOP - 16);
    const plain = createSheetHost({ preload: '/p.cjs', url: () => 'learn://app/index.html?window=sheet', platform: 'linux' }); // no staticKey: always measured
    await openOnce(plain);
    expect((await openOnce(plain)).w.options.height).toBe(900 - SHEET_TOP - 16);
  });

  it('names a height by platform, text size, density and what the sheet lists', () => {
    expect(sheetHeightKey({ platform: 'darwin', fontSize: 13, density: 'regular', digest: 'abc' })).toBe('darwin|13|regular|abc');
    const digest = shortcutsDigest(COMMANDS, 'darwin');
    expect(digest).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{16}$/);
    expect(shortcutsDigest(COMMANDS.map((c) => (c.id === 'app.settings' ? { ...c, label: '환경설정…' } : c)), 'darwin')).not.toBe(digest);
    // Commands without a key are not on the sheet: where they sit in the registry changes nothing.
    const keyless = COMMANDS.filter((c) => c.accelerator === undefined && c.key === undefined);
    const listed = COMMANDS.filter((c) => c.accelerator !== undefined || c.key !== undefined);
    expect(shortcutsDigest([...keyless, ...listed], 'darwin')).toBe(digest);
  });
});
```

- import를 `import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';`, `import { LearnError, commandLabel, type CommandSpec, type SheetPayload, type SheetResult } from '@learn/domain';`로

  ```ts
  /**
   * The key of a static sheet's natural height (P-4): what that height can depend on. The ⌘/ sheet does not follow the
   * text size or density today (useApplyPrefs is the main window's); they are in the key so that a sheet that does is
   * never sized from another setting.
   */
  export function sheetHeightKey(o: { platform: string; fontSize: number; density: string; digest: string }): string {
    return `${o.platform}|${o.fontSize}|${o.density}|${o.digest}`;
  }

  /** What the ⌘/ sheet is drawn from: every registry shortcut as it lists one (id, label, keys), hashed. */
  export function shortcutsDigest(commands: readonly CommandSpec[], platform: string): string {
    const rows = commands
      .filter((c) => c.accelerator !== undefined || c.key !== undefined)
      .map((c) => [c.id, commandLabel(c, platform), c.accelerator ?? '', JSON.stringify(c.key ?? null)].join('\u0001'));
    return createHash('sha256').update(rows.join('\u0002')).digest('hex').slice(0, 16);
  }
  ```
- `createSheetHost(opts: { … })`의 `onSheetClosed?(parent: BrowserWindow): void;` 다음에:

  ```ts
     * time (the duplicate question names a file).

  ```

```ts
  function show(parent: BrowserWindow, payload: SheetPayload): Promise<SheetResult | null> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const width = SHEET_WIDTH[payload.kind];
      const room = parent.getContentBounds();
      const maxHeight = sheetMaxHeight(room.height, opts.platform);
      const key = opts.staticKey?.(payload) ?? null;
      const known = key === null ? undefined : heights.get(key);
      const win = new BrowserWindow({
        parent,
        modal: true, // macOS: a sheet, centred over the parent and dimming it (the system's placement)
        show: false,
        width,
        // Measured at full height first, then shrunk to the content; a static sheet measured before starts at that height.
        height: known === undefined ? maxHeight : Math.min(known, maxHeight),
        useContentSize: true,
        resizable: false,
        minimizable: false,
        maximizable: false,
        fullscreenable: false,
        frame: opts.platform === 'darwin',
        title: '',
        backgroundColor: themeHex[nativeTheme.shouldUseDarkColors ? 'dark' : 'light'].bgRaised,
        webPreferences: {
          preload: opts.preload,
          sandbox: true,
          contextIsolation: true,
          nodeIntegration: false,
          webSecurity: true,
          spellcheck: false,
          backgroundThrottling: false,
        },
      });
      registerWindowKind(win.webContents, 'sheet'); // Task 11: only an open sheet reaches sheet:*
      const id = win.webContents.id;
      let done = false;
      let watchdog: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
      let hung: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
      const settle = (result: SheetResult | null) => {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        clearTimeout(watchdog);
        clearTimeout(hung);
        pending.delete(id);
        resolve(result);
        if (!win.isDestroyed()) win.close();
        // Keyboard focus goes back to the window the sheet hung over (Linux/Windows do not always hand it back).
        if (!parent.isDestroyed()) parent.focus();
      };
      pending.set(id, { payload, settle });
      /** onSheetShown ran for this sheet: only then does its closing tell the parent (shown and closed come in pairs). */
      let announced = false;
      const announce = () => {
        if (announced || parent.isDestroyed()) return;
        announced = true;
        opts.onSheetShown?.(parent);
      };
      win.on('closed', () => {
        settle(null);
        if (announced && !parent.isDestroyed()) opts.onSheetClosed?.(parent);
      });
      // A sheet whose page never comes up, or stops answering, must not hold the import (or the window) forever: it
      // ends unanswered.
      win.webContents.on('render-process-gone', () => settle(null));
      win.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (_event, _code, _description, _url, isMainFrame) => {
        if (isMainFrame) settle(null);
      });
      win.on('unresponsive', () => {
        clearTimeout(hung);
        hung = setTimeout(() => settle(null), UNRESPONSIVE_GRACE_MS);
      });
      win.on('responsive', () => clearTimeout(hung));
      // Measured from the moment its document exists, alongside the first paint rather than after it (P-4): rendered,
      // its font loaded (at most 300 ms more), then measured again — never boxes with no text (T13-m6). null: the
      // measurement failed, and the sheet is shown unsized rather than the question lost.
      const height = new Promise<number | null>((settled) => {
        win.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
          void (async () => {
            const rendered = await contentHeight(win.webContents, '[data-sheet-root]');
            const fonts = await fontsReady(win.webContents, '[data-sheet-root]');
            if (known !== undefined) return Math.min(known, maxHeight);
            // Re-measured briefly, keeping the first height otherwise: the show watchdog never loses this race.
            const natural = await contentHeight(win.webContents, '[data-sheet-root]', rendered, REMEASURE_MS);
            if (key !== null && fonts) heights.set(key, natural); // a height in a fallback font is not worth keeping
            return Math.min(natural, maxHeight);
          })().then(settled, () => settled(null));
        });
      });
      // Shown only once the page has painted (ready-to-show) and been sized: the first frame on screen is the sized one.
      const painted = new Promise<void>((settled) => win.once('ready-to-show', () => settled()));
      void Promise.all([height, painted]).then(async ([h]) => {
        if (win.isDestroyed()) return;
        if (h !== null) {
          try {
            win.setContentSize(width, h);
            if (opts.platform !== 'darwin') win.setPosition(Math.round(room.x + (room.width - width) / 2), room.y + SHEET_TOP);
            await markSized(win.webContents);
          } catch {
            // Closed or gone mid-way: shown as it is, below, if it is still there.
          }
        }
        if (win.isDestroyed()) return;
        clearTimeout(watchdog);
        announce();
        win.show();
      });
      watchdog = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!win.isDestroyed() && !win.isVisible()) settle(null);
      }, SHEET_SHOW_TIMEOUT_MS);
      win.loadURL(opts.url()).catch(() => settle(null));
    });
  }
```

```ts
/** A window as the follower list reads it. */
export interface PageWindow {
  isDestroyed(): boolean;
  isVisible(): boolean;
  webContents: { id: number; isDestroyed(): boolean };
}

/**
 * The pages a theme change waits for: live windows on screen. A hidden one — the settings window prepared ahead of
 * ⌘, (P-4) — takes the change from the same prefsChanged broadcast, but nobody sees it, and a page still loading would
 * hold the native theme for the whole THEME_FOLLOW_MS.
 */
export function shownPages(windows: ReadonlyArray<PageWindow | null>): number[] {
  return windows.flatMap((w) => (w && !w.isDestroyed() && !w.webContents.isDestroyed() && w.isVisible() ? [w.webContents.id] : []));
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Runs `fn` in the window's next idle period, or after `timeoutMs` when none comes (a page that stays busy). Returns
 * its cancel. The browser's functions are taken when called, so node tests pass their own.
 */
export function whenIdle(
  fn: () => void,
  timeoutMs: number,
  ric: (cb: () => void, opts: { timeout: number }) => number = (cb, opts) => requestIdleCallback(cb, opts),
  cic: (id: number) => void = (id) => cancelIdleCallback(id),
): () => void {
  const id = ric(fn, { timeout: timeoutMs });
  return () => cic(id);
}
```

```ts
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { api } from '../api';
import { whenIdle } from '../ui/idle';

/** At most this long after the first list, main hears it even from a page that never idles. */
export const IDLE_REPORT_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000;
/** Once per page: a remount (the fatal screen after a render failure) does not ask again. */
let reported = false;

/**
 * Tells main, once, that this main-window page has settled its first list (`ready`) and been idle: main then prepares
 * the settings window hidden, so ⌘, only shows it (spec 8, P-4) — never while the app is still starting.
 */
export function useReportIdle(ready: boolean): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || reported) return;
    return whenIdle(() => {
      reported = true;
      void api().ui.reportIdle().catch(() => {});
    }, IDLE_REPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
  }, [ready]);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Every window by its `?window=` kind, sorted, with " (hidden)" after one not on screen — e.g. ['main', 'settings (hidden)']:
 * the settings window main prepares ahead of ⌘, (P-4) is there from launch on.
 */
export const windowKinds = (app: ElectronApplication): Promise<string[]> =>
  app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) =>
    BrowserWindow.getAllWindows()
      .filter((w) => !w.isDestroyed() && !w.webContents.isDestroyed())
      .map((w) => `${/[?&]window=(\w+)/.exec(w.webContents.getURL())?.[1] ?? ''}${w.isVisible() ? '' : ' (hidden)'}`)
      .sort(),
  );

/** Whether the settings window main prepares once the main window is idle exists, loaded and measured (data-sized). */
export async function settingsPrepared(app: ElectronApplication): Promise<boolean> {
  return app.evaluate(async ({ BrowserWindow }) => {
    const w = BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().find((x) => !x.isDestroyed() && !x.webContents.isDestroyed() && x.webContents.getURL().includes('window=settings'));
    if (!w || w.webContents.isLoading()) return false;
    return (await w.webContents.executeJavaScript("document.documentElement.dataset.sized === '1'", false)) === true;
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: 두 페이지가 같은 메시지로 바뀌는 테마 — 실패하는 E2E와 구현**

지금의 순서(dossier-main §6.8): 설정 창의 타일 클릭 → 그 페이지가 `useLayoutEffect`로 바로 교체 → `prefs.set` → main이 저장 →
`prefsChanged` 방송 → 메인 페이지가 그 렌더 뒤 교체. 그래서 설정 페이지가 2프레임 앞섰고, 두 보고를 기다린 네이티브(설정 창
제목 막대)는 그 페이지보다 4프레임 늦었다(next-session "테마 전환에서 설정 창 제목 막대가 늦다"). 바꾼 순서: 클릭 → 타일 선택만
→ `prefs.set` → main이 `pageChanged`(보이는 두 페이지를 기다림) 뒤 저장한 prefs를 **모든 창에 한 루프로** 방송 → 각 페이지가 그
메시지의 작업 안에서(그 메시지가 일으키는 다시 그리기보다 먼저) 교체하고 곧바로 보고 → 둘 다 오면 `nativeTheme`. "바꾸라"
메시지는 새 이벤트가 아니라 이미 모든 창이 받는 `prefsChanged`다(창별 preload의 허용 목록에 이미 있다, P-5).

`R/settings/theme.ts` 전체:
```ts
import { useLayoutEffect } from 'react';
import type { Prefs } from '@learn/domain';
import { api } from '../api';
import { useLearnEvent } from '../events';

export type Shade = 'light' | 'dark';

/** The theme the page is drawn in: the pref, or the system appearance for 시스템 설정. */
export const resolveTheme = (theme: Prefs['theme'], systemDark: boolean): Shade => (theme === 'system' ? (systemDark ? 'dark' : 'light') : theme);

interface ShadeTarget {
  dataset: DOMStringMap;
}
interface ShadeOptions {
  /**
   * The page has `shade`: called once, right after the swap (or at once when nothing changed). Main lets the native
   * theme follow it (T13R4-m1).
   */
  onShown?: () => void;
}

/**
 * <html data-theme> (tokens.css: color-scheme light or dark, so every light-dark() token follows). The change is instant
 * on every platform: a crossfade's first frame came after AppKit had turned the native title bar and vibrancy (Mac run 2,
 * 183–283 ms of dark native over a light page). The page reports it right after the synchronous swap, with no frame
 * wait: the report crosses to main and main's native call while this page paints, and AppKit repaints its parts a frame
 * or two after it is told (Mac run 3, critique m4: waiting for the next frame and a timer put the native parts 3 frames,
 * 50 ms, behind the page). Main still applies nothing native before the report, and falls back after THEME_FOLLOW_MS.
 * Returns whether anything changed.
 */
export function applyShade(root: ShadeTarget, shade: Shade, opts: ShadeOptions = {}): boolean {
  const shown = opts.onShown ?? (() => {});
  if (root.dataset['theme'] === shade) {
    shown();
    return false;
  }
  root.dataset['theme'] = shade;
  shown();
  return true;
}

/** <html data-theme> on `theme` now, reported to main right after (ui.themeShown). */
function showTheme(theme: Prefs['theme']): void {
  const shade = resolveTheme(theme, matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
  applyShade(document.documentElement, shade, { onShown: () => void api().ui.themeShown({ shade }).catch(() => {}) });
}

/**
 * Keeps <html data-theme> on the saved theme pref, in the main and the settings window alike, and on the system
 * appearance while it is 시스템 설정. Until `theme` is known the page follows prefers-color-scheme, which main keeps on the
 * same pref (nativeTheme.themeSource): the first value changes nothing visible.
 *
 * A change made in a page reaches every page in one message: main saves the pref, then sends prefsChanged to all
 * windows in one loop. Each page swaps in that message's own task — before the re-render the message also causes — and
 * reports at once, so the main and the settings page change in the same frame and the native parts follow both (spec 8:
 * the clicked page no longer leads by its round trip). The settings window's tile shows the pick on the click; its
 * theme waits for this message like the main window's.
 *
 * 시스템 설정 is resolved from prefers-color-scheme, which main moves only once it applies the native theme: the
 * appearance that change brings, like a change of the system's own appearance, is applied at once.
 */
export function useApplyTheme(theme: Prefs['theme'] | undefined): void {
  useLearnEvent('prefsChanged', ({ prefs }) => showTheme(prefs.theme));
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!theme) return;
    showTheme(theme);
    if (theme !== 'system') return;
    const system = matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const follow = () => showTheme(theme);
    system.addEventListener('change', follow);
    return () => system.removeEventListener('change', follow);
  }, [theme]);
}

/**
 * The tile the settings window shows: the one just picked until the saved pref agrees (or the write failed), else the
 * saved pref. Its ring moves with the click, not after the round trip (T13M-m6).
 */
export const shownTheme = (picked: Prefs['theme'] | null, saved: Prefs['theme']): Prefs['theme'] => picked ?? saved;
/** The pick is settled once the saved pref has come round to it. */
export const pickSettled = (picked: Prefs['theme'] | null, saved: Prefs['theme'] | undefined): boolean => picked !== null && picked === saved;
```
`R/settings/SettingsApp.tsx` 41–48행을:
```tsx
  // The theme tile just picked is selected on the click (T13M-m6) and gives way to the saved pref once that has come
  // round to it, or when the write fails. The theme itself changes when main sends the saved prefs to both windows at
  // once, not on the click: this window and the main window change in the same frame (spec 8).
  const [pickedTheme, setPickedTheme] = useState<Prefs['theme'] | null>(null);
  const savedTheme = prefsQuery.data?.theme;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pickSettled(pickedTheme, savedTheme)) setPickedTheme(null);
  }, [pickedTheme, savedTheme]);
  useApplyTheme(savedTheme);
```
로 바꾼다. `M/ipc/settings.ts`는 그대로다(`deps.theme.changed`가 방송보다 먼저: main은 페이지들이 바꾸기 전에 기다릴 목록을
가진다). 그 처리기 위 주석 `// The pages change first; the native theme follows them (T13R4-m1).`를
`// The pages change first, both on this one broadcast (spec 8); the native theme follows their reports (T13R4-m1).`로.

```ts
test('⌘, shows the settings window main prepared hidden once the main window was idle: no new window, placed over the main window as it is now (P-4)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  const { app } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    // launch() returns once it is prepared: hidden, loaded, measured.
    expect(await windowKinds(app)).toEqual(['main', 'settings (hidden)']);
    const prepared = app.windows().find((p) => p.url().includes('window=settings'))!;
    await app.evaluate(({ app: electronApp }) => {
      const g = globalThis as { __made?: number };
      g.__made = 0;
      electronApp.on('browser-window-created', () => void (g.__made = (g.__made ?? 0) + 1));
    });
    // The main window moved after the window was measured: it is placed over where the main window is now.
    await (await mainWindow(app)).evaluate((w) => w.setPosition(60, 80));
    const settings = await expectWindow(app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.settings'));
    expect(settings).toBe(prepared);
    expect(await app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __made?: number }).__made)).toBe(0);
    expect(await windowKinds(app)).toEqual(['main', 'settings']);
    await expect.poll(() => fitsContent(app, settings)).toBe(true);
    const [main, own] = await Promise.all([(await mainWindow(app)).evaluate((w) => w.getBounds()), (await settingsWindow(app)).evaluate((w) => w.getBounds())]);
    expect(Math.abs(own.x + own.width / 2 - (main.x + main.width / 2))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(own.y).toBeGreaterThan(main.y);
    // Closed by the user, it is gone; the next ⌘, makes a new one (none is prepared behind it).
    await settings.close();
    await expect.poll(() => windowKinds(app)).toEqual(['main']);
    const again = await expectWindow(app, 'settings', () => runMenuCommand(app, 'app.settings'));
    expect(again).not.toBe(prepared);
    expect(await app.evaluate(() => (globalThis as { __made?: number }).__made)).toBe(1);
  } finally {
    await app.close();
  }
});
```

```ts
test('macOS: closing the main window discards the prepared settings window; the next main window prepares one again (P-4)', async ({}, testInfo) => {
  test.skip(process.platform !== 'darwin', 'Linux/Windows quit with the main window (the test above)');
  const { app } = await launch(...dirs(testInfo));
  try {
    expect(await windowKinds(app)).toEqual(['main', 'settings (hidden)']);
    await (await mainWindow(app)).evaluate((w) => w.close());
    await expect.poll(() => windowKinds(app)).toEqual([]); // no hidden renderer left for nobody
    const reopened = app.waitForEvent('window');

    await expect.poll(() => settingsPrepared(app), { timeout: 15_000 }).toBe(true);

    await app.close();
  }
});
```

### Task 13: 마일스톤 마무리 — 키보드 여정·axe·명령 전수 실행·투어 완성·실제 ⌘O 패널·하네스 정리·데모·증거 예산·문서·Mac `all`·브랜치 검토·PR

#### 계약과 다른 점 (판정 기록)

1. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-16으로 해소.** **데모의 "좁은 창 자동 접힘" 장(명세 10절)은 항목 패널이 접히는 것만 보인다.** 메인 창의 최소 폭이 960(`layout.windowMinWidth`)이라
   창을 가장 좁혀도 내용 열은 960 − 240 − 320 = 400 → 항목 패널만 접히고, 사이드바는 720 ≥ 520이라 남는다. 사이드바까지 접히는 것은
   200% 확대(`setZoomFactor`)로만 생기는데, 앱에는 확대 메뉴가 없어 데모에 넣으면 사용자 경로가 아닌 장면이 된다(AC18 셀이 이미 이 점을
   밝힌다). **권장 판정**: 데모 장은 "창이 좁아지면 항목 패널이 먼저 접힌다 → 넓히면 다시 나온다"만 보이고, "그다음 사이드바"는 Task 6의
   200% 확대 E2E가 맡는다. 아래 Step 9가 이 판정대로 쓰였다. 데모 창이 처음부터 1200보다 좁으면(러너의 1024 모드) 이 장은 빠지고
   `notes`에 그 사실이 남는다.
2. **컨트롤러 판정 Q-17로 해소.** **실제 ⌘O 패널 캡처는 `V/library.evidence.ts`가 아니라 `V/shell.evidence.ts`에 둔다.** 계약 B.9는 UI 작업의 증거 절을
   `V/library.evidence.ts`(`m4-library.json`)에 모으라고 하지만, ⌘O 패널은 라이브러리 기능이 아니라 창 크롬(메인 창의 `asSheet`, M3
   follow-up D의 "패널 아래 창은 메인이지만 키가 아니다")이고, 같은 종류의 판정(설정 창의 폴더 패널 시트, `hasSheet`, `pressEscape`)과
   `results`/`check`/`guard`/`save` 장치가 이미 `shell.evidence.ts`에 있다. **권장 판정**: `shell.evidence.ts`에 `@evidence` 테스트 하나로
   더하고 판정은 `m3-shell.json`의 `checks`에 남긴다(마지막 판정 테스트가 함께 단언한다). Mac `all`이 `@evidence`를 돌리므로 실행 수는
   늘지 않는다. 아래 Step 6이 이 판정대로 쓰였다.

**정렬 메모(2026-10-24, 판정 Q-1–Q-49와 이웃 초안에 맞춘 것 — 판정 요청이 아니다):**

  고르고 코드의 `click()`은 아무것도 하지 않는다(열기는 더블클릭·↩·`openItem`), esc는 선택을 비운다(Q-43), 커서 행만 `tabindex="0"`(Q-48),
  정렬 단추·열 경계는 Tab·F6 밖이다(Q-49 — 키보드만의 정렬·폭은 M5 입력), 행은 절대 위치라 화면 순서는 `data-index`(`rowAt`)로 읽는다,

- [ ] **Step 2: 키보드 전용 여정(명세 1절 조건 4) — 테스트** `E/keyboard.spec.ts`

이 작업의 E2E는 앞 작업이 만든 동작을 키보드 하나로 잇는다. 그래서 "실패하는 테스트 → 구현"이 아니라 "테스트 → 통과 확인"이고, 실패하면 그것은
이 테스트가 아니라 그 단계가 쓰는 기능의 결함이다(아래 "실패했을 때").

파일 머리의 import 줄을 바꾼다. 지금(Task 3이 `rowAt`를 더한 뒤):

```ts
  releaseSaveDialog, rowAt, rowByTitle, runMenuCommand, selectRows, stubOpenDialog,
```
